"""Preliminary metadata overlap retrieval for new Commons arrivals; never admission."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import re
import shutil
import unicodedata
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_interval_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.prepare import split_for
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

THRESHOLD = 0.55
OMIT = {"jpg", "jpeg", "png", "tif", "tiff", "dsc", "dscf", "img", "ansicht", "actm"}


def terms(title):
    """Same Unicode letter/character4gram features as the completed1188 review."""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title.removeprefix("File:").casefold())
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    tokens = [t for t in re.findall(r"[^\W\d_]+", text) if len(t) >= 3 and t not in OMIT]
    result = set()
    for token in tokens:
        padded = "^" + token + "$"
        result.update(padded[i : i + 4] for i in range(max(1, len(padded) - 3)))
    return result


def retrieve(anchors, queries):
    """Sparse deterministic squared-smooth-IDF cosine, retaining five neighbors."""
    for rows in [anchors, queries]:
        if len({r["id"] for r in rows}) != len(rows):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate title source identity")
    if {r["id"] for r in anchors} & {r["id"] for r in queries}:
        raise ValueError("Title query is already an anchor")
    if not anchors:
        raise ValueError("Expected held-out title anchors")
    vocabulary = [terms(r["title"]) for r in [*anchors, *queries]]
    frequency = Counter(t for ts in vocabulary for t in ts)
    weight = {t: (math.log((1 + len(vocabulary)) / (1 + n)) + 1) ** 2 for t, n in frequency.items()}
    postings, norms = defaultdict(list), []
    for index, ts in enumerate(vocabulary):
        norms.append(math.sqrt(math.fsum(weight[t] for t in sorted(ts))))
        if index < len(anchors):
            for term in sorted(ts):
                postings[term].append(index)
    results = []
    for index, row in enumerate(queries):
        scores = defaultdict(list)
        for term in sorted(vocabulary[len(anchors) + index]):
            for other in postings[term]:
                scores[other].append(weight[term])
        ranked = sorted(
            (
                (math.fsum(parts) / (norms[j] * norms[len(anchors) + index]), j)
                for j, parts in scores.items()
                if norms[j] and norms[len(anchors) + index]
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )[:5]
        neighbors = [
            {
                "score": value,
                "id": anchors[j]["id"],
                "split": anchors[j]["split"],
                "origin": anchors[j].get("anchor_origin", "existing-corpus"),
                "title": anchors[j]["title"],
                "same_author": row.get("author") == anchors[j].get("author"),
            }
            for value, j in ranked
        ]
        results.append(
            {
                "id": row["id"],
                "title": row["title"],
                "decision": "withhold-uninformative-title"
                if not neighbors
                else "withhold-title-risk"
                if neighbors[0]["score"] >= THRESHOLD
                else "no-title-flag",
                "neighbors": neighbors,
            }
        )
    return results


def main(base_path, arrivals_path, output):
    base_ref, arrivals_ref = ref(base_path), ref(arrivals_path)
    base = [json.loads(line) for line in base_path.read_text().splitlines()]
    arrivals = read(arrivals_path)
    if len({r["id"] for r in base}) != len(base):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate prior corpus identity")
    known = {r["id"] for r in base}
    new, seen = [], set()
    for row in arrivals:
        identity = row["sha1_hex"]
        if identity in known or identity in seen:
            raise ValueError("New arrival is already in the prior corpus or duplicated")
        seen.add(identity)
        bucket = split_for(identity)
        new.append(
            {
                **row,
                "id": identity,
                "split": "train" if bucket == "train" else "reserved",
                "initial_hash_bucket": bucket,
            }
        )
    held = [
        dict(r, anchor_origin="existing-corpus")
        for r in base
        if r["split"] in ["val", "test", "reserved"]
    ]
    held += [dict(r, anchor_origin="new-reserved") for r in new if r["split"] == "reserved"]
    queries = [r for r in new if r["split"] == "train"]
    results = retrieve(held, queries)
    assert ref(base_path) == base_ref and ref(arrivals_path) == arrivals_ref
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, output / "executed-source.py")
    policy = {
        "threshold": THRESHOLD,
        "features": "NFKD/accent-folded casefolded Unicode letter tokens>=3, unchanged omit set and unique boundary-padded character4grams; numeric tokens dropped.",
        "score": "Cosine with squared smooth IDF log((1+N)/(1+document_frequency))+1 over all anchors and queries. Deterministic sorted terms and math.fsum accumulation; same threshold/features as prior1188-source review.",
        "anchors": "Every prior val/test/reserved source and every newly reserved source hash bucket.",
        "action": "Preserve all new reserved sources; flag every new train title with top score>=.55 or no feature neighbor. A no-title-flag result is not training eligibility.",
        "timing": "Preliminary all-arrivals metadata analysis before complete new cache/protected/duplicate/content results. Recompute on the actual final candidate set before any coupled admission; IDF depends on its population.",
        "limits": "Metadata retrieval only. Generic vehicle/species/place names give false positives; aliases/crops/missing or cross-language metadata can evade flags. No scene identity/independence or source quality claim.",
    }
    save(output / "policy.json", policy)
    save(output / "decisions.json", results)
    save(output / "new-reserved.json", [r for r in new if r["split"] == "reserved"])
    report = {
        "status": "completed-preliminary-all-arrivals-title-retrieval-no-training-admission",
        "driver": ref(output / "executed-source.py"),
        "base": base_ref,
        "arrivals": arrivals_ref,
        "policy": ref(output / "policy.json"),
        "decisions": ref(output / "decisions.json"),
        "new_reserved": ref(output / "new-reserved.json"),
        "anchors": len(held),
        "prior_heldout_anchors": len(held) - sum(r["split"] == "reserved" for r in new),
        "new_reserved_anchors": sum(r["split"] == "reserved" for r in new),
        "train_queries": len(queries),
        "counts": dict(Counter(r["decision"] for r in results)),
        "new_reserved_top_risk_matches": sum(
            bool(r["neighbors"])
            and r["neighbors"][0]["origin"] == "new-reserved"
            and r["decision"] == "withhold-title-risk"
            for r in results
        ),
        "training_admission": False,
        "scope": policy["timing"],
    }
    save(output / "report.json", report)
    print({"report": ref(output / "report.json"), "counts": report["counts"]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ["base", "arrivals", "output"]:
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.base.resolve(), args.arrivals.resolve(), args.output.resolve())

def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second

def fit(plan, phase):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    import yaml
    from local_excess_risk import local_excess_risk
    from noisy_objective import ADC_only, apply_ADC_weight
    from paired_response_objective import paired_response_loss
    from regional_dc_objective import regional_dc_excess
    from robust_spectral_objective import spectral_loss

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    root = Path(plan["root"])
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["config"]["path"]).read_text())
    recipe = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["config"]["path"]).read_text())
    counts = {label: 0 for label in recipe["arms"]}
    updates = dict(counts)
    supervised = dict(counts)
    zero_ADC = dict(counts)
    peak_evaluations = dict(counts)
    LIVE_PROGRESS.update(phase=phase, counts=counts, updates=updates, last_completed_step=0)

    def fresh():
        modules = {k: classes()[k](256).cuda() for k in recipe["arms"]}
        for name, value in modules["paired-control"].state_dict().items():
            assert all(torch.equal(value, m.state_dict()[name]) for m in modules.values())
        assert all(m.relative_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0 for m in modules.values())
        assert modules["harmonic-context"].harmonic_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0
        for label, m in modules.items():
            assert (
                sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameters"]
                and len(m.state_dict()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameter_tensors"]
            )
            m.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, label=label: counts.__setitem__(label, counts[label] + 1)
            )
        opts = {k: torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(), lr=config["lr"]) for k, m in modules.items()}
        emas = {
            k: {n: v.detach().clone() for n, v in m.state_dict().items()}
            for k, m in modules.items()
        }
        return modules, opts, emas

    modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
    maximum = {k: {n: 0.0 for n, _ in m.named_parameters()} for k, m in modules.items()}
    cache_rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    reference_trace = read(plan["baseline_training"]["path"])["trace"]
    compatible_steps = 0
    smoke_trace = read(root / "smoke-result-v1.json")["trace"] if phase == "train" else None
    checkpointdir = root / "checkpoints"
    checkpointdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    trace = []
    last = 0
    journal = (root / f"{phase}-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step):
        dest = checkpointdir / f"{phase}-step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not dest.exists()
        with dest.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "horizon": 1000,
                    "module_config": {"max_window": 256},
                    "arms": recipe["arms"],
                    "models": {k: m.state_dict() for k, m in modules.items()},
                    "emas": emas,
                    "optimizers": {k: o.state_dict() for k, o in optimizers.items()},
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "updates": dict(updates),
                    "parent": plan["parent"],
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "config": config,
                    "torch_CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "torch_CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                },
                stream,
            )
        return dest

    for step in range(1, 11 if phase == "smoke" else 1001):
        resource_check(root)
        item = cache_rows[step - 1]
        assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        assert ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
        base = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
        assert fingerprint(base) == item["parent_values"]
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
        batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in a.items()}
        base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "arms": {},
        }
        progress = max(0, step - config["warmup"]) / max(1, 1000 - config["warmup"])
        lr = (
            config["lr"]
            * min(1, step / config["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        for label, module in modules.items():
            optimizer = optimizers[label]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")), return_aux=True
            )
            if step == 1:
                assert torch.equal(output, base) and aux["correction"].count_nonzero() == 0
            scale = (
                batch["variance"]
                .clamp_min(0)
                .mean((1, 2, 3), keepdim=True)
                .sqrt()
                .clamp_min(recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"] / 65535)
            )
            error = (output - batch["target"]) / scale
            pixel = (error.square() + config["pixel_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
            derivatives = [error[..., 1:] - error[..., :-1], error[..., 1:, :] - error[..., :-1, :]]
            gradient = (
                sum(
                    (v.square() + config["gradient_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
                    for v in derivatives
                )
                / 2
            )
            arm = recipe["arms"][label]
            is_ADC = ADC_only(item["metadata"]["noise"])
            peak_bonus = arm["spectral_peak_bonus"] if not is_ADC else 0
            assert peak_bonus == 0
            spectral = spectral_loss(
                module,
                output,
                batch["target"],
                batch["colors"],
                aux,
                arm["loss_floor_DN16"],
                arm["penalty"],
                arm["spectral_epsilon"],
            )
            peak_evaluations[label] += int(peak_bonus > 0)
            loss = config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * (
                pixel + config["gradient_weight"] * gradient + config["spectral_weight"] * spectral
            )
            local_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["local_risk_weight"]:
                local_penalty = local_excess_risk(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["local_risk_window_native"],
                    transition=recipe["local_risk_transition_noise_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["local_risk_weight"]
                    * local_penalty
                )
            dc_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["regional_DC_weight"]:
                dc_penalty = regional_dc_excess(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["regional_DC_window_native"],
                    transition=arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["regional_DC_weight"]
                    * dc_penalty
                )
            pair_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["paired_response_weight"] and len(batch["pair_indices"]):
                pair_penalty = paired_response_loss(
                    output,
                    batch["target"],
                    batch["pair_units"],
                    batch["pair_indices"],
                    epsilon=recipe["pair_epsilon"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["paired_response_weight"]
                    * pair_penalty
                )
            loss = apply_ADC_weight(loss, item["metadata"]["noise"], arm["ADC_loss_weight"])
            has_supervision = not (is_ADC and arm["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0)
            supervised[label] += int(has_supervision)
            zero_ADC[label] += int(not has_supervision)
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            for name, p in module.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                maximum[label][name] = max(maximum[label][name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                if not has_supervision:
                    assert p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0
            if not has_supervision:
                assert loss == 0
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(module.parameters(), 1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
            optimizer.step()
            updates[label] += 1
            decay = min(config["EMA_decay"], (1 + step) / (10 + step))
            with torch.no_grad():
                for name, value in module.state_dict().items():
                    emas[label][name].lerp_(value, 1 - decay)
            row["arms"][label] = {
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "pixel": float(pixel.detach()),
                "gradient": float(gradient.detach()),
                "spectral": float(spectral.detach()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "lr": lr,
                "local_excess_risk": float(local_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_excess": float(dc_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_transition_units": arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                "paired_response": float(pair_penalty.detach()),
                "coupled_pairs": len(batch["pair_indices"]),
                **(
                    {
                        "spatial_correction_RMS_DN16": float(
                            aux["spatial_correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt()
                        )
                        * 65535
                    }
                    if "spatial_correction" in aux
                    else {}
                ),
            }
            if label == "paired-control":
                expected = reference_trace[step - 1]["arms"]["paired-response"]
                assert {k: row["arms"][label][k] for k in expected} == expected, (
                    phase,
                    step,
                    "V160 control trace",
                )
                compatible_steps += 1
            del (
                output,
                aux,
                error,
                pixel,
                derivatives,
                gradient,
                spectral,
                local_penalty,
                dc_penalty,
                loss,
                scale,
                pair_penalty,
            )
        if phase == "train" and step <= 10:
            assert row == smoke_trace[step - 1], (step, "smoke/train prefix continuation")
        trace.append(row)
        journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        journal.flush()
        LIVE_PROGRESS["last_completed_step"] = step
        last = step
        if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "phase": phase,
                        "step": step,
                        "arms": row["arms"],
                        "CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),
                    }
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
            save(
                root / f"{phase}-progress-v1.json",
                {"step": step, "counts": counts, "updates": updates},
            )
        del batch, base, a
        if phase == "smoke" and step == 8:
            path = checkpoint(8)
            s = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
            for label in modules:
                modules[label].load_state_dict(s["models"][label], strict=True)
                optimizers[label].load_state_dict(s["optimizers"][label])
                emas[label] = {n: v.cuda() for n, v in s["emas"][label].items()}
                assert len(optimizers[label].state) == recipe["arms"][label][
                    "parameter_tensors"
                ] and all(float(v["step"]) == 8 for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["models"][label][n])
                    for n, v in modules[label].state_dict().items()
                )
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["emas"][label][n]) for n, v in emas[label].items()
                )
                reloaded = optimizers[label].state_dict()
                assert reloaded["param_groups"] == s["optimizers"][label]["param_groups"]
                for index, state in reloaded["state"].items():
                    for key, value in state.items():
                        assert torch.equal(value.cpu(), s["optimizers"][label]["state"][index][key])
            torch.set_rng_state(s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state(s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            assert torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            assert torch.equal(torch.cuda.get_rng_state().cpu(), s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            del s
        if phase == "train" and step % 250 == 0:
            checkpoint(step)
    journal.close()
    final = checkpoint(last) if phase == "smoke" else checkpointdir / "train-step1000.pt"
    assert counts == updates == {k: last for k in modules}
    for label, module in modules.items():
        assert (
            min(maximum[label].values()) > 0
            and len(optimizers[label].state) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameter_tensors"]
        )
        assert all(float(v["step"]) == last for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(t).all()
            for state in optimizers[label].state.values()
            for t in state.values()
        )
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*module.state_dict().values(), *emas[label].values()]
        )
    expected_ADC = sum(ADC_only(x["metadata"]["noise"]) for x in cache_rows[:last])
    assert supervised == {
        k: last - (expected_ADC if v["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0 else 0)
        for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    assert zero_ADC == {
        k: (expected_ADC if v["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0 else 0) for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    assert peak_evaluations == {
        k: (last - expected_ADC if v["spectral_peak_bonus"] else 0)
        for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    if phase == "train":
        previous = read(plan["baseline_training"]["path"])
        assert ref(previous["checkpoint"]["path"]) == previous["checkpoint"]
        saved = torch.load(previous["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        assert equal_tree(
            modules["paired-control"].state_dict(), saved["models"]["paired-response"]
        )
        assert equal_tree(emas["paired-control"], saved["emas"]["paired-response"])
        assert equal_tree(
            optimizers["paired-control"].state_dict(), saved["optimizers"]["paired-response"]
        )
        del saved
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-head-phase",
            "phase": phase,
            "steps": last,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": ref(final),
            "counts": counts,
            "updates": updates,
            "supervised_batches": supervised,
            "zero_ADC_gradient_batches": zero_ADC,
            "peak_weight_evaluations": peak_evaluations,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "loss_floors_DN16": {k: v["loss_floor_DN16"] for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()},
            "initial_outputs_exact_parent": True,
            "trace": trace,
            "exact_V160_control_trace_rows": compatible_steps,
            "control_final_raw_EMA_Adam_exact": phase == "train",
            "head_image_evaluations": 8 * last,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": recipe["scope"],
        },
    )


def worker(path, phase):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"{phase}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    try:
        if phase == "parity":
            parity(plan)
        else:
            fit(plan, phase)
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "progress": LIVE_PROGRESS,
                "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            },
        )
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        for phase in ("parity", "smoke", "train"):
            guard(plan)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "phase": phase},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"{phase}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
                        "-P",
                        plan["runner"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(path),
                        "--phase",
                        phase,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase", "phase": phase, "child": owner},
                )
                observed = 0.0
                last = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < (1800 if phase in ("parity", "smoke") else 7200), phase
                assert child.returncode == 0, phase
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][phase] = ref(root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json")
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "worker", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("parity", "smoke", "train"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path))
    elif args.mode == "worker":
        worker(args.path.resolve(), args.phase)
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

        adam = state["optimizers"][arm]["state"]

            assert int(values["step"]) == 1000

        gradients = result["parameter_maximum_gradients"][arm]
        assert len(gradients) == tensors and all(
            np.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in gradients.values()
        )
    for key in ("models", "emas"):
        native, archived = state[key]["noisy-control"], old_state[key]["noisy-only"]

        assert all(torch.equal(v, archived[k]) for k, v in native.items())
    new_adam = state["optimizers"]["noisy-control"]
    old_adam = old_state["optimizers"]["noisy-only"]

    assert new_adam["state"].keys() == old_adam["state"].keys()
    for key, fields in new_adam["state"].items():
        assert all(
            torch.equal(v, old_adam["state"][key][name])
            if torch.is_tensor(v)
            else v == old_adam["state"][key][name]
            for name, v in fields.items()
        )
    if states_only:

            root / "independent-training-state-audit-v1.json",

                "control_raw_EMA_and_Adam_states_exact": True,
                "new_forwards": 0,
                "new_noise_draws": 0,
                "CUDA_initialized": False,
                "scope": "Final training-state check while endpoint collection is in progress. Exact native control trace/model/EMA/Adam and finite states of both arms; this does not inspect endpoint quality or claim pixel replay before it exists.",
            },
        )

                np.load(one["prediction"]["path"]), np.load(two["prediction"]["path"])

            "status": "pass-both-finite-states-and-exact-native-control-reproduction",

            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "training_result": ref(root / "train-result-v1.json"),
            "training_journal": ref(root / "train-trace-v1.jsonl"),

            "checkpoint": result["checkpoint"],
            "old_V151_training": ref(previous / "train-result-v1.json"),

            "steps_per_arm": 1000,

            "control_raw_EMA_and_Adam_states_exact": True,
            "native_control_predictions_exact": 1644,
            "all_named_tensor_gradients_nonzero_finite_each_arm": True,
            "batch_domains": dict(Counter(row["domain"] for row in journal)),
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_initialized": False,
            "scope": "Final fixed matched trial state/binding audit, using the archived V151 noisy-only matrix as exact control. Retained1644 control predictions are exact; All822 cases,including ADC controls,have the V151 archive. No neural,parent/DINO or noise call. """Cache authorized personal RAWs and phase-bin targets for data review only."""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import rawpy
from PIL import Image
from prepare_public_raw_quarantine import protected_hashes, protected_identity, sha

from demosaic.io import orient, read_raw
from demosaic.raw_clean import bin_bayer
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

PERSONAL_ROOTS = (Path("/home/dllu/pictures/raw"), Path("/mnt/dataz/pictures/raw"))


def reference(path):
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": sha(path)}


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def cache_source(source, output):
    """Copy once while verifying the library's import SHA1; originals stay read-only."""
    source = Path(source).resolve()
    if not any(root in source.parents for root in PERSONAL_ROOTS):
        raise ValueError("Expected an explicitly authorized personal RAW source root")
    match = re.fullmatch(
        r".+_([a-f0-9]{40})\.(?:raf|arw|dng|nef|cr2|rw2)", source.name, re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError("Expected the library's import-hashed RAW filename")
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    target = output / source.name
    if target.exists():
        with target.open("rb") as stream:
            assert hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha1").hexdigest() == match[1]
    else:
        before = source.stat()
        temporary = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + ".partial")
        digest = hashlib.sha1()
        with source.open("rb") as reader, temporary.open("xb") as writer:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: reader.read(8 * 2**20), b""):
                digest.update(chunk)
                writer.write(chunk)
        assert digest.hexdigest() == match[1], "Original differs from import SHA1"
        after = source.stat()
        assert (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) == (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
        temporary.replace(target)
    return {
        **reference(target),
        "original_path": str(source),
        "import_sha1": match[1],
        "bytes": target.stat().st_size,
    }


def prepare(selection_path, output):
    selection_path = Path(selection_path).absolute()
    selection = json.loads(selection_path.read_text())
    assert (
        selection["status"] == "personally-authorized-source-inspection-selection-quarantine-only"
    )
    assert (
        selection["permission"]["quote"]
        == "I hereby grant permission to use my photos (so don't worry about licensing)."
    )
    assert reference(selection["permission"]["PROMPT"]["path"]) == selection["permission"]["PROMPT"]
    assert Path(selection["permission"]["PROMPT"]["path"]).resolve() == Path("PROMPT.md").resolve()
    assert selection["permission"]["quote"] in Path("PROMPT.md").read_text()
    assert selection["files"] and len({f["source"] for f in selection["files"]}) == len(
        selection["files"]
    )
    excluded, protection = protected_hashes()
    for filename in [
        "configs/real-camera-qualitative.json",
        "/mnt/external/demosaic/raw-clean-public-extension-v2/bin4/manifest.json",
    ]:
        p = Path(filename)
        protection[str(p.absolute())] = sha(p)
        data = json.loads(p.read_text())
        if isinstance(data, list):
            excluded.update(x["source_sha256"] for x in data)
        else:
            excluded.update(x["id"] for x in data["rows"])
    days = set()
    for filename in [
        "configs/real-camera-qualitative.json",
        "configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json",
    ]:
        for year, month, day in re.findall(
            r"(20\d\d)-(\d\d)-(\d\d)-\d\d-\d\d-\d\d", Path(filename).read_text()
        ):
            date = datetime(int(year), int(month), int(day)).date()
            days.update(str(date + timedelta(days=i)) for i in range(-7, 8))
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (output / ".prepare.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        source_paths = [
            Path(__file__),
            Path("scripts/prepare_public_raw_quarantine.py"),
            *[Path("src/demosaic") / n for n in ("raw_clean.py", "io.py", "color.py", "cfa.py")],
        ]
        recipe = {
            "selection": reference(selection_path),
            "source_files": [reference(p) for p in source_paths],
            "protection_sources": protection,
            "excluded_days_plus_minus7": sorted(days),
            "factors": [4, 8],
            "max_ISO": 200,
            "source_near_white_limit": 0.001,
            "rawpy": rawpy.__version__,
            "libraw": list(rawpy.libraw_version),
            "numpy": np.__version__,
        }
        recipe_path = output / "recipe.json"
        if recipe_path.exists():
            assert json.loads(recipe_path.read_text()) == recipe, (
                "Recipe changed; choose a new output"
            )
        else:
            save(recipe_path, recipe)
        archive = output / "source"
        archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for path in source_paths:
            destination = archive / path.name
            if not destination.exists():
                shutil.copyfile(path, destination)
            assert sha(destination) == sha(path)
        shutil.copyfile(selection_path, archive / "selection.json")
        (output / "captures").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        rows = []
        for entry in selection["files"]:
            assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage(output).free > 128 * 2**30
            index = entry["candidate_index"]
            assert Path(entry["source"]).name[:10] not in days
            record_path = output / "captures" / f"{index:03d}.json"
            if record_path.exists():
                row = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
                for item in [row["source"], *row["caches"], row["screen"], row["preview"]]:
                    assert sha(item["path"]) == item["sha256"]
                rows.append(row)
                continue
            source = cache_source(entry["source"], output / "sources")
            assert source["sha256"] not in excluded
            exif = json.loads(
                subprocess.run(
                    [
                        "exiftool",
                        "-j",
                        "-n",
                        "-DateTimeOriginal",
                        "-ISO",
                        "-Model",
                        "-FNumber",
                        "-ExposureTime",
                        source["path"],
                    ],
                    check=True,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=30,
                ).stdout
            )[0]
            date = datetime.strptime(exif["DateTimeOriginal"][:19], "%Y:%m:%d %H:%M:%S")
            assert date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S") == Path(entry["source"]).name[:19]
            assert str(date.date()) not in days and protected_identity(exif["Model"], exif) is None
            raw, meta = read_raw(source["path"])
            assert meta.camera == "GFX100S" and 0 < meta.iso <= 200 and meta.iso == exif["ISO"]
            assert np.isfinite(raw).all() and min(raw.shape) // 8 - 2 >= 256
            caches = []
            for factor in (4, 8):
                rgb = bin_bayer(raw, meta.pattern, factor=factor)
                pixels = np.rint(np.clip(rgb, 0, 1) * 65535).astype(np.uint16)
                path = output / f"bin{factor}" / f"{source['sha256']}.npy"
                path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                with path.with_suffix(".npy.tmp").open("wb") as stream:
                    np.save(stream, pixels, allow_pickle=False)
                path.with_suffix(".npy.tmp").replace(path)
                caches.append(
                    {
                        **reference(path),
                        "shape": list(pixels.shape),
                        "bin_factor": factor,
                        "dtype": "uint16",
                        "color_space": "linear-camera-RGB",
                    }
                )
                if factor == 4:
                    fraction = float((pixels.max(-1) >= 65500).mean())
                else:
                    linear = np.clip(
                        (
                            pixels.astype(np.float32)
                            / 65535

"""CPU algebra/compute audit of width folding; no model-quality or GPU claim."""

import argparse
import copy
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref, save

from demosaic.pretrained_rgb import RgbRestorationTrunk
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

PARENT = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic/models/dino-convnext-wide-long-control-b16-v63-step20000.pt")
PARENT_SHA = "ed70952dd33c5d7da39199bf1306b58b579862920fb0cccd6b222f19871bc9b5"


def fold_width(value):
    n, c, h, w = value.shape
    if w % 2:
        raise ValueError("Width folding requires an even padded width")
    return value.reshape(n, c, h, w // 2, 2).permute(0, 1, 4, 2, 3).reshape(n, 2 * c, h, w // 2)


def unfold_width(value):
    n, twice_c, h, w = value.shape
    if twice_c % 2:
        raise ValueError("Width unfolding requires phase-paired channels")
    return (
        value.reshape(n, twice_c // 2, 2, h, w)
        .permute(0, 1, 3, 4, 2)
        .reshape(n, twice_c // 2, h, 2 * w)
    )


def folded_kernel(weight):
    """Independent phase-index derivation for stride1/padding1 dense3x3."""
    out_channels, in_channels, kh, kw = weight.shape
    if (kh, kw) != (3, 3):
        raise ValueError("This diagnostic supports only dense3x3 kernels")
    result = weight.new_zeros(2 * out_channels, 2 * in_channels, 3, 3)
    for output_phase in (0, 1):
        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
            block_offset, input_phase = divmod(output_phase + dx, 2)
            result[output_phase::2, input_phase::2, :, block_offset + 1] = weight[:, :, :, dx + 1]
    return result


class FoldedWidthConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, original):
        super().__init__()
        if (
            original.kernel_size != (3, 3)
            or original.stride != (1, 1)
            or original.padding != (1, 1)
            or original.dilation != (1, 1)
            or original.groups != 1
            or original.padding_mode != "zeros"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported convolution geometry")
        self.register_buffer("weight", folded_kernel(original.weight.detach()))
        self.register_buffer(
            "bias",
            None if original.bias is None else original.bias.detach().repeat_interleave(2),
        )

    def forward(self, value):
        width = value.shape[-1]
        fmt = (
            torch.channels_last
            if value.is_contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
            else torch.contiguous_format
        )
        padded = F.pad(value, (0, width % 2)) if width % 2 else value
        packed = fold_width(padded).contiguous(memory_format=fmt)
        result = F.conv2d(packed, self.weight, self.bias, padding=1)
        return unfold_width(result)[..., :width].contiguous(memory_format=fmt)


def convert_trunk(model):
    """Local wrappers preserve existing stride2/down/up modules and all offsets."""
    result = copy.deepcopy(model)

    def visit(module):
        for name, child in list(module.named_children()):
            if isinstance(child, nn.Conv2d) and child.kernel_size == (3, 3):
                setattr(module, name, FoldedWidthConv(child))
            else:
                visit(child)

    visit(result)
    return result


def difference(actual, expected):
    delta = actual.double() - expected.double()
    return {
        "max_abs": float(delta.abs().max()),
        "RMS": float(delta.square().mean().sqrt()),
        "expected_max_abs": float(expected.double().abs().max()),
        "finite": bool(torch.isfinite(actual).all() and torch.isfinite(expected).all()),
        "exact": bool(torch.equal(actual, expected)),
    }


def numpy_convolution(value, weight, bias):
    """Tiny independent scalar cross-correlation, including every padded boundary."""
    n, _, height, width = value.shape
    padded = np.pad(value, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (1, 1), (1, 1)))
    output = np.empty((n, len(weight), height, width), dtype=np.float64)
    for batch in range(n):
        for channel in range(len(weight)):
            for y in range(height):
                for x in range(width):
                    patch = padded[batch, :, y : y + 3, x : x + 3]
                    output[batch, channel, y, x] = np.sum(patch * weight[channel]) + bias[channel]
    return output


def census(model):
    rows, hooks = [], []

    def capture(name, module, inputs, output):
        x = inputs[0]
        if isinstance(module, nn.ConvTranspose2d):
            mac = x.numel() * module.out_channels // module.groups
        else:
            mac = output.numel() * module.in_channels // module.groups
        mac *= module.kernel_size[0] * module.kernel_size[1]
        eligible = isinstance(module, nn.Conv2d) and module.kernel_size == (3, 3)
        rows.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "kind": type(module).__name__,
                "weight_shape": list(module.weight.shape),
                "input_shape": list(x.shape),
                "output_shape": list(output.shape),
                "MAC_native32_B1": mac,
                "MAC_native512_B4": mac * 1024,
                "eligible_width_fold": eligible,
                "weight_elements": module.weight.numel(),
            }
        )

    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if isinstance(module, (nn.Conv2d, nn.ConvTranspose2d)):
            hooks.append(
                module.register_forward_hook(
                    lambda module, inputs, output, name=name: capture(name, module, inputs, output)
                )
            )
    try:
        model(torch.zeros(1, 3, 32, 32), torch.ones(1, 1, 32, 32) * 0.1)
    finally:
        for hook in hooks:
            hook.remove()
    assert len(rows) == 64 and sum(r["eligible_width_fold"] for r in rows) == 58
    original = sum(r["MAC_native32_B1"] for r in rows)
    eligible = sum(r["MAC_native32_B1"] for r in rows if r["eligible_width_fold"])
    return {
        "layers": rows,
        "MAC_per_native_pixel": original // (32 * 32),
        "MAC_native512_B4": original * 1024,
        "MAC_100MP_without_overlap_or_padding": original // (32 * 32) * 100_000_000,
        "dense_folded_MAC_native512_B4": (original + eligible) * 1024,
        "eligible_original_weight_elements": sum(
            r["weight_elements"] for r in rows if r["eligible_width_fold"]
        ),
        "folded_kernel_dense_storage_factor": 4,
        "folded_kernel_structural_nonzero_fraction": 0.5,
        "folded_even_width_activation_element_factor": 1,
        "convention": "Dense convolution MACs include padded-zero taps; one MAC is one multiply plus add. Bias, activation, residual, packing, conditioning, DINO, physics, tile overlap and output work excluded. Target census is analytical scaling of the executed native32/B1 geometry, not a target-size forward or timing.",
    }


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(output):
    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == "" and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    root = writable_path(output).resolve()
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    executed = root / "executed-source.py"
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, executed)
    source = ref(__file__)
    trunk_source = ref("src/demosaic/pretrained_rgb.py")
    shutil.copyfile(trunk_source["path"], root / "executed-pretrained-rgb.py")
    assert ref(PARENT)["sha256"] == PARENT_SHA
    initial_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
        torch.manual_seed(20261020)
        state = torch.load(PARENT, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        assert state["step"] == 20000
        prefix = "pretrained_rgb.network."
        weights = {
            k.removeprefix(prefix): v for k, v in state["ema"].items() if k.startswith(prefix)
        }
        assert len(weights) == 64 and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in weights.values())
        model = RgbRestorationTrunk().eval().requires_grad_(False)
        model.load_state_dict(weights, strict=True)
        del state
        measured_census = census(model)
        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261020)
        selected = [
            "m_head",
            "m_down1.0.res.0",
            "m_down2.0.res.0",
            "m_down3.0.res.0",
            "m_body.0.res.0",
            "m_tail",
        ]
        cases = []
        for dtype in [torch.float64, torch.float32]:
            for fmt_name, fmt in [
                ("contiguous", torch.contiguous_format),
                ("channels_last", torch.channels_last),
            ]:
                for width in [6, 7]:
                    for name in selected:
                        layer = copy.deepcopy(model.get_submodule(name)).to(dtype=dtype)
                        candidate = FoldedWidthConv(layer)
                        layer.to(memory_format=fmt)
                        candidate.to(memory_format=fmt)
                        value = torch.randn(
                            (1, layer.in_channels, 5, width), generator=generator
                        ).to(dtype)
                        value = value.contiguous(memory_format=fmt)
                        expected, actual = layer(value), candidate(value)
                        error = difference(actual, expected)
                        assert error["finite"]
                        if dtype == torch.float64:
                            assert error["max_abs"] <= 1e-11 * max(1, error["expected_max_abs"])
                        cases.append(
                            {
                                "layer": name,
                                "dtype": str(dtype),
                                "format": fmt_name,
                                "input_shape": list(value.shape),
                                **error,
                            }
                        )
        # Nonzero bias and all image edges are independently checked outside
        # the learned bias-free trunk. There is no clean target or image score.
        layer = nn.Conv2d(3, 5, 3, padding=1, bias=True).double()
        value = torch.randn((1, 3, 5, 7), generator=generator, dtype=torch.float64)
        independent = numpy_convolution(
            value.numpy(), layer.weight.detach().numpy(), layer.bias.detach().numpy()
        )
        numpy_error = difference(FoldedWidthConv(layer)(value), torch.from_numpy(independent))
        assert numpy_error["max_abs"] < 1e-12
        full_cases = []
        examples = {
            "numpy-input": value.numpy(),
            "numpy-kernel": layer.weight.detach().numpy(),
            "numpy-bias": layer.bias.detach().numpy(),
            "numpy-expected": independent,
        }
        # The actual trunk deliberately casts its head/tail inputs to FP32;
        # module.double() cannot make that a supported FP64 execution path.
        # FP64 algebra is checked above at the individual-convolution level.
        for dtype in [torch.float32]:
            original = copy.deepcopy(model).to(dtype=dtype)
            candidate = convert_trunk(original)
            assert sum(isinstance(m, FoldedWidthConv) for m in candidate.modules()) == 58
            rgb = torch.randn((1, 3, 32, 32), generator=generator).to(dtype) * 0.2
            noise = torch.ones((1, 1, 32, 32), dtype=dtype) * 0.1
            for fmt_name, fmt in [
                ("contiguous", torch.contiguous_format),
                ("channels_last", torch.channels_last),
            ]:
                original.to(memory_format=fmt)
                candidate.to(memory_format=fmt)
                a = original(rgb.contiguous(memory_format=fmt), noise.contiguous(memory_format=fmt))
                b = candidate(
                    rgb.contiguous(memory_format=fmt), noise.contiguous(memory_format=fmt)
                )
                error = difference(b, a)
                assert error["finite"]
                full_cases.append(
                    {
                        "dtype": str(dtype),
                        "format": fmt_name,
                        "input_shape": list(rgb.shape),
                        **error,
                    }
                )
                if fmt_name == "contiguous":
                    examples[str(dtype) + "-input"] = rgb.numpy()
                    examples[str(dtype) + "-noise"] = noise.numpy()
                    examples[str(dtype) + "-original"] = a.numpy()
                    examples[str(dtype) + "-folded"] = b.numpy()
    assert torch.equal(initial_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    assert ref(__file__) == source and ref(PARENT)["sha256"] == PARENT_SHA
    assert ref(trunk_source["path"]) == trunk_source
    arrays = root / "generated-trunk-arrays.npz"
    np.savez(arrays, **examples)
    result = {

        "executed_source": ref(executed),
        "parent_checkpoint": ref(PARENT),
        "trunk_source": trunk_source,
        "executed_trunk_source": ref(root / "executed-pretrained-rgb.py"),
        "parent_EMA_trunk_tensors_strictly_loaded": 64,
        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
        "numpy": str(np.__version__),
        "seed": 20261020,
        "CPU_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
        "selected_kernel_cases": cases,
        "independent_numpy_nonzero_bias_and_boundary_case": numpy_error,
        "whole_trunk_cases": full_cases,

        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "model_quality_statistics_read": False,
        "production_or_training_modified": False,
        "scope": "Generated CPU inputs and genuine V63 EMA trunk only, without DINO/measurement offsets, physical inverse or photo inference. FP64 checks the algebra; FP32 is approximate, not bitwise/full-model/RGB16 parity. This dense width-fold implementation doubles eligible convolution MACs and quadruples their dense kernel storage. No CUDA timing, memory-peak, quality or speedup claim; no training/inference/default change or queued GPU execution.",
    }
    save(root / "receipt.json", result)
    print(
        {
            "receipt": ref(root / "receipt.json"),
            "kernel_cases": len(cases),

    )

"""Queue CPU-only color arithmetic and native boards after the exact review exits."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil

TERMINAL = "completed-objective-inference-awaiting-statistical-and-manual-native-closure"
STAGES = {"boundary", "known", "unseen", "full427", "statistics", "sensitivity",
          "gfx", "analytic", "hue", "highlights"}


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def ref(path):
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": sha(path)}


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def alive(owner):
    try:
        p = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        return p.create_time() == owner["created"] and p.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        return False


def ready(status, owner):
    if status["controller"] != owner:
        raise RuntimeError("Review owner identity differs")
    if status["status"].startswith("failed-"):
        raise RuntimeError("Review failed; no automatic closure/retry")
    if alive(owner):
        return False
    if status["status"] != TERMINAL:
        raise RuntimeError("Review exited without complete inference")
    if set(status["completed"]) != STAGES or len(status["completed"]) != len(STAGES):
        raise RuntimeError("Review stages are incomplete")
    return not alive(status["child"])


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def main(plan_path):
    os.nice(10)
    plan = read(plan_path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["worker"]
    assert ref(plan["review_plan"]["path"]) == plan["review_plan"]

"""Freeze isolated CUDA EMA measurements after the existing inference profiler."""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
BASE = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic")
ROOT = BASE / "benchmarks/mixed16-EMA-after-profile-v1"
STATUS = BASE / "runs/mixed16-EMA-after-profile-v1.json"
PROFILE = BASE / "runs/mixed16-packed-profile-after-quarter-v1.json"
TERMINAL = "completed-bounded-mixed16-quarter-FP32-CUDA-profiles-awaiting-trace-analysis"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "sha256": digest}


def alive(owner):
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        return (
            process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
        )
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        return False


def guard(plan):
    for path, digest in {**plan["inputs"], **plan["guards"]}.items():
        assert ref(path)["sha256"] == digest, path


def profile_ready(plan):
    status = read(plan["profile_status"])
    if status["status"] != TERMINAL:
        raise RuntimeError("Complete inference profiles must finish before EMA measurement")
    assert status["controller"] == plan["profile_owner"]
    assert all(not alive(status[key]) for key in ("controller", "child"))
    assert status["plan"] == plan["profile_plan"] == ref(plan["profile_plan"]["path"])
    previous = read(plan["profile_plan"]["path"])
    expected = [ref(Path(p) / "result.json") for p in previous["outputs"]]
    assert status["completed"] == expected and len(expected) == 2
    for item, checkpoint in zip(expected, plan["checkpoints"], strict=True):
        result = read(item["path"])
        assert result["status"] == "completed-packed-mixed16-bounded-FP32-CUDA-inference-profile"
        assert result["checkpoint"]["path"] == str(Path(checkpoint).resolve())
        assert result["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == ref(checkpoint)["sha256"]
        assert result["checkpoint"]["step"] == 10000
        assert result["CUDA_initialized"] and result["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] > 0
        assert result["hooked_unhooked_traced_RGB_bitwise_equal"]
        assert (
            result["model_and_actual_DINO_state_unchanged"] and result["CPU_and_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
        )
        assert result["trace"] == ref(result["trace"]["path"])
    return status


def gate(plan):
    profile_ready(plan)
    previous = read(plan["profile_plan"]["path"])
    guard(previous)
    controller = Path(plan["profile_plan"]["path"]).with_name("controller.py")
    assert ref(controller)["sha256"] == previous["guards"][str(controller)]
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("frozen_prior_profile_controller", controller)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    # This exact frozen gate reruns the completed10k training validator on CPU.
    checkpoints = module.gate(previous)
    assert [item["path"] for item in checkpoints] == plan["checkpoints"]
    assert all(item["step"] == 10000 and item["example_draws"] == 160000 for item in checkpoints)
    return checkpoints


def prepare():
    assert not ROOT.exists() and not STATUS.exists()
    profile = read(PROFILE)
    assert alive(profile["controller"]) and profile["plan"] == ref(profile["plan"]["path"])
    previous = read(profile["plan"]["path"])
    guard(previous)
    cpu_root = BASE / "benchmarks/mixed16-EMA-benchmark-CPU-v1"
    proofs = [cpu_root / arm / "result.json" for arm in ("no-dino8k", "dino2k")]
    worker = REPO / "scripts/benchmark_ema_updates.py"
    audit_path = cpu_root / "audit.json"
    audit = read(audit_path)
    assert audit["worker"] == ref(worker) and not audit["CUDA_initialized"]
    assert audit["matched_cases"] == 16 and audit["matched_final_state_hashes"] == 32
    assert audit["actual_unfinished_profile_rejected_before_input_load_or_output_creation"]
    assert audit["prior_independent_replay"] == ref(audit["prior_independent_replay"]["path"])
    inputs = [
        Path(profile["plan"]["path"]),
        *proofs,
        audit_path,
        Path(audit["prior_independent_replay"]["path"]),
    ]
    versions = set()
    reference = None
    for proof in proofs:
        result = read(proof)
        assert result["status"] == "completed-EMA-CPU-instrumentation-preflight-no-GPU-timing"
        assert result["strict_state_equivalence_passed"] and not result["CUDA_initialized"]
        assert result["source"]["sha256"] == ref(worker)["sha256"]
        assert result["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"])["sha256"]
        inputs.append(Path(result["checkpoint"]["path"]))
        assert len(result["cases"]) == 8 and all(case["passed"] for case in result["cases"])
        assert (
            result["source_and_initial_EMA_values_unchanged"]
            and result["CPU_Python_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
        )
        versions.add(result["torch"])
        assert reference is None or reference == result["frozen_train"]
        reference = result["frozen_train"]
        assert reference == ref(reference["path"])
        for measurement in result["measurements"]["profiles"].values():
            assert measurement["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] == 0
            assert measurement["trace"] == ref(measurement["trace"]["path"])
            inputs.append(Path(measurement["trace"]["path"]))
    assert len(versions) == 1
    ROOT.mkdir()
    tools, work = ROOT / "tools", ROOT / "work"
    tools.mkdir()
    package = work / "src/demosaic"
    package.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name in ("__init__.py", "safety.py"):
        shutil.copyfile(Path(previous["work"]) / "src/demosaic" / name, package / name)
    shutil.copyfile(worker, tools / worker.name)
    shutil.copyfile(reference["path"], ROOT / "original-train.py")
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, ROOT / "controller.py")
    plan = {
        "python": previous["python"],
        "work": str(work),
        "tools": str(tools),
        "profile_status": str(PROFILE),
        "profile_plan": profile["plan"],
        "profile_owner": profile["controller"],
        "checkpoints": previous["checkpoints"],
        "frozen_train": ref(ROOT / "original-train.py"),
        "torch_version": versions.pop(),
        "CPU_preflights": [ref(p) for p in proofs],
        "outputs": [
            str(BASE / f"benchmarks/mixed16-quarter-EMA-CUDA-{arm}-v1")
            for arm in ("no-dino", "dino")
        ],
        "inputs": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in inputs},
        "guards": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in ROOT.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
        "warmup": 3,
        "samples": 10,
        "scope": "After exact complete inference-profile owner/child exit and independent "
        "completed10k training revalidation: two serial actual10k FP32 EMA comparisons. "
        "Eight original decay positions/five updates each, strict byte equality before "
        "timings. Three warmups/ten balanced synchronized samples per method and two "
        "genuine CUDA traces per arm.300s own-child limit;32GiB RAM/500GiB disk reserves. "
        "Source/EMA input and RNG unchanged. No network inference, backward, optimizer "
        "update, learned checkpoint, production change or automatic adoption. "
        "An arithmetic mismatch is retained as a rejection without timings. "
        "Isolated EMA latency does not establish whole-step training throughput.",
    }
    assert all(not Path(p).exists() for p in plan["outputs"])
    (ROOT / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
    guard(plan)
    try:
        gate(plan)
    except RuntimeError as error:
        assert "Complete inference profiles" in str(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("A live unfinished profile was admitted")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "prepared": ref(ROOT / "plan.json"),
                "inputs": len(plan["inputs"]),
                "guards": len(plan["guards"]),
            }
        )
    )


def run():
    assert not STATUS.exists()
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan.json")
    guard(plan)
    info = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan.json"),
        "previous_owner": plan["profile_owner"],
        "completed": [],
    }

    def record(status, **values):
        info.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        temporary = STATUS.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(STATUS)

    record("waiting-for-exact-inference-profile-owner-exit-no-CUDA-EMA-work")
    try:
        while alive(plan["profile_owner"]):
            time.sleep(15)
        guard(plan)
        checkpoints = gate(plan)
        env = {
            **os.environ,
            "PYTHONPATH": str(Path(plan["work"]) / "src"),
            "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "2",
            "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "2",
            "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1",
        }
        for checkpoint, output in zip(checkpoints, plan["outputs"], strict=True):
            assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage(BASE).free > 500 * 2**30
            guard(plan)
            with (ROOT / (checkpoint["arm"] + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        str(Path(plan["tools"]) / "benchmark_ema_updates.py"),
                        "--checkpoint",
                        checkpoint["path"],
                        "--train-source",
                        plan["frozen_train"]["path"],
                        "--train-sha256",
                        plan["frozen_train"]["sha256"],
                        "--output",
                        output,
                        "--expected-torch",
                        plan["torch_version"],
                        "--device",
                        "cuda",
                        "--warmup",
                        str(plan["warmup"]),
                        "--samples",
                        str(plan["samples"]),
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record(
                    "measuring-isolated-EMA-on-actual10k-CUDA-state",
                    arm=checkpoint["arm"],
                    child=owner,
                )
                try:
                    code = child.wait(timeout=300)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    assert alive(owner)
                    child.terminate()
                    try:
                        child.wait(timeout=10)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        child.kill()
                        child.wait()
                    raise
                assert code == 0 and not alive(owner)
            result_path = Path(output) / "result.json"
            result = read(result_path)
            assert (
                result["checkpoint"]["sha256"]
                == checkpoint["sha256"]
                == ref(checkpoint["path"])["sha256"]
            )
            assert result["CUDA_initialized"] and result["CPU_Python_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
            assert (
                result["source_and_initial_EMA_values_unchanged"]
                and result["checkpoint_bytes_unchanged"]
            )
            assert (
                result["source"]["sha256"]
                == ref(Path(plan["tools"]) / "benchmark_ema_updates.py")["sha256"]
            )
            if result["strict_state_equivalence_passed"]:
                assert result["status"] == "completed-EMA-CUDA-state-and-latency-measurement"
                assert all(
                    p["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] > 0
                    for p in result["measurements"]["profiles"].values()
                )
            else:
                assert result["status"] == "rejected-EMA-state-difference-no-timing-or-adoption"
                assert result["measurements"] is None
            info["completed"].append(ref(result_path))
        guard(plan)
        record(
            "completed-bounded-CUDA-EMA-comparisons-awaiting-analysis", no_automatic_adoption=True
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-no-automatic-restart-or-adoption", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.prepare_only:
        prepare()
    else:
        with (REPO / ".cache/mixed16-EMA-after-profile-v1.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            run()

    spec.loader.exec_module(legacy)
    saved = torch.load(plan["baseline_export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = classes()["noisy-control"](256).cuda().eval()
    adapter = classes()["relative-phase"](256).cuda().eval()
    missing, unexpected = adapter.load_state_dict(saved["state_dict"], strict=False)
    assert missing == ["relative_in.weight"] and not unexpected
    assert adapter.relative_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0
    module.load_state_dict(saved["state_dict"], strict=True)
    collection = read(plan["baseline_collection"]["path"])
    archived = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in collection["observations"]}
    cases = read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")["observations"]
    selected = [c for c in cases if c["kind"] == "mesh" and c["seed"] == 2026112302]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "photo"
        and (
            "3e638bbb" in c["id"]
            or ("02a76fd3" in c["id"] and c["variant"]["name"] == "photo-faint")
        )
    ]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "flat"
        and c["id"]
        in (
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-adc-only-RGGB",
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-iso6400-prior-RGGB",
            "gray-l0.02-adc-only-RGGB",
            "gray-l0.02-iso12800-prior-RGGB",
        )
    ]
    selected += [
        c
        for c in cases
        if c["kind"] == "real"
        and (
            c["id"].startswith("mesh-") or c["id"] in ("main-overcast-sky", "main-building-detail")
        )
    ]
    assert len(selected) == 28
    before, adapter_before = model_hash(module), model_hash(adapter)
    rows = []
    for case in selected:
        resource_check(root)
        assert (
            ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        )
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"])).cuda()
        inputs = [torch.from_numpy(a[k]).cuda() for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")]
        with torch.inference_mode():
            first = module(base, *inputs).cpu().numpy()
            second = legacy.LateSpectralDetail.forward(module, base, *inputs).cpu().numpy()
            third = adapter(base, *inputs).cpu().numpy()
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, second)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, third)
        assert ref(archived[case["id"]]["path"]) == archived[case["id"]]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, np.load(archived[case["id"]]["path"]))
        rows.append({"id": case["id"], "exact_legacy_forward_and_archived": True})
    assert model_hash(module) == before and model_hash(adapter) == adapter_before
    save(
        root / "parity-result-v1.json",

            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "legacy_base": plan["legacy_base"],
            "baseline_export": plan["baseline_export"],
            "rows": rows,

            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": "Current native, frozen V151 base forward and zero-relative-adapter embedding agree exactly on28 native256/384/512/768 cases across all CFAs and protected real controls. All agree with saved V151 noisy-only raw arrays. Three actual evaluations per case,84 total. No target/reference enters forward.",
