        adam_clocks,
        matching_parameters,
        restore_matching_state,
        update_matching_ema,
        warm_start_matching,
    )
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    name = arm + "-train"
    owner = own()
    require_worker_launch(plan, name, owner)
    (ROOT / f"{name}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    counts = {k: 0 for k in ["wrapper", "frozen", "network", "sampler", "projection"]}
    initial = torch.load(plan["initial_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = instrument(factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts)
    optimizer, ema, warmstart = warm_start_matching(
        module, initial, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
    )
    del initial
    save(ROOT / f"{arm}-warmstart-v1.json", warmstart)
    frozen = model_hash(module.frozen)
    assert frozen == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
    CPU_RNG, CUDA_RNG = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
    updates = skipped = images = 0
    trace = []
    checkpoints = []
    restoration = None
    maximum = {name: 0.0 for name in matching_parameters(module)}
    with (ROOT / f"{arm}-train-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
        for step, item in enumerate(rows, 1):
            resources(plan, name, owner)
            assert (
                ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
                and ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
            )
            arrays = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
            parent = np.load(item["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == item["inputs"] and fingerprint(
                parent
            ) == item["parent_values"]
            assert units[step - 1]["step"] == step and units[step - 1]["batch"] == item["arrays"]
            p = max(0, step - plan["warmup"]) / (plan["steps"] - plan["warmup"])
            lr = (
                plan["lr"]
                * min(1, step / plan["warmup"])
                * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * p)) / 2)
            )
            row = {
                "step": step,
                "batch": item["arrays"],
                "parent": item["parent"],
                "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
                "noisy": bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0)),
                "lr": lr,
            }
            if row["noisy"]:
                batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in arrays.items()}
                base = torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda()
                pair_units = torch.tensor(
                    units[step - 1]["candidate_units_FP32"], device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
                ).reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                    group["lr"] = lr
                output, aux = module(
                    base,
                    *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                    return_aux=True,
                )
                loss, terms, mask = objective(
                    output,
                    aux["frozen_output"],
                    batch,
                    pair_units,
                    plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]],
                )
                assert torch.isfinite(loss)
                loss.backward()
                zero = []
                for key, parameter in matching_parameters(module).items():
                    assert parameter.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all(), key
                    maximum[key] = max(maximum[key], float(parameter.grad.abs().max()))
                    if parameter.grad.count_nonzero() == 0:
                        zero.append(key)
                assert not any(p.grad is not None for p in module.frozen.parameters())
                norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    matching_parameters(module).values(),
                    plan["gradient_clip"],
                    error_if_nonfinite=True,
                )
                optimizer.step()
                updates += 1
                images += len(base)
                decay = update_matching_ema(
                    module,
                    ema,
                    total_updates=plan["initial_updates"] + updates,
                    maximum_decay=plan["EMA_decay"],
                )
                row.update(
                    loss=float(loss.detach()),
                    terms={k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
                    gradient_norm=float(norm),
                    zero_gradient_tensors=zero,
                    flat_mask=fingerprint(mask.cpu().numpy()),
                    flat_eligible_pixels=int(mask.sum()),
                    correction_RMS_DN16=float(aux["correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt())
                    * 65535,
                    EMA_decay=decay,
                )
                del batch, base, pair_units, output, aux, loss, terms, mask
            else:
                skipped += 1
                row["skipped"] = "zero variance;no matching,projection or optimizer call"
            assert model_hash(module.frozen) == frozen
            row.update(
                updates=updates,
                total_network_updates=plan["initial_updates"] + updates,
                counts=dict(counts),
            )
            trace.append(row)
            journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            journal.flush()
            if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
                progress(
                    name,
                    {
                        "status": "training",
                        "owner": owner,
                        "arm": arm,
                        "step": step,
                        "updates": updates,
                        "counts": counts,
                        "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                    },
                )
            if step in [8, 250, 500, 750, 1000]:
                clocks = adam_clocks(module, optimizer)
                assert clocks["network"]["steps"] == [float(plan["initial_updates"] + updates)]
                assert clocks["adapter"]["steps"] == ([float(updates)] if arm == "evidence" else [])
                checkpoint = Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "checkpoints" / f"{arm}-step{step:04d}.pt"
                payload = {
                    "models": module.state_dict(),
                    "ema": ema,
                    "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                    "arm": arm,
                    "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                    "step": step,
                    "updates": updates,
                    "initial_updates": plan["initial_updates"],
                    "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                }
                with checkpoint.open("xb") as stream:
                    torch.save(payload, stream)
                checkpoints.append(ref(checkpoint))
                del payload
                if step == 8:
                    before = model_hash(module)
                    saved = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                    del module, optimizer
                    gc.collect()
                    module = instrument(factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts)
                    optimizer, ema, restoration = restore_matching_state(
                        module, saved, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                    )
                    assert model_hash(module) == before
                    restoration.update(
                        checkpoint=ref(checkpoint), continued_at_row=9, repeated_prefix_forwards=0
                    )
                    save(ROOT / f"{arm}-restoration-v1.json", restoration)
                    del saved
            del arrays, parent
    assert len(trace) == 1000 and updates == 900 and skipped == 100 and images == 3600
    assert counts == {
        "wrapper": 900,
        "frozen": 900,
        "network": 900,
        "sampler": 4500,
        "projection": 900 if arm == "evidence" else 0,
    }
    assert torch.equal(CPU_RNG, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        CUDA_RNG, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    if arm == "evidence":
        assert maximum["phase_evidence_in.weight"] > 0
    assert any(value > 0 for key, value in maximum.items() if key.startswith("network."))
    guard(plan)
    save(
        ROOT / f"{arm}-train-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-warmstart-one-pass",
            "owner": owner,
            "arm": arm,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "trace": trace,
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "final_checkpoint": checkpoints[-1],
            "updates": updates,
            "skipped_ADC": skipped,
            "training_images": images,
            "counts": counts,
            "initial_updates": 900,
            "final_Adam_clocks": adam_clocks(module, optimizer),
            "restoration": restoration,
            "frozen_module_hash": frozen,
            "frozen_unchanged": True,
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_source_draws": 0,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    progress(
        name,
        {
            "status": "completed-training",
            "owner": owner,
            "arm": arm,
            "step": 1000,
            "updates": 900,
            "counts": counts,
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit("Use train_flat_spatial_evidence_trial.py")

"""Compare specified private RAW crops locally without ground-truth claims.

Selection JSON: [{"source": "/read-only/photo.raf", "x": 0.2, "y": 0.3,
                  "size": 512, "display_exposure": 2.0}]
x/y give fractional top-left sensor coordinates; crops are snapped to even phase.
Optional regions name native xywh ROIs inside each context. With RawNIND,
native triplets compare methods on the same noisy capture; no panel is GT.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import torch
from report_raw_pair import rawnind_comparators

from demosaic.cfa import bilinear, color_indices, malvar, pack
from demosaic.color import render
from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.io import read_raw
from demosaic.noise import Sensor
from demosaic.nonlocal_reference import load_nonlocal_reference
from demosaic.precision import COMPUTE_DTYPES, amp_context
from demosaic.prior import wiener_packed
from demosaic.reference import RawNind, publisher_input_scale
from demosaic.reporting import center_crop, display_crop, save_triplet
from demosaic.safety import writable_path
from demosaic.suite import freeze_checkpoint


@torch.inference_mode()
def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("selection", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("checkpoint", nargs="+", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--rawnind", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--nonlocal-reference", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--rawnind-gain-modes", nargs="+", choices=("cfa-ls", "cfa-channel"), default=["cfa-ls"]
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=("cpu", "cuda"), default="cuda")
    parser.add_argument("--precision", choices=COMPUTE_DTYPES, default="bfloat16")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.device == "cpu" and args.precision != "float32":
        raise ValueError("CPU qualitative comparisons require --precision float32")
    output = writable_path(args.output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if (output / "selection-and-metadata.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Comparison already exists; choose a new output directory")
    archive = output / "source"
    archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for path in [
        Path(__file__),
        Path(__file__).with_name("report_raw_pair.py"),
        *sorted(Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")),
    ]:
        (archive / path.name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    (archive / "selection.json").write_bytes(args.selection.read_bytes())
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    models, weights = [], []
    for path in args.checkpoint:
        frozen, digest = freeze_checkpoint(path, output / "weights")
        model, state = load_checkpoint(frozen, args.device)
        model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        run_name = Path(state.get("config", {}).get("run", path.parent)).name
        label = f"{run_name}, step {state['step']}"
        models.append((label, model, args.precision))
        weights.append(
            {
                "label": label,
                "source": str(path),
                "sha256": digest,
                "snapshot": str(frozen),
                "compute_precision": args.precision,
                "device": args.device,
                "memory_format": "channels_last",
                "model_config": model.config.to_dict(),
            }
        )
        del state
    if args.rawnind:
        references, receipts = rawnind_comparators(
            args.rawnind, args.rawnind_gain_modes, device=args.device
        )
        models = references + models
        weights += receipts
    if args.nonlocal_reference:
        reference = load_nonlocal_reference(
            args.nonlocal_reference, device=args.device, archive=output
        )
        models.append((reference.receipt["label"], reference, "float32"))
        weights.append(reference.receipt)
    selections = json.loads(args.selection.read_text())
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(selections),
        len(models) + 3,
        figsize=(4 * (len(models) + 3), 4 * len(selections)),
        squeeze=False,
    )
    records, crops, float_contexts = [], [], []
    for row, selection in enumerate(selections):
        source = Path(selection["source"])
        with source.open("rb") as reader:
            source_sha = hashlib.file_digest(reader, "sha256").hexdigest()
        if selection.get("source_sha256", source_sha) != source_sha:
            raise ValueError("Qualitative source hash differs from the fixed selection")
        raw, metadata = read_raw(selection["source"])
        if selection.get("camera", metadata.camera) != metadata.camera:
            raise ValueError("Qualitative camera differs from the fixed selection")
        h, w = raw.shape
        size = selection.get("size", 512)
        if size < 32 or size % 2 or size > min(h, w):
            raise ValueError("RAW context must be even, at least32 and fit the capture")
        y = min(h - size, int(h * selection["y"])) // 2 * 2
        x = min(w - size, int(w * selection["x"])) // 2 * 2
        crop = torch.from_numpy(raw[y : y + size, x : x + size].copy()).to(args.device)
        del raw
        colors = color_indices(metadata.pattern, device=args.device)[None]
        packed = pack(crop[None, None]).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        # These priors are disclosed assumptions, not camera calibration.
        shot, read = Sensor(iso=metadata.iso or 100).coefficients()
        if ("shot" in selection) != ("read" in selection):
            raise ValueError("A crop noise override requires both shot and read")
        shot, read = selection.get("shot", shot), selection.get("read", read)
        variance = packed.clamp_min(0) * shot + read
        wb = torch.tensor(metadata.white_balance, device=args.device)[None]
        matrix = torch.tensor(metadata.camera_to_srgb, device=args.device)[None]
        print(
            json.dumps({"event": "camera-start", "camera": metadata.camera, "device": args.device}),
            flush=True,
        )
        images = [
            ("Bilinear", bilinear(packed, colors)),
            ("Malvar 2004, WB", malvar(packed, colors, wb)),
            ("Variance prior + Malvar", malvar(wiener_packed(packed, variance), colors, wb)),
        ]
        for label, model, precision in models:
            if isinstance(model, RawNind):
                model.input_scale = torch.tensor(
                    publisher_input_scale(
                        metadata.white_levels, metadata.black_levels, metadata.adc_white_level
                    ),
                    device=args.device,
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                )
            if hasattr(model, "set_noise"):
                model.set_noise(shot, read)
            with amp_context(args.device, dtype=precision):
                prediction = model(packed, variance, colors, wb, matrix)
            if not torch.isfinite(prediction).all():
                raise ValueError(f"Nonfinite qualitative prediction: {label}")
            images.append((label, prediction))
        rendered = dict(images)
        regions = selection.get(
            "regions", [{"name": "center", "xywh": center_crop((size, size), size=160)}]
        )
        for region in regions:
            roi = region["xywh"]
            rx, ry, rw, rh = roi
            if min(rx, ry) < 0 or min(rw, rh) < 1 or rx + rw > size or ry + rh > size:
                raise ValueError("Native ROI must fit its fixed RAW context")
            for label, model, precision in models:
                if isinstance(model, RawNind):
                    continue
                model_receipt = next(r for r in weights if r["label"] == label)
                for baseline, reference, _ in models:
                    if not isinstance(reference, RawNind):
                        continue
                    reference_receipt = next(r for r in weights if r["label"] == baseline)
                    caption = f"{metadata.camera} / {selection.get('purpose', row)} / {region['name']} / {label} / {baseline}"
                    panels = [
                        ("Noisy (Malvar)", rendered["Malvar 2004, WB"]),
                        ("Restored", rendered[label]),
                        ("RawNIND (not GT)", rendered[baseline]),
                    ]
                    crops.append(
                        save_triplet(
                            output,
                            f"{row}:{region['name']}:{label}:{baseline}",
                            [
                                (
                                    name,
                                    display_crop(
                                        rgb,
                                        wb,
                                        matrix,
                                        roi,
                                        exposure=selection.get("display_exposure", 1),
                                    ),
                                )
                                for name, rgb in panels
                            ],
                            caption=caption,
                            metadata={
                                "source": str(source),
                                "source_sha256": source_sha,
                                "raw_metadata": asdict(metadata),
                                "context_xywh": [x, y, size, size],
                                "sensor_roi_xywh": [x + rx, y + ry, rw, rh],
                                "context_roi_xywh": roi,
                                "region": region["name"],
                                "model_label": label,
                                "checkpoint_sha256": model_receipt["sha256"],
                                "compute_precision": precision,
                                "device": args.device,
                                "baseline": reference_receipt,
                                "conditioning": {
                                    "shot": shot,
                                    "read": read,
                                    "source": selection.get("noise_source", "declared prior"),
                                },
                                "white_balance": metadata.white_balance,
                                "camera_to_srgb": metadata.camera_to_srgb,
                                "display_exposure": selection.get("display_exposure", 1),
                                "reference": "RawNIND on the same noisy capture; comparator, not GT; no pixelwise score",
                            },
                        )
                    )
        for col, (label, rgb) in enumerate(images):
            path = output / f"capture-{row}-method-{col}-linear-f32.npy"
            values = rgb.float().cpu().numpy()
            np.save(path, values, allow_pickle=False)
            with path.open("rb") as reader:
                digest = hashlib.file_digest(reader, "sha256").hexdigest()
            float_contexts.append(
                {
                    "image": path.name,
                    "source": str(source),
                    "model": label,
                    "context_xywh": [x, y, size, size],
                    "shape": list(values.shape),
                    "dtype": "float32",
                    "sha256": digest,
                    "encoding": "Unquantized linear camera RGB before display exposure/clipping",
                }
            )
            display = render(rgb * selection.get("display_exposure", 1), wb, matrix)
            axes[row, col].imshow(display[0].permute(1, 2, 0).cpu().numpy())
            axes[row, col].set_title(metadata.camera + " / " + label)
            axes[row, col].axis("off")
        records.append(
            {
                "raw": asdict(metadata),
                "crop_xywh": [x, y, size, size],
                "shot_prior": shot,
                "read_prior": read,
                "source_sha256": source_sha,
                **selection,
            }
        )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "event": "camera-complete",
                    "camera": metadata.camera,
                    "native_crops_so_far": len(crops),
                }
            ),
            flush=True,
        )
    figure.tight_layout()
    figure.savefig(output / "comparison.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)
    (output / "selection-and-metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + "\n")
    (output / "checkpoints.json").write_text(json.dumps(weights, indent=2) + "\n")
    result = {
        "scope": "Single-capture qualitative comparisons; no clean reference or pixelwise quality score.",
        "selection": records,
        "models": weights,
        "native_crops": crops,
        "float_contexts": float_contexts,
        "source_files": {
            p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in archive.glob("*.py")
        },
        "runtime": {
            "device": args.device,
            "neural_precision": args.precision,
            "torch": str(torch.__version__),
            "cuda_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
        },
    }
    if args.device == "cpu" and result["runtime"]["cuda_initialized"]:
        raise RuntimeError("CPU comparison unexpectedly initialized CUDA")
    (output / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    lines = [
        "# Cross-camera qualitative comparison",
        "",
        "Single noisy captures; no clean reference or quality scores.",
        "When present, RawNIND is a comparator, **not GT**.",
        "Native panels use identical coordinates/WB/matrix/exposure with no resizing.",
        "The separate [overview](comparison.png) is resized and is not a 100% view.",
        "",
    ]
    for crop in crops:
        lines += [crop["caption"], "", f"![Native method comparison]({crop['image']})", ""]
    lines += ["[Complete source, checkpoint, noise and ROI records](report.json).", ""]
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Four fixed V165 endpoints with exact V164 phase control and durable journals."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_pair_common_trial import classes


def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second


def validate(root):
    import torch

    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert (
        read(root / "status-v1.json")["status"]
        == "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"
    )
    result = read(root / "train-result-v1.json")
    assert result["counts"] == result["updates"] == {"fine-control": 1000, "pair-common": 1000}
    assert result["steps"] == 1000 and result["initial_outputs_exact_parent"]
    assert ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
    state = torch.load(result["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    assert state["step"] == state["horizon"] == 1000 and state["parent"] == plan["parent"]
    assert (
        set(state["arms"])
        == set(state["models"])
        == set(state["emas"])
        == {"fine-control", "pair-common"}
    )
    for arm in state["arms"]:
        assert (
            len(state["models"][arm])
            == len(state["emas"][arm])
            == len(state["optimizers"][arm]["state"])
            == state["arms"][arm]["parameter_tensors"]
        )
        assert all(float(v["step"]) == 1000 for v in state["optimizers"][arm]["state"].values())
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ["models", "emas"] for v in state[key][arm].values()
        )
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all()
            for s in state["optimizers"][arm]["state"].values()
            for v in s.values()
        )
        for key in ["models", "emas"]:
            model = classes()[arm](**state["module_config"])
            model.load_state_dict(state[key][arm], strict=True)
            assert sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) == state["arms"][arm]["parameters"]
    previous = read(plan["baseline_training"]["path"])
    assert ref(previous["checkpoint"]["path"]) == previous["checkpoint"]
    old = torch.load(previous["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    for key in ["models", "emas", "optimizers"]:
        assert equal_tree(state[key]["fine-control"], old[key]["fine-pair"]), key
    assert len(result["trace"]) == len(previous["trace"]) == 1000
    for row, prior in zip(result["trace"], previous["trace"], strict=True):
        assert (
            row["step"] == prior["step"]
            and row["batch"] == prior["batch"]
            and row["domain"] == prior["domain"]
        )
        expected = prior["arms"]["fine-pair"]
        assert {k: row["arms"]["fine-control"][k] for k in expected} == expected

    smoke = read(root / "smoke-result-v1.json")
    assert smoke["exact_V164_control_trace_rows"] == 10

            ),

def collect(root):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    ready = read(root / "review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json")
    assert ready["status"] == "pass-actual-final-state-and-exact-control-before-review-claim"
    result = read(root / "train-result-v1.json")
    assert ready["checkpoint"] == result["checkpoint"] == ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"])
    state = torch.load(result["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    design = read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")
    assert len(design["observations"]) == 822 and design["new_component_forwards"] == 3288
    assert not (root / "review.claim").exists()
    (root / "review.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    collections = {}
    total = controls_exact = saved_predictions = 0
    for arm in state["arms"]:
        for endpoint, key in [("raw", "models"), ("EMA", "emas")]:
            label = f"{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000"
            point = Path(plan["quality_output_roots"][label]) / label
            point.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            module = classes()[arm](**state["module_config"]).cuda().eval()
            assert Path(module.forward.__code__.co_filename).is_relative_to(
                Path(plan["work"]) / "src"
            )
            module.load_state_dict(state[key][arm], strict=True)
            before = model_hash(module)
            exported = point / "module.pt"
            with exported.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(
                    {
                        "component": state["arms"][arm]["class"],
                        "module_config": state["module_config"],
                        "state_dict": state[key][arm],
                        "parent": state["parent"],
                        "paired_training_checkpoint": result["checkpoint"],
                        "arm": arm,
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "step": 1000,
                    },
                    stream,
                )
            old_collection = (
                read(plan["control_collections"][label]["path"]) if arm == "fine-control" else None
            )
            old = (
                {r["id"]: r["prediction"] for r in old_collection["observations"]}
                if old_collection
                else {}
            )
            if old_collection:
                assert before == old_collection["module_before"] == old_collection["module_after"]
            count = [0]
            module.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, count=count: count.__setitem__(0, count[0] + 1)
            )
            rows = []
            observation_stream = (point / "observations-v1.jsonl").open("x")
            forward_stream = (point / "forward-events-v1.jsonl").open("x")
            for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):
                assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
                disk = {
                    "local_free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(root).free,
                    "external_free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free,
                }
                assert (
                    disk["local_free_bytes"] > 56 * 2**30
                    and disk["external_free_bytes"] > 136 * 2**30
                ), disk
                assert (
                    ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
                    and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
                )
                arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
                base = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
                batch = {
                    k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda()
                    for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]
                }
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    output, aux = module(torch.from_numpy(base).cuda(), **batch, return_aux=True)
                value = output.cpu().numpy()
                assert (
                    value.dtype == np.float32
                    and value.shape == base.shape
                    and np.isfinite(value).all()
                )
                forward_stream.write(
                    json.dumps({"index": index, "id": case["id"], "returned_forwards": count[0]})
                    + "\n"
                )
                forward_stream.flush()
                if old_collection:
                    prediction = old[case["id"]]
                    assert ref(prediction["path"]) == prediction
                    archived_value = np.load(prediction["path"])
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(value, archived_value)
                    assert fingerprint(value) == fingerprint(archived_value)
                    del archived_value
                    controls_exact += 1
                else:
                    path = point / f"prediction-{index:03d}.npy"
                    assert not path.exists()
                    np.save(path, value, allow_pickle=False)
                    prediction = ref(path)
                    saved_predictions += 1
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "id": case["id"],
                        "prediction": prediction,
                        "values": fingerprint(value),
                        "parent": case["parent"],
                        "inputs": {k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in batch},
                        "support_mean": float(aux["support"].mean()),
                        "coefficient_correction_RMS": float(
                            aux["spectral_delta"].abs().square().mean().sqrt()
                        ),
                        "module_forwards": 1,
                        **(
                            {
                                "spatial_correction_RMS_DN16": float(
                                    aux["spatial_correction"].square().mean().sqrt()
                                )
                                * 65535
                            }
                            if "spatial_correction" in aux
                            else {}
                        ),
                        "archive_replayed_bit_exact": bool(old_collection),
                    }
                )
                observation_stream.write(json.dumps(rows[-1], allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                observation_stream.flush()
                total += 1
                if index % 64 == 0:
                    print(
                        json.dumps(
                            {"endpoint": label, "done": index + 1, "current_head_calls": total}
                        ),
                        flush=True,
                    )
                del batch, arrays, base, output, aux, value
            observation_stream.close()
            forward_stream.close()
            assert count[0] == 822 and before == model_hash(module)
            assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
                cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
            )
            path = point / "collection-v1.json"
            save(
                path,
                {
                    "status": "completed-fixed-endpoint",
                    "arm": arm,
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "export": ref(exported),
                    "module_before": before,
                    "module_after": model_hash(module),
                    "observations": rows,
                    "component_forwards": count[0],
                    "RNG_unchanged": True,
                    "observation_journal": ref(point / "observations-v1.jsonl"),
                    "forward_journal": ref(point / "forward-events-v1.jsonl"),
                    "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
                    "new_noise_draws": 0,
                    "adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay": bool(old_collection),
                    "original_control_collection": plan["control_collections"].get(label),
                },
            )
            collections[label] = ref(path)
            del module
    assert total == 3288 and controls_exact == saved_predictions == 1644
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "review-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-four-fixed-endpoints-awaiting-independent-quality-and-native-viewing",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "collections": collections,
            "component_forwards": total,
            "control_replayed_exact": controls_exact,
            "new_prediction_arrays": saved_predictions,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--validate-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    (validate if args.validate_only else collect)(args.root.absolute())

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import signal

from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

from train_v43_quality_trial import live

CHECKS = REPO / ".cache/current-quality-20261023-v1/raw-patch-memory-pilot-v1/run"
BASE = CHECKS.parents[1]


def require_checked_result(result):
    """Adopt only the original completed16+2 implementation check."""
    assert result["status"] == "completed-patch-memory-global-implementation-check"
    assert result["arm"] == "V140" and result["phase"] in ("CPU", "CUDA")
    assert result["updates"] == result["all_AdamW_steps"] == 18
    assert result["model_EMA_tensor_count"] == 107 and result["optimizer_state_count"] == 16
    assert result["raw_global_only"] and result["frozen_parent91_model_and_EMA_exact"]
    assert result["model_EMA_Adam_finite"] and result["frozen_encoder_no_gradients"]
    assert result["all_observed_inputs_match_saved_control"]
    assert all(
        result["counts"][k] == 18
        for k in (
            "training_forwards",
            "encoder_forwards",
            "optimizer_steps",
            "prepared_training_batches",
        )
    )
    assert len(result["changed_global_resume_rejections"]) == 8


QUALITY_STAGES = {
    "bind-endpoint",
    "collect",
    "report",
    "audit",
    "faint-analyze",
    "faint-audit",
    "camera-JPEG",
}


def quality_dependency_ready(state, owner, owner_live):
    """Require the original native-review completion and exact-owner exit."""
    assert state["owner"] == owner
    assert not state["status"].startswith("failed"), state
    completed = state["status"] == "completed-memory-only1000-review-awaiting-actual-native-viewing"
    if not owner_live:
        assert completed, "Dependency owner exited without its completed receipt"
    if completed:
        assert set(state["completed"]) == QUALITY_STAGES
        assert all(v is True for v in state["completed"].values())
        for key in [
            "primary_report",
            "primary_audit",
            "faint_result",
            "faint_audit",
            "camera_JPEGs",
        ]:
            assert state[key].keys() >= {"path", "sha256"}
    return completed and not owner_live


def prepare(root):
    import yaml

    original = read(CHECKS / "plan.json")
    guard(original)
    audit = read(CHECKS / "independent-audit-v1.json")
    assert audit["status"].startswith("passed-independent-patch-memory")
    quality = BASE / "raw-global-memory-only-quality-v1"
    quality_queue = read(quality / "queue-plan-v1.json")
    guard(quality_queue)
    previous = read(REPO / "docs/results/raw-global-memory-only-queue-v1.json")
    quality_owner = previous["quality_owner"]
    assert live(quality_owner)
    assert read(quality / "status.json")["owner"] == quality_owner
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work = root / "work"
    old_work = Path(original["work"])
    for directory in ("src", "scripts", "configs"):
        shutil.copytree(
            old_work / directory, work / directory, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__")
        )
    script = work / "scripts" / Path(__file__).name
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, script)
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(original["arms"]["V140"]["train"]).read_text())
    assert config["steps"] == 1000 and config["raw_global_only"] is True
    assert config["model"]["raw_global_conditioning"] == "patch-memory-v4"
    config["run"] = str(work / "artifacts/train/V140")
    config["validation_protocol"] = str(work / "configs/evaluation.yaml")
    train = work / "configs/train-V140.yaml"
    train.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config, sort_keys=False))
    plan = {
        **original,
        "root": str(root),
        "work": str(work),
        "artifact_root": str(work / "artifacts"),
        "worker_script": ref(script),
        "core_worker_script": ref(work / "scripts/train_reviewed_shadow_trial.py"),
        "parent_selection": ref(work / "configs/parent-selection.json"),
        "arms": {"V140": {**original["arms"]["V140"], "train": str(train)}},
        "phase_result_status": "completed-patch-memory-global-pilot-training-phase",
        "maximum_train_worker_seconds": 28800,
        "gradient_observation_steps": sorted({*range(1, 17), *range(25, 1001, 25)}),
        "adopted_phase_results": {},
        "production_launched": False,
        "quality_dependency": {
            "status": str(quality / "status.json"),
            "owner": quality_owner,
            "queue": ref(quality / "queue-plan-v1.json"),
            "absolute_deadline_unix": quality_queue["absolute_deadline_unix"],

    # Exact receipt copies retain their original checkpoint/input/source paths.
    adopted = []
    for phase in ("CPU", "CUDA"):
        src = CHECKS / f"{phase}-V140-result.json"
        result = read(src)
        require_checked_result(result)
        assert (
            not live(result["owner"]) and ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
        )
        dest = root / src.name
        shutil.copyfile(src, dest)
        assert dest.read_bytes() == src.read_bytes()
        plan["adopted_phase_results"][f"{phase}-V140"] = ref(dest)
        adopted.extend((ref(src), ref(dest)))
    control = read(BASE / "raw-global-only-pilot-v1/run/plan.json")
    plan["prospective_domain_batches"] = control["prospective_domain_batches"]
    plan["inputs"] = [
        *original["inputs"],
        ref(CHECKS / "plan.json"),
        ref(CHECKS / "independent-audit-v1.json"),
        *adopted,
        plan["quality_dependency"]["queue"],
        ref(BASE / "raw-global-only-pilot-v1/run/plan.json"),
    ]
    plan["frozen_files"] = {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    plan["scope"] = (
        "Original V140 fresh1000-update patch-memory pilot, never resume a discarded18-update check. "
        "Adopt exact completed CPU/CUDA16+2 receipts without replay;69 trained neural modules, "
        "V12020k parent,90782/27,seed70/quota.5/zeroPSF/native256B16BF16/16trainable tensors/LR1e-3/warm100. "
        "Every clean/noisy batch matches savedV137. A later matched native review also compares actualV139 "
        "hashes and reuses all old predictions. Wait originalV139 native/faint/JPEG numeric review and "
        "exact owner exit within that original deadline; no score threshold or human publication gate. "
        "Then50GiB/128GiB internal/208GiB external admission stable15s,2h headroom limit,12GiB CUDAcap, "
        "32GB runtime floor,8h worker. No existing job/guard/data change, old inference, retry, horizon reset "
        "or extension. Train1000 plus64 validation/1064encoder calls. Quality remains unmeasured; "
        "standing native/camera quality collection is separately prepared, not launched by this driver."
    )
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    guard(plan)
    return root / "plan.json"


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    state = {
        "controller": owner,
        "plan": ref(path),
        "completed": dict(plan["adopted_phase_results"]),
    }
    child = child_owner = None

    def record(status, **fields):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        dependency = plan["quality_dependency"]
        record("waiting-for-original-V139-native-review", child=None)
        while True:
            guard(plan)
            assert time.time() < dependency["absolute_deadline_unix"]
            observed = read(dependency["status"])
            if quality_dependency_ready(observed, dependency["owner"], live(dependency["owner"])):
                for key in (
                    "primary_report",
                    "primary_audit",
                    "faint_result",
                    "faint_audit",
                    "camera_JPEGs",
                ):
                    assert ref(observed[key]["path"]) == observed[key]
                assert read(observed["primary_audit"]["path"])["status"].startswith("passed")
                assert read(observed["faint_audit"]["path"])["status"].startswith("passed")
                break
            time.sleep(15)
        deadline, stable = time.time() + plan["headroom_wait_seconds"], None
        record(
            "waiting-for-training-headroom",
            phase="train",
            arm="V140",
            headroom_deadline_unix=deadline,
        )
        while True:
            assert time.time() < deadline
            enough = (
                psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 50 * 2**30
                and shutil.disk_usage(root).free >= 128 * 2**30
                and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free >= 208 * 2**30
            )
            stable = (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable) if enough else None
            if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= 15:
                break
            time.sleep(2)
        guard(plan)
        env = dict(
            os.environ,
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
            HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
            TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
            OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
            OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
            CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
            PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
        )
        with (root / "train-V140-v1.log").open("x") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen(
                [plan["python"], "-P", plan["worker_script"]["path"], "worker", str(path)],
                cwd=work,
                env=env,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            record("running-patch-memory-training", child=child_owner)
            assert child.wait(timeout=plan["maximum_train_worker_seconds"]) == 0
        binding = ref(root / "train-V140-result.json")
        result = read(binding["path"])
        assert result["updates"] == 1000 and not live(result["owner"])
        state["completed"]["train-V140"] = binding
        record("completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons", child=None)
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if live(child_owner):
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        record("failed-training-preserved-no-automatic-retry", child=None, error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller", "worker"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path.resolve()))
    elif args.mode == "controller":
        controller(args.path.resolve())
    else:
        worker(args.path.resolve(), "train", "V140")

"""Start the validated serial review, CPU closure and retained-reference queue."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_interval_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def identity(process):
    return {"pid": process.pid, "created": psutil.Process(process.pid).create_time()}


def wait_status(path, owner):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        if process.create_time() != owner["created"] or process.status() == psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE:
            raise RuntimeError("Queued owner exited before publishing its wait status")
        if path.exists():
            status = read(path)
            assert status["controller"] == owner
            if status["status"].startswith("failed-"):
                raise RuntimeError("Queued owner failed; inspect its log")
            return
        time.sleep(0.1)
    raise RuntimeError("Queued owner did not publish its wait status")


def main(plan_path, preflight_path, *, validate_preflight=None):
    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "", "Review must inherit a visible CUDA device"
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    preflight = read(preflight_path)
    if validate_preflight is None:
        assert (
            preflight["status"]
            == "completed-historical-bank-review-preflight-no-new-quality-evidence"
        )
        assert preflight["comparison_rows_exact"] == 108 and len(preflight["CPU_portability"]) == 2
    else:
        validate_preflight(preflight)
    assert preflight["CUDA_initialized"] is False
    status = read(plan["training_status"])
    assert status["controller"] == plan["training_owner"]
    process = psutil.Process(status["controller"]["pid"])
    assert (
        process.create_time() == status["controller"]["created"]
        and process.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
    )
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    with (root / "queue.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    source = root / "queue-source.py"
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, source)
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(str(work / p) for p in ("src", "scripts")),
        HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"],
        HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
    )
    cpu_env = {**env, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": ""}
    started = []

    def launch(name, command, environment):
        with (root / (name + "-controller.log")).open("xb") as log:
            p = subprocess.Popen(
                [plan["python"], "-P", *command],
                cwd=work,
                env=environment,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
        owner = identity(p)
        started.append(owner)
        save(
            root / (name + "-launch.json"),
            {"owner": owner, "launched_unix": time.time(), "command": command},
        )
        return owner

    try:
        review = launch("review", [plan["worker"]["path"], "controller", str(plan_path)], env)
        wait_status(root / "status.json", review)
        closure = read(root / "closure-template.json")
        closure["review_owner"] = review
        save(root / "closure-plan.json", closure)
        close_owner = launch(
            "closure", [closure["worker"]["path"], str(root / "closure-plan.json")], cpu_env
        )
        wait_status(root / "closure-status.json", close_owner)
        supplement = read(root / "reference-template.json")
        supplement["closure_owner"] = close_owner
        save(root / "reference-plan.json", supplement)
        references = launch(
            "reference", [supplement["worker"]["path"], str(root / "reference-plan.json")], cpu_env
        )
        time.sleep(0.2)
        for item in started:
            p = psutil.Process(item["pid"])
            assert p.create_time() == item["created"] and p.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
        guard(plan)
        save(
            root / "queue-launch.json",
            {
                "status": "queued-exact-training-exit-review-and-CPU-closure-manual-review-pending",
                "plan": ref(plan_path),
                "preflight": ref(preflight_path),
                "source": ref(source),
                "review_owner": review,
                "closure_owner": close_owner,
                "reference_owner": references,
                "closure_plan": ref(root / "closure-plan.json"),
                "reference_plan": ref(root / "reference-plan.json"),
                "scope": "No new inference while training is live. Serial full10-stage review after exact successful training exit; then CPU saved-array/criteria/native boards and retained V43/RawNIND supplement. Actual visual inspection and final quality decision remain required; no automatic promotion or retry.",
            },
        )
        print({"queue": ref(root / "queue-launch.json"), "owners": started})
    except BaseException as error:
        # These groups belong only to this queue; never terminate the trainer.
        for item in reversed(started):
            try:
                p = psutil.Process(item["pid"])
                if p.create_time() == item["created"]:
                    os.killpg(item["pid"], signal.SIGTERM)
            except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, ProcessLookupError):
                pass
        save(root / "queue-failure.json", {"error": repr(error), "owners": started})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--preflight", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.plan.absolute(), args.preflight.absolute())

"""Freeze a prospective linear-RGB uniform-field grid on CPU, without inference."""

import argparse
import colorsys
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
import yaml

from demosaic.safety import writable_path
from demosaic.suite import observation

SUITE = "linear-RGB-flat-grid-v1"
LEVELS = [0.02, 0.18, 0.9]
SATURATIONS = [0.5, 0.98]
PATTERNS = ["RGGB", "BGGR", "GRBG", "GBRG"]
CONDITIONS = ["adc-only", "iso12800-prior"]
COEFFICIENTS = {"adc-only": (0.0, 0.0), "iso12800-prior": (0.00256, 0.0000262144)}


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def palette():
    colors = []
    for level in LEVELS:
        colors.append(
            {
                "id": f"gray-l{level:.2f}",
                "hue_degrees": None,
                "saturation": 0.0,
                "peak": level,
                "linear_srgb": [level] * 3,
            }
        )
        for saturation in SATURATIONS:
            for degrees in range(0, 360, 15):
                colors.append(
                    {
                        "id": f"h{degrees:03d}-s{saturation:.2f}-l{level:.2f}",
                        "hue_degrees": degrees,
                        "saturation": saturation,
                        "peak": level,
                        "linear_srgb": list(colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(degrees / 360, saturation, level)),
                    }
                )
    assert len(colors) == 147
    return colors


def validate(plan):
    assert (
        plan["suite"] == SUITE
        and plan["native_patch"] == 256
        and plan["roi_xywh"] == [48, 48, 160, 160]
    )
    expected = {
        (r["id"], condition, pattern)
        for r in palette()
        for condition in CONDITIONS
        for pattern in PATTERNS
    }
    actual = {(r["id"], r["condition"]["name"], r["pattern"]) for r in plan["cases"]}
    assert len(actual) == len(plan["cases"]) == 1176 and actual == expected
    colors = {r["id"]: r for r in palette()}
    for case in plan["cases"]:
        assert case["palette"] == case["id"] and case["source"] == colors[case["id"]]
        assert case["draws_per_pattern"] == 1 and case["condition"]["exposure"] == 1
        assert (case["condition"]["shot"], case["condition"]["read"]) == COEFFICIENTS[
            case["condition"]["name"]
        ]
    assert plan["adc_bits"] == 16 and plan["adc_black"] == 0.03
    assert len(set(plan["native_preview_cases"])) == 3
    for i in plan["native_preview_cases"]:
        case = plan["cases"][i]
        assert case["pattern"] == "RGGB" and case["condition"]["name"] == "iso12800-prior"
    assert {plan["cases"][i]["id"] for i in plan["native_preview_cases"]} == {
        "h030-s0.98-l0.90",
        "h315-s0.98-l0.90",
        "gray-l0.18",
    }


def prior_snapshot(workflow):
    if workflow is None:
        return None
    data = json.loads(Path(workflow).read_text())
    owner = data["controller"]
    p = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
    assert abs(p.create_time() - owner["created"]) < 0.01 and p.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
    assert data["status"] in [
        "training-control-to1000",
        "trained-control-1000",
        "training-wide-to1000",
        "trained-wide-1000",
        "both1000-observations-checked",
    ]
    assert all(
        not (Path(p) / name).exists()
        for p in data["outputs"].values()
        for name in ["summary.json", "report.json"]
    )
    return {
        "path": str(workflow),
        "sha256": sha(workflow),
        "snapshot": data,
        "no_training_trial_score_outputs_exist": True,
    }


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(output, workflow):
    os.nice(5)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    before = prior_snapshot(workflow)
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    archive = output / "source"
    archive.mkdir()
    sources = {str(p): sha(p) for p in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    for p in [*Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py"), Path(__file__), Path("configs/evaluation.yaml")]:
        (archive / p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
    protocol = yaml.safe_load(Path("configs/evaluation.yaml").read_text())
    conditions = [
        next(c for c in protocol["conditions"] if c["name"] == name) for name in CONDITIONS
    ]
    seed = 20261017
    cases = []
    previews = []
    for source in palette():
        rgb = (
            torch.tensor(source["linear_srgb"], dtype=torch.float32)[None, :, None, None]
            .expand(1, 3, 256, 256)
            .clone()
        )
        for condition in conditions:
            for pattern in PATTERNS:
                batch = observation(
                    rgb,
                    [source["id"]],
                    condition,
                    pattern,
                    protocol["white_balance"],
                    protocol["camera_to_srgb"],
                    seed,
                )
                assert batch["target"].shape == (1, 3, 256, 256) and batch["packed"].shape == (
                    1,
                    4,
                    128,
                    128,
                )
                assert float(batch["target"].min()) > 0 and float(batch["target"].max()) < 1
                assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in batch.values())
                assert torch.equal(
                    batch["target"], batch["target"][..., :1, :1].expand_as(batch["target"])
                )
                filename = source["id"] + "-" + condition["name"] + "-" + pattern + ".npz"
                path = output / filename
                np.savez_compressed(path, **{k: v.numpy() for k, v in batch.items()})
                record = {
                    "id": source["id"],
                    "palette": source["id"],
                    "source": source,
                    "condition": condition,
                    "pattern": pattern,
                    "arrays": str(path),
                    "sha256": sha(path),
                    "target_camera_RGB": batch["target"][0, :, 0, 0].tolist(),
                    "draws_per_pattern": 1,
                }
                if (
                    source["id"] in ["h030-s0.98-l0.90", "h315-s0.98-l0.90", "gray-l0.18"]
                    and condition["name"] == "iso12800-prior"
                    and pattern == "RGGB"
                ):
                    previews.append(len(cases))
                cases.append(record)
        if len(cases) % 96 == 0:
            print(json.dumps({"completed_observations": len(cases), "total": 1176}), flush=True)
    after = prior_snapshot(workflow)
    assert sources == {str(p): sha(p) for p in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    plan = {
        "suite": SUITE,
        "native_patch": 256,
        "roi_xywh": [48, 48, 160, 160],
        "white_balance": protocol["white_balance"],
        "camera_to_srgb": protocol["camera_to_srgb"],
        "seed": seed,
        "adc_bits": 16,
        "adc_black": 0.03,
        "protocol_sha256": sha("configs/evaluation.yaml"),
        "cases": cases,
        "native_preview_cases": previews,
        "source_files": sources,
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "workflow_before": before,
        "workflow_after": after,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "scope": "24 fixed scene-linear HSV hues at15degree intervals, saturation.5/.98, peak.02/.18/.9, plus3grays; two noise conditions and4CFAs, one draw/case. Fixed WB/camera, no clipping, original16bit ADC/black.03. Chosen after parent color failures but frozen before treatment scoring when workflow supplied; finite diagnostic grid, not a natural-photo ranking or independent training-repeat sample.",
    }
    validate(plan)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    (output / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "plan": str(output / "plan.json"),
                "sha256": sha(output / "plan.json"),
                "observations": len(cases),
                "sources": 147,
                "bytes": sum(Path(c["arrays"]).stat().st_size for c in cases),
            }
        ),
        flush=True,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--before-workflow-scoring", type=Path)
    a = p.parse_args()
    main(a.output, a.before_workflow_scoring)

"""Probe uniform-field preprocessing without a neural network or output fitting.

The inverse of the spatially averaged GAT/Malvar field assumes a constant scene.
It is a numerical diagnostic, not a proposed photographic denoiser or correction.
"""

import argparse
import json
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from prepare_color_grid import sha, validate

import demosaic.pretrained_rgb as frontend
from demosaic.cfa import malvar
from demosaic.safety import writable_path
from demosaic.vst import GeneralizedAnscombe


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def independent_inverse(z, transform):
    """NumPy64 scalar interpolation/tail, using the same numerical GAT table."""
    z = np.asarray(z, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
    expected, means = transform.expected.numpy(), transform.means.numpy()
    index = np.clip(np.searchsorted(expected, z), 1, len(means) - 1)
    left, right = expected[index - 1], expected[index]
    value = means[index - 1] + (z - left) / (right - left) * (means[index] - means[index - 1])
    algebraic = z * math.sqrt(transform.q) + z**2 / 4
    anchor = expected[-1] * math.sqrt(transform.q) + expected[-1] ** 2 / 4
    correction = means[-1] - anchor - 0.25
    tail = algebraic + 0.25 + correction * anchor / np.maximum(algebraic, anchor)
    return (np.where(z > expected[-1], tail, value) * transform.shot).astype(np.float32)


def descriptive(values):
    return {
        "mean": float(np.mean(values)),
        "p95": float(np.quantile(values, 0.95)),
        "maximum": float(np.max(values)),
    }


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(inputs, saved_report, output):
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    plan = read(inputs)
    validate(plan)
    saved = read(saved_report)
    old = read(saved["plan"])
    assert sha(saved["plan"]) == saved["plan_sha256"]
    assert old["input_plan_sha256"] == sha(inputs) and old["cases"] == plan["cases"]
    previous = {(r["model_index"], r["case"]): r for r in saved["results"]}
    assert len(previous) == 1176 * len(saved["checkpoints"])
    output = writable_path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("Physical diagnostic exists; choose a new output")
    source_dir = Path(frontend.__file__).parent
    source_files = [
        source_dir / n
        for n in ["pretrained_rgb.py", "vst.py", "cfa.py", "prior.py", "color.py", "precision.py"]
    ]
    sources = {str(p): sha(p) for p in source_files}
    profiles = {}
    results, groups = [], defaultdict(list)
    for i, case in enumerate(plan["cases"]):
        assert sha(case["arrays"]) == case["sha256"]
        with np.load(case["arrays"], allow_pickle=False) as values:
            b = {k: torch.from_numpy(values[k].copy()) for k in values.files}
        assert torch.equal(b["target"], b["target"][..., :1, :1].expand_as(b["target"]))
        condition = case["condition"]
        key = condition["shot"], condition["read"]
        if key not in profiles:
            profiles[key] = GeneralizedAnscombe(*key) if key[0] else None
        transform = profiles[key]
        packed = b["packed"]
        z = packed if transform is None else transform(packed)
        gat_difference, inverse_difference = 0.0, 0.0
        if transform is not None:
            counts = np.maximum(packed.numpy().astype(np.float64) / transform.shot, -transform.q)
            expected = (
                2 * counts / (np.sqrt(counts + transform.q) + math.sqrt(transform.q))
            ).astype(np.float32)
            gat_difference = float(np.max(np.abs(expected - z.numpy())))
            assert gat_difference < 2e-6
        proxy = torch.zeros_like(z) if not any(key) else torch.ones_like(z)
        rgb = malvar(z, b["colors"], b["wb"] if transform is None else None)
        rgb, normalized, noise, _, offset, span = frontend.physical_rgb_features(
            z, proxy, b["colors"], b["wb"], b["matrix"], rgb=rgb, stabilized=True
        )
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [rgb, normalized, noise, offset, span])
        roundtrip = float((normalized * span + offset - rgb).abs().max())
        assert roundtrip < 1e-5
        dc = rgb[..., 48:208, 48:208].double().mean((2, 3), keepdim=True).float()
        estimate = dc if transform is None else transform.inverse(dc)
        if transform is not None:
            expected = independent_inverse(dc.numpy(), transform)
            inverse_difference = float(np.max(np.abs(expected - estimate.numpy())))
            assert inverse_difference < 1e-7
        truth = b["target"][0, :, 0, 0].double().numpy()
        phase_means = packed[..., 24:104, 24:104].numpy().astype(np.float64).mean((0, 2, 3))
        sensor_mean = np.array([phase_means[b["colors"].numpy()[0] == c].mean() for c in range(3)])
        error = estimate.numpy().reshape(3).astype(np.float64) - truth
        row = {
            "case": i,
            "palette": case["palette"],
            "source": case["source"],
            "condition": condition["name"],
            "pattern": case["pattern"],
            "uniform_GAT_MHC_mean_estimate_error_camera_RGB": error.tolist(),
            "direct_CFA_mean_error_camera_RGB": (sensor_mean - truth).tolist(),
            "normalization_roundtrip_max_abs_transformed_error": roundtrip,
            "NumPy64_GAT_forward_max_abs_difference": gat_difference,
            "NumPy64_inverse_of_mean_max_abs_difference": inverse_difference,
            "normalized_noise_max": float(noise.max()),
            "offset": float(offset.flatten()[0]),
            "span": float(span.flatten()[0]),
            "saved_model_max_abs_channel_mean_error": {
                m["label"]: max(abs(v) for v in previous[mi, i]["metrics"]["camera_RGB_mean_error"])
                for mi, m in enumerate(saved["checkpoints"])
            },
        }
        groups[condition["name"], case["source"]["saturation"], case["source"]["peak"]].append(row)
        results.append(row)
        if (i + 1) % 196 == 0:
            print(json.dumps({"completed": i + 1, "total": 1176}), flush=True)
    summaries = []
    for key, rows in sorted(groups.items()):
        summaries.append(
            {
                "condition": key[0],
                "saturation": key[1],
                "peak": key[2],
                "cases": len(rows),
                "uniform_GAT_MHC_mean_max_abs_channel_error": descriptive(
                    [
                        max(abs(v) for v in r["uniform_GAT_MHC_mean_estimate_error_camera_RGB"])
                        for r in rows
                    ]
                ),
                "direct_CFA_mean_max_abs_channel_error": descriptive(
                    [max(abs(v) for v in r["direct_CFA_mean_error_camera_RGB"]) for r in rows]
                ),
                "saved_model_max_abs_channel_mean_error": {
                    m["label"]: descriptive(
                        [r["saved_model_max_abs_channel_mean_error"][m["label"]] for r in rows]
                    )
                    for m in saved["checkpoints"]
                },
            }
        )
    assert len(results) == 1176 and len(summaries) == 18
    assert all(sha(p) == s for p, s in sources.items()) and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (output / "source").mkdir()
    for p in [Path(__file__), *source_files]:
        (output / "source" / p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
    result = {
        "status": "completed-CPU-uniform-field-physical-frontend-diagnostic",
        "input_plan": str(inputs),
        "input_plan_sha256": sha(inputs),
        "saved_model_report": str(saved_report),
        "saved_model_report_sha256": sha(saved_report),
        "source_files": sources,
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "rows": results,
        "groups": summaries,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "scope": "All fixed1176 uniform fields, no neural model loaded/inferred, new random draws or source photographs. Rebuild production GAT/Malvar/normalization; invert the spatial mean under an explicit uniform-scene assumption. Direct CFA mean is another constant-scene estimator. No target fitting, learned-output correction or proposed photographic denoiser. Independent NumPy forward/scalar interpolation uses the same numerical expectation table, not an independent derivation of that table. Finite numerical checks cannot identify why the trained CNN shifts color or establish photo quality.",
    }
    (output / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"report": str(output / "report.json"), "cases": len(results)}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
