"""Independently inspect the frozen RAW-head warmup state and primary artifacts."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import yaml
from audit_fresh_dino_statistics import sha
from audit_long_commons_artifacts import audit_panels
from audit_raw_kernel_joint_state import audit_joint_state
from audit_sensor_mean_artifacts import exited
from review_raw_kernel_results import REPO, completed_primary, read

from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def audit_head_state(checkpoint, recipe, plan, log_path, steps):
    assert sha(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint["sha256"]
    state = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    parent = torch.load(plan["parent"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    assert sha(plan["parent"]) == plan["parent_sha256"]
    cfg = state["config"]
    assert state["step"] == steps <= cfg["steps"] == recipe["steps"] == 1000
    assert cfg["raw_kernel_only"] is True and state["model_config"]["raw_kernel_reconstruction"]
    assert cfg["initialized_from"]["sha256"] == plan["parent_sha256"]
    assert cfg["source_sha256"] == plan["source_bundle_sha256"]
    for key, value in recipe.items():
        if key != "validation_protocol":
            assert cfg[key] == value, key
    assert (
        sha(cfg["validation_protocol"])
        == sha(recipe["validation_protocol"])
        == cfg["validation_protocol_sha256"]
    )
    phase = state["model_config"].get("raw_kernel_phase_conditioning", False)
    assert type(phase) is bool and phase == recipe["model"].get(
        "raw_kernel_phase_conditioning", False
    )
    head_names = [
        "pretrained_rgb.raw_kernel.coefficients.bias",
        "pretrained_rgb.raw_kernel.coefficients.weight",
    ]
    if phase:
        head_names.append("pretrained_rgb.raw_kernel.phase_coefficients")
        channels = 3 * len(recipe["model"].get("raw_kernel_windows", [1, 5, 17])) * 4 * 9
        assert state["model"][head_names[-1]].shape == (4, 4, channels)
    assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91 + len(head_names)
    assert len(parent["ema"]) == 91
    assert state["model"].keys() == state["ema"].keys()
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == len(head_names)
    assert {int(v["step"]) for v in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()} == {steps}
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for k in ["model", "ema"] for v in state[k].values())
    assert all(
        torch.isfinite(v).all()
        for item in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        for v in item.values()
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
    )
    for name, value in parent["ema"].items():
        assert torch.equal(state["model"][name], value) and torch.equal(
            state["ema"][name], value
        ), name
    new = sorted(set(state["model"]) - set(parent["ema"]))
    assert new == head_names
    assert all(torch.count_nonzero(state["model"][name]) > 0 for name in new)
    assert all(key in state for key in ["python_rng", "torch_rng", "cuda_rng"])
    expected_cuda_states = 1 if torch.device(cfg["device"]).type == "cuda" else 0
    assert len(state["cuda_rng"]) == expected_cuda_states and math.isfinite(state["best"])
    snapshot = Path(cfg["source_snapshot"])
    package = Path(plan["package"]) / "demosaic"
    project = package.parents[1]
    names = {p.name for p in package.glob("*.py")}
    for name in names:
        assert sha(snapshot / name) == sha(package / name)
    fixed = {
        "pyproject.toml": project / "pyproject.toml",
        "uv.lock": project / "uv.lock",
        "Noise2VST-LICENSE": project / "third_party/gaussian/Noise2VST-LICENSE",
        "KAIR-LICENSE": project / "third_party/gaussian/KAIR-LICENSE",
        "paired-manifest.json": Path(cfg["paired_manifest"]),
        "raw-clean-manifest.json": Path(cfg["raw_clean_manifest"]),
        "validation-manifest.jsonl": Path(cfg["validation_manifest"]),
        "validation_protocol.yaml": Path(recipe["validation_protocol"]),
    }
    for name, path in fixed.items():
        assert sha(snapshot / name) == sha(path)
    assert {p.name for p in snapshot.iterdir()} == names | set(fixed) | {"manifest.jsonl"}
    bundle = hashlib.sha256()
    for name in sorted(names | set(fixed)):
        bundle.update(name.encode() + (snapshot / name).read_bytes())
    assert bundle.hexdigest() == cfg["source_sha256"]
    assert sha(snapshot / "manifest.jsonl") == sha(cfg["manifest"])
    for key in ["manifest", "validation_manifest", "raw_clean_manifest", "paired_manifest"]:
        assert cfg[key + "_sha256"] == sha(cfg[key])
    records = [
        r
        for line in Path(log_path).read_text().splitlines()
        if (r := json.loads(line)).get("event") == "train"
    ]
    assert [r["step"] for r in records] == sorted(
        {1, *range(cfg["log_every"], steps + 1, cfg["log_every"])}
    )
    assert {r["domain"] for r in records} == {"synthetic", "paired-RAW", "native-RAW-synthetic"}
    assert all(math.isfinite(v) for r in records for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, (int, float)))
    assert all(len(r["batch_sha256"]) == 64 for r in records)
    return {
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "step": steps,
        "original_planned_updates": cfg["steps"],
        "source_bundle_sha256": cfg["source_sha256"],
        "source_bundle_independently_reconstructed": True,
        "all91_existing_model_and_EMA_tensors_bitwise_parent": True,
        "new_head_tensors": new,
        "model_tensors": len(state["model"]),
        "EMA_tensors": len(state["ema"]),
        "AdamW_states": len(state["optimizer"]["state"]),
        "all_state_finite": True,
        "all_original_recipe_fields_exact_except_resolved_protocol": True,
        "four_manifest_hashes_and_snapshot_contents_exact": True,
        "complete_RNG_present": True,
        "training_log": {
            "path": str(log_path),
            "sha256": sha(log_path),
            "train_rows": len(records),
        },
        "learning_rates": [g["lr"] for g in state["optimizer"]["param_groups"]],
    }


def main(workflow, training_workflow, after_workflow, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    after = read(after_workflow)
    if (
        after["status"]
        != "completed-independent-primary-statistics-and-hue-awaiting-artifact-native-review"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("RAW-head statistics/hue workflow has not completed")
    exited(after)
    after_plan = read(after["plan"])
    assert after_plan["previous_workflow"] == str(workflow)
    status, _training, _, plan = completed_primary(workflow, training_workflow)
    assert after["checkpoint"] == status["checkpoint"]
    assert after_plan["previous_owner"] == status["controller"]
    for path, digest in after_plan["guards"].items():
        assert sha(path) == digest
    recipe = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["recipe"]).read_text())
    joint = recipe.get("raw_kernel_only", False) is False
    steps = plan["review_updates"] if joint else 1000
    cp = {
        **status["checkpoint"],
        "step": steps,
        "arm": "phase-joint-restoration" if joint else "head-only-warmup",
    }
    result = {
        "status": "completed-independent-RAW-head-state-native-and-RGB16-integrity-audit",
        "workflow": str(workflow),
        "workflow_sha256": sha(workflow),
        "training_workflow": str(training_workflow),
        "training_workflow_sha256": sha(training_workflow),
        "after_workflow": str(after_workflow),
        "after_workflow_sha256": sha(after_workflow),
        "boundary": (audit_joint_state if joint else audit_head_state)(
            cp, recipe, plan, Path(plan["run"]) / "metrics.jsonl", steps
        ),
        **audit_panels(
            status["outputs"],
            [cp],
            old_registry=REPO / "docs/results/wide-flat-palette-full4k-review.json",
        ),
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "scope": "State/native-preview/fullRGB16 integrity only. Selected CPU and hue arrays have separate independent Torch64 audits. Actual native visual review and quality interpretation remain required; no continuation or promotion.",
    }
    output = writable_path(output)
    assert not output.exists()
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    (output / "audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    (output / Path(__file__).name).write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    print(json.dumps({"output": str(output), "PNG": 19, "F32": 23, "RGB16": 2}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ["workflow", "training-workflow", "after-workflow", "output"]:
        p.add_argument("--" + name, required=True, type=Path)
    main(**vars(p.parse_args()))

    output,

    original = read(original_path)

    assert original["planned_updates"] == original["boundary_updates"] == 4000

    assert handoff["status"] == "completed-verified-checkpoint-handoff-original-owners-exited"

    external = read(external_path)

    assert external["model_EMA_AdamW_RNG_best_exact"] and external["all16_observations_exact"]
    assert not alive(external["controller"]) and not alive(external["child"])
    assert not external["CUDA_initialized"]
    retention = read(retention_path)
    assert (
        retention["status"]
        == "completed-real-CUDA-checkpoint-writer-repeat-and-different-state-rejection"
    )
    assert retention["identical_repeat_with_interleaved_best_save"]
    assert retention["changed_state_rejected_and_retained_unchanged"]
    for item in [
        retention["source"],
        retention["fixed_driver"],
        retention["completed_GPU_preflight"],
        retention["retained"],
    ]:

    tests = ET.parse(test_path).getroot()

        and not tests.findall(".//failure")
        and not tests.findall(".//error")
    )
    assert tests.find(".//testcase").get("classname") == "tests.test_spectral_trial_retention"
    preflights, added = [], []
    for status_path, device in [(cpu_path, "cpu"), (cuda_path, "cuda")]:
        status = read(status_path)
        assert status["status"] == "completed-spectral-engineering-preflight"
        assert (
            status["restart_full_model_EMA_AdamW_RNG_exact"]
            and status["matched_observations_and_final_RNG"]
        )
        assert not alive(status["controller"]) and not alive(status["child"])
        assert ref(status["plan"]["path"]) == status["plan"]
        previous = read(status["plan"]["path"])
        guard(previous)
        assert previous["device"] == device and previous["engineering_only"]
        assert (
            ref(REPO / "scripts/train_spectral_trial.py")["sha256"] == previous["worker"]["sha256"]
        )
        for source in (Path(original["work"]) / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"):
            assert (
                ref(source)["sha256"]
                == ref(Path(previous["work"]) / "src/demosaic" / source.name)["sha256"]
            )
        added += [ref(status_path), status["plan"]]
        preflights.append(previous)
    assert external["preflight"] == ref(cpu_path.parent / "plan.json")
    root = writable_path(output).resolve()
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work = root / "work"
    oldwork = Path(original["work"])
    for path in original["frozen_files"]:
        source = Path(path)
        if source.relative_to(oldwork).parts[0] == "scripts":
            continue
        target = work / source.relative_to(oldwork)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    for source in (REPO / "scripts").glob("*.py"):
        target = work / "scripts" / source.name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    arms = []

        cfg["run"] = str(work / "runs" / arm["name"])
        cfg["validation_protocol"] = str(work / "configs/evaluation.yaml")
        assert {k for k in cfg if cfg[k] != old_cfg[k]} == {"run", "validation_protocol"}
        path = work / "configs" / (arm["name"] + ".yaml")
        path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg, sort_keys=True))
        arm.update(config=str(path), run=cfg["run"])
        arms.append(arm)
    run = Path(arms[0]["run"])
    run.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(handoff["metrics"]["path"], run / "metrics.jsonl")
    shutil.copyfile(handoff["checkpoint"]["path"], run / "step-001000.pt")
    plan = copy.deepcopy(original)
    consumed = math.ceil(handoff["original_active_seconds_consumed"])
    assert 0 < consumed < original["timeout_seconds"]
    plan.update(
        status="frozen-explicit-spectral-retention-recovery-original4000",
        root=str(root),
        work=str(work),
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/train_spectral_trial.py"),
        arms=arms,
        recovery_of=ref(original_path),
        handoff=ref(handoff_path),
        resume={
            "control": {
                "step": 1000,
                "checkpoint": handoff["checkpoint"],
                "observations": handoff["observations"],
            }
        },
        arm_timeout_seconds={
            "control": original["timeout_seconds"] - consumed,
            "spectral": original["timeout_seconds"],
        },
        scope="Explicit retention-wrapper repair. Control resumes verified1000 and performs only remaining3000 original updates; spectral starts from original V63 EMA and performs original4000. All46 model modules/data/loss/noise/seed/B16/BF16/source RNG and original4000 LR horizon/criteria unchanged. No automatic retry, extension or promotion.",
    )
    plan["inputs"] += [
        ref(original_path),
        ref(handoff_path),
        handoff["checkpoint"],
        handoff["observations"],
        handoff["metrics"],
        ref(external_path),
        external["plan"],
        external["result"],
        ref(test_path),
        ref(retention_path),
        ref(REPO / "tests/test_spectral_trial_retention.py"),
        ref(__file__),
        *added,
    ]
    unique = {}
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        if item["path"] in unique:
            assert unique[item["path"]] == item["sha256"]
        unique[item["path"]] = item["sha256"]
    plan["inputs"] = [{"path": path, "sha256": sha} for path, sha in sorted(unique.items())]
    plan["frozen_files"] = {
        str(p): ref(p)["sha256"]
        for p in work.rglob("*")
        if p.is_file() and p.relative_to(work).parts[0] != "runs"
    }
    assert (
        plan["worker"]["sha256"]
        == preflights[0]["worker"]["sha256"]
        == preflights[1]["worker"]["sha256"]
    )
    guard(plan)
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    print(
        {
            "plan": ref(root / "plan.json"),
            "frozen_files": len(plan["frozen_files"]),
            "inputs": len(plan["inputs"]),
            "original_control_timeout_remaining": plan["arm_timeout_seconds"]["control"],
        }
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

    assert len(inputs["shadow_observations"]) == 64

        },

Existing V120 shadow64 already complete; all old material/GFX controls reused. Total236 calls across3 models,64 new noise observations, zero RAW/reference/optimizer work. Independent metrics and actual native review follow collection.",

def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None

    def record(status, **details):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **details)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        began = time.monotonic()
        record("waiting-for-original1000-pilot-training")
        training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
        while True:
            assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_training_wait_seconds"]
            if deadline := plan.get("absolute_training_wait_deadline_unix"):
                assert time.time() < deadline
            guard(plan)
            status = read(Path(training["root"]) / "status.json")
            assert status["plan"] == plan["training_plan"]
            assert status["controller"] == plan["training_owner"]
            if status["status"].startswith("failed"):
                raise RuntimeError("Original pilot training failed; preserve all work")
            if not live(plan["training_owner"]):
                assert status["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons"
                assert status.get("child") is None or not live(status["child"])
                break
            time.sleep(15)
        inputs = read(plan["input_plan"]["path"])
        for arm in plan.get("arms", ("V126", "V127")):
            result_binding = status["completed"][f"train-{arm}"]
            assert ref(result_binding["path"]) == result_binding
            result = read(result_binding["path"])
            assert result["updates"] == 1000 and not live(result["owner"])
            assert result["model_EMA_Adam_finite"] and result["all_AdamW_steps"] == 1000
            assert ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
            endpoint = root / arm
            work = endpoint / "work"
            execution = {
                **inputs,
                **{
                    key: plan[key]
                    for key in (
                        "launch_RAM_GiB",
                        "runtime_RAM_GiB",
                        "CUDA_quota_GiB",
                        "launch_internal_reserve_GiB",
                        "runtime_internal_reserve_GiB",
                        "launch_external_reserve_GiB",
                        "runtime_external_reserve_GiB",
                    )
                },
                "root": str(endpoint),
                "work": str(work),
                "step": 1000,
                "model_label": f"{arm} 1k EMA",
                "checkpoint": result["checkpoint"],
                "EMA_tensors": 91,
                "raw_frequency_features": False,
                "expected_lineage": {**training["parent"], "step": training["parent_step"]},
                "expected_backbone": training["backbones"][arm],
                "collector": ref(work / "scripts/collect_retained_checkpoint_pilot.py"),
                "observations": inputs["shadow_observations"] + inputs["retained_observations"],
                "planned_new_root_forwards": 86,
                "planned_new_encoder_forwards": 86,
                "inputs": [*plan["inputs"], result_binding, result["checkpoint"]],
                "frozen_files": plan["frozen_files"],
                "scope": plan["scope"],
            }
            execution_path = endpoint / "plan-v1.json"
            save(execution_path, execution)
            guard(execution)
            record("waiting-for-pilot-quality-headroom", arm=arm)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200
                time.sleep(5)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
            )
            with (endpoint / "collect.log").open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", execution["collector"]["path"], str(execution_path)],
                    cwd=work,
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-new-pilot-endpoint-collection", arm=arm, child=owner)
                began = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_collector_seconds"]
                    time.sleep(2)
                assert child.wait() == 0
            result_path = endpoint / "collection-v1.json"
            assert read(result_path)["counts"] == {"root": 86, "encoder": 86}
            state["completed"][arm] = ref(result_path)
            record("completed-new-pilot-endpoint-collection")
        record("completed-pilot-predictions-awaiting-independent-and-native-review")
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if live(owner):
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        record("failed-pilot-quality-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--input-plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--training-plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--arms", nargs="+")
    parser.add_argument("--matched-control-collection", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--matched-control-label", default="V126 1k EMA")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(
            prepare(
                args.path.resolve(),
                args.input_plan.resolve(),
                args.training_plan.resolve(),
                args.arms,
                args.matched_control_collection,
                args.matched_control_label,
            )
        )
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

    actual = {row["id"]: row for row in collection["observations"]}
    expected = {row["id"]: row for row in execution["observations"]}
    assert len(actual) == len(collection["observations"])
    assert len(expected) == len(execution["observations"])
    assert len(actual) == len(expected) == len(observations)
    assert {row["id"] for row in observations} == set(actual) == set(expected)
    keys = (
        "arrays",
        "input_fingerprints",
        "target",
        "ROI_xywh",
        "display_exposure",
        "noise",
        "reference_role",
    )
    attached = []
    for row in observations:
        assert all(row.get(key) == expected[row["id"]].get(key) for key in keys)
        prediction = actual[row["id"]]["prediction"]
        assert ref(prediction["path"]) == prediction
        attached.append(
            {
                **row,
                "controls": [
                    *row["controls"],
                    {
                        "model": {"label": execution["model_label"]},
                        "prediction": prediction,
                    },
                ],
            }
        )
    return attached


def progress_ready(plan, state, arm, progress):
    """Allow a live immutable snapshot, or the same worker's completed prefix."""
    assert state["plan"] == plan["training_plan"]
    assert state["controller"] == plan["training_owner"]
    assert not state["status"].startswith("failed"), state.get("error", state["status"])
    if not live(plan["training_owner"]):
        assert state["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons"
    if progress is None:
        if not live(plan["training_owner"]):
            raise RuntimeError("Training exited without the declared progress snapshot")
        return False
    assert progress["status"] == "immutable-progress-checkpoint-within-original-training-budget"
    assert progress["arm"] == arm and progress["step"] == plan["step"] == 1000
    assert progress["declared_training_horizon"] == plan["training_horizon"] == 20000
    counts = progress["counts_at_checkpoint"]
    assert all(
        counts[k] == 1000
        for k in ("training_forwards", "optimizer_steps", "prepared_training_batches")
    )
    assert counts["validation_forwards"] == 32 and counts["encoder_forwards"] == 1032
    assert counts["target_contexts"] == 16000
    rows = progress["observed_inputs"]
    assert len(rows) == 1000 and [r["step"] for r in rows] == list(range(1, 1001))
    if live(progress["owner"]):
        assert state.get("child") == progress["owner"]
        assert state.get("phase") == "train" and state.get("arm") == arm
        assert state["status"] == "running-quality-training"
    else:
        binding = state["completed"].get(f"train-{arm}")
        if binding is None:
            return False  # Exact worker exit and controller accounting can differ by one poll.
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        result = read(binding["path"])
        assert result["owner"] == progress["owner"] and result["updates"] == 20000
        assert result["observed_inputs"][:1000] == rows
    return True


def run_child(plan, state, record, command, work, log_path, *, cuda, timeout):
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0" if cuda else "",
        HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
        TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
        PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
    )
    child = owner = None
    try:
        with log_path.open("x") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                cwd=work,
                env=env,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            record("collecting-progress" if cuda else "analyzing-progress-on-CPU", child=owner)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while child.poll() is None:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < timeout
                assert (
                    shutil.disk_usage(Path(plan["root"])).free
                    > plan["runtime_internal_reserve_GiB"] * 2**30
                )
                assert (
                    shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free
                    > plan["runtime_external_reserve_GiB"] * 2**30
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            assert child.wait() == 0, (command, child.returncode)
    except BaseException:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if live(owner):
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["controller_source"]
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
        "reports": {},
    }

    def record(status, **details):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **details)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    began = time.monotonic()
    try:
        training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
        prior = None
        for arm in plan["arms"]:
            record("waiting-for-immutable-training-progress", arm=arm, child=None)
            snapshot_path = Path(plan["worker_root"]) / f"train-{arm}-progress1000.json"
            while True:
                if deadline := plan.get("absolute_training_wait_deadline_unix"):
                    assert time.time() < deadline
                observed = read(plan["training_status"])
                progress = read(snapshot_path) if snapshot_path.exists() else None
                if progress_ready(plan, observed, arm, progress):
                    break
                assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_training_wait_seconds"]
                time.sleep(15)
            guard(plan)
            assert ref(progress["checkpoint"]["path"]) == progress["checkpoint"]
            if prior is not None:
                keys = ("step", "domain", "clean_sha256", "batch_sha256")
                assert [[r[k] for k in keys] for r in progress["observed_inputs"]] == [
                    [r[k] for k in keys] for r in prior["observed_inputs"]
                ]
            endpoint, work = root / arm, root / arm / "work"
            execution = {
                **{k: v for k, v in plan.items() if k.startswith(("launch_", "runtime_"))},
                "root": str(endpoint),
                "work": str(work),
                "step": 1000,
                "training_horizon": 20000,
                "progress_checkpoint": True,
                "raw_spatial_features": arm == "V132",
                "raw_frequency_features": False,
                "model_label": f"{arm} progress1k/20k",
                "checkpoint": progress["checkpoint"],
                "EMA_tensors": training["restoration_tensors_by_arm"][arm],
                "expected_lineage": {**training["parent"], "step": training["parent_step"]},
                "expected_backbone": training["backbones"][arm],
                "collector": ref(work / "scripts/collect_retained_checkpoint_pilot.py"),
                "observations": plan["observations"],
                "CUDA_quota_GiB": plan["CUDA_quota_GiB"],
                "planned_new_root_forwards": 102,
                "planned_new_encoder_forwards": 102,
                "inputs": [*plan["inputs"], ref(path), ref(snapshot_path), progress["checkpoint"]],
                "frozen_files": plan["frozen_files"],
                "scope": plan["scope"],
            }
            execution_path = endpoint / "plan-v1.json"
            save(execution_path, execution)
            record("waiting-for-progress-collection-headroom", child=None)
            waited, stable = time.monotonic(), None
            while True:
                if deadline := plan.get("absolute_training_wait_deadline_unix"):
                    assert time.time() < deadline
                enough = psutil.virtual_memory().available >= plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30
                stable = (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable) if enough else None
                if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= plan.get(
                    "stable_headroom_seconds", 15
                ):
                    break
                assert time.monotonic() - waited < plan["maximum_headroom_wait_seconds"]
                time.sleep(2)
            run_child(
                plan,
                state,
                record,
                [plan["python"], "-P", execution["collector"]["path"], str(execution_path)],
                work,
                endpoint / "collect.log",
                cuda=True,
                timeout=plan["maximum_collector_seconds"],
            )
            collection_path = endpoint / "collection-v1.json"
            collection = read(collection_path)
            assert collection["plan"] == ref(execution_path)
            assert collection["counts"] == {"root": 102, "encoder": 102}
            assert collection["progress_checkpoint_verified"]
            assert collection["training_horizon"] == 20000
            state["completed"][arm] = ref(collection_path)
            record("completed-progress-collection", child=None)
            analysis_root = root / f"analysis-{arm}"
            analysis_root.mkdir()
            observations = plan["observations"]
            extra = []
            if prior is not None:
                control = read(state["completed"]["V131"]["path"])
                rows = {r["id"]: r for r in control["observations"]}
                observations = [
                    {
                        **o,
                        "controls": [
                            *o["controls"],
                            {
                                "model": {"label": "V131 progress1k/20k"},
                                "prediction": rows[o["id"]]["prediction"],
                            },
                        ],
                    }
                    for o in observations
                ]
                extra = [state["completed"]["V131"], *[r["prediction"] for r in rows.values()]]
            elif dependency := plan.get("saved_progress_control"):
                record("waiting-for-saved-V131-progress-predictions", child=None)
                while True:
                    previous = read(dependency["status"])
                    assert previous["plan"] == dependency["plan"]
                    assert previous["owner"] == dependency["owner"]
                    assert not previous["status"].startswith("failed")
                    binding = previous["completed"].get(dependency["arm"])
                    if binding is not None:
                        break
                    assert live(dependency["owner"])
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_training_wait_seconds"]
                    time.sleep(15)
                control, control_execution = checked_collection(binding, 102)
                observations = attach_progress_control(observations, control, control_execution)
                original = read(dependency["plan"]["path"])
                snapshot = Path(original["worker_root"]) / "train-V131-progress1000.json"
                assert control_execution["checkpoint"] == read(snapshot)["checkpoint"]
                extra = [
                    binding,
                    control["plan"],
                    ref(snapshot),
                    *[r["prediction"] for r in control["observations"]],
                ]
            analysis = {
                **execution,
                "root": str(analysis_root),
                "observations": observations,
                "actual_neural_execution": ref(execution_path),
                "inputs": [*execution["inputs"], ref(collection_path), *extra],
            }
            analysis_path = analysis_root / "plan-v1.json"
            save(analysis_path, analysis)
            derived_collection = analysis_root / "collection-v1.json"
            save(
                derived_collection,
                {
                    **collection,
                    "plan": ref(analysis_path),
                    "actual_neural_collection": ref(collection_path),
                    "new_forwards_in_this_derivation": 0,
                },
            )
            for helper, arguments in (
                ("report_checkpoint_pilot.py", [str(analysis_path), str(derived_collection)]),
                ("audit_checkpoint_pilot.py", [str(analysis_root)]),
            ):
                run_child(
                    plan,
                    state,
                    record,
                    [plan["python"], "-P", str(work / "scripts" / helper), *arguments],
                    work,
                    analysis_root / (helper + ".log"),
                    cuda=False,
                    timeout=plan["maximum_CPU_analysis_seconds"],
                )
            audit = analysis_root / "independent-audit-v1.json"
            assert read(audit)["status"] == "passed-independent-FFT-metric-and-native-pixel-audit"
            state["reports"][arm] = {
                "report": ref(analysis_root / "report-v1/report.json"),
                "independent_audit": ref(audit),
            }
            record("completed-progress-report-and-independent-audit", child=None)
            prior = progress
        record("completed-progress-comparisons-awaiting-actual-native-viewing", child=None)
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-progress-review-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error), child=None)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--training", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--shadow-inputs", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--faint-inputs", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--arms", nargs="+", choices=(*ARMS, "V133"), default=ARMS)
    parser.add_argument("--training-format", default="matched-raw-spatial-v1")
    parser.add_argument("--saved-progress-control", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(
            prepare(
                args.path,
                args.training,
                args.shadow_inputs,
                args.faint_inputs,
                arms=tuple(args.arms),
                training_format=args.training_format,
                saved_progress_control_path=args.saved_progress_control,
            )
        )
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

"""Prepare a deterministic ordinary-photo epoch order for one frozen recipe."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import random
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import yaml

from demosaic.data import CleanDataset
from demosaic.photo_epoch_order import file_hash, reader_policy, training_policy
from demosaic.train import training_domain

READER_KEYS = (
    "seed",
    "patch_size",
    "synthetic_fraction",
    "flat_fraction",
    "augmentation_downsample",
    "weak_texture_fraction",
    "fine_weak_texture_fraction",
    "flat_chroma_stops",
    "optical_blur_probability",
    "photographic_low_contrast_fraction",
    "reviewed_roi_catalogue",
    "reviewed_roi_fraction",
    "reviewed_roi_catalogue_sha256",
    "photo_sampling_reference_manifest",
    "photo_sampling_reference_sha256",
)


def build_order(reader, config):
    """Enumerate selection metadata only; never load/augment a sample."""
    steps, batch = config["steps"], config.get("batch_size", 4)
    if type(steps) is not int or steps <= 0 or type(batch) is not int or batch <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Photo epoch preparation needs positive integer steps/batch")
    if config.get("optimizer_batch_groups", 1) != 1 or reader.photo_epoch_order is not None:
        raise ValueError("Prepare an ordinary-photo order from an unmodified single-group reader")
    count = len(reader.rows)
    if count > np.iinfo(np.int32).max:
        raise ValueError("Photographic epoch order exceeds int32 source indices")
    manifest_hash = file_hash(reader.manifest)
    order = np.full(steps * batch, -1, dtype=np.int32)
    domains, families, old_visits, new_visits, ordinary_visits = (Counter() for _ in range(5))
    permutation, offset, epoch = [], count, -1
    first_full_step = None
    for step in range(1, steps + 1):
        domain = training_domain(
            step, reader.seed, config.get("paired_fraction", 0), config.get("raw_clean_fraction", 0)
        )
        domains[domain] += 1
        if domain != "commons":
            continue
        for index in range((step - 1) * batch, step * batch):
            rng = random.Random(reader.seed + index)
            draw = rng.random()
            if draw < reader.flat_fraction + reader.synthetic_fraction:
                families["procedural"] += 1
                continue
            initial = (
                reader.photo_sampling_reference.initial(rng)
                if reader.photo_sampling_reference
                else reader.rows[rng.randrange(count)]
            )
            region = reader.reviewed_roi_for_index(index)
            if region is not None:
                identity = region.record["id"]
                old_visits[identity] += 1
                new_visits[identity] += 1
                families["reviewed"] += 1
                continue
            previous = (
                reader.photo_sampling_reference.eligible(initial, rng)
                if reader.photo_sampling_reference
                else initial
            )
            old_visits[previous["id"]] += 1
            if offset == count:
                epoch += 1
                permutation = list(range(count))
                random.Random(f"photo-epoch-v1:{reader.seed}:{epoch}:{manifest_hash}").shuffle(
                    permutation
                )
                offset = 0
            position = permutation[offset]
            offset += 1
            order[index] = position
            identity = reader.rows[position]["id"]
            ordinary_visits[identity] += 1
            new_visits[identity] += 1
            families["ordinary"] += 1
            if first_full_step is None and len(ordinary_visits) == count:
                first_full_step = step
    summary = {
        "domains": dict(domains),
        "Commons_families": dict(families),
        "available_train_photos": count,
        "with_replacement_unique_photos": len(old_visits),
        "epoch_order_unique_photos": len(new_visits),
        "ordinary_unique_photos": len(ordinary_visits),
        "first_complete_ordinary_epoch_step": first_full_step,
        "complete_ordinary_epochs": families["ordinary"] // count,
        "partial_epoch_draws": families["ordinary"] % count,
        "ordinary_visit_histogram_including_zero": dict(
            sorted(Counter(ordinary_visits.get(r["id"], 0) for r in reader.rows).items())
        ),
    }
    return order, summary


def prepare(recipe_path, output):
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    recipe_payload = recipe_path.read_bytes()
    config = yaml.safe_load(recipe_payload)
    (output / "reader-recipe.yaml").write_bytes(recipe_payload)
    reader = CleanDataset(config["manifest"], **{k: config[k] for k in READER_KEYS if k in config})
    values, summary = build_order(reader, config)
    path = output / "ordinary-photo-order.npy"
    np.save(path, values, allow_pickle=False)
    manifest = {"path": str(reader.manifest.resolve()), "sha256": file_hash(reader.manifest)}
    header = {
        "format": "photo-epoch-order-v1",
        "source_manifest": manifest,
        "ordered_train_ids_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            ("\n".join(r["id"] for r in reader.rows) + "\n").encode()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "reader_policy": reader_policy(
            reader.seed,
            reader.flat_fraction,
            reader.synthetic_fraction,
            reader.reviewed_roi_fraction,
            reader.reviewed_rois.sha256 if reader.reviewed_rois else None,
        ),
        "training_policy": training_policy(config),
        "horizon_steps": config["steps"],
        "order": {"path": path.name, "sha256": file_hash(path)},
        "algorithm": "Python Random.shuffle of active row indices for each epoch; independent seed string photo-epoch-v1:{reader_seed}:{zero_based_epoch}:{manifest_sha256}. Only ordinary-photo slots advance the epoch.",
        "summary": summary,
        "scope": "Prepared future ordering only; no trained-quality result. Family/domain/reviewed selection remains fixed. No __getitem__, augmentation, sensor observation or neural execution; reviewed catalogue constructor validates its caches.",
    }
    header_path = output / "photo-epoch-order.json"
    header_path.write_text(json.dumps(header, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"header": str(header_path), "sha256": file_hash(header_path), **summary}))
    return header_path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("recipe", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    prepare(args.recipe, args.output)

"""Compare an unchanged exact-flat panel with an additional retained control."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from audit_pilot_flat_safety import reductions
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_pilot_flat_safety import spatial_metrics
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar


def compare(candidate, control, output):
    plans = [read(p / "plan-v1.json") for p in (candidate, control)]
    for plan in plans:
        guard(plan)
    assert plans[0]["observations"] == plans[1]["observations"]
    predictions = []
    for root, plan in zip((candidate, control), plans, strict=True):
        collection = read(root / "collection-v1.json")
        assert collection["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
        assert collection["counts"] == {"root": 48, "encoder": 48}
        predictions.append({r["id"]: r["prediction"] for r in collection["observations"]})
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    rows, images = [], []
    max_error = channels = 0

    def load(binding):
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        return np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)

    for observation in plans[0]["observations"]:
        with load(observation["arrays"]) as archive:
            arrays = {k: archive[k] for k in archive.files}
        values = [
            ("V120", load(observation["control"])),
            (plans[1]["model_label"], load(predictions[1][observation["id"]])),
            (plans[0]["model_label"], load(predictions[0][observation["id"]])),
        ]
        target = arrays["target"].astype(np.float64)
        for label, value in values:
            error = (value.astype(np.float64) - target)[..., 48:208, 48:208]
            measured, independent = spatial_metrics(error), reductions(error)
            for key in ("DC_RGB", "MSE", "DC_MSE", "spatial_MSE"):
                delta = float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(measured[key]) - independent[key])))
                max_error = max(max_error, delta)
                np.testing.assert_allclose(measured[key], independent[key], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-16)
            for side in ("1", "4", "16", "32"):
                a, b = measured["block_RMS"][side], independent["block_RMS"][side]
                max_error = max(max_error, abs(a - b))
                np.testing.assert_allclose(a, b, rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-16)
            rows.append(
                {"id": observation["id"], "case": observation["case"], "method": label, **measured}
            )
        case = observation["case"]
        if case["pattern"] != "RGGB" or case["condition"]["name"] != "iso12800-prior":
            continue
        cells = [("Noisy Malvar", noisy_malvar(arrays)), *values, ("GT (analytic flat)", target)]
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(cells), 192), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
        for i, (label, value) in enumerate(cells):
            draw.text((8 + 168 * i, 5), label, fill="black", font=font)
            canvas.paste(
                Image.fromarray(pixels(value, arrays, [48, 48, 160, 160], 1)), (8 + 168 * i, 24)
            )
        path = output / (case["id"] + "-three-method-flat.png")
        canvas.save(path)
        saved = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
        from audit_checkpoint_pilot import crop

        for i, (_, value) in enumerate(cells):
            cell = crop(value, arrays, [48, 48, 160, 160], 1)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(saved[24:184, 8 + 168 * i : 168 + 168 * i], cell)
            channels += cell.size
        images.append(
            {
                "image": ref(path),
                "case": case,
                "ROI_xywh": [48, 48, 160, 160],
                "display_exposure": 1,
                "no_resize": True,
                "methods": [label for label, _ in cells],
            }
        )
    summary = []
    for condition in ("adc-only", "iso12800-prior"):
        for label in ("V120", plans[1]["model_label"], plans[0]["model_label"]):
            selected = [
                r
                for r in rows
                if r["method"] == label and r["case"]["condition"]["name"] == condition
            ]
            assert len(selected) == 24
            summary.append(
                {
                    "method": label,
                    "condition": condition,
                    "mean_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(
                        np.mean([r["spatial_MSE"] ** 0.5 * 65535 for r in selected])
                    ),
                    "mean_block32_RMS_DN16": float(
                        np.mean([r["block_RMS"]["32"] * 65535 for r in selected])
                    ),
                    "max_abs_DC_DN16": max(
                        max(abs(x) for x in r["DC_RGB"]) * 65535 for r in selected
                    ),
                }
            )
    assert len(rows) == 144 and len(images) == 6 and channels == 2304000
    save(
        output / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "scored-and-independently-audited-same48-flat-control-comparison",
            "plans": [ref(root / "plan-v1.json") for root in (candidate, control)],
            "checkpoints": [p["checkpoint"] for p in plans],
            "operator": ref(__file__),
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "images": images,
            "independent_maximum_metric_difference": max_error,
            "PNG_channels_exact": channels,
            "new_neural_calls_in_report": 0,
            "scope": "Same48 exact fields, all3 methods, shared native160 ROI/display. "
            "V129 controls were newly collected separately; V120 and candidate predictions reused. "
            "One draw per color/condition/CFA, not photographic quality or universal flat safety.",
        },
    )
    print(summary)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

            upstream = torch.autograd.grad(loss, output, retain_graph=True)[0].detach().cpu()
            cpu_head = copy.deepcopy(model.wave_readout).cpu()
            cpu_head._forward_pre_hooks.clear()
            cpu_output = (
                cpu_head(captured["evidence"], captured["bins"], captured["support"])
                * aux["sigma"].cpu()
            )
            cpu_gradients = torch.autograd.grad(
                (cpu_output * upstream).sum(), tuple(cpu_head.parameters())
            )
            loss.backward()
            differences = []
            gradients = {}
            for (name, p), expected in zip(
                model.wave_readout.named_parameters(), cpu_gradients, strict=True
            ):
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                torch.testing.assert_close(p.grad.cpu(), expected, **plan["gradient_tolerance"])
                gradients[name] = int(p.grad.count_nonzero())
                differences.append(float((p.grad.cpu() - expected).abs().max()))
                assert bool(p.grad.count_nonzero()) == (update > 1 or name.startswith("mixing."))
            assert all(
                p.grad is None
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if not n.startswith("wave_readout.")
            )
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                model.wave_readout.parameters(), 1, error_if_nonfinite=True
            )
            optimizer.step()
            decay = update_ema(model, ema, updates=update)
            assert inherited_hash(model) == inherited
            assert clocks(model, optimizer) == {"tensors": 4, "states": 4, "steps": [float(update)]}
            record = {
                "update": update,
                "domain": domain,
                "case": case["id"],
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "terms": term_values,
                "independent_nine_term_FP32_total_exact": True,
                "mask_pixels": int(mask.sum()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "nonzero_gradient_coordinates": gradients,
                "CPU_GPU_parameter_gradient_maximum_difference": max(differences),
                "parameter_gradient_coordinates": sum(
                    p.numel() for p in model.wave_readout.parameters()
                ),
                "EMA_decay": decay,
                "Adam_clocks": clocks(model, optimizer),
                "inherited_hash": inherited,
                "model_hash": model_hash(model),
                "counts": dict(counts),
            }
            records.append(record)
            save(ROOT / f"update-{update}-v1.json", record)
            path = ARTIFACTS / f"probe-step{update}.pt"
            payload = {
                "models": model.state_dict(),
                "ema": ema,
                "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                "updates": update,
                "inherited_hash": inherited,
                "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                "component": type(model).__name__,
                "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                "scope": "Admission only;never a training initializer",
            }
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(pack_checkpoint(payload, plan["initializer"]["export"]), stream)
            checkpoints.append(ref(path))
            del (
                output,
                aux,
                loss,
                terms,
                mask,
                batch,
                base,
                pair_units,
                payload,
                upstream,
                cpu_head,
                cpu_output,
                cpu_gradients,
            )
            captured.clear()
            if update == 1:
                saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                hook.remove()
                del model, optimizer
                gc.collect()
                model = instrument(
                    LatePooledPhaseWaveDetail(**plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts
                ).train()
                optimizer, ema = restore_factored(
                    model, saved, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                )
                assert (
                    model_hash(model) == record["model_hash"] and inherited_hash(model) == inherited
                )
                hook = model.wave_readout.register_forward_pre_hook(capture)
                save(
                    ROOT / "restoration-v1.json",
                    {
                        "checkpoint": ref(path),
                        "model_Adam_EMA_CPU_CUDA_RNG_exact": True,
                        "repeated_prefix_forwards": 0,
                        "Adam_clocks": clocks(model, optimizer),
                    },
                )
                del saved
            print("update", update, "gradients", gradients, flush=True)
        assert counts == {
            "wrapper": 16,
            "frozen": 16,
            "network": 14,
            "sampler": 70,
            "projection": 14,
        }
        guard(plan)
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "pass-V187-frozen-baseline-native-CUDA-parity-head-gradients-and-restoration",
                "owner": owner,
                "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                "parities": parities,
                "records": records,
                "checkpoints": checkpoints,
                "counts": counts,
                "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "inherited189_tensors_unchanged": True,
                "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
                "parent_DINO_calls": 0,
                "protected_optimizer_inputs": 0,
                "scope": plan["scope"],
            },
        )
        print(
            "PASS7initialparities/6nonzeroheadparities/2updates/508CPU-GPUgradients/restoration",
            flush=True,
        )
    except BaseException as exc:
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-failure-v1.json",
            {"owner": owner, "error": repr(exc), "time_UTC": time.time()},
        )
        raise


def launch():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    assert not (ROOT / "admission-launch-v1.json").exists()
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",

            cwd=REPO,

            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    owner = {"pid": process.pid, "created": psutil.Process(process.pid).create_time()}
    save(ROOT / "admission-launch-v1.json", {"owner": owner, "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")})
    print(json.dumps(owner))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

"""Native readout comparisons; all prior completed panel pixels remain exact."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from audit_coherent_pair_evidence_trial import terminal
from lossless_native import load_native
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_pooled_phase_trial import METHODS, ROOT, guard, read, ref, save


def render(root=ROOT, *, fixture=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    if fixture:
        assert root != ROOT and plan["fixture_only_no_actual_V187_quality"] is True
    else:
        assert root == ROOT
        guard(plan)
        seal = read(root / "render-source-v1.json")
        assert seal["renderer"] == ref(__file__) and seal["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
        terminal(root / "scores-v1.json")
        for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
            assert read(root / name)["status"].startswith("pass-")
    result = read(root / "scores-v1.json")
    assert result["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
    previous_figures = ROOT.parent / "V185-spatial-context-trial-v1/figures-v1.json"
    if not fixture:
        assert seal["previous_figures"] == ref(previous_figures)
    prior = read(previous_figures)
    out = root / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    channels = copied_channels = 0
    for old in prior["images"]:
        if old["triplet"] and not old["panels"][1]["label"].startswith("V185-spatial-context-"):
            continue
        assert ref(old["image"]["path"]) == old["image"]
        source = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]))
        case = old["case"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        values = result["native_predictions"][case["id"]]
        anchor = np.asarray(old["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        variants = []
        if old["triplet"]:
            endpoint = "raw" if old["panels"][1]["label"].endswith("-raw") else "EMA"
            variants.append([old["panels"][0], METHODS[endpoint], old["panels"][-1]])
        else:
            assert [p["label"] for p in old["panels"][:19]] == [
                "Noisy Malvar",
                "V143 parent",
                "V169 EMA",
                "V172-EMA",
                "V175-EMA",
                "V178-control-raw",
                "V178-control-EMA",
                "V178-evidence-raw",
                "V178-evidence-EMA",
                "V180-local-phase-raw",
                "V180-local-phase-EMA",
                "V181-flat-spatial-raw",
                "V181-flat-spatial-EMA",
                "V183-coherent-pair-raw",
                "V183-coherent-pair-EMA",
                "V184-wave-readout-raw",
                "V184-wave-readout-EMA",
                "V185-spatial-context-raw",
                "V185-spatial-context-EMA",
            ]
            selections = (
                old["panels"][:19] + [METHODS[e] for e in ["raw", "EMA"]] + old["panels"][19:]
            )
            variants.append(selections)
        for selections in variants:
            panels = []
            bindings = {}
            for selection in selections:
                if isinstance(selection, str):
                    binding = values[selection]
                    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                    value = load_native(binding)
                    displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                    actual = pixels(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        actual, independent_display(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    )
                    assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                    channels += actual.size
                    bindings[selection] = binding
                    panels.append((selection, actual))
                else:
                    x, y, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                    assert w == h == 160
                    panels.append((selection["label"], source[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
                    copied_channels += w * h * 3
            board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(panels), 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4),
                f"{'CPU LAYOUT FIXTURE / NO V187 QUALITY | ' if fixture else ''}{case['id']} | V187 pooled-selection wave readout above frozen V183 EMA,contrast{old['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
                font=font,
                fill="black",
            )
            records = []
            for index, (label, value) in enumerate(panels):
                x = 8 + 168 * index
                draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
                records.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})
            path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
            board.save(path)
            image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
            for record, (_, value) in zip(records, panels, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = record["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], value)
            figures.append(
                {
                    "case": case,
                    "ROI_xywh": old["ROI_xywh"],
                    "anchor": old["anchor"],
                    "contrast": old["contrast"],
                    "exposure": old["exposure"],
                    "image": ref(path),
                    "panels": records,
                    "predictions": bindings,
                    "source_figure": old["image"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                    "triplet": old["triplet"],
                }
            )
    assert len(figures) == 60 and sum(f["triplet"] for f in figures) == 12 and channels == 8294400
    assert copied_channels == 80256000
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(figures), 4):
        group = figures[start : start + 4]
        width = max(Image.open(f["image"]["path"]).width for f in group)
        sheet = Image.new("RGB", (width, 212 * len(group)), "#eeeeee")
        for row, item in enumerate(group):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, 212 * row))
        path = out / f"sheet-{len(sheets):02d}.png"
        sheet.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(group))),
                "image": ref(path),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-layout-fixture-not-quality"
            if fixture
            else "rendered-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V187_quality": fixture,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(root / "scores-v1.json"),
            "images": figures,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "new_RGB_channels_independently_checked": channels,
            "unchanged_RGB_channels_copied": copied_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered60nativefigures12triplets;fixture", fixture, "newchannels", channels, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    render(args.fixture_root if args.fixture_root else ROOT, fixture=args.fixture_root is not None)

    original_call = torch.nn.Module._call_impl

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("No Module forward in final publication verification")

    torch.nn.Module._call_impl = forbidden

            training["final_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
        )

            plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def fingerprint(array):
    return {
        "shape": list(array.shape),
        "dtype": array.dtype.str,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(array).tobytes()).hexdigest(),
    }


def sample_RGB(rgb, colors):
    return np.stack(
        [
            np.stack([image[int(color), p // 2 :: 2, p % 2 :: 2] for p, color in enumerate(layout)])
            for image, layout in zip(rgb, colors, strict=True)
        ]
    )

def execute(plan_path):

    for binding in plan["sources"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"])["sha256"] == binding["sha256"]
        assert Path(binding["path"]).read_text() == binding["text"]
    assert ref(plan["source_cache"]["path"]) == plan["source_cache"]
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, [4, 5])
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    save(ROOT / "owner-v1.json", owner)
    cache = read(plan["source_cache"]["path"])
    selected = set(plan["selected_steps"])
    batches = [r for r in cache["batches"] if r["step"] in selected]
    assert len(batches) == 307
    rows = []
    checked = 0
    with (
        (EXTERNAL / "input-only-selections-v1.jsonl").open("x") as selections,
        (EXTERNAL / "scored-rows-v1.jsonl").open("x") as scored,
    ):
        for number, item in enumerate(batches, 1):
            assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > 48 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > (111 + 0.5 + 1.25) * 2**30
            assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
            with np.load(item["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as source:
                inputs = {key: source[key] for key in ["packed", "variance", "colors"]}
                for key, value in inputs.items():
                    assert fingerprint(value) == item["inputs"][key]
                    checked += 1
                observation_selections = [
                    describe_phase_holdout(raw, variance, colors, count=plan["peaks_per_direction"])
                    for raw, variance, colors in zip(
                        inputs["packed"], inputs["variance"], inputs["colors"], strict=True
                    )
                ]
                assert len(observation_selections) == 4
                selection_record = {
                    "step": item["step"],
                    "original_inputs": item["arrays"],
                    "observations": observation_selections,
                }
                selections.write(json.dumps(selection_record, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                selections.flush()
                os.fsync(selections.fileno())
                # Target/pair interpretation starts only after this durable input-only record.
                target, pairs = source["target"], source["pair_indices"]
                for key, value in [("target", target), ("pair_indices", pairs)]:
                    assert fingerprint(value) == item["inputs"][key]
                    checked += 1
                clean = sample_RGB(np.maximum(target, np.float32(0)), inputs["colors"])
                first, second = pairs.T
                assert fingerprint(clean[first]) == item["metadata"]["sensor"]["clean_packed_a"]
                assert fingerprint(clean[second]) == item["metadata"]["sensor"]["clean_packed_b"]
                shot, read_noise = [item["metadata"]["noise"][k] for k in ["shot", "read"]]
                for pair_index, (present, absent) in enumerate(pairs):
                    signal = clean[present].astype(np.float64) - clean[absent].astype(np.float64)
                    for member, index in [("present", int(present)), ("absent", int(absent))]:
                        directions = []
                        for direction in observation_selections[index]:
                            a, b = direction["selection_phase"], direction["other_phase"]
                            actual_a = shot * clean[index, a].astype(np.float64) + read_noise
                            actual_b = shot * clean[index, b].astype(np.float64) + read_noise
                            reference_a = tapered_spectrum(clean[index, a], actual_a)
                            reference_b = tapered_spectrum(clean[index, b], actual_b)
                            template_b = tapered_spectrum(signal[b])["spectrum"]
                            peaks = []
                            for peak in direction["peaks"]:
                                y, x = peak["bin_yx"]
                                va = float(reference_a["noise_variance"][y, x])
                                vb = float(reference_b["noise_variance"][y, x])
                                peaks.append(
                                    dict(
                                        peak,
                                        clean_selection_power=float(
                                            abs(reference_a["spectrum"][y, x]) ** 2 / va
                                        ),
                                        clean_other_power=float(
                                            abs(reference_b["spectrum"][y, x]) ** 2 / vb
                                        ),
                                        hidden_template_other_power=float(
                                            abs(template_b[y, x]) ** 2 / vb
                                        ),
                                        other_proxy_over_actual_variance=peak[
                                            "other_noise_variance"
                                        ]
                                        / vb,
                                    )
                                )
                            directions.append(
                                {"selection_phase": a, "other_phase": b, "peaks": peaks}
                            )
                        row = {
                            "step": item["step"],
                            "pair": pair_index,
                            "member": member,
                            "frame_index": index,
                            "original_inputs": item["arrays"],
                            "fine_ladder": item["metadata"].get("training_distribution")
                            == "fine-mesh-ladder-v1",
                            "directions": directions,
                        }
                        scored.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                        scored.flush()
                        rows.append(row)
            if number % 25 == 0:
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "batches": number,
                            "observations": len(rows),
                            "RSS": psutil.Process().memory_info().rss,
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
    assert checked == 1535 and len(rows) == 1228
    assert sum(len(d["peaks"]) for r in rows for d in r["directions"]) == 9824
    save(
        EXTERNAL / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-all1228-input-only-selections-followed-by-GT-scoring",
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "rows": rows,
            "input_selection_journal": ref(EXTERNAL / "input-only-selections-v1.jsonl"),
            "scored_journal": ref(EXTERNAL / "scored-rows-v1.jsonl"),
            "input_array_fingerprints_checked": checked,
            "npz_files_hashed": 307,
            "selected_peaks": 9824,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_renders": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "new_checkpoint_loads": 0,
            "Torch_imported": "torch" in sys.modules,
            "RAW_decoder_imported": "rawpy" in sys.modules,
            "peak_RSS_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss * 1024,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    print("Completed1228observations9824peaks;no restoration", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
