    for folder in roots:
        status = read(folder / "controller-status.json")
        assert status["status"].startswith(("completed-", "failed-full-precision-quality-"))
        assert not any(alive(status[k]) for k in ("controller", "child"))
        owners += [status[k] for k in ("controller", "child")]
        states.append(ref(folder / "controller-status.json"))
    assert read(replay / "outputs/receipt.json")["models"][0]["model"] == "V43"
    root = root.resolve()
    assert root.is_relative_to(REPO / ".cache")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work = root / "work"
    for folder in ("src/demosaic", "scripts"):
        for source in (REPO / folder).glob("*.py"):
            target = work / folder / source.name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    for name in (
        "pyproject.toml",
        "uv.lock",
        "configs/evaluation.yaml",
        "docs/mature-fixed-execution-pilot.md",
        "tests/test_mature_precision_execution.py",
        "tests/test_mature_precision_tools.py",
        "tests/test_mature_quality_pairs.py",
    ):
        target = work / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / name, target)
    files = {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    inputs = (
        original["inputs"]
        + list(failed["models"].values())
        + [ref(original_path), ref(failed_path), ref(tests), ref(replay / "outputs/receipt.json")]
        + states
    )
    inputs += [
        c["RGB"]
        for m in read(pilot / "work/GPU-output/receipt.json")["models"]
        for c in m["captures"]
    ]
    replicas = []
    for index in range(2):
        folder = root / f"replica{index}"
        folder.mkdir()
        child = copy.deepcopy(original)
        child.update(
            root=str(folder),
            work=str(work),
            output=str(work / f"replica{index}-outputs"),
            models=failed["models"],
            worker=ref(work / "scripts/probe_mature_precision_cuda.py"),
            execution_policy=EXECUTION,
            inputs=inputs,
            frozen_files=files,
            scope="New fixed-backend finite precision replica; separate from the failed autotuned qualification. No automatic full-quality/full-frame continuation or adoption.",
        )
        save(folder / "plan.json", child)
        guard(child)
        replicas.append(ref(folder / "plan.json"))
    plan = {
        "root": str(root),
        "work": str(work),
        "python": original["python"],
        "HF_HOME": original["HF_HOME"],
        "execution_policy": EXECUTION,
        "replicas": replicas,
        "blocking_owners": owners,
        "inputs": inputs + replicas,
        "frozen_files": files,
        "controller": ref(work / "scripts/run_mature_fixed_precision.py"),
        "unit_tests": {"JUnit": ref(tests), "passed": 26},
        "CPU_proofs": [original["CPU_preflight"], ref(Path(failed["output"]) / "CPU-receipt.json")],
        "protocol": ref(work / "docs/mature-fixed-execution-pilot.md"),
        "scope": "Two fresh source-frozen fixed-backend replicas only. All first-replica FP32 outputs retain original1/.25DN16 parity; all348 capture files require pairwise SHA identity and all48 timed files require first-capture SHA identity in subsequent CPU audit. Then actual48 native cells and independent scalar review are required. No quality/speed interpretation here, no gate relaxation or automatic continuation.",
    }
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    guard(plan)
    print(ref(root / "plan.json"))


def run(plan_path):
    from queue_tf32x3_cuda import stop_owned

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    state = {"plan": ref(plan_path), "controller": owner, "completed": []}
    child = None

    def record(status, **extra):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **extra)
        save(root / "controller-status.json", state)

    def resources(gib):
        return (
            psutil.virtual_memory().available >= gib * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage(root).free >= 64 * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free >= 500 * 2**30
        )

    try:
        assert ref(__file__) == plan["controller"]
        assert not any(alive(o) for o in plan["blocking_owners"])
        for index, item in enumerate(plan["replicas"]):
            began, stable = time.monotonic(), None
            record("waiting-for-stable-fixed-precision-headroom", replica=index)
            while True:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 3600
                stable = (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable) if resources(48) else None
                if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= 60:
                    break
                time.sleep(5)
            guard(plan)
            cp = read(item["path"])
            guard(cp)
            work = Path(plan["work"])
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
                HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"],
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="4",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="4",
                PYTHONPATH=str(work / "src") + ":" + str(work / "scripts"),
            )
            with (root / f"replica{index}.log").open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", cp["worker"]["path"], item["path"]],
                    cwd=work,
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-fixed-precision-replica", child=child_owner)
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 900
                while child.poll() is None:
                    if time.monotonic() > deadline or not resources(24):
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "Owned fixed-precision worker reached resource/runtime bound"
                        )
                    time.sleep(2)
                assert child.wait() == 0
            receipt = Path(cp["output"]) / "receipt.json"
            result = read(receipt)
            assert result["owner"] == child_owner and result["execution_policy"] == EXECUTION
            restoration = read(Path(cp["output"]) / "fixed-execution-restoration.json")
            assert (
                restoration["receipt"] == ref(receipt)
                and restoration["outer_backend_settings_restored_exact"]
            )
            save(
                Path(cp["root"]) / "controller-status.json",
                {
                    "controller": owner,
                    "child": child_owner,
                    "plan": item,
                    "receipt": ref(receipt),
                    "status": "completed-mature-precision-pilot-arrays-awaiting-native-and-independent-scalar-review",
                },
            )
            state["completed"].append(index)
            record("completed-fixed-precision-replica", receipt=ref(receipt))
        guard(plan)
        record("completed-fixed-precision-replicas-awaiting-execution-native-and-scalar-review")
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            stop_owned(child, state["child"])
        record("failed-fixed-precision-replicas-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "run"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    prepare(args.path) if args.mode == "prepare" else run(args.path.resolve())

"""Isolated mature-model CUDA accuracy gate, then resident-only timing.

Refuse unfinished exact training/review owners before initializing CUDA. Never
integrate into the CLI, run full-frame exports, alter weights, or train here.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from experimental_tf32x3_conv import convolution
from probe_tf32x3_cpu import difference, ref

from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.precision import amp_context, cudnn_autotune
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def alive(owner):
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        return process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        return False


def require_idle(plan):
    if any(alive(owner) for owner in plan["blocking_owners"]):
        raise RuntimeError("Exact training/review owners are live; no CUDA preflight")
    for dependency in plan["completed_dependencies"]:
        state = json.loads(Path(dependency["path"]).read_text())
        if state["status"] != dependency["status"] or state["controller"] != dependency["controller"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Successful exact training/review closure is required")
        if state["plan"] != dependency["plan"] or ref(state["plan"]["path"]) != state["plan"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Dependency plan changed")
        if state.get("child") and alive(state["child"]):
            raise RuntimeError("Dependency child is still live")
    for dependency in plan.get("required_completed_receipts", []):
        state = json.loads(Path(dependency["path"]).read_text())
        if state["status"] != dependency["status"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Completed retained-reference boards are required")


@contextmanager
def accelerated_hidden(network):
    if torch.is_grad_enabled() or network.training:
        raise ValueError("Inference eval mode with disabled gradients required")
    layers = [(name, layer) for name, layer in network.named_modules()
              if isinstance(layer, torch.nn.Conv2d) and name not in ("m_head", "m_tail")]
    for _, layer in layers:
        if (layer.groups != 1 or layer.bias is not None or layer.dilation != (1, 1)
                or layer.padding_mode != "zeros" or "forward" in layer.__dict__):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported or already modified hidden convolution")
    changed = []
    try:
        for _, layer in layers:
            def forward(value, layer=layer):
                return convolution(value, layer.weight, stride=layer.stride, padding=layer.padding)
            layer.forward = forward
            changed.append(layer)
        yield len(changed)
    finally:
        for layer in reversed(changed):
            del layer.forward


def tensors(path):
    with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as data:
        return {key: torch.from_numpy(data[key].copy()) for key in data.files}


def args_on_device(batch):
    return [batch[key].cuda().contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last) if key in ("packed", "variance")
            else batch[key].cuda() for key in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix")]


def state_hash(model):
    import hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
        digest.update(name.encode() + value.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes())
    return digest.hexdigest()


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(plan_path):
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    plan_path = Path(plan_path).resolve()
    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    require_idle(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["worker"]
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(item["path"]) == item
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 48 * 2**30
    assert psutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free > 500 * 2**30
    output = writable_path(plan["output"])
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (output / "plan.json").write_bytes(plan_path.read_bytes())
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    cases = []
    status_path = output / "status.json"

    def record(status, **fields):
        status_path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": status, "owner": owner, **fields}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    record("starting-isolated-CUDA-accuracy-gates")
    try:
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(16 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory, 0)
        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(73)
        # Fresh CPU-known inputs, exact FP64 reference, no device RNG/noisy redraw.
        for n, (shape, oc, kernel, stride, padding) in enumerate([
            ((1, 3, 7, 11), 5, 3, 1, 1), ((2, 4, 9, 5), 7, 2, 2, 0),
            ((1, 8, 4, 6), 3, 3, 1, 1), ((2, 3, 2, 2), 2, 2, 2, 0),
            ((1, 64, 3, 5), 65, 3, 1, 1),
        ]):
            x = torch.randn(shape, generator=generator).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
            w = torch.randn((oc, shape[1], kernel, kernel), generator=generator).contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
            expected = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x.double(), w.double(), stride=stride, padding=padding).float()
            actual = convolution(x.cuda(), w.cuda(), stride=stride, padding=padding).cpu()
            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5)
            print(json.dumps({"operator_case": n, "FP64_reference_pass": True}), flush=True)
        for label, checkpoint in plan["checkpoints"].items():
            model, state = load_checkpoint(checkpoint["path"], "cuda")
            model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
            step = state["step"]
            del state
            before, identities = state_hash(model), {k: id(v) for k, v in model.named_parameters()}
            for fixture in plan["fixtures"]:
                batch = tensors(fixture["observation"]["path"])
                args = args_on_device(batch)
                model.set_noise(fixture["conditioning"]["shot"], fixture["conditioning"]["read"])
                rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
                with cudnn_autotune("cuda", enabled=True), amp_context("cuda", dtype="float32"):
                    baseline = model(*args)
                    with accelerated_hidden(model.pretrained_rgb.network) as count:
                        assert count == 59
                        predicted = model(*args)
                        assert torch.equal(predicted, model(*args))
                    assert torch.equal(baseline, model(*args))
                error = difference(predicted, baseline)
                target = output / f"{label}-{fixture['label']}-RGB-f32.npz"
                np.savez(target, IEEE=baseline.cpu().numpy(), candidate=predicted.cpu().numpy())
                assert torch.equal(rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state())
                assert torch.isfinite(predicted).all() and predicted.dtype == torch.float32
                assert state_hash(model) == before and identities == {k: id(v) for k, v in model.named_parameters()}
                case = {"model": label, "checkpoint": checkpoint, "step": step, "fixture": fixture,
                        "arrays": ref(target), "difference": error, "exact_repeat": True,
                        "exact_original_after_context": True, "RNG_unchanged": True,
                        "full_model_state_and_parameter_identities_unchanged": True}
                cases.append(case)
                with (output / "accuracy-cases.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
                    stream.write(json.dumps(case) + "\n")
                print(json.dumps({"model": label, "fixture": fixture["label"], **error}), flush=True)
                if error["maximum_DN16"] > 1 or error["RMS_DN16"] > .25:
                    record("rejected-CUDA-RGB-accuracy-no-timing-or-fullframe", cases=cases)
                    return
                del args, baseline, predicted
            assert state_hash(model) == before and identities == {k: id(v) for k, v in model.named_parameters()}
            del model
        # All six full output arrays must pass before any resident timing.
        record("all-CUDA-array-gates-passed-starting-resident-only-timing", cases=cases)
        timings = []
        serving = next(f for f in plan["fixtures"] if f["label"] == "GFX-four-native512")
        for label, checkpoint in plan["checkpoints"].items():
            model, state = load_checkpoint(checkpoint["path"], "cuda")
            model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
            del state
            args = args_on_device(tensors(serving["observation"]["path"]))
            model.set_noise(serving["conditioning"]["shot"], serving["conditioning"]["read"])
            before = state_hash(model)
            with cudnn_autotune("cuda", enabled=True), amp_context("cuda", dtype="float32"):
                # Warm both policies, excluding JIT/search and device startup.
                for _ in range(3):
                    model(*args)
                    with accelerated_hidden(model.pretrained_rgb.network):
                        model(*args)
                for policy in ["IEEE", "candidate", "candidate", "IEEE", "candidate", "IEEE", "IEEE", "candidate"]:
                    torch.cuda.synchronize()
                    start = time.perf_counter()
                    if policy == "candidate":
                        with accelerated_hidden(model.pretrained_rgb.network):
                            model(*args)
                    else:
                        model(*args)
                    torch.cuda.synchronize()
                    timings.append({"model": label, "policy": policy, "seconds": time.perf_counter() - start})
            assert state_hash(model) == before
            del model, args
        for item in plan["inputs"]:
            assert ref(item["path"]) == item
        receipt = {"status": "completed-isolated-TF32x3-CUDA-array-gates-and-resident-timing-awaiting-native-review",
                   "plan": ref(plan_path), "owner": owner, "cases": cases, "resident_timings": timings,
                   "scope": plan["scope"]}
        (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        record(receipt["status"], receipt=ref(output / "receipt.json"))
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-TF32x3-CUDA-preflight-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error), cases=cases)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().plan)

"""Stage a bounded new Commons download without modifying the source archive."""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from demosaic.prepare import free_license
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

GIB = 2**30
OPERATIONAL = {
    "status",
    "attempts",
    "download_path",
    "downloaded_bytes",
    "http_etag",
    "http_last_modified",
    "last_error",
    "download_started_at",
    "downloaded_at",
    "updated_at",
}


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def connect(path, *, readonly=False):
    connection = (
        sqlite3.connect(f"file:{Path(path).resolve()}?mode=ro", uri=True)
        if readonly
        else sqlite3.connect(path)
    )
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    connection.execute("PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY")
    return connection


def lock_downloads():
    repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    handle = (repository / ".cache/commons-qi-download.lock").open("a")
    fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    return handle


def select(root, source, downloader, *, byte_budget, max_images, reserve_gib):
    root = writable_path(root)
    repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    if not root.is_relative_to(repository / ".cache"):
        raise ValueError("Local staging must be under this repository's .cache")
    if byte_budget <= 0 or max_images <= 0 or reserve_gib < 224:
        raise ValueError("Expected a positive bounded selection and at least224GiB reserve")
    if shutil.disk_usage(repository).free < byte_budget + reserve_gib * GIB:
        raise ValueError("Selection plus local reserve exceeds current free space")
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    handle = lock_downloads()
    source_db = source / "quality_images.sqlite3"
    source_refs = [ref(source_db)]
    wal = source_db.with_name(source_db.name + "-wal")
    if wal.exists():
        source_refs.append(ref(wal))
    now = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    with connect(source_db, readonly=True) as src:
        src.execute("BEGIN")
        known = {r[0] for r in src.execute("SELECT sha1_hex FROM images WHERE status='downloaded'")}
        candidates = [
            dict(r)
            for r in src.execute(
                "SELECT page_id,sha1_hex,byte_size,license,original_url FROM images "
                "WHERE status='pending' AND eligible=1 AND in_category=1 "
                "AND width>=2048 AND height>=2048 AND width*height<=120000000 "
                "AND byte_size>0 AND byte_size<=268435456"
            )
        ]
        # Hash ordering spreads the subset across the archive's page IDs;
        # semantic diversity still needs later content/protected-scene review.
        candidates.sort(
            key=lambda r: hashlib.sha256(f"commons-local-v1:{r['page_id']}".encode()).digest()
        )
        selected, used, hashes = [], 0, set()
        for candidate in candidates:
            digest = candidate["sha1_hex"]
            url = urlsplit(candidate["original_url"] or "")
            if (
                not free_license(candidate["license"])
                or digest in known
                or digest in hashes
                or len(digest or "") != 40
                or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in digest)
                or url.scheme != "https"
                or url.hostname != "upload.wikimedia.org"
            ):
                continue
            if used + candidate["byte_size"] > byte_budget:
                continue
            row = dict(
                src.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM images WHERE page_id=?", (candidate["page_id"],)
                ).fetchone()
            )
            selected.append(row)
            used += row["byte_size"]
            hashes.add(digest)
            if len(selected) == max_images:
                break
        if not selected:
            raise ValueError("No new eligible source originals fit the selection")
        database = root / "quality_images.sqlite3"
        with connect(database) as dest:
            schema = src.execute(
                "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('images','state')"
            ).fetchall()
            if len(schema) != 2:
                raise ValueError("Unexpected source index schema")
            for row in schema:
                dest.execute(row[0])
            for row in src.execute(
                "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name IN ('images','state') AND sql IS NOT NULL"
            ):
                dest.execute(row[0])
            for row in selected:
                target = dict(row)
                for field in OPERATIONAL:
                    target[field] = None
                target.update(status="pending", attempts=0, updated_at=now)
                keys = list(target)
                dest.execute(
                    f"INSERT INTO images ({','.join(keys)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' for _ in keys)})",
                    [target[k] for k in keys],
                )
            dest.execute(
                "INSERT INTO state VALUES (?,?,?)",
                ("stage_scope", "bounded pending subset; no active training admission", now),
            )
    for item in source_refs:
        if ref(item["path"]) != item:
            raise RuntimeError("Source index changed during staging; inspect before launching")
    snapshot = root / "selected-source-records.json"
    snapshot.write_text(json.dumps(selected, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    code = root / "source"
    code.mkdir()
    copies = []
    for path in [downloader, downloader.with_name("config.py")]:
        target = code / path.name
        shutil.copyfile(path, target)
        copies.append({"original": ref(path), "copy": ref(target)})
    plan = {
        "status": "frozen-bounded-new-local-Commons-download-selection",
        "root": str(root),
        "source_index": source_refs,
        "driver": ref(__file__),
        "selection": ref(snapshot),
        "initial_database": ref(database),
        "downloader_sources": copies,
        "config_path": str(downloader.with_name("config.toml").resolve()),
        "selected_images": len(selected),
        "selected_bytes": used,
        "byte_budget": byte_budget,
        "local_reserve_gib": reserve_gib,
        "maximum_images": max_images,
        "workers": 2,
        "requests_per_second": 0.25,
        "selection_policy": "Pending/category/eligible, canonical free_license, min2048 side/max120MP/max256MiB; unique SHA1 absent from downloaded archive; deterministic page-ID hash order, greedy byte cap; HTTPS Wikimedia upload URLs only.",
        "scope": "New local-only originals plus full attribution records. Original archive/index remain read-only. No preparation, training membership, protected split or active experiment changes. Later independent integrity, duplicate/protected-scene/content screening and a separate data study remain required.",
    }
    (root / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    handle.close()
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                k: plan[k]
                for k in (
                    "root",
                    "selected_images",
                    "selected_bytes",
                    "byte_budget",
                    "local_reserve_gib",
                )
            }
        )
    )


def run(root):
    root = writable_path(root)
    plan = read(root / "plan.json")
    if root != Path(plan["root"]):
        raise ValueError("Staged download root differs from its frozen plan")
    if ref(__file__) != plan["driver"] or ref(plan["selection"]["path"]) != plan["selection"]:
        raise ValueError("Staged source/selection changed")
    for item in plan["downloader_sources"]:

"""Training-only robust delivered-RGB spectral errors in RAW-proxy units."""

import math

from delivered_spectral_objective import spectral_loss as delivered_loss


def charbonnier_power(power, epsilon):
    """Stable sqrt(power + epsilon**2) - epsilon, with finite zero derivatives.

    Rationalization avoids cancellation for tiny powers. For a complex error
    normalized by sqrt(variance), its gradient relative to squared error is
    1 / (2 * sqrt(power + epsilon**2)). Weak nonzero errors gain relative
    pressure, including errors in flat targets; no target-power mask is used.
    """
    if not math.isfinite(epsilon) or epsilon <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Charbonnier epsilon must be finite and positive")
    return power / ((power + epsilon**2).sqrt() + epsilon)


def spectral_loss(module, output, target, colors, aux, floor, penalty, epsilon):
    """Keep V153 RGB MSE arithmetic exact, or change only its penalty shape.

    Twelve C-major RGB phases, original analysis/band, and the repeated RAW
    frame-noise scales match V153. These scales define training units, not
    calibrated post-demosaic covariance. Targets never enter model forward.
    """
    if penalty == "mse":
        if epsilon != 0:
            raise ValueError("MSE control must use epsilon zero")
        return delivered_loss(module, output, target, colors, aux, floor, "delivered-RGB")
    if penalty != "charbonnier":
        raise ValueError("Unknown delivered spectral penalty")
    if output.shape != target.shape or output.ndim != 4 or output.shape[1] != 3:
        raise ValueError("Expected matching delivered RGB and target")
    import torch
    from torch.nn import functional as F

    from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32

    with torch.autocast(output.device.type, enabled=False), ieee_fp32():
        error = F.pixel_unshuffle(output.float() - target.float(), 2)
        spectrum, _ = module.analysis(error, aux["geometry"][4])
        noise = aux["noise_power"].repeat(1, 3)
        assert noise.shape == spectrum.shape[:2]
        variance = noise[:, :, None, None].clamp_min((floor / 65535) ** 2)
        power = spectrum.abs().square() / variance
        band = getattr(module, f"band_{aux['geometry'][4]}")
        return (charbonnier_power(power, epsilon) * band).sum() / (
            band.sum().clamp_min(1) * spectrum.shape[0] * spectrum.shape[1]
        )

def read(path):

def audit_state(checkpoint, recipe, source_files, manifest_hashes, parent, log_path, steps):
    """Check an actual saved boundary against its actual original recipe."""
    assert sha(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint["sha256"] and checkpoint["step"] == steps
    state = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    cfg = state["config"]
    assert state["step"] == steps <= cfg["steps"] == recipe["steps"]
    assert cfg["initialized_from"]["sha256"] == parent
    for key, value in recipe.items():
        if key != "validation_protocol":
            assert cfg.get(key) == value, (checkpoint["arm"], key)
    assert cfg["source_sha256"] == SOURCE
    assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
    assert state["model"].keys() == state["ema"].keys()
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    for key in ["model", "ema"]:
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[key].values())
    assert all(
        torch.isfinite(v).all()
        for item in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        for v in item.values()
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
    )
    assert {int(v["step"]) for v in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()} == {steps}
    assert all(key in state for key in ["python_rng", "torch_rng", "cuda_rng"])
    assert len(state["cuda_rng"]) == 1
    assert math.isfinite(state["best"])
    snapshot = Path(cfg["source_snapshot"])
    assert {p.name for p in snapshot.glob("*.py")} == {Path(p).name for p in source_files}
    for path, digest in source_files.items():
        assert sha(snapshot / Path(path).name) == digest
    for key in ["manifest", "validation_manifest", "raw_clean_manifest", "paired_manifest"]:
        assert cfg[key + "_sha256"] == manifest_hashes[cfg[key]] == sha(cfg[key])
    assert sha(cfg["validation_protocol"]) == cfg["validation_protocol_sha256"]
    protocol_hashes = {
        digest
        for path, digest in manifest_hashes.items()
        if Path(path).name == Path(recipe["validation_protocol"]).name
    }
    assert protocol_hashes == {cfg["validation_protocol_sha256"]}
    records = [
        r
        for line in Path(log_path).read_text().splitlines()
        if (r := json.loads(line)).get("event") == "train"
    ]
    assert [r["step"] for r in records] == [1, *range(25, steps + 1, 25)]
    assert all(math.isfinite(v) for r in records for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, (float, int)))
    result = {
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "step": steps,
        "original_planned_updates": cfg["steps"],
        "source_bundle_sha256": SOURCE,
        "seed": cfg["seed"],
        "model_tensors": 91,
        "EMA_tensors": 91,
        "AdamW_states": 89,
        "all_state_finite": True,
        "complete_RNG_present": True,
        "all_original_recipe_fields_exact_except_resolved_validation_protocol_path": True,
        "four_manifest_and_validation_protocol_hashes_verified": True,
        "source_snapshot_files_exact": True,
        "training_log": {
            "path": str(log_path),
            "sha256": sha(log_path),
            "train_rows": len(records),
        },
        "learning_rates": [g["lr"] for g in state["optimizer"]["param_groups"]],
    }
    return result, records


def crop_sha(crop):
    return crop.get("checkpoint_sha256", crop.get("model", {}).get("sha256"))


def pixels(path, crop):
    assert sha(path) == crop["png_sha256"]
    assert [p["png_xywh"] for p in crop["panels"]] == RECTANGLES
    assert crop["pixel_scale"] == "1 image pixel = 1 PNG pixel; open original at 100%"
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        assert im.mode == "RGB" and im.size == (512, 192)
        return np.array(im)


def preview_difference(expected, actual):
    difference = np.abs(expected.astype(np.int16) - actual.astype(np.int16))
    changed = int(np.count_nonzero(difference))
    maximum = int(difference.max())
    assert maximum <= DISPLAY_MAX_LSB and changed <= DISPLAY_MAX_CHANGED_CHANNEL_VALUES
    return {"changed_channel_values": changed, "maximum_8bit_code_difference": maximum}


def audit_panels(outputs, checkpoints, *, replay_extra_models=False, old_registry=OLD_REGISTRY):
    """Inspect actual selected artifacts; replay can retain extra historical models."""
    selected = {c["sha256"]: c["arm"] for c in checkpoints}
    methods = len(selected)
    assert methods == len(checkpoints) and methods >= 1
    old_runs = historical_runs(old_registry, OLD_REGISTRY_SHA)
    images, floats, files, runs, display_checks, tif_crops = [], [], [], {}, [], []
    for panel, two_method_count in PANELS.items():
        count = two_method_count // 2 * methods
        root = Path(outputs[panel])
        report = root / ("report.json" if panel in {"gfx", "three-camera"} else "summary.json")
        data = read(report)
        allowed = set(selected) | ({RAWNIND} if panel == "three-camera" else set())
        if not replay_extra_models:
            assert len(data["models"]) == methods + (panel == "three-camera")
            assert {m.get("sha256", m.get("weight_sha256")) for m in data["models"]} == allowed
            assert len(data["native_crops"]) == count
        candidate_labels = {m["label"] for m in data["models"] if m.get("sha256") in selected}
        assert len(candidate_labels) == methods
        crops = [
            c
            for c in data["native_crops"]
            if crop_sha(c) in selected
            and (panel != "three-camera" or c["baseline"]["gain_mode"] == "cfa-channel")
        ]
        assert len(crops) == count
        previous_report = Path(old_runs[panel]["report"])
        assert sha(previous_report) == old_runs[panel]["report_sha256"]
        previous = read(previous_report)
        old_crops = [c for c in previous["native_crops"] if crop_sha(c) == PARENT]
        float_lookup = {}
        for item in data.get("float_contexts", []):
            if panel == "three-camera" and item["model"] not in (
                candidate_labels
                | {"Bilinear", "Malvar 2004, WB", "Variance prior + Malvar", "RawNIND:CFA-channel"}
            ):
                assert replay_extra_models
                continue
            path = root / item["image"]
            assert sha(path) == item["sha256"] and item["dtype"] == "float32"
            value = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
            assert value.dtype == np.float32 and list(value.shape) == item["shape"]
            assert np.isfinite(value).all()
            floats.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(path), "shape": list(value.shape)})
            if panel == "gfx":
                matching = [
                    old
                    for old in previous["float_contexts"]
                    if old["region"] == item["region"] and old["role"] == item["role"]
                ]
                assert len(matching) == 1 and item["sha256"] == matching[0]["sha256"]
                assert sha(previous_report.parent / matching[0]["image"]) == item["sha256"]
            if panel == "three-camera":
                key = item["source"], item["model"]
                assert key not in float_lookup
                float_lookup[key] = (item, value)
        if panel == "three-camera":
            assert len(float_lookup) == 3 * (methods + 4)
            sources = {key[0] for key in float_lookup}
            assert len(sources) == 3
            assert all(
                sum(key[0] == source for key in float_lookup) == methods + 4 for source in sources
            )
        gfx_frames = {}
        if panel == "gfx":
            frames = [f for f in data["full_frames"] if f["model_label"] in candidate_labels]
            assert len(frames) == methods
            for frame in frames:
                assert len(frame["files"]) == 2 and frame["display_exposure"] == 4.0
                for item in frame["files"]:
                    path = root / item["path"]
                    assert sha(path) == item["sha256"] and path.stat().st_size == item["bytes"]
                    with tifffile.TiffFile(path) as tif:
                        page = tif.pages[0]
                        assert page.shape == (8746, 11662, 3)
                        assert page.bitspersample == 16 and page.samplesperpixel == 3
                        description = json.loads(page.description)
                        assert description["bits_per_sample"] == 16
                        if "srgb16" in path.name:
                            assert description["color_space"] == "sRGB" and 34675 in page.tags
                        else:
                            assert description["color_space"] == "linear-camera-RGB"
                    value = tifffile.memmap(path, mode="r")
                    codes = int(np.unique(value[::97, ::101]).size)
                    assert value.dtype == np.uint16 and codes > 256
                    files.append({**item, "path": str(path), "sampled_unique_codes": codes})
                    if "srgb16" in path.name:
                        gfx_frames[frame["model_label"]] = value
        seen = set()
        per_arm = {digest: set() for digest in selected}
        for crop in crops:
            digest, key = crop_sha(crop), identity(panel, crop)
            assert (digest, key) not in seen
            seen.add((digest, key))
            per_arm[digest].add(key)
            matching = [c for c in old_crops if identity(panel, c) == key]
            assert len(matching) == 1, (panel, key)
            old = matching[0]
            for field in [
                *FIELDS,
                "variance_multiplier",
                "validation_index",
                "validation_seed",
                "source_id",
                "noisy_sha256",
            ]:
                assert (field in crop) == (field in old) and crop.get(field) == old.get(field), (
                    panel,
                    field,
                )
            actual = pixels(root / crop["image"], crop)
            retained = pixels(previous_report.parent / old["image"], old)
            for x in [8, 344]:
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                    actual[24:184, x : x + 160], retained[24:184, x : x + 160]
                )
            assert crop["display_exposure"] > 0
            if panel in {"gfx", "three-camera"}:
                assert "not GT" in crop["panels"][2]["label"]
            if panel == "full427":
                assert crop["reference"] == "Exact synthetic clean target"
            if panel == "gfx":
                assert crop["full_frame"] and crop["display_exposure"] == 4.0
                x, y = crop["region"]["noisy_xy"]
                assert crop["region"]["size"] == 160
                codes = gfx_frames[crop["model_label"]][y : y + 160, x : x + 160].astype(np.uint32)
                # 65535 = 255 * 257: nearest 8-bit code from the full sRGB16 TIFF.
                preview = ((codes + 128) // 257).astype(np.uint8)
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(preview, actual[24:184, 176:336])
                tif_crops.append(
                    {
                        "png": str(root / crop["image"]),
                        "region": crop["region"]["name"],
                        "exact_full_sRGB16_native_ROI": True,
                    }
                )
            if panel == "three-camera":
                assert crop["baseline"]["sha256"] == RAWNIND
                assert crop["baseline"]["gain_mode"] == "cfa-channel"
                wb = torch.tensor(crop["white_balance"])[None]
                matrix = torch.tensor(crop["camera_to_srgb"])[None]
                for label, x in [
                    ("Malvar 2004, WB", 8),
                    (crop["model_label"], 176),
                    ("RawNIND:CFA-channel", 344),
                ]:
                    metadata, value = float_lookup[crop["source"], label]
                    assert metadata["context_xywh"] == crop["context_xywh"]
                    displayed = display_crop(
                        torch.from_numpy(np.array(value, copy=True)),
                        wb,
                        matrix,
                        crop["context_roi_xywh"],
                        exposure=crop["display_exposure"],
                    )
                    codes = np.rint(displayed.clip(0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8)
                    display_checks.append(
                        {
                            "png": str(root / crop["image"]),
                            "panel_x": x,
                            **preview_difference(codes, actual[24:184, x : x + 160]),
                        }
                    )
            images.append(
                {
                    "panel": panel,
                    "path": str(root / crop["image"]),
                    "sha256": crop["png_sha256"],
                    "arm": selected[digest],
                    "checkpoint_sha256": digest,
                    "metadata": crop,
                    "saved_V60_control": str(previous_report.parent / old["image"]),
                }
            )
        first = next(iter(per_arm.values()))
        assert all(len(keys) == count // methods and keys == first for keys in per_arm.values())
        if panel == "gfx":
            assert {c["region"]["name"] for c in crops} == {
                "overcast-sky",
                "building-detail",
                "foliage",
                "chain-link-fence",
            }
        runs[panel] = {
            "report": str(report),
            "report_sha256": sha(report),
            "selected_native_PNGs": len(crops),
        }
    assert len(images) == 19 * methods and len(floats) == 8 + 3 * (methods + 4)
    assert len(files) == 2 * methods
    assert len(display_checks) == 18 * methods and len(tif_crops) == 4 * methods
    return {
        "runs": runs,
        "images": images,
        "float_arrays": floats,
        "full_RGB16_files": files,
        "common_noisy_reference_pixels_and_transform_metadata_exact_to_V60": True,
        "three_camera_saved_F32_to_PNG_checks": display_checks,
        "three_camera_display_check_bounds": {
            "maximum_LSB": DISPLAY_MAX_LSB,
            "maximum_changed_channel_values_per_panel": DISPLAY_MAX_CHANGED_CHANNEL_VALUES,
            "scope": "8-bit preview rerender only; every mismatch retained. No bound on restoration/metric/color errors.",
        },
        "GFX_full_sRGB16_to_native_PNG_checks": tif_crops,
        "limitations": "Integrity and declared display-rounding checks, not actual visual inspection or quality. Real GFX/RawNIND references are not exact GT; photographic synthetic targets are exact for that synthetic observation only.",
    }

    assert train_plan["parent"]["sha256"] == PARENT and train_plan["planned_updates"] == 20000

    result = {
        "status": "completed-independent-long-data-state-native-and-RGB16-integrity-audit",

        "workflow_sha256": sha(workflow),
        "training_workflow": str(TRAINING),

        "logged_observations": observed,
        **audit_panels(status["outputs"], checkpoints),
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),

"""Count scheduled photograph identities, stopping the real reader before pixels.

This is a source-selection audit, not a training or clean-target replay. A frozen
plan supplies recipe/source/trace hashes. Independent Python selection must agree
with the actual reader, including the complete local RNG state at the stop.
"""

import argparse
import ast
import csv
import hashlib
import inspect
import json
import math
import os
import random
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import torch
import yaml

import demosaic.data as data_module
from demosaic.data import CleanDataset
from demosaic.train import training_domain


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def reference(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def guard(plan):
    for ref in plan["frozen_files"]:
        if reference(ref["path"]) != ref:
            raise ValueError(f"Changed frozen audit input: {ref['path']}")


def definition(path, name):
    node = next(
        n for n in ast.parse(Path(path).read_text()).body if getattr(n, "name", None) == name
    )
    return ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)


class SelectionStop(Exception):
    def __init__(self, caller, family):
        assert caller.f_code is CleanDataset.__getitem__.__code__
        values = caller.f_locals
        region = values.get("region")
        self.row = {
            "index": values["index"],
            "family": family,
            "source_id": values["record"]["id"] if family == "photographic" else "",
            "reviewed": region is not None,
        }
        self.rng_state = values["rng"].getstate()


def stop_photo(*args, **kwargs):
    raise SelectionStop(inspect.currentframe().f_back, "photographic")


def stop_family(family):
    def stop(*args, **kwargs):
        selected = "fine-weak-texture" if kwargs.get("frequency_profile") == "fine-v1" else family
        raise SelectionStop(inspect.currentframe().f_back, selected)

    return stop


def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError("Neural execution is forbidden in a source-selection audit")


def summarize(counts, visits, ordinary, reviewed, available):
    total_photos = sum(visits.values())
    entropy = -sum((n / total_photos) * math.log(n / total_photos) for n in visits.values())
    histogram = Counter(visits.values())
    histogram[0] = available - len(visits)
    return {
        "families": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
        "photographic_draws": total_photos,
        "reviewed_draws": sum(reviewed.values()),
        "ordinary_draws": sum(ordinary.values()),
        "unique_photographic_sources": len(visits),
        "unique_ordinary_sources": len(ordinary),
        "unique_reviewed_sources": len(reviewed),
        "available_training_sources": available,
        "source_coverage_percent": 100 * len(visits) / available,
        "source_identity_entropy_effective_count": math.exp(entropy),
        "visits_histogram_including_unvisited": dict(sorted(histogram.items())),
        "reviewed_visits_by_source": dict(sorted(reviewed.items())),
        "ordinary_max_visits": max(ordinary.values(), default=0),
        "reviewed_min_max_visits": [min(reviewed.values()), max(reviewed.values())]
        if reviewed
        else [],
    }


def audit_recipe(recipe, plan, output):
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(recipe["config"]).read_text())
    label = recipe["label"]
    assert config["steps"] == 20000 and config["batch_size"] == 16
    assert config.get("optimizer_batch_groups", 1) == 1
    assert config["augmentation_downsample"] == 2
    source_root = Path(recipe["executed_source_root"])
    functions = {
        "data.py": ["CleanDataset"],
        "photo_sampling.py": ["PhotoSamplingReference"],
        "reviewed_rois.py": ["ReviewedPhotoROIs"],
        "train.py": ["training_domain", "domain_indices"],
        "paired_training.py": ["paired_step"],
        "raw_clean.py": ["raw_clean_step"],
    }
    for filename, names in functions.items():
        for name in names:
            assert definition(source_root / filename, name) == definition(
                Path(data_module.__file__).parent / filename, name
            ), (label, filename, name)

    keys = [
        "patch_size",
        "synthetic_fraction",
        "seed",
        "flat_fraction",
        "augmentation_downsample",
        "weak_texture_fraction",
        "flat_chroma_stops",
        "optical_blur_probability",
        "photographic_low_contrast_fraction",
        "reviewed_roi_catalogue",
        "reviewed_roi_fraction",
        "reviewed_roi_catalogue_sha256",
        "fine_weak_texture_fraction",
        "photo_sampling_reference_manifest",
        "photo_sampling_reference_sha256",
    ]
    reader = CleanDataset(config["manifest"], **{k: config[k] for k in keys if k in config})
    active = {row["id"] for row in reader.rows}
    catalogue = read(config["reviewed_roi_catalogue"])
    bank = [row["id"] for row in catalogue["examples"]]
    initial_ids = [
        json.loads(line)["id"]
        for line in Path(config["photo_sampling_reference_manifest"]).read_text().splitlines()
        if json.loads(line)["split"] == "train"
    ]
    fractions = sorted(set(plan["counterfactual_fractions"] + [config["reviewed_roi_fraction"]]))
    counters = {f: [Counter(), Counter(), Counter(), Counter()] for f in fractions}
    traced = {}
    for line in (
        Path(recipe["trace_prefix"]).read_text().splitlines() if recipe.get("trace_prefix") else []
    ):
        record = json.loads(line)
        index = record["source"]["draw_index"]
        assert record["data_step"] == index // 16 + 1
        assert index not in traced
        traced[index] = record
    trace_matches = 0
    domains, cumulative = Counter(), []
    audit_rows = 0
    path = output / f"{label}-metadata-draws.csv"
    with (
        path.open("w", newline="") as stream,
        patch.object(np, "load", stop_photo),
        patch.object(data_module, "smooth_scene", stop_family("smooth-field")),
        patch.object(data_module, "synthetic", stop_family("procedural")),
        patch.object(data_module, "weak_texture", stop_family("weak-texture")),
        patch.object(torch.nn.Module, "_call_impl", forbidden),
    ):
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            stream,
            fieldnames=["step", "index", "family", "source_id", "reviewed"],
            lineterminator="\n",
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        for step in range(1, config["steps"] + 1):
            seed = config["seed"]
            paired, native = config["paired_fraction"], config["raw_clean_fraction"]
            domain = (
                "paired"
                if random.Random(f"paired:{seed}:{step}").random() < paired
                else (
                    "native"
                    if random.Random(f"raw-clean:{seed}:{step}").random() < native / (1 - paired)
                    else "commons"
                )
            )
            assert domain == training_domain(step, seed, paired, native)
            domains[domain] += 1
            if domain == "commons":
                for index in range((step - 1) * 16, step * 16):
                    rng = random.Random(seed + index)
                    draw = rng.random()
                    family = (
                        "smooth-field"
                        if draw < config["flat_fraction"]
                        else (
                            "fine-weak-texture"
                            if draw
                            < config["flat_fraction"] + config.get("fine_weak_texture_fraction", 0)
                            else (
                                "weak-texture"
                                if draw < config["flat_fraction"] + config["weak_texture_fraction"]
                                else (
                                    "procedural"
                                    if draw < config["flat_fraction"] + config["synthetic_fraction"]
                                    else "photographic"
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    identity, reviewed = "", False
                    if family == "photographic":
                        initial = initial_ids[rng.randrange(len(initial_ids))]
                        digest = hashlib.sha256(
                            f"reviewed-photo-roi-v1:{seed}:{index}".encode()
                        ).digest()
                        bank_rng = random.Random(int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "little"))
                        gate = bank_rng.random()
                        bank_id = bank[bank_rng.randrange(len(bank))]
                        ordinary_rng = random.Random()
                        ordinary_rng.setstate(rng.getstate())
                        ordinary_id = initial
                        while ordinary_id not in active:
                            ordinary_id = initial_ids[ordinary_rng.randrange(len(initial_ids))]
                        for fraction, (types, visits, ordinary, region) in counters.items():
                            selected = gate < fraction
                            selected_id = bank_id if selected else ordinary_id
                            types[
                                "photographic-reviewed" if selected else "photographic-ordinary"
                            ] += 1
                            visits[selected_id] += 1
                            (region if selected else ordinary)[selected_id] += 1
                        reviewed = gate < config["reviewed_roi_fraction"]
                        identity = bank_id if reviewed else ordinary_id
                        if not reviewed:
                            rng.setstate(ordinary_rng.getstate())
                    else:
                        for types, _, _, _ in counters.values():
                            types[family] += 1
                    expected = {
                        "index": index,
                        "family": family,
                        "source_id": identity,
                        "reviewed": reviewed,
                    }
                    try:
                        reader[index]
                    except SelectionStop as actual:
                        assert actual.row == expected, (label, step, actual.row, expected)
                        assert actual.rng_state == rng.getstate(), (label, index, "local RNG")
                    else:
                        raise AssertionError("Reader continued beyond the metadata stop")
                    writer.writerow({"step": step, **expected})
                    audit_rows += 1
                    if index in traced:
                        source = traced[index]["source"]
                        assert source["kind"] == family
                        if identity:
                            assert source["source_id"] == identity
                            assert (source["reviewed_roi_xywh"] is not None) == reviewed
                        trace_matches += 1
            if step % 1000 == 0:
                cumulative.append(
                    {
                        "step": step,
                        "fractions": {
                            str(f): {
                                "unique_sources": len(values[1]),
                                "photographic_draws": sum(values[1].values()),
                            }
                            for f, values in counters.items()
                        },
                    }
                )
    assert trace_matches == len(traced)
    summaries = {str(f): summarize(*values, len(active)) for f, values in counters.items()}
    return {
        "label": label,
        "config": reference(recipe["config"]),
        "seed": config["seed"],
        "steps": config["steps"],
        "batch_size": 16,
        "actual_reviewed_fraction": config["reviewed_roi_fraction"],
        "bank_regions": len(bank),
        "noise_pair_draws": config.get("noise_pair_draws", 1),
        "domain_batches": dict(domains),
        "source_context_slots": 16 * sum(domains.values()),
        "actual_reader_metadata_stops": audit_rows,
        "actual_trace_rows_matched": trace_matches,
        "draws": reference(path),
        "fraction_summaries": summaries,
        "cumulative": cumulative,
        "constructor_reviewed_cache_checks": len(bank),
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    plan = read(args.plan)
    guard(plan)
    output = Path(plan["output"])
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    state = random.getstate(), np.random.get_state(), torch.get_rng_state()
    results = [audit_recipe(recipe, plan, output) for recipe in plan["recipes"]]
    assert state[0] == random.getstate()
    now = np.random.get_state()
    assert state[1][0] == now[0] and np.array_equal(state[1][1], now[1]) and state[1][2:] == now[2:]
    assert torch.equal(state[2], torch.get_rng_state()) and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    guard(plan)
    result = {
        "status": "passed-full-schedule-actual-reader-metadata-and-independent-selection",
        "plan": reference(args.plan),
        "recipes": results,
        "global_Python_NumPy_Torch_RNG_unchanged": True,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "new_training_targets": 0,
        "geometry_augmentations": 0,
        "neural_forwards": 0,
        "noise_observations": 0,
        "RAW_decodes": 0,
        "optimizer_updates": 0,
        "scope": "Full prospective source schedules; actual execution validated only at saved trace rows. Source identity repetition is not repeated augmented pixels. Counterfactual fractions are metadata only, not quality outcomes. Constructor checks read the original reviewed caches.",
    }
    (output / "result-v1.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "status": result["status"],
                "recipes": [
                    {
                        "label": row["label"],
                        "stops": row["actual_reader_metadata_stops"],
                        "trace_matches": row["actual_trace_rows_matched"],
                        "actual": row["fraction_summaries"][str(row["actual_reviewed_fraction"])],
                    }
                    for row in results
                ],
            },
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                n: int(p.grad.count_nonzero())
                for n, p in model.named_parameters()
                if p.requires_grad and p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
            }
            assert len(gradients) == 142 and all(v > 0 for v in gradients.values())
            assert all(p.grad is None for p in model.frozen.parameters())
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                (p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad), 1, error_if_nonfinite=True
            )
            optimizer.step()
            decay = update_matching_ema(model, ema, total_updates=900 + update, maximum_decay=0.999)
            clocks = adam_clocks(model, optimizer)
            assert clocks["network"]["steps"] == [float(900 + update)] and clocks["adapter"][
                "steps"
            ] == [float(update)]
            assert model_hash(model.frozen) == frozen
            record = {
                "update": update,
                "case": case["id"],
                "arrays": case["arrays"],
                "parent": case["parent"],
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "terms": {k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
                "mask_pixels": int(mask.sum()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "nonzero_gradients": gradients,
                "EMA_decay": decay,
                "Adam_clocks": clocks,
                "model_hash": model_hash(model),
                "CPU_GPU_loss_difference": abs(
                    float(terms["flat_spatial"].detach()) - float(cpu_loss.detach())
                ),
                "CPU_GPU_gradient_maximum_difference": float((gpu_grad - cpu_grad).abs().max()),
                "native_gradient_coordinates": cpu_grad.numel(),
                "counts": dict(counts),
            }
            records.append(record)
            save(ROOT / f"update-{update}-v1.json", record)
            path = EXTERNAL / f"probe-step{update}.pt"
            payload = {
                "models": model.state_dict(),
                "ema": ema,
                "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                "initial_updates": 900,
                "updates": update,
                "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                "component": type(model).__name__,
                "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                "scope": "Loss probe only,not training initializer",
            }
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(payload, stream)
            checkpoints.append(ref(path))
            del (
                output,
                aux,
                loss,
                terms,
                mask,
                reference,
                cpu_loss,
                cpu_grad,
                gpu_grad,
                batch,
                base,
                pair_units,
                payload,
            )
            if update == 1:
                saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                del model, optimizer
                gc.collect()
                model = instrument(
                    factory("evidence", plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts
                ).train()
                optimizer, ema, restored = restore_matching_state(
                    model, saved, lr=1e-4, weight_decay=0.01
                )
                assert model_hash(model) == record["model_hash"] and all(
                    restored[k]
                    for k in [
                        "model_loaded_strictly",
                        "Adam_exact",
                        "EMA_exact",
                        "CPU_RNG_exact",
                        "CUDA_RNG_exact",
                    ]
                )
                save(
                    ROOT / "restoration-v1.json",
                    dict(restored, checkpoint=ref(path), repeated_prefix_forwards=0),
                )
                del saved
        assert counts == {"wrapper": 2, "frozen": 2, "network": 2, "sampler": 10, "projection": 2}
        guard(plan)
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "pass-V181-flat-spatial-CUDA-native-gradients-FP32-total-and-restoration",
                "owner": owner,
                "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                "records": records,
                "checkpoints": checkpoints,
                "counts": counts,
                "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "new_noise_draws": 0,
                "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
                "protected_optimizer_inputs": 0,
                "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
                "scope": plan["scope"],
            },
        )
        print(
            "PASS two real native updates/FP32 totals/CPU-GPU loss+gradients/genuine warm restoration;no quality claim"
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            ROOT / "admission-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "owner": owner,
                "error": repr(error),
                "counts": counts,
                "completed_updates": len(records),
                "scope": "Preserved failure,no automatic retry",

        )

    modules = sorted(p.name for p in (work / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))
    old_modules = sorted(p.name for p in (Path(previous["work"]) / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))
    assert modules == old_modules and len(modules) == 47
    differences = [
        name for name in modules
        if ref(work / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"]
        != ref(Path(previous["work"]) / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"]
    ]
    assert differences == ["train.py"]
    config_source = REPO / "configs/dino-convnext-late-rgb-head-only-v92.yaml"

    old_cfg = yaml.safe_load(Path(previous["arms"][0]["config"]).read_text())

    } == {k: v for k, v in old_cfg.items() if k not in ["run", "experiment_notes", "validation_protocol"]} | {
        "validation_protocol": "configs/evaluation.yaml"
    }
    assert cfg["late_rgb_only"] is True and cfg["model"]["late_rgb_refinement"] == "global"
    cfg["run"] = str(work / "runs/control")
    cfg["validation_protocol"] = str(work / "configs/evaluation.yaml")

def restart_plan(plan, result, *, resume=False):
    root = Path(plan["root"]) / ("fresh8plus8" if resume else "first8")
    root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["arms"][0]["config"]).read_text())
    cfg["run"] = str(root / "run")
    config = root / "config.yaml"
    config.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg, sort_keys=True))
    child_plan = copy.deepcopy(plan)
    child_plan.update(
        root=str(root), boundary_updates=16 if resume else 8,
        arms=[{"name": "control", "late_rgb_mode": "global", "config": str(config), "run": cfg["run"]}],
    )
    child_plan["inputs"].append(ref(config))
    if resume:
        prior = read(result)
        assert prior["actual_step"] == 8
        run = Path(cfg["run"])
        run.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(prior["metrics"]["path"], run / "metrics.jsonl")
        child_plan["resume"] = {"control": {
            "checkpoint": prior["checkpoint"], "observations": prior["observations"], "step": 8,
        }}
        child_plan["inputs"] += [ref(result), prior["checkpoint"], prior["observations"]]
    path = root / "plan.json"
    guard(child_plan)
    save(path, child_plan)
    return path


def run(plan_path):
    plan_path = Path(plan_path).resolve()
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["helper"]
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    status = {"plan": ref(plan_path), "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}}

    def record(value, **fields):
        status.update(status=value, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        save(root / "status.json", status)
        print(json.dumps({"status": value, "stage": status.get("stage")}), flush=True)

    def resources():
        return (
            psutil.virtual_memory().available / 2**30,
            shutil.disk_usage(plan["repository"]).free / 2**30,
            shutil.disk_usage(root).free / 2**30,
        )

    child = None

    def launch(path, stage):
        nonlocal child
        current = read(path)
        guard(current)
        record("waiting-for-head-only-resources", stage=stage)
        since, deadline = None, time.monotonic() + plan["timeout_seconds"]
        while True:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "Head-only resource wait exhausted; no retry"
            if resources_allow(plan, *resources(), launch=True):
                since = time.monotonic() if since is None else since
                if time.monotonic() - since >= plan["stable_seconds"]:
                    break
            else:
                since = None
            time.sleep(5)
        env = dict(os.environ, **plan["cache_environment"])
        env.update(
            PYTHONPATH=str(Path(plan["work"]) / "src") + ":" + str(Path(plan["work"]) / "scripts"),
            HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1", TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" if plan["device"] == "cpu" else "0",
            CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8", OMP_NUM_THREADS="2", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="2",
        )
        with (Path(current["root"]) / "worker.log").open("xb") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen(
                [plan["python"], "-P", plan["worker"]["path"], "worker", str(path), "--arm", "control"],
                cwd=plan["work"], env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
            )
            owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            record("running-source-frozen-head-only-worker", child=owner)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + plan["timeout_seconds"]
            while child.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic() > deadline or not resources_allow(plan, *resources()):
                    raise RuntimeError("Head-only runtime/resource bound reached; no retry")
                time.sleep(5)
            assert child.wait() == 0, stage
        return Path(current["root"]) / "control-result.json"

    try:
        actual_result = launch(plan_path, "uninterrupted")
        if plan["engineering_only"]:
            first = launch(restart_plan(plan, None), "first-eight")
            fresh = launch(restart_plan(plan, first, resume=True), "fresh-process-eight-to-sixteen")
        import torch
        from audit_flat_palette import identical

        actual = read(actual_result)
        assert actual["common_model_and_EMA_exact_parent"] and actual["common_backward_absent"]
        state = torch.load(actual["checkpoint"]["path"], weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
        historical = read(plan["historical_preflight" if plan["engineering_only"] else "historical_control"]["path"])
        assert read(actual["observations"]["path"]) == read(historical["observations"]["path"])
        assert actual["captures"][0]["initial_model_sha256"] == historical["captures"][0]["initial_model_sha256"]
        for x, y in zip(actual["logged_observations"], historical["logged_observations"], strict=True):
            assert all(x[k] == y[k] for k in ["step", "domain", "lr", "batch_sha256"])
        old_state = torch.load(historical["checkpoint"]["path"], weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
        for key in ["python_rng", "torch_rng", "cuda_rng"]:
            identical(state[key], old_state[key])
        if plan["engineering_only"]:
            restarted = read(fresh)
            other = torch.load(restarted["checkpoint"]["path"], weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
            keys = ["model", "ema", "optimizer", "python_rng", "torch_rng", "cuda_rng", "best", "step", "model_config"]
            for key in keys:
                identical(state[key], other[key])
            assert read(actual["observations"]["path"]) == read(restarted["observations"]["path"])
            assert actual["source_sha256"] == restarted["source_sha256"]
            assert restarted["common_model_and_EMA_exact_parent"]
            assert restarted["common_backward_absent"]
        guard(plan)
        record(
            COMPLETE if plan["engineering_only"] else "completed-original4000-head-only-awaiting-full-quality-and-native-review",
            result=ref(actual_result), fresh_process_result=ref(fresh) if plan["engineering_only"] else None,
            exact_common_model_and_EMA=True, matched_original_inputs_LRs_and_RNG=True,
            fresh_process_all_state_exact=True if plan["engineering_only"] else None,
            engineering_only=plan["engineering_only"],
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            assert alive(status["child"]) and os.getpgid(child.pid) == child.pid
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        record("failed-head-only-study-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="mode", required=True)
    p = commands.add_parser("prepare")
    p.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--device", choices=["cpu", "cuda"], required=True)
    p.add_argument("--cpu", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--cuda", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--full", action="store_true")
    p = commands.add_parser("run")
    p.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        prepare(args.root, args.device, cpu=args.cpu, cuda=args.cuda, full=args.full)
    else:
        run(args.plan)
