def worker(root):
    plan_path = root / "plan-v1.json"
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["worker"]
    (root / "worker.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30
    saved = torch.load(plan["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    module = LateSpectralMatrixDetail(**saved["module_config"]).cuda().eval()
    module.load_state_dict(saved["state_dict"], strict=True)
    training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
    assert (
        Path(module.forward.__code__.co_filename)
        .resolve()
        .is_relative_to(Path(training["work"]) / "src")
    )
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    initial = model_hash(module)
    old = {o["id"]: o for o in read(plan["collection"]["path"])["observations"]}
    count = [0]
    module.register_forward_hook(lambda *args: count.__setitem__(0, count[0] + 1))
    for mode in MODES:
        (root / mode).mkdir()
    journal = (root / "trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")
    observations = []
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for index, case in enumerate(plan["cases"]):
            assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
            assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            assert ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
            a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
            batch = {
                k: torch.from_numpy(a[k]).cuda() for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")
            }
            base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"])).cuda()
            output, aux = module(base, **batch, return_aux=True)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                output.cpu().numpy(), np.load(old[case["id"]]["prediction"]["path"])
            )
            target = torch.from_numpy(a["target"]).cuda()
            observed, geometry = module.analysis(batch["packed"])
            desired, _ = module.analysis(mosaic(target, batch["colors"]), geometry[4])
            desired -= aux["parent_spectrum"]
            innovation = observed - aux["parent_spectrum"]
            layouts = batch["colors"][:, None].expand(-1, geometry[5], -1).reshape(-1, 4)
            descriptor = frequency_descriptor(observed, aux["noise_power"], layouts)
            band = getattr(module, f"band_{geometry[4]}")
            cap = descriptor[:, :4].sum(1, keepdim=True) * band
            scalar, matrix, relaxed, H = coefficient_witnesses(innovation, desired, cap)
            absolute = H.abs()
            bound = (absolute.sum(1).amax(1) * absolute.sum(2).amax(1)).sqrt()
            assert bound.max() <= 1 + 2e-6
            assert torch.isfinite(H).all()
            del H, absolute, output
            fields = {
                "scalar": scalar,
                "matrix": matrix,
                "L2": relaxed,
                "band": desired * band,
                "unbanded": desired,
            }
            proposals = {k: module.synthesis(v, geometry) for k, v in fields.items()}
            full_matrix = malvar(proposals["matrix"], batch["colors"], batch["wb"])
            alpha = image_alpha(base, target, full_matrix)
            predictions = {}
            for label in MODES:
                if "image-alpha" in label:
                    correction = full_matrix * alpha
                else:
                    key = (
                        "scalar"
                        if "scalar" in label
                        else "matrix"
                        if "matrix" in label
                        else "L2"
                        if "L2" in label
                        else "unbanded"
                        if "unbanded" in label
                        else "band"
                    )
                    proposal = proposals[key]
                    if "frozen-support" in label:
                        proposal = proposal * aux["support"]
                    correction = malvar(proposal, batch["colors"], batch["wb"])
                value = (base + correction).cpu().numpy()
                assert value.dtype == np.float32 and np.isfinite(value).all()
                dest = root / label / f"prediction-{index:03d}.npy"
                np.save(dest, value)
                predictions[label] = ref(dest)
            row = {
                "id": case["id"],
                "index": index,
                "predictions": predictions,
                "replayed_prediction_exact": True,
                "component_forwards": 1,
                "frozen_support_mean": float(aux["support"].mean()),
                "image_alpha": alpha,
                "maximum_matrix_gauge": float(bound.max()),
                "coefficient_squared_error": {
                    k: float((v - desired).abs().square().sum()) for k, v in fields.items()
                },
                "parent_coefficient_squared_error": float(desired.abs().square().sum()),
                "learned_coefficient_squared_error": float(
                    (aux["spectral_delta"] - desired).abs().square().sum()
                ),
            }
            observations.append(row)
            import json

            journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            journal.flush()
            if index % 16 == 0:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {
                        "status": "running-fixed-oracle-diagnostic",
                        "done": index + 1,
                        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
                        "plan": ref(plan_path),
                    },
                )
                print("completed", index + 1, "of792", flush=True)
            del (
                a,
                batch,
                base,
                aux,
                target,
                observed,
                desired,
                innovation,
                layouts,
                descriptor,
                cap,
                scalar,
                matrix,
                relaxed,
                fields,
                proposals,
                full_matrix,
                correction,
                value,
                proposal,
                bound,
            )
    assert count[0] == 792 and model_hash(module) == initial
    assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-GT-using-diagnostic-awaiting-array-audit-native-review",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "worker": ref(__file__),
            "observations": observations,
            "new_component_forwards": count[0],
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "model_before": initial,
            "model_after": model_hash(module),
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    save(
        root / "status-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-fixed-oracle-diagnostic",
            "result": ref(root / "result-v1.json"),

"""Freeze the held-out DSCF3842/3835 mesh case from cached RAWs and camera JPEGs."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from PIL import Image, ImageCms, ImageOps
from prepare_gfx_highlight_inputs import integer_offset

from demosaic.cfa import color_indices, malvar, pack
from demosaic.color import render
from demosaic.io import read_raw
from demosaic.realdata import read_reference
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def binding(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def camera_jpeg(path):
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 120_000_000
    with Image.open(path) as image:
        image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(image)
        profile = image.info.get("icc_profile")
        image = image.convert("RGB")
        if profile:
            image = ImageCms.profileToProfile(
                image,
                ImageCms.ImageCmsProfile(io.BytesIO(profile)),
                ImageCms.createProfile("sRGB"),
                outputMode="RGB",
            )
        return image.copy()


def green(values, wb, matrix):
    return render(values, wb, matrix)[0, 1].numpy()


def jpeg_offset(anchor, image, x, y):
    """Coarse area8 NCC only selects coordinates; native pixels are never warped."""
    size, radius, factor = anchor.shape[0], 128, 8
    window = np.asarray(image.crop((x - radius, y - radius, x + size + radius, y + size + radius)))
    full = window[:, :, 1].astype(np.float32) / 255
    coarse_a = anchor.reshape(size // factor, factor, size // factor, factor).mean((1, 3))
    side = (size + 2 * radius) // factor
    coarse_b = full.reshape(side, factor, side, factor).mean((1, 3))
    cx, cy, coarse_score = integer_offset(
        coarse_a, coarse_b, radius // factor, radius // factor, radius=radius // factor
    )
    fx, fy, score = integer_offset(
        anchor, full, radius + cx * factor, radius + cy * factor, radius=16
    )
    return cx * factor + fx, cy * factor + fy, score, coarse_score


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(selection, output, decoded=None):
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    selection = Path(selection).resolve()
    plan = json.loads(selection.read_text())
    paths = {}
    for role, item in plan["sources"].items():
        path = Path(item["path"]).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(Path.cwd() / ".cache")
        assert binding(path)["sha256"] == item["sha256"]
        paths[role] = path
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    save(
        output / "execution-plan-v1.json",
        {
            "selection": binding(selection),
            "driver": binding(__file__),
            "registration_helper": binding(
                Path(__file__).with_name("prepare_gfx_highlight_inputs.py")
            ),
            "sources": {k: binding(v) for k, v in paths.items()},
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "scope": "New held-out green-mesh inputs only; no training/model/noise generation or full-frame model restoration.",
        },
    )
    x, y, size, height = plan["raw_context_xywh"]
    assert x % 2 == y % 2 == 0 and size == height == 768
    if decoded:
        from demosaic.io import RawMetadata

        previous = json.loads(Path(decoded).read_text())
        assert previous["source_bindings"] == {k: binding(v) for k, v in paths.items()}
        assert previous["context_xywh"] == plan["raw_context_xywh"]
        assert binding(previous["arrays"]["path"]) == previous["arrays"]
        with np.load(previous["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as stored:
            raw_context = stored["raw_context"].copy()
            reference = stored["reference_window"].copy()
        metadata = RawMetadata(**previous["metadata"])
        ref_metadata = RawMetadata(**previous["reference_metadata"])
        calibration = previous["reference_calibration"]
        decoder_opens = 0
    else:
        raw, metadata = read_raw(paths["noisy"])
        ref_raw, reference, ref_metadata, calibration = read_reference(paths["reference"])
        assert raw.shape == ref_raw.shape == (8746, 11662)
        raw_context = raw[y : y + size, x : x + size].copy()
        reference = reference[y - 128 : y + size + 128, x - 128 : x + size + 128].copy()
        del raw, ref_raw
        decoder_opens = 3
    assert metadata.iso == 6400 and ref_metadata.iso == 100
    assert metadata.pattern == ref_metadata.pattern == "RGGB"
    decoded_path = output / "decoded-contexts-v1.npz"
    np.savez(decoded_path, raw_context=raw_context, reference_window=reference)
    save(
        output / "decoded-contexts-v1.json",
        {
            "arrays": binding(decoded_path),
            "metadata": asdict(metadata),
            "reference_metadata": asdict(ref_metadata),
            "reference_calibration": calibration,
            "source_bindings": {k: binding(v) for k, v in paths.items()},
            "context_xywh": plan["raw_context_xywh"],
            "RAW_decoder_opens": decoder_opens,
        },
    )
    packed = pack(torch.from_numpy(raw_context)[None, None])
    wb = torch.tensor(metadata.white_balance)[None]
    matrix = torch.tensor(metadata.camera_to_srgb)[None]
    colors = color_indices(metadata.pattern)[None]
    noisy = malvar(packed, colors, wb)
    # Match the two independent captures using input/reference only.
    dx, dy, score = integer_offset(noisy[0, 1].numpy(), reference[:, :, 1], 128, 128, radius=16)
    reference_context = reference[128 + dy : 128 + dy + size, 128 + dx : 128 + dx + size].copy()
    del reference
    reference_tensor = torch.from_numpy(reference_context).permute(2, 0, 1)[None]
    registrations = {"reference_RAW_minus_noisy_RAW_xy": [dx, dy], "reference_RAW_green_NCC": score}
    images = {}
    offsets = {}
    for role, rgb in [("noisy_camera_jpeg", noisy), ("reference_camera_jpeg", reference_tensor)]:
        im = camera_jpeg(paths[role])
        # The expected central crop is14x10 pixels smaller than visible RAW.
        bx, by = x - (11662 - im.width) // 2, y - (8746 - im.height) // 2
        anchor = green(rgb, wb, matrix)
        ox, oy, corr, coarse_corr = jpeg_offset(anchor, im, bx, by)
        offsets[role] = [bx + ox - x, by + oy - y]
        images[role] = im
        registrations[role] = {
            "JPEG_context_minus_noisy_context_xy": offsets[role],
            "JPEG_context_origin_xy": [bx + ox, by + oy],
            "green_NCC": corr,
            "coarse_area8_green_NCC": coarse_corr,
            "raw_anchor_xy": [
                x + (dx if role.startswith("reference") else 0),
                y + (dy if role.startswith("reference") else 0),
            ],
            "note": "Integer coordinates only. Residual lens/camera-pipeline geometry and radiometry differences remain.",
        }
    # reference_tensor is at [x+dx,y+dy], but its JPEG search above starts at x,y;
    # its returned offset already maps that specific reference context to JPEG.
    arrays = output / "inputs-v1.npz"
    condition = plan["conditioning"]
    variance = packed.clamp_min(0) * condition["shot"] + condition["read"]
    np.savez(
        arrays,
        packed=packed.numpy(),
        variance=variance.numpy(),
        colors=colors.numpy(),
        wb=wb.numpy(),
        matrix=matrix.numpy(),
        noisy_rgb=noisy.numpy(),
        reference_rgb=reference_tensor.numpy(),
        raw_context=raw_context,
    )
    records = []
    for region in plan["regions"]:
        jx, jy = region["noisy_camera_jpeg_xy"]
        edge = region["size"]
        nx, ny = jx - offsets["noisy_camera_jpeg"][0], jy - offsets["noisy_camera_jpeg"][1]
        roi = [nx - x, ny - y, edge, edge]
        assert min(roi[:2]) >= 64 and roi[0] + edge <= size - 64 and roi[1] + edge <= size - 64
        rx, ry = nx + dx, ny + dy
        # reference JPEG offset above is relative to context origin x,y,
        # so apply it to the within-context region, without adding dx/dy twice.
        rjx, rjy = (
            nx + offsets["reference_camera_jpeg"][0],
            ny + offsets["reference_camera_jpeg"][1],
        )
        previews = {}
        for role, cx, cy in [("noisy_camera_jpeg", jx, jy), ("reference_camera_jpeg", rjx, rjy)]:
            pixels = np.asarray(images[role].crop((cx, cy, cx + edge, cy + edge))).copy()
            file = output / (region["name"] + "-" + role + "-native.npy")
            np.save(file, pixels, allow_pickle=False)
            previews[role] = {
                "pixels": binding(file),
                "xywh": [cx, cy, edge, edge],
                "scope": "Native camera-rendered sRGB8 pixels; no resizing/warping.",
            }
        records.append(
            {
                "name": region["name"],
                "ROI_xywh": roi,
                "noisy_raw_xywh": [nx, ny, edge, edge],
                "reference_raw_xywh": [rx, ry, edge, edge],
                "camera_JPEGs": previews,
            }
        )
    derived = {
        **plan,
        "regions": records,
        "registrations": registrations,
        "raw_metadata": asdict(metadata),
        "reference_metadata": asdict(ref_metadata),
        "reference_AHD_calibration": calibration,
    }
    save(output / "selection-derived-v1.json", derived)
    result = {
        "status": "prepared-new-DSCF3842-3835-green-mesh-inputs-no-model-work",
        "selection": binding(selection),
        "derived_selection": binding(output / "selection-derived-v1.json"),
        "input_arrays": binding(arrays),
        "context_shape": [1, 3, size, size],
        "conditioning": condition,
        "display_exposure": plan["display_exposure"],
        "cases": records,
        "registrations": registrations,
        "source_bindings": {k: binding(v) for k, v in paths.items()},
        "new_neural_forwards": 0,
        "new_noise_observations": 0,
        "RAW_decoder_opens": decoder_opens,
        "optimizer_updates": 0,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "scope": "New768 context and two native160 ROIs fixed from source/camera JPEGs only. ISO100 AHD and cameraJPEGs are qualitative comparators, not GT. Same noisy WB/matrix used for raw-method displays. Standing3879/3880 and all training unchanged.",
    }
    save(output / "result-v1.json", result)
    print(json.dumps({"status": result["status"], "registrations": registrations}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("selection", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--decoded",
        type=Path,
        help="Reuse a preserved decoded-contexts JSON after an alignment-only failure",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.selection, args.output, args.decoded)

"""Run two frozen mature-parent objective arms to their first1000 boundary."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def ref(path):
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": sha(path)}


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def guard(plan):
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert sha(item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    for path, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert sha(path) == digest, path


def worker(plan_path, arm_name):
    import torch
    from audit_flat_palette import train_rows
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    import demosaic.train as training

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    arm = next(a for a in plan["arms"] if a["name"] == arm_name)
    with (root / (arm_name + ".claim")).open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 128 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 500 * 2**30
    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    quota = min(torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device),
                24 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(quota, device)
    parent = torch.load(plan["parent"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    constructor = training.JointDemosaic
    prepare = training.prepare_training_batch
    capture, first16 = {}, []

    def instrument(options):
        model = constructor(options)
        capture["model"] = model

        def first_forward(module, args):
            for name, value in module.restoration_state_dict().items():
                assert torch.equal(value.cpu(), parent["ema"][name]), name
            capture["initial_EMA_exact"] = True
            capture["DINO_sha256"] = model_hash(module.context.backbone)
            hook.remove()

        hook = model.register_forward_pre_hook(first_forward)
        return model

    def observe(*args, **kwargs):
        batch = prepare(*args, **kwargs)
        if args[0] <= 16:
            first16.append({"step": args[0], "domain": args[1],
                            "batch_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(batch)})
            if len(first16) == 16:
                save(root / (arm_name + "-first16.json"), first16)
        return batch

    training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = instrument, observe
    try:
        checkpoint = training.train(arm["config"], initialize=plan["parent"]["path"],
                                    stop_after=1000)
    finally:
        training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = constructor, prepare
    model = capture.pop("model")
    assert capture["DINO_sha256"] == model_hash(model.context.backbone)
    assert all(not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
    state = torch.load(checkpoint, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
    assert state["step"] == 1000 and state["config"]["steps"] == 4000
    assert state["config"]["reconstruction_objective"] == arm["objective"]
    assert state["config"]["manifest_sha256"] == plan["training_manifest_sha256"]
    assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    for field in ["model", "ema"]:
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[field].values())
    for values in state["optimizer"]["state"].values():
        assert int(values["step"]) == 1000
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor))
    rows = train_rows(Path(checkpoint).parent)
    assert [r["step"] for r in rows] == [1, *range(25, 1001, 25)]
    assert len(first16) == 16
    guard(plan)
    result = {"status": "completed-one-objective-first1000-awaiting-quality-review",
              "arm": arm_name, "checkpoint": ref(checkpoint), "capture": capture,
              "metrics": ref(Path(checkpoint).parent / "metrics.jsonl"),
              "first16": ref(root / (arm_name + "-first16.json")),
              "finite_states": {"model": 91, "EMA": 91, "AdamW": 89},
              "logged_observations": rows, "source_sha256": state["config"]["source_sha256"],
              "actual_step": 1000, "planned_steps": 4000,
              "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}}
    save(root / (arm_name + "-result.json"), result)


def controller(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    info = {"controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "plan": ref(plan_path), "completed": {}}

    def record(status, **values):
        info.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        save(root / "status.json", info)
        print(json.dumps({"status": status, "arm": info.get("arm")}), flush=True)

    try:
        record("starting-frozen-mature-objective-first1000-trial")
        for arm in plan["arms"]:
            guard(plan)
            env = dict(os.environ)
            env.update(PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join([str(Path(plan["work"]) / p)
                                                 for p in ["src", "scripts"]]),
                       HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"], HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1")
            with (root / (arm["name"] + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", plan["worker"]["path"], "worker", str(plan_path),
                     "--arm", arm["name"]], cwd=plan["work"], env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                identity = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-objective-first1000", arm=arm["name"], child=identity)
                try:
                    code = child.wait(timeout=plan["per_arm_timeout_seconds"])
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    # Terminate only this exact owned process group, including its data workers.
                    import signal
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    child.wait(timeout=30)
                    raise
            assert code == 0, f"{arm['name']} exited {code}"
            result_path = root / (arm["name"] + "-result.json")
            result = read(result_path)
            assert result["actual_step"] == 1000 and result["planned_steps"] == 4000
            info["completed"][arm["name"]] = ref(result_path)
            record("completed-one-objective-first1000", arm=arm["name"])
        a, b = [read(info["completed"][a["name"]]["path"]) for a in plan["arms"]]
        assert read(a["first16"]["path"]) == read(b["first16"]["path"])
        assert a["capture"] == b["capture"] and a["source_sha256"] == b["source_sha256"]
        for x, y in zip(a["logged_observations"], b["logged_observations"], strict=True):
            assert all(x[k] == y[k] for k in ["step", "domain", "lr", "batch_sha256"])
        guard(plan)
        record("completed-matched-objective-first1000-awaiting-full-quality-and-native-review",
               all41_logged_observations_and_first16_match=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-objective-trial-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["controller", "worker"])
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--arm", choices=["control", "logmse"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "controller":
        controller(args.plan)
    else:
        worker(args.plan, args.arm)

"""Test a lower photographic ROI quota against the existing full V131 control."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import random
import shutil
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_quality_recipes import REPO, controller
from train_quality_recipes import prepare as prepare_recipes

from train_v43_quality_trial import live

ARM = "V133"

CONTROL_CONTROLLER = (
    REPO / ".cache/current-quality-20261023-v1/raw-spatial-training-admission-v2/run"
)


def validate_recipes(candidate, control):
    ignored = {"run", "experiment_notes", "reviewed_roi_fraction"}
    assert {k: v for k, v in candidate.items() if k not in ignored} == {
        k: v for k, v in control.items() if k not in ignored
    }, "Quota comparison differs beyond the photographic quota"
    assert candidate["reviewed_roi_fraction"] == 0.05
    assert control["reviewed_roi_fraction"] == 0.5
    assert candidate["steps"] == 20000 and candidate["seed"] == 70
    assert candidate["batch_size"] == 16 and candidate["patch_size"] == 256
    assert candidate["precision"] == "bfloat16"
    assert candidate["checkpoint_every"] == 1000
    assert candidate["model"]["raw_spatial_features"] is False


def source_compatibility(candidate, original):
    """Permit exactly the early ROI resume check; valid training is unchanged."""
    a, b = Path(candidate).read_bytes(), Path(original).read_bytes()
    if a == b:
        return {"candidate": ref(candidate), "control": ref(original), "bytes_exact": True}
    assert Path(candidate).name == "train.py"
    early = b'        require_resume_rois(resume_state["config"], config)\n'
    late = b'        require_resume_rois(state["config"], config)\n'
    position = b'        require_resume_photo_sampling(state["config"], config)\n'
    assert a.count(early) == 1 and a.count(position) == 1
    assert a.replace(early, b"").replace(position, late + position) == b
    return {
        "candidate": ref(candidate),
        "control": ref(original),
        "bytes_exact": False,
        "only_change": "Move pure ROI resume compatibility check before model construction",
        "reversing_guard_relocation_restores_all_original_bytes": True,
    }


def unchanged_slots(config, step):
    """Compare the existing independent ROI gates without reading any pixels."""
    result = []
    for index in range((step - 1) * config["batch_size"], step * config["batch_size"]):
        if random.Random(config["seed"] + index).random() < (
            config["flat_fraction"] + config["synthetic_fraction"]
        ):
            result.append(True)
            continue
        payload = hashlib.sha256(
            f"reviewed-photo-roi-v1:{config['seed']}:{index}".encode()
        ).digest()
        gate = random.Random(int.from_bytes(payload[:8], "little")).random()
        result.append(gate < 0.05 or gate >= 0.5)
    return result


def checked_control(binding, phase):
    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    result = read(binding["path"])
    assert result["status"] == "completed-raw-spatial-training-phase"
    assert result["arm"] == "V131" and result["phase"] == phase
    assert result["updates"] == (20000 if phase == "train" else 18)
    assert result["all_AdamW_steps"] == result["updates"]
    assert result["model_EMA_Adam_finite"] and result["optimizer_state_count"] == 89
    assert result["model_EMA_tensor_count"] == 91
    assert len(result["observed_inputs"]) == result["updates"]
    assert not live(result["owner"])
    assert ref(result["checkpoint"]["path"]) == result["checkpoint"]
    return result

def compare_inputs(candidate, control, config):
    """Verify saved unaffected batches and real example tensors without NN calls."""
    import numpy as np

    assert len(candidate["observed_inputs"]) == len(control["observed_inputs"])
    counts = Counter()
    for actual, previous in zip(
        candidate["observed_inputs"], control["observed_inputs"], strict=True
    ):
        step, domain = actual["step"], actual["domain"]
        assert (step, domain) == (previous["step"], previous["domain"])
        mask = (
            unchanged_slots(config, step) if domain == "commons" else [True] * config["batch_size"]
        )
        counts[f"{domain}_steps"] += 1
        if all(mask):
            assert all(actual[k] == previous[k] for k in ("clean_sha256", "batch_sha256"))
            counts[f"{domain}_whole_batches_exact"] += 1
        else:
            counts["Commons_batches_with_expected_selection_changes"] += 1
        if step <= 18:
            assert ref(actual["prepared_tensors"]["path"]) == actual["prepared_tensors"]
            assert ref(previous["prepared_tensors"]["path"]) == previous["prepared_tensors"]
            with (
                np.load(actual["prepared_tensors"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as a,
                np.load(previous["prepared_tensors"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as b,
            ):
                assert set(a.files) == set(b.files)
                for key in a.files:
                    av, bv = a[key], b[key]
                    assert av.shape == bv.shape and av.dtype == bv.dtype
                    if av.ndim and av.shape[0] == config["batch_size"]:
                        av, bv = av[mask], bv[mask]
                    assert np.array_equal(av, bv), (step, key, "unaffected examples")
                    counts["exact_unaffected_prepared_values"] += av.size
            counts["unaffected_first18_examples"] += sum(mask)
    return dict(counts)


def worker(path, phase, arm):
    import yaml

    assert arm == ARM
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    if phase == "train":
        dependency = plan["deferred_train_control"]
        status = read(dependency["controller_status"])
        assert status["plan"] == dependency["controller_plan"]
        assert status["controller"] == dependency["controller_owner"]
        assert status["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons"
        assert not live(status["controller"])
        binding = ref(dependency["result"])
        assert status["completed"]["train-V131"] == binding
        plan["matched_control_results"][phase] = binding
        plan["inputs"] = [*plan["inputs"], binding]
    binding = plan["matched_control_results"][phase]
    control = checked_control(binding, phase)
    resolved = root / f"{phase}-{arm}-resolved-plan-v1.json"
    assert not resolved.exists()
    save(resolved, {**plan, "original_worker_plan": ref(path)})
    training_worker(resolved, phase, arm)
    result = ref(root / f"{phase}-{arm}-result.json")
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["arms"][arm][phase]).read_text())
    proof = compare_inputs(read(result["path"]), control, config)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-{arm}-input-comparison-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "passed-quota-only-unaffected-batch-and-example-proof",
            "candidate": result,
            "control": binding,
            "config": ref(plan["arms"][arm][phase]),
            "counts": proof,
            "new_forwards_for_comparison": 0,
            "scope": "Different model training states; saved input arrays only. This is not quality evidence.",
        },
    )


def continue_cpu(path, original_path):
    """Finish only two updates from the preserved actual sixteen-step check."""
    import os
    import time

    import numpy as np
    import psutil
    import torch
    import yaml
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    import demosaic.train as training

    plan, original = read(path), read(original_path)
    guard(plan)
    guard(original)
    root, old_root = Path(plan["root"]), Path(original["root"])
    failed = read(old_root / "status.json")
    prefix = read(old_root / "CPU-V133-failure.json")
    assert failed["status"].startswith("failed") and not live(failed["controller"])
    assert failed["phase"] == "CPU" and not live(failed["child"])
    deadline = failed["child"]["created"] + original["maximum_smoke_worker_seconds"]
    assert time.time() < deadline and prefix["current"] == "rejected-resume"
    assert all(
        prefix["counts"][k] == 16
        for k in (
            "training_forwards",
            "optimizer_steps",
            "prepared_training_batches",
            "encoder_forwards",
        )
    )
    assert len(prefix["observed_inputs"]) == 16
    checkpoint = old_root / "CPU-V133-step16.pt"
    preserved = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    assert preserved["step"] == 16 and preserved["config"]["steps"] == 20000
    assert len(preserved["model"]) == len(preserved["ema"]) == 91
    assert len(preserved["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    assert all(float(v["step"]) == 16 for v in preserved["optimizer"]["state"].values())
    execution = root / "CPU-continuation-plan-v1.json"
    assert not execution.exists()
    save(
        execution,
        {
            "worker_plan": ref(path),
            "original_plan": ref(original_path),
            "prefix_failure": ref(old_root / "CPU-V133-failure.json"),
            "checkpoint16": ref(checkpoint),
            "absolute_original_CPU_deadline_unix": deadline,
            "remaining_optimizer_and_neural_calls": 2,
            "scope": "Explicit continuation after terminal prevalidation-order failure; no original prefix replay or new CPU schedule.",
        },
    )
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["arms"][ARM]["CPU"]).read_text())
    constructor, factory, optimizer_factory = (
        training.JointDemosaic,
        training.prepare_training_batch,
        training.make_optimizer,
    )
    counts, inputs, gradients, captured = Counter(), [], {}, {}

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("Changed ROI settings must reject before construction")

    rejected = {}
    training.JointDemosaic = forbidden
    try:
        for name, expected_error in (("quota", "ROI fraction"), ("catalogue", "ROI catalogue")):
            options = dict(config, run=config["run"] + "-rejected-" + name)
            if name == "quota":
                options["reviewed_roi_fraction"] = 0.5
            else:
                catalogue = read(config["reviewed_roi_catalogue"])
                catalogue["resume_rejection_note"] = "No original catalogue mutation"
                target = root / "rejected-catalogue-v1.json"
                save(target, catalogue)
                options["reviewed_roi_catalogue"] = str(target)
            recipe = root / f"CPU-rejected-{name}-v1.yaml"
            recipe.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(options, sort_keys=False))
            try:
                training.train(recipe, resume=checkpoint, stop_after=1)
            except ValueError as error:
                assert expected_error in str(error)
                rejected[name] = str(error)
            else:
                raise AssertionError("Changed reviewed settings accepted")
    finally:
        training.JointDemosaic = constructor

    def construct(options):
        model = constructor(options)
        captured["model"] = model

        def before(module, args):
            assert time.time() < deadline
            if not counts["training_forwards"]:
                state = module.restoration_state_dict()
                assert state.keys() == preserved["model"].keys()
                assert all(torch.equal(state[k].cpu(), v) for k, v in preserved["model"].items())
                assert model_hash(module.context.backbone) == config["expected_dino_sha256"]
            assert module.training
            counts["training_forwards"] += 1
            assert counts["training_forwards"] <= 2

        model.register_forward_pre_hook(before)
        model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(
            lambda *args: counts.update(encoder_forwards=1)
        )
        return model

    def batch(step, domain, clean, **kwargs):
        assert step in (17, 18)
        clean_hash = training.batch_fingerprint(
            {k: v for k, v in clean.items() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)}
        )
        value = factory(step, domain, clean, **kwargs)
        counts.update(prepared_training_batches=1, target_contexts=len(value["packed"]))
        dest = root / f"CPU-V133-step-{step:02d}-inputs.npz"
        np.savez(
            dest,
            **{
                k: v.detach().cpu().numpy() for k, v in value.items() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
            },
        )
        inputs.append(
            {
                "step": step,
                "domain": domain,
                "clean_sha256": clean_hash,
                "batch_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(value),
                "selected_shadow_targets": 0,
                "prepared_tensors": ref(dest),
            }
        )
        return value

    def optimizer(model, options):
        result = optimizer_factory(model, options)

        def before(*args):
            for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
                if parameter.requires_grad:
                    assert parameter.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all()
                    gradients[name] = max(gradients.get(name, 0), float(parameter.grad.abs().max()))

        result.register_step_pre_hook(before)
        result.register_step_post_hook(lambda *args: counts.update(optimizer_steps=1))
        return result

    try:
        training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch, training.make_optimizer = (
            construct,
            batch,
            optimizer,
        )
        last = Path(training.train(plan["arms"][ARM]["CPU"], resume=checkpoint, stop_after=2))
    finally:
        training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch, training.make_optimizer = (
            constructor,
            factory,
            optimizer_factory,
        )
    assert time.time() < deadline
    assert counts == Counter(
        training_forwards=2,
        encoder_forwards=2,
        optimizer_steps=2,
        prepared_training_batches=2,
        target_contexts=2,
    )
    state = torch.load(last, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    assert state["step"] == 18 and len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    assert all(float(s["step"]) == 18 for s in state["optimizer"]["state"].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ("model", "ema") for v in state[key].values())
    assert all(
        torch.isfinite(v).all()
        for s in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        for v in s.values()
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
    )
    assert len(gradients) == 89 and any(v > 0 for v in gradients.values())
    rows = prefix["observed_inputs"] + inputs
    result = root / "CPU-V133-result.json"
    save(
        result,
        {
            "status": plan["phase_result_status"],
            "phase": "CPU",
            "arm": ARM,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "checkpoint": ref(last),
            "updates": 18,
            "counts": dict(Counter(prefix["counts"]) + counts),
            "new_continuation_counts": dict(counts),
            "domain_counts": dict(Counter(r["domain"] for r in rows)),
            "observed_inputs": rows,
            "prefix_adopted_without_replay": ref(execution),
            "initial_checks": [{"resume16_model91_exact": True, "official_encoder_exact": True}],
            "changed_reviewed_quota_resume_rejections": rejected,
            "model_EMA_Adam_finite": True,
            "all_AdamW_steps": 18,
            "optimizer_state_count": 89,
            "model_EMA_tensor_count": 91,
            "source_sha256": state["config"]["source_sha256"],
            "prefix_source_sha256": preserved["config"]["source_sha256"],
            "frozen_encoder_no_gradients": all(
                not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None
                for p in captured["model"].context.backbone.parameters()
            ),
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": 0,
            "scope": "Discarded CPU16+2 check: original16 states retained; only two actual new resumed updates, original absolute CPU deadline preserved.",
        },
    )
    proof = compare_inputs(
        read(result), checked_control(plan["matched_control_results"]["CPU"], "CPU"), config
    )
    save(
        root / "CPU-V133-input-comparison-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "passed-quota-only-unaffected-batch-and-example-proof",
            "candidate": ref(result),
            "control": plan["matched_control_results"]["CPU"],
            "counts": proof,
            "new_forwards_for_comparison": 0,
        },
    )
    guard(plan)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller", "worker", "continue-cpu"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("CPU", "CUDA", "train"))
    parser.add_argument("--arm", choices=(ARM,))
    parser.add_argument("--original-plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path.resolve()))
    elif args.mode == "controller":
        controller(args.path.resolve())
    elif args.mode == "continue-cpu":
        continue_cpu(args.path.resolve(), args.original_plan.resolve())
    else:
        worker(args.path.resolve(), args.phase, args.arm)

    for case in cases.values():
        if case.get("cohort") not in ("adc-photo256", "adc-sloped512") or case["pattern"] != "RGGB":

            cells.append(cell)
        if case["kind"] == "real" and "cases" in case:
            window = next(v for v in case["cases"] if v["ROI_xywh"] == roi)
            for key, name in (
                ("noisy_camera_jpeg", "ISO6400 JPEG native"),
                ("reference_camera_jpeg", "ISO100 JPEG, not GT"),
            ):
                binding = window["camera_JPEGs"][key]["pixels"]
                assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                cells.append(np.load(binding["path"]))
                names.append(name)
        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(cells), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"{case['id']} | paired1k, contrast{contrast}, RAW exposure{exposure:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="black",
        )
        panels = []
        for j, (name, cell) in enumerate(zip(names, cells, strict=True)):
            assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
            xywh = [8 + 168 * j, 44, 160, 160]
            board.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), xywh[:2])
            draw.text((xywh[0], 24), name, font=font, fill="black")
            panels.append({"label": name, "xywh": xywh})
            channels += cell.size
        dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}.png"
        board.save(dest)
        reread = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for panel, cell in zip(panels, cells, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y : y + h, x : x + w], cell)
        record = {
            **item,
            "image": ref(dest),
            "panels": panels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "JPEG_display": "native sRGB8 without exposure/contrast change"
            if "cases" in case
            else None,
        }
        images.append(record)
        make_triplets = (case["kind"] == "mesh" and case["present"] and contrast == 1) or (
            case["kind"] == "photo"
            and ("3e638bbb" in case["id"] or case.get("cohort") == "adc-photo256")
        )
        if make_triplets:
            for j, label in enumerate(labels):
                sources = [0, j + 2, len(values) - 1]
                triplet = Image.new("RGB", (512, 212), "#eeeeee")
                td = ImageDraw.Draw(triplet)
                td.text(
                    (8, 4),
                    f"{case['id']} | contrast{contrast}, exposure{exposure:g}",
                    font=font,
                    fill="black",
                )
                tp = []
                for col, source in enumerate(sources):
                    xywh = [8 + 168 * col, 44, 160, 160]
                    triplet.paste(Image.fromarray(cells[source]), xywh[:2])
                    td.text((xywh[0], 24), names[source], font=font, fill="black")
                    tp.append(
                        {
                            "label": names[source],
                            "xywh": xywh,
                            "source_xywh": panels[source]["xywh"],
                        }
                    )
                    triplet_channels += cells[source].size
                dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}-{label}-triplet.png"
                triplet.save(dest)
                actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
                for panel, source in zip(tp, sources, strict=True):
                    x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[y : y + h, x : x + w], cells[source])
                images.append(
                    {
                        **record,
                        "image": ref(dest),
                        "panels": tp,
                        "triplet_source_board": record["image"],
                    }
                )
    assert len(images) == 72
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(images), 4):
        subset = images[start : start + 4]
        sheet = Image.new(
            "RGB",
            (max(Image.open(v["image"]["path"]).width for v in subset), 212 * len(subset)),
            "white",
        )
        for j, item in enumerate(subset):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, j * 212))
        dest = out / f"sheet-{start // 4:02d}.png"
        sheet.save(dest)
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for j, item in enumerate(subset):
            pixels0 = np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]))
            h, w, _ = pixels0.shape
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[j * 212 : j * 212 + h, :w], pixels0)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "image": ref(dest),
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(subset))),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-and-independently-pixel-checked",
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "renderer": ref(__file__),
            "images": images,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "checkpoints": {k: read(v["path"])["export"] for k, v in collections.items()},
            "parent": plan["parent"],
            "direct_RGB_channels": channels,
            "triplet_RGB_channels": triplet_channels,
            "all_RGB_channels_checked": channels + triplet_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Fixed V148 source-board ROIs/transforms:26 main boards+16 mixed controls, plus6 prospective ADC boards and24 repeated-cell triplets across4 endpoints. All160x160 native crops,no resize. New ADC photos use contrast40/exposure1; planes use contrast8/exposure.18 divided by level, with common exact target means as anchors. All real priors/windows/JPEGs and old photo/flat controls retained. Real references notGT. Actual native viewing remains required.",
        },
    )
    print(
        "Rendered72 native figures; independently checked RGB channels", channels + triplet_channels
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)

"""Check actual raw/EMA matched browser captures against their public PNG pixels."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from PIL import Image
from train_flat_spatial_evidence_trial import REPO, save

METHODS = {
    "control": {e: f"V180-local-phase-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
    "evidence": {e: f"V181-flat-spatial-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
}


def verify(directory, output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    browser = read(directory / "browser-records-v1.json")
    assert browser["fixture_only_no_V181_quality"] is False and browser["JS_errors"] == []
    assert len(browser["records"]) == 480 and len(browser["metadata"]) == 96
    viewer = Path(browser["viewer"])
    manifest_path = viewer.with_name("manifest-v1.json")
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["native_figures"] == 60
    expected_old = read(REPO / "docs/results/v180-local-phase-evidence-final-v1.json")[
        "viewer_method_checkpoints"
    ]
    assert set(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == set(expected_old) | set(
        METHODS["evidence"].values()
    )
    for method, entry in expected_old.items():
        assert manifest["method_checkpoints"][method] == entry
    for entry in manifest["method_checkpoints"].values():
        assert ref(entry["source_checkpoint"]["path"]) == entry["source_checkpoint"]
    images = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in manifest["images"] if not item["triplet"]}
    assert len(images) == 48
    for item in images.values():
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
    assert len({(m["case"], m["endpoint"]) for m in browser["metadata"]}) == 96
    for record in browser["metadata"]:
        for arm in ["control", "evidence"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
            metadata = manifest["method_checkpoints"][method]
            assert metadata["state"] == record["endpoint"]
            for value in [method, metadata["source_checkpoint"]["sha256"], metadata["module_hash"]]:
                assert value in record["description"]
    channels = 0
    assert len({(r["case"], r["endpoint"], r["id"]) for r in browser["records"]}) == 480
    for record in browser["records"]:
        rect = record["rect"]
        assert rect["width"] == rect["height"] == 160
        assert rect["x"].is_integer() and rect["y"].is_integer()
        item = images[record["source"]]
        expected_panel = next(p for p in item["panels"] if p["label"] == record["label"])
        assert expected_panel["xywh"] == record["panel"]
        if record["id"] in ["a", "b"]:
            arm = "control" if record["id"] == "a" else "evidence"
            assert record["label"] == METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
        x, y, width, height = record["panel"]
        assert width == height == 160
        expected = np.asarray(Image.open(record["source"]).convert("RGB"))[
            y : y + height, x : x + width
        ]
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(record["screenshot"]).convert("RGB"))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        channels += actual.size
    assert channels == 36864000
    save(
        output,
        {
            "status": "pass-actual-matched-browser-480-native-crops-checkpoint-state-and-source-pixels",
            "viewer": ref(viewer),
            "manifest": ref(manifest_path),
            "browser_records": ref(directory / "browser-records-v1.json"),
            "browser_version": browser["browser"],
            "cases": 48,
            "matched_raw_EMA_pairs": 96,
            "browser_crop_screenshots": 480,
            "RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG": channels,
            "rectangle_width_height": [160, 160],
            "per_method_state_metadata_checked": True,
            "matched_default_V180_EMA_vs_V181_EMA": True,
            "click_keyboard_flip_and_navigation": True,
            "JS_errors": [],
            "screenshot_bindings": [ref(r["screenshot"]) for r in browser["records"]],
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V181_quality": False,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "scope": "Actual headless-browser screenshot pixels and source/checkpoint-state metadata are checked. Image-quality gains and costs require the separate matched measurements and actual human native viewing.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS480actualbrowsercrops/36864000RGBchannels/raw+EMAstate-metadata")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify(args.directory.resolve(), args.output.resolve())

"""Freeze full quality/native panels using the actual late-RGB training code."""

import argparse
import copy
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from prepare_directional_bank_review import references
from queue_late_rgb_review import validate_preflight
from review_directional_bank import alive
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def prepare(training_path, historical_path, closure_path, preflight_path, output):
    training, historical = read(training_path), read(historical_path)
    guard(training)
    assert (
        training["parent"] == historical["parent"]
        and not training["engineering_only"]
        and training["boundary_updates"] == 4000
    )
    status_path = Path(training["root"]) / "status.json"
    status = read(status_path)
    assert alive(status["controller"]) and status["status"] in (
        "running-source-frozen-late-rgb-arm",
        "waiting-for-late-rgb-resources",
    )
    proof = read(preflight_path)
    validate_preflight(proof)
    root = writable_path(output).resolve()
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work, trained = root / "work", Path(training["work"])
    sources = [*trained.glob("src/demosaic/*.py")]
    sources += [trained / p for p in ["pyproject.toml", "uv.lock", "configs/evaluation.yaml"]]
    sources += [p for p in (trained / "third_party").rglob("*LICENSE*") if p.is_file()]
    for source in sources:
        target = work / source.relative_to(trained)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    for source in Path("scripts").glob("*.py"):
        target = work / source
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    core = {
        str(p.relative_to(trained)): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in trained.glob("src/demosaic/*.py")
    }
    assert len(core) == 47 and all(ref(work / p)["sha256"] == sha for p, sha in core.items())
    for item in proof["scripts"]:
        assert ref(work / "scripts" / Path(item["path"]).name)["sha256"] == item["sha256"]
    criteria = training["protocol"]
    assert ref(criteria["path"]) == criteria
    snapshot = work / "docs/late-dino-rgb-v90-v91.md"
    snapshot.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(criteria["path"], snapshot)
    assert ref(snapshot)["sha256"] == criteria["sha256"]
    plan = copy.deepcopy(historical)
    plan.update(
        root=str(root),
        work=str(work),
        python=training["python"],
        HF_HOME=training["cache_environment"]["HF_HOME"],
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/review_late_rgb_trial.py"),
        training_status=str(status_path),
        training_plan=ref(training_path),
        training_owner=status["controller"],
        actual_training_core=core,
        static_input_recipe=ref(historical_path),
        engineering_preflight=False,
        review_CPU_preflight=ref(preflight_path),
        quality_numerical_scorer=ref(work / "scripts/score_late_rgb_eligibility.py"),
        quality_criteria={
            "predeclared_snapshot": ref(snapshot),
            "scope": "Original4000 matched global/spatial late RGB experiment. Full primary/sensitivity/weak-carrier/all192 ADC/hue/native panels; matched SSIM limit from the frozen protocol. Fresh starts only. No automatic extension/promotion.",
        },
        git_head_at_freeze=subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
        scope="Fresh V90/V91 original4000 final EMA review after exact successful training exits. Same full427, known4/unseen5, sensitivity/analytic/ADC/hue/GFX/highlight panels, fresh V63 and witnessed retained V43/RawNIND. Native160 triplets include foliage/fence. No protected-final scoring, extension or promotion.",
    )
    plan.pop("recovery_of", None)
    plan["outputs"] = {k: str(work / "outputs" / k) for k in historical["outputs"]}
    closure = copy.deepcopy(read(closure_path))
    closure.update(
        root=str(root),
        output=str(work / "outputs/closure"),
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/close_late_rgb_review.py"),
        closure_engine=ref(work / "scripts/close_bank_detachment_review.py"),
        historical_replay=False,
        scope="CPU saved-array/arithmetic, fixed late RGB criteria and exact native boards after all10 stages. Actual viewing remains required; no promotion.",
    )
    for k in ["review_owner", "review_plan", "recovery_of", "frozen_files", "inputs"]:
        closure.pop(k, None)
    supplement = copy.deepcopy(read(Path(closure_path).parent / "reference-plan.json"))
    supplement.update(
        output=str(work / "outputs/reference-closure"),
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/prepare_directional_reference_boards.py"),
        closure_root=str(root),
    )
    supplement.pop("closure_owner", None)
    for panel, spec in supplement["panels"].items():
        spec["fresh_report"] = str(
            work
            / "outputs"
            / (
                "gfx/report.json"
                if panel == "gfx"
                else f"closure/{panel}-native-sources/report.json"
            )
        )
    inputs = [
        *historical["inputs"],
        ref(training_path),
        ref(historical_path),
        ref(closure_path),
        ref(preflight_path),
        criteria,
        ref(snapshot),
    ]
    for template in [closure, supplement]:
        inputs += list(references(template))
    unique = {}
    for item in inputs:
        if item["path"] in unique:
            assert unique[item["path"]] == item["sha256"]
        unique[item["path"]] = item["sha256"]
    plan["inputs"] = [{"path": p, "sha256": s} for p, s in sorted(unique.items())]
    plan["frozen_files"] = {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    guard(plan)
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    closure.update(
        review_plan=ref(root / "plan.json"),
        inputs=plan["inputs"],
        frozen_files=plan["frozen_files"],
    )
    save(root / "closure-template.json", closure)
    save(root / "reference-template.json", supplement)
    print(
        {
            "plan": ref(root / "plan.json"),
            "frozen_files": len(plan["frozen_files"]),
            "model_modules": len(core),
        }
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ["training-plan", "historical-review", "historical-closure", "preflight", "output"]:
        p.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    prepare(
        a.training_plan.resolve(),
        a.historical_review.resolve(),
        a.historical_closure.resolve(),
        a.preflight.resolve(),
        a.output,
    )

"""Discarded CUDA execution sweep for the same mixed optimizer batch16."""

import argparse
import gc
import json
import os
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from probe_raw_feature_coordinates import alive, batch_fingerprint, guard, read, ref
from probe_raw_residual_units import digest

from demosaic.cfa import bilinear
from demosaic.model import JointDemosaic, ModelConfig
from demosaic.optimizer_batches import backward_groups
from demosaic.precision import amp_context
from demosaic.train import make_optimizer


def run(plan_path):
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    for entry in plan["completed_workflows"]:
        state = read(entry["path"])
        assert state["status"] == entry["terminal_status"] and not alive(state["controller"])
    assert torch.cuda.is_available() and psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
    root, status = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["status"])
    assert not status.exists()
    with (root / "launch.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()) + "\n")
    info = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
    }

    def record(stage, **fields):
        info.update(status=stage, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        temporary = status.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(status)
        print(json.dumps(info), flush=True)

    try:
        record("loading-frozen-training-fixtures-for-mixed-execution-sweep")
        fixtures = read(plan["fixtures"]["path"])
        assert len(fixtures) == 16
        batches = []
        for entry in fixtures:
            assert ref(entry["fixture"]["path"]) == entry["fixture"]
            with np.load(entry["fixture"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
                values = {key: torch.from_numpy(arrays[key].copy()) for key in arrays.files}
            assert batch_fingerprint(values) == entry["batch_fingerprint"]
            assert values["packed"].shape == (4, 4, 128, 128)
            batches.append({key: value.cuda() for key, value in values.items()})
        points = []
        for enabled in (False, True):
            arm = "dino" if enabled else "no-dino"
            for forward in plan["forward_group_order"]:
                assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
                torch.manual_seed(51)
                options = {
                    **plan["model_config"],
                    "dino": enabled,
                    "dino_feature_fusion": "packed-convnext" if enabled else "bottleneck",
                }
                model = JointDemosaic(ModelConfig(**options))
                initial = digest(
                    ("packed_isotropic." + key, value)
                    for key, value in model.packed_isotropic.state_dict().items()
                )
                assert initial == plan["initial_RAW_state_SHA256"]
                model = model.cuda().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
                optimizer = make_optimizer(model, {"lr": 2e-4})
                backbone = digest(model.context.backbone.state_dict().items()) if enabled else None
                if enabled:
                    assert backbone == plan["official_frozen_DINO_SHA256"]
                count = 863 if enabled else 852
                assert sum(p.requires_grad for p in model.parameters()) == count
                model.eval()
                with torch.inference_mode(), amp_context("cuda", dtype="float32"):
                    for batch in batches:
                        actual = model(
                            *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"])
                        )
                        assert torch.equal(actual, bilinear(batch["packed"], batch["colors"]))
                config = {
                    "optimizer_batch_groups": 4,
                    "optimizer_forward_groups": forward,
                    "data_seed_per_step": True,
                    "amp": True,
                    "precision": "float32",
                    "model": options,
                }
                record("timing-mixed-optimizer-batch16", arm=arm, forward_groups=forward)
                times, losses = [], []
                with amp_context("cuda", dtype="float32"):
                    for update in range(plan["warmup_updates"] + plan["timed_updates"]):
                        indices = [(update * 4 + offset) % 16 for offset in range(4)]
                        selected = [(i + 1, fixtures[i]["domain"], batches[i]) for i in indices]
                        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 16 * 2**30
                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
                        if update == plan["warmup_updates"]:
                            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
                        started = time.perf_counter()
                        model.train()
                        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                        loss, _, norm, _ = backward_groups(
                            model, selected, lambda step, domain, batch: batch, config
                        )
                        optimizer.step()
                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
                        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
                        assert torch.isfinite(loss) and torch.isfinite(norm)
                        if update >= plan["warmup_updates"]:
                            times.append(elapsed)
                            losses.append(loss.item())
                peak_allocated = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 2**30
                peak_reserved = torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved() / 2**30
                assert len(optimizer.state) == count
                expected_step = plan["warmup_updates"] + plan["timed_updates"]
                assert all(
                    int(state["step"]) == expected_step for state in optimizer.state.values()
                )
                assert all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in model.state_dict().values())
                assert all(
                    torch.isfinite(value).all()
                    for state in optimizer.state.values()
                    for value in state.values()
                )
                assert all(
                    p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                    for p in model.parameters()
                    if p.requires_grad
                )
                if enabled:
                    assert backbone == digest(model.context.backbone.state_dict().items())
                    assert all(
                        not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None
                        for p in model.context.backbone.parameters()
                    )
                point = {
                    "arm": arm,
                    "forward_groups": forward,
                    "physical_forward_batch": forward * 4,
                    "effective_batch": 16,
                    "timed_update_seconds": times,
                    "timed_losses": losses,
                    "median_update_seconds": statistics.median(times),
                    "range_seconds": [min(times), max(times)],
                    "examples_per_second": 16 * len(times) / sum(times),
                    "peak_allocated_GiB": peak_allocated,
                    "peak_reserved_GiB": peak_reserved,
                    "initial_RAW_state_SHA256": initial,
                    "DINO_SHA256": backbone,
                    "finite_model_gradient_optimizer_states": count,
                    "Adam_steps": expected_step,
                    "learned_weights_discarded": True,
                }
                points.append(point)
                (root / "points.json").write_text(json.dumps(points, indent=2) + "\n")
                del model, optimizer, actual, loss, norm
                gc.collect()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        combined = {
            forward: sum(
                sum(p["timed_update_seconds"]) for p in points if p["forward_groups"] == forward
            )
            for forward in plan["forward_group_order"]
        }
        winner = min(combined, key=combined.get)
        assert all(
            batch_fingerprint({key: value.cpu() for key, value in batch.items()})
            == entry["batch_fingerprint"]
            for batch, entry in zip(batches, fixtures, strict=True)
        )
        guard(plan)
        result = {
            "status": "completed-discarded-mixed-batch-execution-sweep",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "points": points,
            "combined_timed_seconds": combined,
            "fastest_observed_common_forward_groups": winner,
            "all_fixture_fingerprints_unchanged": True,
            "GPU": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
            "torch": str(torch.__version__),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        }
        (root / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        record(result["status"], result=ref(root / "receipt.json"))
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-no-automatic-restart-no-weights-exported", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
