def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None

    def record(status, **details):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **details)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        audit = read(root / "input-audit-v1.json")
        assert (
            audit["plan"] == ref(path)
            and audit["status"] == "passed-independent-faint-target-and-ADC-preparation-audit"
        )
        for label, specification in plan["methods"].items():
            spec = dict(specification)
            if label == "V130":
                record("waiting-for-original-V1301000-endpoint", child=None)
                while True:
                    assert time.time() < plan["absolute_training_deadline_unix"]
                    guard(plan)
                    training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
                    current = read(Path(training["root"]) / "status.json")
                    assert (
                        current["plan"] == plan["training_plan"]
                        and current["controller"] == plan["training_owner"]
                    )
                    if current["status"].startswith("failed"):
                        raise RuntimeError("Original V130 training failed; preserve partial work")
                    if not live(plan["training_owner"]):
                        assert current["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons"
                        assert current.get("child") is None or not live(current["child"])
                        binding = current["completed"]["train-V130"]
                        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                        result = read(binding["path"])
                        assert result["updates"] == result["all_AdamW_steps"] == 1000
                        assert (
                            result["model_EMA_Adam_finite"]
                            and result["all_observed_inputs_match_saved_control"]
                        )
                        assert result["owner"] == plan["training_worker"] and not live(
                            result["owner"]
                        )
                        spec["checkpoint"] = result["checkpoint"]
                        break
                    time.sleep(15)
            assert ref(spec["checkpoint"]["path"]) == spec["checkpoint"]
            endpoint = root / label
            work = endpoint / "work"
            observations = []
            for original in plan["observations"]:
                controls = []
                for previous, binding in state["completed"].items():
                    collected = read(binding["path"])
                    row = next(r for r in collected["observations"] if r["id"] == original["id"])
                    controls.append(
                        {
                            "model": {
                                "label": previous if previous == "V120" else f"{previous} 1k EMA"
                            },
                            "prediction": row["prediction"],
                        }
                    )
                observations.append({**original, "controls": controls})
            execution = {
                **plan,
                **spec,
                "root": str(endpoint),
                "work": str(work),
                "model_label": label if label == "V120" else f"{label} 1k EMA",
                "observations": observations,
                "EMA_tensors": 91,
                "raw_frequency_features": False,
                "collector": ref(work / "scripts/collect_retained_checkpoint_pilot.py"),
                "planned_new_root_forwards": 16,
                "planned_new_encoder_forwards": 16,
                "inputs": [
                    *plan["inputs"],
                    ref(path),
                    spec["checkpoint"],
                    ref(root / "input-audit-v1.json"),
                    *state["completed"].values(),
                ],
            }
            execution_path = endpoint / "plan-v1.json"
            save(execution_path, execution)
            guard(execution)
            record("waiting-for-faint-ADC-headroom", label=label, child=None)
            began = time.monotonic()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < plan["launch_RAM_GiB"] * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200
                time.sleep(5)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
            )
            with (root / f"{label}.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", execution["collector"]["path"], str(execution_path)],
                    cwd=work,
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("collecting-new-faint-ADC-observations", label=label, child=owner)
                began = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_collector_seconds"]
                    time.sleep(2)
                assert child.wait() == 0, (label, child.returncode)
            binding = ref(endpoint / "collection-v1.json")
            collected = read(binding["path"])
            assert collected["plan"] == ref(execution_path) and collected["counts"] == {
                "root": 16,
                "encoder": 16,
            }
            assert collected["RNG_unchanged"] and not live(owner)
            state["completed"][label] = binding
            record("completed-new-faint-ADC-method", child=None)
        record("completed48-faint-ADC-forwards-awaiting-independent-and-native-review", child=None)
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if live(owner):
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        record("failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path))
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

"""Apply the predeclared context criteria without promoting a model."""

import argparse
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import score_directional_bank_eligibility as shared
from review_context_trial import BOUNDARY
from train_directional_interval_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def evaluate_primary(statistics, control, context, parent):
    result = shared.evaluate_primary(statistics, control, context, parent)
    result["matched_context_effect"] = result.pop("matched_bank_effect")
    return result


def adc_detail(rows, models):
    cases = {}
    for role, label in models.items():
        selected = [
            r
            for r in rows
            if r["model"] == label and r["kind"] == "carrier" and r["condition"] == "adc-only"
        ]
        keyed = {
            (r["level"], r["contrast"], r["period"], r["pattern"], r["draw"]): r for r in selected
        }
        shared.require(len(keyed) == len(selected) == 192, "Incomplete or duplicate ADC cases")
        cases[role] = keyed
    shared.require(cases["control"].keys() == cases["context"].keys(), "ADC cases differ")
    groups, comparisons = defaultdict(list), []
    for key in sorted(cases["control"]):
        first = cases["control"][key]["metrics"]["in_phase_gain"]
        second = cases["context"][key]["metrics"]["in_phase_gain"]
        shared.require(math.isfinite(first) and math.isfinite(second), "Nonfinite ADC gain")
        delta = second - first
        groups[key[:3]].append(delta)
        comparisons.append(
            {
                "case": list(key),
                "context_minus_control_gain": delta,
                "gain_loss_at_most_.05": delta >= -0.05,
            }
        )
    shared.require(
        len(groups) == 12 and all(len(v) == 16 for v in groups.values()),
        "ADC layout/draw coverage differs",
    )
    return {
        "cases": comparisons,
        "group_means": [
            {"level_contrast_period": list(k), "context_minus_control_gain": math.fsum(v) / 16}
            for k, v in sorted(groups.items())
        ],
        "no_ADC_case_loses_more_than_.05": all(c["gain_loss_at_most_.05"] for c in comparisons),
    }


def evaluate_analytic(summary, rows, control, context):
    weak = shared.evaluate_analytic(summary, rows, control, context)
    for comparison in weak["comparisons"]:
        comparison["measurements"]["context"] = comparison["measurements"].pop("bank")
        comparison["context_minus_control_gain"] = comparison.pop("bank_minus_control_gain")
    weak["checkpoint_bindings"]["context"] = weak["checkpoint_bindings"].pop("bank")
    models = {role: item["analytic_label"] for role, item in weak["checkpoint_bindings"].items()}
    adc = adc_detail(rows, models)
    return {
        "high_noise_weak_carriers": weak,
        "ADC_detail": adc,
        "weak_detail_claim_criteria_pass": weak["all_criteria_pass"]
        and adc["no_ADC_case_loses_more_than_.05"],
        "scope": "Full analytic coverage/arithmetic first. Two high-noise gain/flat contrasts and all192 ADC layout/draw cases; retain12 group means. These descriptive fixtures do not establish photo quality or training-seed uncertainty.",
    }


def main(plan_path, output):
    from compare_long_commons_scores import rows

    from demosaic.safety import writable_path

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    boundary = read(root / "training-boundary.json")
    shared.require(
        boundary["status"] == BOUNDARY and boundary["engineering_preflight"] is False,
        "Production context training boundary has not been verified",
    )
    control, context = boundary["checkpoints"]
    shared.require(
        [c["label"] for c in [control, context]] == ["V86-original4000", "V87-original4000"]
        and all(c["step"] == 4000 for c in [control, context]),
        "Wrong study/boundary",
    )
    for checkpoint in [control, context]:
        shared.require(
            ref(checkpoint["path"])["sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"], "Checkpoint changed"
        )
    statistics = read(root / "primary-statistics.json")
    shared.require(
        not statistics.get("preflight_only"), "Historical replay is not production evidence"
    )
    checked = set()
    for source in statistics["sources"]:
        for side in ["first", "second"]:
            for key in ["report", "cases"]:
                path = source[side][key]
                if path not in checked:
                    shared.require(
                        ref(path)["sha256"] == source[side][key + "_sha256"], "Source changed"
                    )
                    checked.add(path)
    analytic = Path(plan["outputs"]["analytic"])
    result = {
        "status": "applied-predeclared-context-numerical-criteria-manual-review-pending",
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "training_boundary": ref(root / "training-boundary.json"),
        "primary_statistics": ref(root / "primary-statistics.json"),
        "analytic_summary": ref(analytic / "summary.json"),
        "analytic_cases": ref(analytic / "per-case.jsonl"),
        "primary": evaluate_primary(
            statistics, control, context, dict(plan["parent"], label="V63-parent")
        ),
        "analytic": evaluate_analytic(
            read(analytic / "summary.json"), rows(analytic / "per-case.jsonl"), control, context
        ),
        "manual_native_color_detail_highlight_review": "required; not evaluated by this tool",
        "eligible_for_automatic_extension_or_promotion": False,
    }
    output = writable_path(output)
    shared.require(not output.exists(), "Output exists; preserve previous criteria applications")
    save(output, result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.plan, args.output)

import argparse

            "V143 parent",
            "Native raw1k",
            "Native EMA1k",
            "Aligned raw1k",
            "Aligned EMA1k",
            "Context raw1k",

        if case["kind"] == "mesh":

            names.append("Periodic detail")
        target = (
            a["reference_rgb"]
            if "reference_rgb" in a
            else np.load(case["reference_binding"]["path"])
            if case["kind"] == "real"
            else a["target"]
        )
        values.append(target)
        names.append("ISO100 AHD, not GT" if case["kind"] == "real" else "Exact constructed GT")
        anchor = np.array(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        contrast, exposure = item["contrast"], item["exposure"]
        cells = []
        for j, value in enumerate(values):
            selected_roi = (
                [0, 0, 160, 160]
                if case["kind"] == "real"
                and j == len(values) - 1
                and value.shape[-2:] == (160, 160)
                else roi
            )
            transformed = anchor + contrast * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
            cell = pixels(transformed, a, selected_roi, exposure)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                cell, independent_display(transformed, a, selected_roi, exposure)

        if case["kind"] == "real" and "cases" in case:
            window = next(v for v in case["cases"] if v["ROI_xywh"] == roi)
            for key, name in (
                ("noisy_camera_jpeg", "ISO6400 JPEG native"),
                ("reference_camera_jpeg", "ISO100 JPEG, not GT"),
            ):
                binding = window["camera_JPEGs"][key]["pixels"]

                cells.append(np.load(binding["path"]))

        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(cells), 212), "#eeeeee")

        dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}.png"

        reread = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for panel, cell in zip(panels, cells, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y : y + h, x : x + w], cell)
        record = {
            **item,
            "image": ref(dest),
            "panels": panels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "JPEG_display": "native sRGB8 without exposure/contrast change"
            if "cases" in case
            else None,
        }
        images.append(record)
        make_triplets = (case["kind"] == "mesh" and case["present"] and contrast == 1) or (
            case["kind"] == "photo" and "3e638bbb" in case["id"]
        )
        if make_triplets:

                    td.text((xywh[0], 24), names[source], font=font, fill="black")
                    tp.append(
                        {
                            "label": names[source],
                            "xywh": xywh,
                            "source_xywh": panels[source]["xywh"],
                        }
                    )
                    triplet_channels += cells[source].size
                dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}-{label}-triplet.png"
                triplet.save(dest)
                actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
                for panel, source in zip(tp, sources, strict=True):
                    x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[y : y + h, x : x + w], cells[source])
                images.append(
                    {
                        **record,
                        "image": ref(dest),
                        "panels": tp,
                        "triplet_source_board": record["image"],
                    }
                )
    assert len(images) == 66
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(images), 4):

        sheet = Image.new(
            "RGB",
            (max(Image.open(v["image"]["path"]).width for v in subset), 212 * len(subset)),

        sheet.save(dest)
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for j, item in enumerate(subset):
            pixels0 = np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]))
            h, w, _ = pixels0.shape
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[j * 212 : j * 212 + h, :w], pixels0)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "image": ref(dest),
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(subset))),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-and-independently-pixel-checked",
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "renderer": ref(__file__),
            "images": images,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "checkpoints": {k: read(v["path"])["export"] for k, v in collections.items()},
            "parent": plan["parent"],
            "direct_RGB_channels": channels,
            "triplet_RGB_channels": triplet_channels,
            "all_RGB_channels_checked": channels + triplet_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Fixed V148 source-board ROIs/transforms:26 main boards+16 mixed controls, plus24 repeated-cell triplets for six endpoints. All160x160 native crops, no resize; all real priors/windows/JPEGs and photo/flat controls. Real references not GT. Actual native viewing remains required.",
        },
    )
    print(
        "Rendered66 native figures; independently checked RGB channels", channels + triplet_channels
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

def review_step_spec(horizon, step):
    """Require explicit selection for longer runs; preserve the original1k default."""
    if type(horizon) is not int or horizon < 8:
        raise ValueError("Need an integer training horizon >=8")
    if step is None:
        if horizon != 1000:
            raise ValueError("Select the review step explicitly for a longer training run")
        step = horizon
    if type(step) is not int or not 0 < step <= horizon:
        raise ValueError("Review step must lie inside the declared training horizon")
    return step, step < horizon


def append_retained_control(observations, previous, collection, *, checked=ref):
    """Adopt a saved method only on exactly the same declared observations."""
    result = deepcopy(observations)
    assert len(result) == len(previous["observations"]) == len(collection["observations"])
    ids = [o["id"] for o in result]
    assert len(set(ids)) == len(ids)
    assert ids == [o["id"] for o in previous["observations"]]
    assert ids == [o["id"] for o in collection["observations"]]
    label = previous["model_label"]
    for current, old, prediction in zip(
        result, previous["observations"], collection["observations"], strict=True
    ):
        assert {k: v for k, v in current.items() if k != "controls"} == {
            k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != "controls"
        }
        assert label not in {
            c.get("model", {}).get("label", c.get("label")) for c in current["controls"]
        }
        binding = prediction["prediction"]
        assert checked(binding["path"]) == binding
        current["controls"].append(
            {
                "model": {
                    "label": label,
                    "step": previous["step"],
                    "sha256": previous["checkpoint"]["sha256"],
                },
                "prediction": deepcopy(binding),
            }
        )
    return result


def select_control_methods(observations, labels):
    """Select and order explicitly named saved controls, preserving prediction bindings."""
    assert len(labels) == len(set(labels)) and labels
    result = deepcopy(observations)
    for observation in result:
        available = {}
        for control in observation["controls"]:
            label = control.get("model", {}).get("label", control.get("label"))
            if label == "V120-profile3879":
                label = "V120"
            assert label not in available
            available[label] = control
        assert all(label in available for label in labels)
        observation["controls"] = [available[label] for label in labels]
    return result

"""Select frequencies in one green CFA phase and describe the other phase.

This within-image sample split is not an unseen-image validation set. Supplied
noisy variance proxies and fitted nuisance affect the statistics; no threshold
is calibrated here. The principal packed band has unresolved native aliases.
"""

import numpy as np
from green_phase_spectrum import tapered_spectrum


def select_phase_frequencies(spectrum, noise_variance, *, count=4):
    """Rank one phase only, suppressing nearby/conjugate bins after each pick."""
    spectrum = np.asarray(spectrum)
    noise_variance = np.asarray(noise_variance)
    if (
        spectrum.ndim != 2
        or noise_variance.shape != spectrum.shape
        or not np.isfinite(spectrum).all()
        or not np.isfinite(noise_variance).all()
        or (noise_variance <= 0).any()
        or not isinstance(count, int)
        or count < 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Require finite 2D spectrum, positive matching variance and count")
    height, width = spectrum.shape
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(height)[:, None] / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(width)[None, :] / 2
    radius = np.hypot(fy, fx)
    available = (radius >= 1 / 16) & (radius <= 1 / 3)
    available &= (fy > 0) | ((fy == 0) & (fx > 0))
    power = np.abs(spectrum) ** 2 / noise_variance
    selected = []
    for _ in range(count):
        score = np.where(available, power, -np.inf)
        flat = int(np.argmax(score))
        if not np.isfinite(score.ravel()[flat]):
            break
        y, x = np.unravel_index(flat, score.shape)
        selected.append((int(y), int(x)))
        for cy, cx in [(y, x), ((-y) % height, (-x) % width)]:
            for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                    available[(cy + dy) % height, (cx + dx) % width] = False
    return selected


def describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors, *, count=4):
    """Both directions of one-phase selection followed by other-phase measurement.

    Each direction's bins depend on its selection phase only. Descriptive power
    and signed principal-band phase agreement in the other phase do not affect
    that selection. Separate physical sensor samples can have independent noise
    under the synthetic model; real-camera independence is not established.
    """
    packed = np.asarray(packed, dtype=np.float64)
    variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
    colors = np.asarray(colors)
    allowed = {(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)}
    if (
        packed.ndim != 3
        or packed.shape[0] != 4
        or variance.shape != packed.shape
        or colors.shape != (4,)
        or tuple(colors) not in allowed
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected matching 4xHxW RAW/variance and standard Bayer colors")
    green = np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
    phases = {int(i): tapered_spectrum(packed[i], variance[i]) for i in green}
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(packed.shape[-2]) / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(packed.shape[-1]) / 2
    output = []
    for a, b in [(int(green[0]), int(green[1])), (int(green[1]), int(green[0]))]:
        selection, held = phases[a], phases[b]
        ay, ax = divmod(a, 2)
        by, bx = divmod(b, 2)
        peaks = []
        for y, x in select_phase_frequencies(
            selection["spectrum"], selection["noise_variance"], count=count
        ):
            first, second = selection["spectrum"][y, x], held["spectrum"][y, x]
            first_noise = float(selection["noise_variance"][y, x])
            second_noise = float(held["noise_variance"][y, x])
            if second_noise <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Other-phase propagated variance must be positive")
            alignment = np.exp(2j * np.pi * ((by - ay) * fy[y] + (bx - ax) * fx[x]))
            product = first * np.conj(second) * alignment
            amplitude_product = abs(first) * abs(second)
            peaks.append(
                {
                    "bin_yx": [y, x],
                    "principal_native_fxy": [float(fx[x]), float(fy[y])],
                    "selection_power": float(abs(first) ** 2 / first_noise),
                    "other_phase_power": float(abs(second) ** 2 / second_noise),
                    "signed_principal_phase_agreement": (
                        float(np.real(product) / amplitude_product)
                        if amplitude_product > 0
                        else 0.0
                    ),
                    "selection_noise_variance": first_noise,
                    "other_noise_variance": second_noise,
                }
            )
        output.append({"selection_phase": a, "other_phase": b, "peaks": peaks})
    return output

import argparse

    BACKBONE,

)


def population(previous, arrivals, *, workspace_cache=None):
    """Preserve every prior pool and every new holdout, including protected flags."""
    pools = {"Commons-heldout", "native150", "protected45"}
    if not previous or any(row.get("pool") not in pools for row in previous):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected previous anchor pool")
    if len({row["id"] for row in previous}) != len(previous):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate previous source identity")
    if len({row["id"] for row in arrivals}) != len(arrivals):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate arrival source identity")
    if any(row["split"] not in {"train", "val", "test"} for row in arrivals):
        raise ValueError("Use all original direct8x arrival hash buckets")
    if {row["id"] for row in previous} & {row["id"] for row in arrivals}:
        raise ValueError("Arrivals overlap the previous source bank")
    commons = [row for row in previous if row["pool"] == "Commons-heldout"]
    if any(row["split"] not in {"val", "test", "reserved"} for row in commons):
        raise ValueError("Training source in the previous heldout pool")
    if len(anchors(commons, previous, workspace_cache=workspace_cache)) != len(previous):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete previous pool coverage")
    additions = [row for row in arrivals if row["split"] in {"val", "test"}]
    selected = [dict(row) for row in previous] + anchors(
        additions, [], workspace_cache=workspace_cache
    )
    locations = reused_locations(selected, [previous, arrivals])
    if any(location is None for location in locations):
        raise ValueError("Missing verified embedding for an anchor")
    return selected, locations


def freeze(previous, arrivals, root, *, reserve_gib=548):
    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    if root.exists() or not root.is_relative_to("/mnt/external/demosaic"):
        raise ValueError("Use a fresh external demosaic bank root")
    resources(root.parent, reserve_gib=reserve_gib)
    old, new = read(previous), read(arrivals)
    if old["status"] != "completed-source-content-anchor-bank-no-training-admission":
        raise ValueError("Previous content bank is incomplete")
    if (
        new["status"]
        != "completed-source-content-neighbors-awaiting-actual-review-no-training-admission"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Arrival embedding computation is incomplete")
    inputs = [ref(previous), ref(arrivals)]
    for receipt in [old, new]:
        if (
            receipt["engineering"]
            or receipt["backbone_unchanged"] != BACKBONE
            or receipt["CUDA_initialized"]
            or not receipt["Torch_RNG_unchanged"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Incompatible or unverified encoder provenance")
        for field in ["plan", "input_rows", "vectors"]:
            item = receipt[field]
            if ref(item["path"]) != item:
                raise ValueError("Changed source embedding artifact")
            inputs.append(item)
    old_plan, new_plan = read(old["plan"]["path"]), read(new["plan"]["path"])
    if any(recipe != RECIPE for recipe in [old["recipe"], old_plan["recipe"], new_plan["recipe"]]):
        raise ValueError("Incompatible source preprocessing")
    if old_plan["model"] != MODEL or old_plan["revision"] != REVISION:
        raise ValueError("Incompatible source encoder")
    if old_plan["model_cache"] != new_plan["model_cache"]:
        raise ValueError("Model cache provenance differs")
    source_rows = [rows(receipt["input_rows"]["path"]) for receipt in [old, new]]
    if len(source_rows[0]) != old["rows"] or len(source_rows[1]) != new["new_sources"]:
        raise ValueError("Source population differs from completed receipt")
    workspace_cache = str(repo / ".cache")
    selected, locations = population(*source_rows, workspace_cache=workspace_cache)
    if len(selected) - len(source_rows[0]) != new["new_reserved_anchors"]:
        raise ValueError("Missing original arrival holdout bucket")
    model_inputs = [r for r in old_plan["inputs"] if r["path"].startswith(old_plan["model_cache"])]
    if len(model_inputs) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Missing pinned model config/weights")
    inputs.extend(model_inputs)
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    files = list((repo / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))
    files += [
        repo / "scripts" / name
        for name in [
            Path(__file__).name,
            "build_commons_content_bank.py",
            "audit_commons_dino_overlap.py",
            "profile_raw_kernel_inference.py",
        ]
    ]
    frozen = []
    for file in files:
        destination = root / "work" / file.relative_to(repo)
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(file, destination)
        frozen.append(ref(destination))
    selected_path = root / "input-rows.jsonl"
    selected_path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in selected))
    plan = {
        "root": str(root),
        "inputs": inputs,
        "source": frozen,
        "previous": ref(previous),
        "arrivals": ref(arrivals),
        "input_rows": ref(selected_path),
        "locations": locations,
        "rows": len(selected),
        "pools": dict(Counter(row["pool"] for row in selected)),
        "model": MODEL,
        "revision": REVISION,
        "model_cache": old_plan["model_cache"],
        "workspace_cache": workspace_cache,
        "backbone": BACKBONE,
        "recipe": RECIPE,
        "reserve_gib": reserve_gib,
        "scope": "Complete previous heldout/native/protected bank plus every prior-arrival val/test hash, including protected flags. Every selected embedding is reused by exact pixel/recipe identity. Recheck source pixels and original B8 CPU encoder replays. No restoration inference, quality selection, automatic exclusion or training admission.",
    }
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    return ref(root / "plan.json")


def run(path):
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from torch.nn import functional as F
    from transformers import AutoModel

    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "":
        raise ValueError("Hide CUDA for source-bank reuse")
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / ".run-claimed").touch(exist_ok=False)
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    started = time.monotonic()
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)

    def status(value, **fields):
        save(
            root / "status.json",
            {
                "status": value,
                "owner": owner,
                "updated_unix": time.time(),
                "plan": ref(path),
                **fields,
            },
        )

    def unchanged():
        for item in [*plan["inputs"], *plan["source"], plan["input_rows"]]:
            if ref(item["path"]) != item:
                raise ValueError("Changed frozen bank input or source")

    try:
        resources(root, started, reserve_gib=plan["reserve_gib"])
        unchanged()
        assert ref(__file__) in plan["source"]
        receipts = [read(plan[name]["path"]) for name in ["previous", "arrivals"]]
        source_rows = [rows(r["input_rows"]["path"]) for r in receipts]
        selected, locations = population(*source_rows, workspace_cache=plan["workspace_cache"])
        assert selected == rows(plan["input_rows"]["path"])
        assert [list(x) for x in locations] == plan["locations"]
        arrays = [
            np.load(r["vectors"]["path"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False) for r in receipts
        ]
        for records, array in zip(source_rows, arrays, strict=True):
            assert array.dtype == np.float32 and array.shape == (len(records), 768)
        status("checking-complete-reused-anchor-pixels-and-vectors")
        vectors = np.lib.format.open_memmap(
            root / "unit-vectors-f32.npy", mode="w+", dtype=np.float32, shape=(len(selected), 768)
        )
        for i, (row, location) in enumerate(zip(selected, locations, strict=True)):
            if i % 128 == 0:
                resources(root, started, reserve_gib=plan["reserve_gib"])
                status(
                    "checking-complete-reused-anchor-pixels-and-vectors",
                    checked=i,
                    total=len(selected),
                )
            assert ref(row["cache"])["sha256"] == row["cache_sha256"]
            pixels = np.load(row["cache"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
            assert pixels.dtype == np.uint16 and list(pixels.shape) == row["shape"]
            source, index = location
            assert key(row) == key(source_rows[source][index])
            vectors[i] = arrays[source][index]
        vectors.flush()
        assert (
            np.isfinite(vectors).all() and np.max(abs(np.linalg.norm(vectors, axis=1) - 1)) < 2e-6
        )
        status("replaying-two-original-B8-encoder-inputs-CPU-only")
        model = (
            AutoModel.from_pretrained(
                MODEL, revision=REVISION, cache_dir=plan["model_cache"], local_files_only=True
            )
            .float()
            .eval()
            .requires_grad_(False)
        )
        assert model.config._commit_hash == REVISION and model_hash(model) == BACKBONE
        rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
        mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406])[None, :, None, None]
        std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225])[None, :, None, None]
        with torch.inference_mode():
            for records, array in zip(source_rows, arrays, strict=True):
                values = torch.stack([image_tensor(row) for row in records[:BATCH]])
                encoded = F.normalize(
                    model(pixel_values=(values - mean) / std).pooler_output.float(), dim=1
                ).numpy()
                assert np.array_equal(encoded, array[:BATCH]), "B8 source embedding replay differs"
        assert model_hash(model) == BACKBONE and torch.equal(rng, torch.get_rng_state())
        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
        unchanged()
        receipt = {
            "status": "completed-source-content-anchor-bank-no-training-admission",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "input_rows": plan["input_rows"],
            "vectors": ref(root / "unit-vectors-f32.npy"),
            "rows": len(selected),
            "fresh": 0,
            "reused": len(selected),
            "pools": plan["pools"],
            "engineering": False,
            "original_two_B8_replays_bitwise": True,
            "all_selected_pixel_hashes_checked": True,
            "all_selected_vectors_exact_to_completed_sources": True,
            "backbone_unchanged": BACKBONE,
            "Torch_RNG_unchanged": True,
            "CUDA_initialized": False,
            "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
            "recipe": RECIPE,
            "training_admission": False,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        }
        save(root / "receipt.json", receipt)
        status(receipt["status"], receipt=ref(root / "receipt.json"))
    except BaseException as error:
        status("failed-reused-content-anchor-bank-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="mode", required=True)
    command = sub.add_parser("freeze")
    for name in ["previous", "arrivals", "root"]:
        command.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    command.add_argument("--reserve-gib", type=int, default=548)
    command = sub.add_parser("run")
    command.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "freeze":
        print(
            json.dumps(
                freeze(args.previous, args.arrivals, args.root, reserve_gib=args.reserve_gib)
            )
        )
    else:
        run(args.plan)

"""Screen both clean references of quarantined paired scenes; never admit training."""

import os

os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "2")
os.environ.setdefault("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "2")

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import rawpy
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from demosaic.io import exif_identity
from demosaic.paired import verify_file
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

SHARED = Path(__file__).with_name("screen_commons_protected.py")
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("paired_shared_overlap", SHARED)
overlap = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(overlap)


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def commons_pool(manifest):
    manifest = Path(manifest)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines()]
    rows = [r for r in rows if r["split"] in ("val", "test")]
    if not rows or len({r["id"] for r in rows}) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("Expected unique protected Commons val/test sources")
    entries, hashes, normalized, ratios, informative = [], [], [], [], []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        path = manifest.parent / row["cache"]
        if sha(path) != row["cache_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Protected Commons cache changed")
        array = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
        if array.dtype != np.uint16 or array.ndim != 3 or array.shape[-1] != 3:
            raise ValueError("Protected Commons cache must be linear uint16 RGB")
        for view in overlap.views(array):
            hashes.append(view["hash"])
            normalized.append(view["normalized"])
            ratios.append(view["ratio"])
            informative.append(view["informative"])
            entries.append((index, row["id"], {k: view[k] for k in ["roi", "orientation"]}))
        if (index + 1) % 500 == 0:
            print(json.dumps({"event": "commons-reference-pool", "sources": index + 1}), flush=True)
    return {
        "entries": entries,
        "hashes": np.stack(hashes),
        "normalized": np.stack(normalized),
        "ratios": np.asarray(ratios),
        "informative": np.asarray(informative),
    }, [{k: row[k] for k in ["id", "split", "title", "cache_sha256"]} for row in rows]


def decode_reference(record, output):
    verified = verify_file(record["path"], record)
    if verified["sha256"] != record["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Acquired reference SHA256 changed")
    with rawpy.imread(record["path"]) as decoder:
        if decoder.raw_pattern is None or decoder.raw_pattern.shape != (2, 2):
            raise ValueError("Expected an ordinary Bayer reference")
        pattern = "".join(
            decoder.color_desc.decode("ascii")[
                decoder.raw_color(decoder.sizes.top_margin + y, decoder.sizes.left_margin + x)
            ]
            for y in range(2)
            for x in range(2)
        )
        if pattern not in ["RGGB", "BGGR", "GRBG", "GBRG"]:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported Bayer reference colors")
        sensor_shape = list(decoder.raw_image_visible.shape)
        rgb = decoder.postprocess(
            half_size=True,
            output_bps=16,
            gamma=(1, 1),
            use_camera_wb=True,
            no_auto_bright=True,
            adjust_maximum_thr=0,
            user_flip=0,
            output_color=rawpy.ColorSpace.sRGB,
        )
    height, width = (value // 4 * 4 for value in rgb.shape[:2])
    if min(height, width) < 128:
        raise ValueError("Reference too small for identity views")
    values = rgb[:height, :width].reshape(height // 4, 4, width // 4, 4, 3)
    cache = ((values.sum((1, 3), dtype=np.uint32) + 8) // 16).astype(np.uint16)
    path = output / f"{record['sha256']}.npy"
    with path.with_suffix(".tmp").open("wb") as handle:
        np.save(handle, cache)
    path.with_suffix(".tmp").replace(path)
    return {
        "source_sha256": record["sha256"],
        "source": record,
        "screen_cache": str(path),
        "screen_sha256": sha(path),
        "screen_shape": list(cache.shape),
        "identity": exif_identity(record["path"]),
        "pattern": pattern,
        "sensor_shape": sensor_shape,
        "render": "LibRaw half-size linear-sRGB/camera-WB/no auto bright/no rotation, then area4; identity screening only",
    }


def contact_pages(outcomes, output):
    for first in range(0, len(outcomes), 20):
        page = Image.new("RGB", (1000, 5 * 176), "white")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(page)
        for i, row in enumerate(outcomes[first : first + 20]):
            if "screen_cache" not in row:
                continue
            array = np.load(row["screen_cache"], allow_pickle=False).astype(np.float32) / 65535
            srgb = np.where(array <= 0.0031308, array * 12.92, 1.055 * array ** (1 / 2.4) - 0.055)
            image = Image.fromarray(np.rint(np.clip(srgb, 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8))
            image.thumbnail((240, 142))
            x, y = (i % 4) * 250, (i // 4) * 176
            page.paste(image, (x, y + 24))
            draw.text((x + 2, y + 2), f"{row['scene']} [{row['reference_index']}]", fill="black")
            draw.text(
                (x + 2, y + 164),
                "HELD" if row["held"] else "screen clear; review pending",
                fill="black",
            )
        page.save(output / f"content-review-{first // 20:02d}.jpg", quality=92)


def screen(manifest, protected, commons, output):
    manifest, protected, commons = (Path(p).resolve() for p in [manifest, protected, commons])
    data = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
    if data["split"] != "quarantine" or any(p["split"] != "quarantine" for p in data["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("Screen only explicitly quarantined acquisitions")
    scenes = [p["scene"] for p in data["selection"]]
    if not scenes or len(set(scenes)) != len(scenes):
        raise ValueError("Expected unique quarantined scenes")
    if any(not 1 <= len(p["clean"]) <= 2 for p in data["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("Expected one or two clean references per scene")
    identities = [r["sha256"] for p in data["selection"] for r in p["clean"]]
    if len(set(identities)) != len(identities) or any(
        len(s) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in s) for s in identities
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected unique SHA256 reference identities")
    recipe = {
        "manifest": str(manifest),
        "manifest_sha256": sha(manifest),
        "protected": str(protected),
        "protected_sha256": sha(protected),
        "commons": str(commons),
        "commons_sha256": sha(commons),
        "script_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "shared_screen_sha256": sha(SHARED),
        "io_source_sha256": sha(inspect.getsourcefile(exif_identity)),
        "rawpy_version": rawpy.__version__,
        "numpy_version": np.__version__,
        "method": "Both clean references; seven full/center/corner views x8 dihedral transforms on both sides; informative std>.005, aspect4%, dHash<=40 OR correlation>=.95. Any flag/decode error holds the whole scene.",
        "scope": "Data identity and content review only. Finite screening cannot prove scene separation. No model scoring or training admission.",
    }
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (output / ".screen.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if (output / "summary.json").exists():
            raise ValueError("Screen result is frozen; use a new output")
        path = output / "recipe.json"
        if path.exists() and json.loads(path.read_text()) != recipe:
            raise ValueError("Screen recipe changed")
        path.write_text(json.dumps(recipe, indent=2) + "\n")
        archive = output / "source"
        archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for p in [manifest, protected, commons, Path(__file__), SHARED]:
            (archive / p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
        cache, ledger = output / "screens", output / "outcomes"
        cache.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        ledger.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        protected_data = overlap.protected_pool(protected)
        common_data, common_sources = commons_pool(commons)
        outcomes = []
        for scene in data["selection"]:
            for index, record in enumerate(scene["clean"]):
                path = ledger / f"{record['sha256']}.json"
                if path.exists():
                    verified = verify_file(record["path"], record)
                    if verified["sha256"] != record["sha256"]:
                        raise ValueError("Saved reference source changed")
                    row = json.loads(path.read_text())
                    if row["source_sha256"] != record["sha256"]:
                        raise ValueError("Reference identity changed")
                    if "screen_cache" in row and sha(row["screen_cache"]) != row["screen_sha256"]:
                        raise ValueError("Saved reference screen changed")
                else:
                    row = {
                        "scene": scene["scene"],
                        "reference_index": index,
                        "source_sha256": record["sha256"],
                    }
                    try:
                        row.update(decode_reference(record, cache))
                    except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError, rawpy.LibRawError) as error:
                        row.update({"held": True, "reason": repr(error)})
                    else:
                        array = np.load(row["screen_cache"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
                        row["protected_matches"] = overlap.matches(array, protected_data)
                        row["commons_matches"] = overlap.matches(array, common_data)
                        row["held"] = bool(row["protected_matches"] or row["commons_matches"])
                        if not any(v["informative"] for v in overlap.views(array)):
                            row.update({"held": True, "reason": "No informative reference views"})
                        if not row["identity"].get("Model"):
                            row.update({"held": True, "reason": "Camera identity missing"})
                    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
                    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2) + "\n")
                    temporary.replace(path)
                outcomes.append(row)
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "event": "paired-reference-screen",
                            "scene": scene["scene"],
                            "reference": index,
                            "held": row["held"],
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
        held = {r["scene"] for r in outcomes if r["held"]}
        clear = [r for r in data["selection"] if r["scene"] not in held]
        contact_pages(outcomes, output)
        cleared = output / "manifest-screen-clear-quarantine.json"
        records = [r for p in clear for role in ["clean", "noisy"] for r in p[role]]
        cleared.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    **data,
                    "selection": clear,

        }
        assert (

        )
        (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Evaluate a sensor-loss trial with audited parent/V60/prior/reference grid arrays."""

import argparse
import copy
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from evaluate_color_grid_cuda import evaluate_records, read
from prepare_color_grid import sha

PARENT = "cc1fb5e6d3e0d042c95495dd7bf1bd07c900cb6f7e3b61541f78c9e08098fea3"
CONTROL = "dde398a05fc5df33167d73967d6b5f62ccf3b165f27f8c745b1fdeb45a87f19a"


def main(
    inputs,
    workflow,
    output,
    reuse_report,
    reuse_audit,
    candidate_arm="sensor-mean-additional1k",
    previous_trial_sha256=None,
):
    status = read(workflow)
    assert status["status"] == "completed-primary-panels-awaiting-hue-statistical-and-native-review"
    owner = status["controller"]
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        if (
            abs(process.create_time() - owner["created"]) < 0.01
            and process.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Primary evaluation owner remains live")
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        pass
    checkpoint = status["checkpoint"]
    candidate = checkpoint["sha256"]
    assert checkpoint["step"] == 1000 and candidate == sha(checkpoint["path"])
    old = read(reuse_report)

    def previous(digest):
        found = [c for c in old["checkpoints"] if c["sha256"] == digest]
        assert len(found) == 1 and found[0]["kind"] == "joint-checkpoint"
        return copy.deepcopy(found[0])

    records = [previous(digest) for digest in [PARENT, CONTROL]]
    records[0]["comparison_role"] = "mature-parent"
    records[1]["comparison_role"] = "matched-loss-off-control-V60-first1k"
    if previous_trial_sha256:
        assert previous_trial_sha256 not in [PARENT, CONTROL, candidate]
        records.append(previous(previous_trial_sha256))
        records[-1]["comparison_role"] = "previous-sensor-loss-trial-first1k"
    records.append(
        {
            "path": checkpoint["path"],
            "sha256": candidate,
            "kind": "joint-checkpoint",
            "arm": candidate_arm,
            "comparison_role": "new-sensor-loss-trial-first1k",
        }
    )
    references = [c for c in old["checkpoints"] if c["kind"] == "authors-RAW-reference-plus-Malvar"]
    assert len(references) == 1
    records.append(copy.deepcopy(references[0]))
    records[-1]["comparison_role"] = "released-nonlocal-reference"
    evaluate_records(inputs, workflow, output, records, PARENT, 1000, reuse_report, reuse_audit)
    # Archive the entry point as well as the shared engine/helpers.
    archive = output / "source" / Path(__file__).name
    archive.write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ["inputs", "workflow", "output", "reuse-report", "reuse-audit"]:
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate-arm", default="sensor-mean-additional1k")
    parser.add_argument("--previous-trial-sha256")
    main(**vars(parser.parse_args()))

"""Reuse completed caches in a separately reviewed, coupled Commons extension."""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
from commons_preparation_review import load_failure_review, validate_coverage

from demosaic.prepare import free_license
from demosaic.safety import REPOSITORY, writable_path

REBIN_FIELDS = {"cache", "cache_sha256", "shape", "bin_factor"}
ACTIVE = {"train", "val", "test"}
REVIEW_STATUS = "completed-source-content-and-conservative-metadata-review-for-future-admission"


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        value = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": value}


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def rows(path):
    values = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_bytes().splitlines()]
    if len({r["id"] for r in values}) != len(values):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate manifest identity")
    return values


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def checked(item):
    require(ref(item["path"]) == item, "Changed review/source binding")
    return read(item["path"])


def reviewed_rows(candidates, review):
    """No flag, reserved source or omitted identity can become training data."""
    by_id = {r["id"]: r for r in candidates}
    require(len(by_id) == len(candidates), "Duplicate candidate identity")
    downloaded = review.get("format_version") == 2
    allowed = {"train", "reserved", "excluded"} if downloaded else {"train", "reserved"}
    require(all(r["split"] in allowed for r in candidates), "Unexpected candidate split")
    require(review["manual_source_content_screen_complete"] is True, "Content review incomplete")
    require(
        review["all_candidate_thumbnails_actually_viewed"] == len(candidates),
        "Content coverage differs",
    )
    sets = {}
    for name in ["eligible_train_ids", "withheld_train_ids", "new_reserved_ids"]:
        values = review[name]
        sets[name] = set(values)
        require(len(values) == len(sets[name]), "Duplicate review decision")
    eligible, withheld, reserved = (sets[k] for k in sets)
    require(
        not eligible & withheld and not (eligible | withheld) & reserved, "Review decisions overlap"
    )
    require(
        eligible | withheld == {r["id"] for r in candidates if r["split"] == "train"},
        "Training decisions incomplete or include a nontraining source",
    )
    require(
        reserved == {r["id"] for r in candidates if r["split"] == "reserved"},
        "Reserved decisions differ",
    )
    if downloaded:
        values = review["preexcluded_ids"]
        require(
            len(values) == len(set(values))
            and set(values) == {r["id"] for r in candidates if r["split"] == "excluded"},
            "Duplicate exclusions differ",
        )
    result = copy.deepcopy(candidates)
    for row in result:
        if row["id"] in withheld:
            row.update(
                original_split="train",
                split="excluded",
                excluded_reason="conservative-new-source-title-content-or-series-risk"
                if downloaded
                else "conservative-new-source-title-or-series-risk",
            )
    return result


def source_fields(row):
    return {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in REBIN_FIELDS}


def freeze(base4, base8, prepared4, candidate8, review_path, output, *, reserve_gib=500):
    require(
        type(reserve_gib) is int and reserve_gib >= 256,
        "External disk reserve must be an integer of at least256GiB",
    )
    output = writable_path(output)
    require(not output.exists(), "Output exists; preserve previous freezes")
    require(psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 24 * 2**30, "System memory guard")
    require(shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free >= reserve_gib * 2**30, "External disk reserve")
    inputs = [ref(p) for p in [base4, base8, prepared4, candidate8, review_path, __file__]]
    review = read(review_path)
    require(
        review["format_version"] in {1, 2} and review["status"] == REVIEW_STATUS,
        "Review not complete",
    )
    downloaded = review["format_version"] == 2
    inventory = checked(review["inventory"])
    if not downloaded:
        require(
            inventory["candidate_manifest"] == ref(candidate8)
            and inventory["base_manifest"] == ref(base8),
            "Wrong reviewed candidate/base",
        )
    duplicate = checked(review["duplicate_audit"])
    require(
        duplicate["manifest_sha256"] == ref(candidate8)["sha256"]
        and duplicate["base_sha256"] == ref(base8)["sha256"],
        "Duplicate audit differs",
    )
    terminal = checked(review["producer_terminal"])
    expected_status = (
        "prepared-and-screened-downloaded-quarantine-awaiting-independent-review"
        if downloaded
        else "prepared-and-screened-quarantine-awaiting-independent-review"
    )
    require(terminal["status"] == expected_status, "Cache producer incomplete")
    require(terminal["receipt"] == review["producer_receipt"], "Wrong producer receipt")
    owner = terminal["owner"]
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        require(
            process.create_time() != owner["created"] or process.status() == psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,
            "Cache producer still live",
        )
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        pass
    producer = checked(review["producer_receipt"])
    if downloaded:
        producer_plan = checked(producer["plan"])
        require(
            producer_plan["engineering_only"] is review["engineering_only"],
            "Engineering/production producer mixed",
        )
    protected = checked(producer["screening"])
    if downloaded:
        require(
            duplicate["max_hamming"] == 8 and duplicate["min_correlation"] == 0.99,
            "Duplicate thresholds differ from the reviewed operator",
        )
        require(
            Path(duplicate["addition_manifest"]).resolve()
            == Path(protected["cleared_manifest"]).resolve()
            and duplicate["addition_sha256"] == protected["cleared_sha256"],
            "Duplicate audit bypasses protected screening",
        )
    expected_four = Path(protected["manifest"]).parent.parent / "prepared4/manifest.jsonl"
    require(
        Path(prepared4).resolve() == expected_four.resolve(), "Wrong complete4 producer manifest"
    )
    area = checked(producer["cache_audit"])
    require(area["area_max_uint16_codes"] <= 1, "Cache/area audit failed")
    if any(area["errors"].values()):
        require(
            downloaded and review.get("preparation_failure_review"),
            "Unreviewed preparation errors remain",
        )
        failure_ref = review["preparation_failure_review"]
        require(ref(failure_ref["path"]) == failure_ref, "Changed preparation failure review")
        failure = load_failure_review(
            failure_ref["path"], producer["plan"], producer_plan["selection"]
        )
        raw_selection = read(producer_plan["selection"]["path"])
        raw_prepared = {"4": rows(prepared4), "8": rows(protected["manifest"])}
        validate_coverage(raw_selection, raw_prepared, area["errors"], failure["errors"])
        require(
            area["prepared"] == {k: len(v) for k, v in raw_prepared.items()},
            "Prepared failure coverage differs",
        )
        inputs.extend(failure["inputs"])
    for contact in review["viewed_contacts"]:
        require(contact["actual_viewed"] is True, "Unviewed content screen")
        require(ref(contact["PNG"]["path"]) == contact["PNG"], "Changed contact screen")
    require(
        [c["PNG"] for c in review["viewed_contacts"]] == [c["PNG"] for c in inventory["contacts"]],
        "Content screens incomplete",
    )
    require(
        sum(c["count"] for c in inventory["contacts"]) == len(inventory["new_rows"]),
        "Content count differs",
    )
    if not downloaded:
        for item in [*review["viewed_title_pair_contacts"], review["viewed_new_reserved_pairs"]]:
            require(ref(item["path"]) == item, "Changed viewed title-pair screen")
        title = checked(review["title_screen"])
        policy = checked(title["policy"])
        require(
            title["inventory"] == review["inventory"] and title["policy"] == review["title_policy"],
            "Wrong title review",
        )
        require(
            policy["threshold"] == 0.55
            and title["status"] == "completed-metadata-risk-screen-no-training-admission",
            "Incomplete title screen",
        )
        decisions = checked(title["decisions"])
        require(
            sorted(r["id"] for r in decisions if r["decision"] == "eligible-after-data-review")
            == review["eligible_train_ids"],
            "Title flag released without separate review",
        )
        require(
            sorted(r["id"] for r in decisions if r["decision"] != "eligible-after-data-review")
            == review["withheld_train_ids"],
            "Title decisions differ",
        )
    old4, old8, combined, four = [rows(p) for p in [base4, base8, candidate8, prepared4]]
    require(len(four) == area["prepared"]["4"], "Prepared4 membership incomplete")
    before8, before4 = ({r["id"]: r for r in group} for group in [old8, old4])
    after = {r["id"]: r for r in combined}
    require(
        before8.keys() <= after.keys() and all(after[k] == r for k, r in before8.items()),
        "Existing source or split changed",
    )
    new = [r for r in combined if r["id"] not in before8]
    if downloaded:
        from review_downloaded_commons import validate_downloaded_review

        inputs += [
            ref(Path(__file__).with_name(name))
            for name in [
                "review_downloaded_commons.py",
                "screen_commons_titles.py",
                "render_commons_contact_sheets.py",
            ]
        ]
        validate_downloaded_review(
            review, inventory, new, base8, prepared4, Path(protected["manifest"]), candidate8
        )
    else:
        require(new == inventory["new_rows"], "Reviewed additions differ")
    reviewed = reviewed_rows(new, review)
    active8 = {k for k, r in before8.items() if r["split"] in ACTIVE}
    require(before4.keys() == active8, "Base4/base8 active membership differs")
    require(
        all(source_fields(r) == source_fields(before8[k]) for k, r in before4.items()),
        "Base4/base8 source metadata differs",
    )
    four_by_id = {r["id"]: r for r in four}
    eligible = [r for r in reviewed if r["split"] == "train"]
    new4, audited = [], []
    for row in eligible:
        require(
            row["id"] in four_by_id and row["id"] not in before4, "Missing/new4 identity collision"
        )
        companion = copy.deepcopy(four_by_id[row["id"]])
        require(source_fields(companion) == source_fields(row), "New4/new8 source or split differs")
        companion["cache"] = str((Path(prepared4).parent / companion["cache"]).resolve())
        for factor, item in [(4, companion), (8, row)]:
            path = (
                (Path(prepared4).parent / item["cache"]).resolve()
                if factor == 4
                else Path(item["cache"]).resolve()
            )
            require(
                path.is_relative_to(REPOSITORY) or path.is_relative_to("/mnt/external"),
                "Cache outside allowed SSD roots",
            )
            require(
                item["bin_factor"] == factor
                and item["dtype"] == "uint16"
                and item["color_space"] == "linear-sRGB"
                and free_license(item["license"]),
                "Invalid cache recipe/license",
            )
            require(ref(path)["sha256"] == item["cache_sha256"], "Cache bytes changed")
            pixels = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
            require(
                pixels.dtype == np.uint16
                and list(pixels.shape) == item["shape"]
                and pixels.ndim == 3
                and pixels.shape[-1] == 3
                and min(pixels.shape[:2]) >= 2048 // factor,
                "Cache shape/dtype differs",
            )
            audited.append(
                {
                    "id": item["id"],
                    "factor": factor,
                    "sha256": item["cache_sha256"],
                    "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                }
            )
        new4.append(companion)
    for item in inputs:
        require(ref(item["path"]) == item, "Input changed during freeze")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, output / "source.py")
    if downloaded:
        source_output = output / "executed-review-sources"
        source_output.mkdir()
        for name in [
            "review_downloaded_commons.py",
            "screen_commons_titles.py",
            "render_commons_contact_sheets.py",
        ]:
            shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).with_name(name), source_output / name)
    outputs = {}
    for factor, source, added in [(4, base4, new4), (8, base8, reviewed)]:
        prefix = Path(source).read_bytes()
        require(prefix.endswith(b"\n"), "Base manifest requires a final newline")
        path = output / f"manifest{factor}.jsonl"
        path.write_bytes(
            prefix + b"".join((json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode() for r in added)
        )
        outputs[str(factor)] = ref(path)
    receipt = {
        "status": "frozen-reviewed-coupled-Commons-extension-no-active-recipe-change",
        "review_format_version": review["format_version"],
        "engineering_only": bool(review.get("engineering_only", False)),
        "external_reserve_gib": reserve_gib,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "manual_review": ref(review_path),
        "manifests": outputs,
        "counts4": dict(Counter(r["split"] for r in old4 + new4)),
        "counts8": dict(Counter(r["split"] for r in old8 + reviewed)),
        "new_train": len(eligible),
        "new_withheld": len(review["withheld_train_ids"]),
        "new_reserved": len(review["new_reserved_ids"]),
        "all_old_rows_and_literal_bytes_preserved": True,
        "new4_new8_training_membership_and_source_metadata_exact": True,
        "new_training_cache_SHA256_header_checks": len(audited),
        "new_training_cache_bytes": sum(a["bytes"] for a in audited),
        "cache_audit": audited,
        "scope": "Separately frozen future corpus only. All old rows/splits and source caches preserved. New4 includes only reviewed active training members; new8 additionally records reserved/excluded arrivals. Finite source/content/title screens do not prove complete scene independence or native noiseless targets. No model-quality result, active recipe update or protected-final performance scoring.",
    }
    (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "receipt": ref(output / "receipt.json"),
                "new_train": len(eligible),
                "counts4": receipt["counts4"],
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for key in ["base4", "base8", "prepared4", "candidate8", "review", "output"]:
        parser.add_argument("--" + key, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--reserve-gib", type=int, default=500)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == "", "Use hidden CUDA for data-only freezing")
    freeze(
        args.base4,
        args.base8,
        args.prepared4,
        args.candidate8,
        args.review,
        args.output,
        reserve_gib=args.reserve_gib,
    )
