    arms = execution_arms(execution, plan["training_execution"], training_format)
    assert len(arms) == plan.get("expected_model_count", len(arms))
    assert set(state["completed"]) == set(plan["expected_training_phases"])
    checkpoints, inputs = [], list(plan["inputs"])
    artifacts = Path(plan["artifact_root"])
    artifacts.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for arm in arms:
        name = arm["arm"]
        accounting = state["completed"][f"train-{name}"]
        assert ref(accounting["path"]) == accounting
        actual = read(accounting["path"])
        assert not live(actual["owner"])
        assert actual["counts"]["training_forwards"] == actual["counts"]["optimizer_steps"] == 20000
        if training_format == "matched-execution-v1":
            assert actual["all_AdamW_steps"] == 20000
            assert actual["model_EMA_Adam_finite"] and actual["frozen_encoder_no_gradients"]
        if name == "V115":
            assert actual["matched_logged_inputs_steps_domains_LRs"] == 801
        training = read(arm["training_plan"]["path"])
        assert ref(actual["checkpoint"]["path"]) == actual["checkpoint"]
        path, digest = freeze_checkpoint(
            actual["checkpoint"]["path"],
            artifacts / "weights",
            cache_dir=plan["shared_checkpoint_cache"],
        )
        assert digest == actual["checkpoint"]["sha256"]
        snapshot = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
        if training_format == "learned-frequency-scopes-v1":
            parent = torch.load(
                training["parent"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True
            )
            verify_frequency_training_state(actual, snapshot, parent, execution["arm_scopes"][name])
            del parent
        if training_format == "independent-noise-mean-v1":
            verify_noise_pair_training_state(actual, snapshot, execution["arm_weights"][name])
        if training_format == "matched-raw-spatial-v1":
            verify_spatial_training_state(actual, snapshot, name == "V132")
        if training_format == "reviewed-photographic-quota-v1":
            import yaml

            comparison_path = Path(training["root"]) / "train-V133-input-comparison-v1.json"
            comparison = read(comparison_path)
            assert comparison["candidate"] == accounting
            expected_config = yaml.safe_load(Path(training["arms"][name]["train"]).read_text())
            verify_quota_training_state(actual, snapshot, comparison, expected_config)
            inputs.append(ref(comparison_path))
        if training_format == "matched-photographic-epoch-v1":
            import yaml

            comparison = None
            if name == "V135":
                comparison_path = Path(training["root"]) / "train-V135-input-comparison-v1.json"
                comparison = read(comparison_path)
                assert comparison["candidate"] == accounting
                inputs.append(ref(comparison_path))
            expected_config = yaml.safe_load(Path(training["arms"][name]["train"]).read_text())
            verify_photo_epoch_training_state(actual, snapshot, comparison, expected_config)
        lineage = {**training["parent"], "step": 20000}
        assert snapshot["step"] == 20000 and snapshot["config"]["initialized_from"] == lineage
        checkpoints.append(
            {
                "arm": name,
                "EMA_tensors": len(snapshot["ema"]),
                **ref(path),
                "expected_lineage": {"step": 20000, "initialized_from": lineage},
                "expected_backbone": training["backbones"][name],
            }
        )
        inputs.extend([accounting, actual["checkpoint"], ref(path)])
    stages = {}
    for name, specification in plan["stages"].items():
        spec = dict(specification)
        if "future_input_witness" in spec:
            binding = ref(spec["future_input_witness"])
            result_binding = ref(spec["future_original_result"])
            result = read(result_binding["path"])
            assert result["averaged_observations"] == spec["observations_per_model"]
            assert (
                result["retained_means"] == binding
                and result["all_streamed_numpy64_means_bit_exact"]
            )
            assert len(Path(binding["path"]).read_text().splitlines()) == spec["calls_per_model"]
            spec["input_witness"] = binding
            inputs.extend([binding, result_binding])
        stages[name] = spec
    result = {**plan, "checkpoints": checkpoints, "stages": stages, "inputs": inputs}
    save(Path(plan["root"]) / "evaluation-plan-v1.json", result)
    return Path(plan["root"]) / "evaluation-plan-v1.json"


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["controller_source"]
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    state = {"owner": owner, "queue_plan": ref(path), "completed": {}}
    child = child_owner = None
    owner_field = plan.get("training_owner_field", "owner")
    execution_field = plan.get("training_execution_field", "execution_plan")

    def record(status, **fields):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        record("waiting-for-exact-matched-training-owner", dependency=plan["training_owner"])
        began = time.monotonic()
        while live(plan["training_owner"]):
            observed = read(plan["training_status"])
            assert (
                observed[owner_field] == plan["training_owner"]
                and observed[execution_field] == plan["training_execution"]
            )
            assert not observed["status"].startswith("failed"), observed["status"]
            assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["maximum_training_wait_seconds"]
            time.sleep(10)
        observed = read(plan["training_status"])
        assert (
            observed[owner_field] == plan["training_owner"]
            and observed[execution_field] == plan["training_execution"]
        )
        assert observed["status"] == plan["expected_training_terminal"]
        assert observed.get("child") is None or not live(observed["child"])
        guard(plan)
        evaluation_path = endpoint_plan(plan, observed)
        evaluation = read(evaluation_path)
        for index, stage in enumerate(plan["stages"]):
            record("waiting-for-quality-headroom", stage=stage, child=None)
            began, stable = time.monotonic(), None
            while True:
                if deadline := plan.get("absolute_stage_headroom_deadlines", {}).get(stage):
                    assert time.time() < deadline
                enough = (
                    psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 48 * 2**30
                    and shutil.disk_usage(root).free
                    >= plan.get("phase_start_internal_free_GiB", 32) * 2**30
                    and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free
                    >= plan[
                        "first_stage_external_free_GiB"
                        if index == 0
                        else "phase_start_external_free_GiB"
                    ]
                    * 2**30
                )
                stable = (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable) if enough else None
                if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= 15:
                    break
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200
                time.sleep(2)
            guard(evaluation)
            work = Path(plan["work"])
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{work / 'src'}:{work / 'scripts'}",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="4",
            )
            with (root / (stage + "-v1.log")).open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        plan["collector_source"]["path"],
                        str(evaluation_path),
                        stage,
                    ],
                    cwd=work,
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-frozen-endpoint-quality-stage", stage=stage, child=child_owner)
                began = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    if deadline := plan.get("absolute_stage_deadlines", {}).get(stage):
                        assert time.time() < deadline
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < 43200
                    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available >= 24 * 2**30
                    assert (
                        shutil.disk_usage(root).free
                        >= plan.get("runtime_internal_reserve_GiB", 16) * 2**30
                    )
                    assert (
                        shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free
                        >= plan["runtime_external_reserve_GiB"] * 2**30
                    )
                    time.sleep(2)
                assert child.wait() == 0, (stage, child.returncode)
            result_path = Path(plan["stages"][stage]["output"]) / "result.json"
            result = read(result_path)
            assert result["owner"] == child_owner and not live(child_owner)
            state["completed"][stage] = ref(result_path)
            record("completed-quality-stage", child=None)
        record(
            "completed-matched-endpoint-evaluation-awaiting-independent-and-native-review",
            child=None,
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                if live(child_owner):
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                child.wait(timeout=30)
        record("failed-quality-evaluation-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["prepare", "controller"])

"""Account for explicitly reviewed source failures without relaxing cache coverage."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE_FIELDS = (
    "title",
    "page_url",
    "original_url",
    "author",
    "license",
    "license_url",
    "attribution",
    "credit",
    "sha1",
    "sha1_hex",
    "download_path",
    "width",
    "height",
)


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def checked(item):
    require(ref(item["path"]) == item, "Changed failure-review evidence")
    return read(item["path"])


def load_failure_review(path, producer, selection):
    if path is None:
        return {"errors": {}, "inputs": []}
    ledger = read(path)
    require(
        ledger["format_version"] == 1
        and ledger["status"] == "reviewed-source-preparation-failures-withheld",
        "Unrecognized source-failure review",
    )
    require(
        ledger["producer_plan"] == producer and ledger["selection"] == selection,
        "Failure review belongs to another producer/selection",
    )
    checked(producer)
    selected = checked(selection)
    by_id = {row["sha1_hex"]: row for row in selected}
    require(len(by_id) == len(selected), "Duplicate selected source identity")
    review = checked(ledger["source_review"])
    entries = ledger["sources"]
    errors = {}
    for row in entries:
        identity = row["id"]
        require(identity in by_id and identity not in errors, "Unknown/duplicate reviewed failure")
        require(row["decision"] == "withhold" and bool(row["reason"]), "Failure was not withheld")
        require(row["source"] == by_id[identity], "Failure source identity/attribution changed")
        require(
            isinstance(row["expected_error"], str) and bool(row["expected_error"]),
            "Missing reviewed failure reason",
        )
        errors[identity] = row["expected_error"]
    require(bool(errors), "Empty source-failure review")
    require(
        review["actual_viewed"] is True
        and len(review["reviewed_ids"]) == len(errors)
        and set(review["reviewed_ids"]) == set(errors),
        "Failure source review is incomplete",
    )
    inputs = [ref(path), producer, selection, ledger["source_review"]]
    for name in ["inspection", "image"]:
        item = review[name]
        require(ref(item["path"]) == item, "Changed inspected source evidence")
        inputs.append(item)
    return {"errors": errors, "inputs": inputs}


def validate_coverage(selection, prepared, failures, reviewed_errors):
    """Every selected source must be cached or one exact reviewed withheld failure."""
    selected = {row["sha1_hex"]: row for row in selection}
    require(len(selected) == len(selection), "Duplicate selected source identity")
    require(set(reviewed_errors) <= set(selected), "Unknown declared failure")
    factors = set(prepared)
    require(
        bool(factors) and factors <= {"4", "8"} and set(failures) == factors,
        "Unexpected/incomplete cache scales",
    )
    accepted = set(selected) - set(reviewed_errors)
    for factor in factors:
        failed = {row["id"]: row["error"] for row in failures[factor]}
        require(len(failed) == len(failures[factor]), "Duplicate actual source failure")
        require(failed == reviewed_errors, "Undeclared, changed or missing source failure")
        values = prepared[factor]
        by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in values}
        require(
            len(by_id) == len(values) and set(by_id) == accepted,
            "Cache/failure source partition differs",
        )
        for identity, row in by_id.items():
            require(
                all(
                    field in row and row[field] == selected[identity][field]
                    for field in SOURCE_FIELDS
                ),
                "Prepared source attribution changed",
            )
            require(
                row["bin_factor"] == int(factor)
                and row["dtype"] == "uint16"
                and row["color_space"] == "linear-sRGB",
                "Prepared pixel recipe changed",
            )
    return accepted

"""Compare retained shadow targets and real-capture conditioning in sensor units."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import linear_rgb

BRIGHTNESS_EDGES = (0, 2**-12, 2**-10, 2**-8, 2**-6, 2**-4, 2**-2, 1, np.inf)
NOISE_EDGES = (0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, np.inf)


def blocks(values):
    """Native160 center split into100 native16 blocks; keep leading axes."""
    values = np.asarray(values)
    if values.shape[-2:] != (256, 256):
        raise ValueError("Expected a256px prepared context")
    values = values[..., 48:208, 48:208]
    shape = values.shape[:-2]
    values = values.reshape(*shape, 10, 16, 10, 16)
    order = tuple(range(len(shape))) + (len(shape), len(shape) + 2, len(shape) + 1, len(shape) + 3)
    return values.transpose(order).reshape(*shape, 100, 16, 16)


def green_sensor_blocks(clean, colors, shot, read_noise):
    """Mean clean measured-green intensity and pre-ADC pixel-noise RMS.

    Average both physical green planes, not all dense RGB green sites. This
    reports pixel-noise conditioning only, not luma-band SNR or output risk.
    """
    clean = np.asarray(clean, dtype=np.float64)
    colors = np.asarray(colors)
    shot, read_noise = np.asarray(shot).reshape(-1), np.asarray(read_noise).reshape(-1)
    if clean.ndim != 4 or clean.shape[1:] != (3, 256, 256):
        raise ValueError("Need Bx3x256x256 camera-linear clean targets")
    if colors.shape != (len(clean), 4) or any(sorted(c.tolist()) != [0, 1, 1, 2] for c in colors):
        raise ValueError("Need one valid Bayer layout per target")
    if (
        len(shot) != len(clean)
        or len(read_noise) != len(clean)
        or np.any(shot < 0)
        or np.any(read_noise < 0)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Need nonnegative per-target shot/read coefficients")
    if (
        not np.isfinite(clean).all()
        or not np.isfinite(shot).all()
        or not np.isfinite(read_noise).all()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Sensor inputs must be finite")
    dense = blocks(clean[:, 1])
    means, variances, valid = [], [], []
    for i, layout in enumerate(colors):
        phases = [
            dense[i, :, phase // 2 :: 2, phase % 2 :: 2].reshape(100, 64)
            for phase in np.flatnonzero(layout == 1)
        ]
        samples = np.concatenate(phases, axis=1)
        mean = samples.mean(axis=1)
        variance = (np.maximum(samples, 0) * shot[i] + read_noise[i]).mean(axis=1)
        means.append(mean)
        variances.append(variance)
        valid.append(((samples >= 0) & (samples < 0.98)).all(axis=1) & (mean > 0))
    means, variances = np.asarray(means), np.asarray(variances)
    return {
        "green_mean": means,
        "pre_ADC_pixel_variance": variances,
        "relative_pixel_noise_RMS": np.sqrt(variances) / np.maximum(means, 1e-12),
        "green_target_valid": np.asarray(valid),
    }


def cell_indices(green_mean, relative_noise):
    return (
        np.searchsorted(BRIGHTNESS_EDGES[1:-1], green_mean, side="right"),
        np.searchsorted(NOISE_EDGES[1:-1], relative_noise, side="right"),
    )


def checked(binding):
    if ref(binding["path"]) != binding:
        raise ValueError("Retained shadow-analysis input changed")
    return Path(binding["path"])


def analyze(plan_path):
    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "" or "torch" in sys.modules:
        raise RuntimeError("Shadow coverage requires NumPy-only CPU execution")
    plan = read(plan_path)
    for item in plan["inputs"] + plan["frozen_files"]:
        checked(item)
    original = read(checked(plan["original_coverage"]))
    contexts = read(checked(original["per_context"]))
    with np.load(checked(original["block_statistics"]), allow_pickle=False) as archive:
        previous = {key: archive[key] for key in archive.files}
    output = Path(plan["output"])
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    values, row_ids, rows = [], [], []
    control = read(checked(plan["training_receipt"]))
    for step in control["observed_inputs"]:
        if step["domain"] == "paired":
            continue
        with np.load(checked(step["prepared_tensors"]), allow_pickle=False) as archive:
            target = archive["sensor_target"]
            assert len(target) == 32 and np.array_equal(target[:16], target[16:])
            data = {
                key: archive[key][:16]
                for key in ["colors", "shot", "read", "target", "wb", "matrix"]
            }
            sensor = green_sensor_blocks(target[:16], data["colors"], data["shot"], data["read"])
        rgb = linear_rgb(data["target"], data)
        support = blocks(((rgb >= 0) & (rgb <= 1)).all(axis=1)).all(axis=(-2, -1))
        sensor["rendered_in_gamut"] = support
        for i in range(16):
            old_index = (step["step"] - 1) * 16 + i
            context = contexts[old_index]
            assert context["step"] == step["step"] and context["example"] == i
            row = {
                "id": context["id"],
                "family": context["family"],
                "source_id": context["source_id"],
                "step": step["step"],
                "example": i,
                "shot": context["shot"],
                "read": context["read"],
                "prepared_tensors": step["prepared_tensors"],
                "prior_row": old_index,
            }
            rows.append(row)
            row_ids.append(context["id"])
        values.append(sensor)
    arrays = {key: np.concatenate([value[key] for value in values]) for key in values[0]}
    indices = [row["prior_row"] for row in rows]
    for key in ["mean_luma", "band_RMS", "relative_band_RMS"]:
        arrays[key] = previous[key][indices]
    assert len(rows) == 272
    arrays["valid"] = arrays["green_target_valid"] & arrays["rendered_in_gamut"]
    arrays["shadow"] = arrays["mean_luma"] < 0.02
    arrays["weak_band"] = (
        (arrays["relative_band_RMS"] < 0.05)
        & (arrays["mean_luma"] > 0)
        & (arrays["band_RMS"] >= 1e-5)
    )
    bx, by = cell_indices(arrays["green_mean"], arrays["relative_pixel_noise_RMS"])
    arrays["brightness_bin"], arrays["relative_noise_bin"] = bx, by
    with (output / "sensor-blocks.npz").open("xb") as stream:
        np.savez(stream, **arrays)
    summaries = []
    families = list(dict.fromkeys(row["family"] for row in rows))
    for family in families:
        selected = np.asarray([row["family"] == family for row in rows])
        valid = arrays["valid"][selected]
        shadow, weak = arrays["shadow"][selected], arrays["weak_band"][selected]
        summaries.append(
            {
                "family": family,
                "context_slots": int(selected.sum()),
                "total_blocks": int(valid.size),
                "valid_blocks": int(valid.sum()),
                "valid_shadow_blocks": int((valid & shadow).sum()),
                "valid_weak_shadow_blocks": int((valid & shadow & weak).sum()),
                "ADC_only_contexts": sum(
                    row["family"] == family and row["shot"] == row["read"] == 0 for row in rows
                ),
            }
        )
    gfx = []
    with np.load(checked(plan["GFX_inputs"]), allow_pickle=False) as archive:
        raw, colors = archive["raw_context"], archive["colors"][0]
    selection = read(checked(plan["GFX_selection"]))
    for region in selection["regions"]:
        x, y, w, h = region["ROI_xywh"]
        assert w == h == 160
        crop = raw[y : y + h, x : x + w].astype(np.float64)
        samples = np.concatenate(
            [
                crop[(phase // 2 - y) % 2 :: 2, (phase % 2 - x) % 2 :: 2].ravel()
                for phase in np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
            ]
        )
        mean = float(samples.mean())
        assert mean > 0
        for name, profile in plan["GFX_profiles"].items():
            variance = float(np.mean(np.maximum(samples, 0) * profile["shot"] + profile["read"]))
            relative = np.sqrt(variance) / mean
            ix, iy = (int(v) for v in cell_indices(mean, relative))
            matches = arrays["valid"] & (bx == ix) & (by == iy)
            families_matches = []
            for family in families:
                selected = np.asarray([row["family"] == family for row in rows])
                count = matches[selected]
                families_matches.append(
                    {
                        "family": family,
                        "blocks_in_same_condition_cell": int(count.sum()),
                        "weak_blocks_in_cell": int((count & arrays["weak_band"][selected]).sum()),
                        "context_slots_in_cell": int(count.any(axis=1).sum()),
                    }
                )
            gfx.append(
                {
                    "region": region["name"],
                    "profile": name,
                    "nominal_profile": profile,
                    "source_sensor_ROI_xywh": region["noisy_raw_xywh"],
                    "observed_green_mean": mean,
                    "input_only_proxy_pixel_variance": variance,
                    "proxy_relative_pixel_noise_RMS": float(relative),
                    "brightness_bin": ix,
                    "relative_noise_bin": iy,
                    "training_matches": families_matches,
                    "scope": "Observed-green mean and existing supplied variance proxy, not clean brightness, calibrated noise, fine-band SNR, GT or a restoration-quality measurement.",
                }
            )
    save(output / "contexts.json", rows)
    result = {
        "status": "completed-retained-shadow-sensor-condition-coverage",
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "analysis_source": ref(__file__),
        "context_slots": 272,
        "excluded_real_paired_slots": 16,
        "families": summaries,
        "sensor_block_arrays": ref(output / "sensor-blocks.npz"),
        "contexts": ref(output / "contexts.json"),
        "GFX_condition_cells": gfx,
        "brightness_edges": [None if np.isinf(x) else x for x in BRIGHTNESS_EDGES],
        "relative_noise_edges": [None if np.isinf(x) else x for x in NOISE_EDGES],
        "new_neural_forwards": 0,
        "new_noise_observations": 0,
        "RAW_decodes": 0,
        "optimizer_updates": 0,
        "Torch_imported": False,
        "scope": "Bounded retained18-step implementation prefix. Simulated-noise clean targets only; native references retain source noise/optics. Compare pre-ADC per-pixel green-noise conditioning, never luma-band SNR. No full-corpus or quality/admission-policy claim; real GFX proxy is uncalibrated.",
    }
    save(output / "analysis-v1.json", result)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "families": summaries,
                "GFX_cells": [
                    {
                        key: row[key]
                        for key in [
                            "region",
                            "profile",
                            "observed_green_mean",
                            "proxy_relative_pixel_noise_RMS",
                            "brightness_bin",
                            "relative_noise_bin",
                        ]
                    }
                    for row in gfx
                ],
            }
        )
    )
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    analyze(args.plan.resolve())

"""Render fixed V168 native views with V169 balanced/branch diagnostics."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3"


def render():
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    result = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
    assert result["component_forwards"] == result["original_predictions_replayed_exact"] == 1644
    prior = read(plan["prior_figures"]["path"])
    out = ROOT / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    channels = 0
    copied_channels = 0
    for index, item in enumerate(prior["images"]):
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
        old = np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]))
        case = item["case"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        anchor = np.asarray(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        values = result["native_predictions"][case["id"]]
        sources = []
        bindings = {}

        def copied(panel, label=None, *, sources=sources, old=old):
            nonlocal copied_channels
            x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
            assert w == h == 160
            sources.append((label or panel["label"], old[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
            copied_channels += w * h * 3

        def predicted(
            method,
            *,
            values=values,
            anchor=anchor,
            item=item,
            a=a,
            sources=sources,
            bindings=bindings,
        ):
            nonlocal channels
            binding = values[method]
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            value = np.load(binding["path"])
            displayed = anchor + item["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
            actual = pixels(displayed, a, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"])
            expected = independent_display(displayed, a, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"])
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
            assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
            channels += actual.size
            sources.append((method, actual))
            bindings[method] = binding

        if "triplet_source_board" in item:
            label = item["panels"][1]["label"]
            endpoint = "EMA" if "EMA" in label else "raw"
            method = (
                ("balanced" if label.startswith("Fine mesh") else "spectral-only") + "-" + endpoint
            )
            copied(item["panels"][0])
            predicted(method)
            copied(item["panels"][-1])
        else:
            mapping = {p["label"]: p for p in item["panels"]}
            for name, label in [
                ("Noisy Malvar", None),
                ("V143 parent", None),
                ("Fine mesh raw1k", "V168 raw"),
                ("Fine mesh EMA1k", "V168 EMA"),
            ]:
                copied(mapping[name], label)
            for method in [
                "balanced-raw",
                "balanced-EMA",
                "spectral-only-raw",
                "spectral-only-EMA",
                "spatial-only-raw",
                "spatial-only-EMA",
            ]:
                predicted(method)
            for panel in item["panels"]:
                if panel["label"].startswith("V161") or panel["label"] in [
                    "Periodic detail",
                    "Exact constructed GT",
                    "ISO100 AHD, not GT",
                    "ISO6400 JPEG native",
                    "ISO100 JPEG, not GT",
                ]:
                    copied(panel)
        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(sources), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"{case['id']} | V169 fixed weights,contrast{item['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{item['exposure']:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="black",
        )
        panels = []
        for j, (label, value) in enumerate(sources):
            x = 8 + 168 * j
            draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
            board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
            panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})

def sample_kind(seed, index):
    rng = random.Random(seed + index)
    draw = rng.random()
    if draw < 0.1:
        rng.uniform(-13, -1)
        return "neutral-flat" if rng.random() < 0.5 else "colored-flat"
    return "weak" if draw < 0.1 + 0.15 else "strong" if draw < 0.1 + 0.2 else "photo"


def audit_data(config, output):
    import torch

    from demosaic.data import CleanDataset, smooth_scene
    from demosaic.train import domain_indices, training_domain

    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == "" and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    records = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(config["manifest"]).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert sum(r["split"] == "train" for r in records) == 88484
    options = {
        key: config[key]
        for key in (
            "seed",
            "synthetic_fraction",
            "flat_fraction",
            "weak_texture_fraction",
            "augmentation_downsample",
            "optical_blur_probability",
            "photographic_low_contrast_fraction",
        )
    }
    options.update(patch_size=64, records=records)
    control, wide = [
        CleanDataset(config["manifest"], **options, flat_chroma_stops=stops) for stops in (0, 8)
    ]
    indices = list(domain_indices("commons", 0, 64, 16, 57, 0.25, 0.25))[:256]
    coverage = collections.Counter()
    changed = 0
    for index in indices:
        kind = sample_kind(57, index)
        before, after = control[index]["rgb"], wide[index]["rgb"]
        assert all(
            x.shape == (3, 64, 64)
            and x.dtype == torch.float32
            and torch.isfinite(x).all()
            and x.min() >= 0
            and x.max() <= 1
            for x in (before, after)
        )
        equal = torch.equal(before, after)
        assert equal == (kind != "colored-flat"), (index, kind)
        coverage[kind] += 1
        changed += not equal
    assert set(coverage) == {"neutral-flat", "colored-flat", "weak", "strong", "photo"}
    neutral, largest = 0, 0.0
    for index in range(1000):
        a, b = random.Random(20261021 + index), random.Random(20261021 + index)
        before, after = smooth_scene(8, a), smooth_scene(8, b, chroma_stops=8)
        assert a.getstate() == b.getstate()
        if torch.equal(before[0], before[1]) and torch.equal(before[1], before[2]):
            assert torch.equal(before, after)
            neutral += 1
        else:
            means = after.mean((1, 2))
            largest = max(largest, float(means.max() / means.min()))
    domains = collections.Counter(training_domain(s, 57, 0.25, 0.25) for s in range(1, 4001))
    kinds = collections.Counter(
        sample_kind(57, i) for i in domain_indices("commons", 0, 4000, 16, 57, 0.25, 0.25)
    )
    assert domains == {"commons": 2026, "native": 990, "paired": 984}
    assert kinds["colored-flat"] == 1618 and largest > 32 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    result = {
        "status": "current-V95-data-route-and-wider-flat-palette-audit-passed",
        "manifest": ref(config["manifest"]),
        "actual_native64_clean_samples": len(indices),
        "kind_counts": dict(coverage),
        "changed_clean_samples": changed,
        "only_colored_smooth_clean_targets_changed": True,
        "smooth_generator_RNG_pairs": 1000,
        "neutral_fields_exact": neutral,
        "maximum_observed_wide_channel_ratio": largest,
        "planned4000_domain_batches": dict(domains),
        "planned4000_Commons_clean_draws": dict(kinds),
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "scope": "Actual current-recipe native64 clean data, with real curated cache reads, plus seeded generator/schedule checks. No model forward or quality claim. Affected mixed batches need not retain identical Poisson draws; per-step seeding isolates later steps. Actual CPU/native32/B1 and CUDA/native256/B16 worker proofs remain separate.",
    }

    return ref(output)

def controller(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    label = "ADC" if plan.get("model_overrides") else "palette"
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
        "observation_audits": {},
    }
    child, owner, snapshot = None, None, None

    def record(status, **extra):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **extra)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    def observe():
        nonlocal snapshot
        snapshot = resource_snapshot(root)
        with (root / "resource-history.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(snapshot) + "\n")
        return snapshot

    def record_monitor(status, **extra):
        names = {
            "paused-V43-evaluation-disk-reserve": f"paused-{label}-training-disk-reserve",
            "running-V43-quality-evaluation": f"running-{label}-training-stage",
        }
        record(names[status], **extra)

    try:
        for phase in plan["phases"]:
            for arm in plan["arms"]:
                guard(plan)
                record(f"waiting-for-{label}-training-headroom", phase=phase, arm=arm)
                began, stable = time.monotonic(), None
                while True:
                    assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["wait_seconds"]
                    stable = (
                        (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable)
                        if headroom(observe(), plan, 48)
                        else None
                    )
                    if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= plan["stable_seconds"]:
                        break
                    time.sleep(2)
                env = dict(
                    os.environ,
                    PYTHONPATH=str(work / "src") + ":" + str(work / "scripts"),
                    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" if phase == "CPU" else "0",
                    HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                    TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                    OMP_NUM_THREADS="2" if phase == "CPU" else "4",
                    OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="2",
                    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
                )
                env.update(plan["cache_environment"])
                with (root / f"{phase}-{arm}.log").open("xb") as log:
                    child = subprocess.Popen(
                        [
                            plan["python"],
                            "-P",
                            str(work / "scripts/train_v43_quality_trial.py"),
                            "worker",
                            str(plan_path),
                            "--phase",
                            phase,
                            "--arm",
                            arm,
                        ],
                        cwd=work,
                        env=env,
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=log,
                        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                        start_new_session=True,
                    )
                    owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                    record(f"running-{label}-training-stage", child=owner)
                    monitor_child(
                        child,
                        owner,
                        plan=plan,
                        observe=observe,
                        record=record_monitor,
                        deadline=time.monotonic() + plan["timeouts_seconds"][phase],
                    )
                    assert child.wait() == 0, (phase, arm, child.returncode)
                path = root / f"{phase}-{arm}-result.json"
                result = read(path)
                assert result["owner"] == owner and result["plan"] == ref(plan_path)
                assert result["engineering_only"] == (phase != "train")
                state["completed"][f"{phase}-{arm}"] = ref(path)
            results = [read(state["completed"][f"{phase}-{a}"]["path"]) for a in plan["arms"]]
            key = "logged_training_observations" if phase == "train" else "early_observations"
            domains = (
                {"native-RAW-synthetic", "paired-RAW"} if phase == "train" else {"native", "paired"}
            )
            if plan.get("identical_training_observations"):
                domains |= {"synthetic" if phase == "train" else "commons"}
            assert len({r["source_sha256"] for r in results}) == 1
            state["observation_audits"][phase] = compare_pair(
                *[r[key] for r in results],
                domains,
                require_changes=not plan.get("identical_training_observations", False),
            )
            if phase == "train":
                for result in results:
                    probe = read(root / f"CUDA-{result['arm']}-result.json")
                    assert result["early_observations"] == probe["early_observations"]
            record(f"completed-matched-{label}-phase", phase=phase)
        guard(plan)
        record(f"completed-matched-V95-{label}-training-awaiting-full-quality-and-native-review")
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            stop_owned_child(child, owner)
        record(
            f"failed-{label}-stage-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
            error=repr(error),
            last_resource_snapshot=snapshot,
        )
        raise

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))

    if args.mode == "prepare":
        assert args.artifact_root
        prepare(args.path, args.artifact_root, adc_training=args.adc_training)
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V184-wave-readout-admission-v1"


def inspect(output):
    result = read(ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json")
    assert (
        result["status"]
        == "pass-V184-frozen-baseline-native-CUDA-parity-head-gradients-and-restoration"
    )
    assert not owner_live(result["owner"])
    plan = read(result["plan"]["path"])
    assert ref(result["plan"]["path"]) == result["plan"]
    for binding in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    for path, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert ref(path)["sha256"] == digest
    assert not output.exists()
    import torch
    from phase_wave_training_state import clocks, fresh_state, inherited_hash, load_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
    from train_local_noise_matching_trial import tree_equal

    from demosaic.late_phase_wave_readout import LatePhaseWaveReadoutDetail

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    initializer = torch.load(
        plan["initializer"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )
    original_call = torch.nn.Module._call_impl

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("No module forward in CPU inspection")

    torch.nn.Module._call_impl = forbidden
    rows = []
    try:
        for update, (binding, record) in enumerate(
            zip(result["checkpoints"], result["records"], strict=True), 1
        ):
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            checkpoint = torch.load(binding["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            module = LatePhaseWaveReadoutDetail(**plan["module_config"])
            module.load_state_dict(checkpoint["models"], strict=True)
            assert len(module.state_dict()) == 193 and len(initializer["state_dict"]) == 189
            assert all(
                torch.equal(module.state_dict()[n], v) for n, v in initializer["state_dict"].items()
            )
            assert model_hash(module) == record["model_hash"]
            optimizer, _ = fresh_state(module, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"])
            optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint["optimizer"])
            assert tree_equal(optimizer.state_dict(), checkpoint["optimizer"])
            assert clocks(module, optimizer) == {
                "tensors": 4,
                "states": 4,
                "steps": [float(update)],
            }
            raw_hash = model_hash(module)
            load_ema(module, checkpoint["ema"])
            assert (
                inherited_hash(module)
                == checkpoint["inherited_hash"]
                == plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
            )
            assert all(
                torch.equal(module.state_dict()[n], v) for n, v in initializer["state_dict"].items()
            )
            assert set(checkpoint["ema"]) == {
                n for n, p in module.named_parameters() if p.requires_grad
            }
            assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in checkpoint["ema"].values())
            rows.append(
                {
                    "checkpoint": binding,
                    "update": update,
                    "strict_state_tensors": 193,
                    "inherited_tensors_exact": 189,
                    "Adam": clocks(module, optimizer),
                    "raw_module_hash": raw_hash,
                    "EMA_module_hash": model_hash(module),
                }
            )
    finally:
        torch.nn.Module._call_impl = original_call
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    proof = {
        "status": "pass-V184-readout-probe-CPU-raw-EMA-Adam-and-inherited-state",
        "admission": ref(ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json"),
        "plan": result["plan"],
        "checkpoints": rows,
        "strict_CPU_raw_EMA_loads": 4,
        "inherited_tensor_comparisons": 756,
        "new_module_forwards": 0,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    }
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(proof, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print("PASS2probecheckpoints/4strictRawEMAloads/756inheritedTensorChecks/4AdamClocks")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    inspect(parser.parse_args().output)

"""Acquire additional RawNIND scenes into quarantine, without training admission.

Use the frozen publisher catalog and cached protected identities. The existing
training allowlist and prepared training manifest remain unchanged.
"""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import inspect
import json
import shutil
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from demosaic.paired import (
    CATALOG_URL,
    DATA_URL,
    DEVELOPMENT_SCENES,
    TRAINING_SCENES,
    download_file,
    select_pairs,
    verify_file,
)
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

# Include related views conservatively, not only exact protected scene names.
EXCLUDED_FAMILIES = ("MuseeL-", "LucieB_", "7D-", "D60-", "boardgames_")


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def permissions_by_scene(text):
    result = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        name, permission = line.split(":", 1)
        if not name.strip() or name.strip() in result:
            raise ValueError("Ambiguous publisher scene permissions")
        result[name.strip()] = permission.strip()
    return result


def plan_extension(dataset, version, permissions, protected, existing):
    if version["license"].get("rightsIdentifier") != "CC-BY-SA-4.0":
        raise ValueError("Expected the reviewed commercially usable dataset license")
    if not protected.get("protected"):
        raise ValueError("A nonempty protected identity receipt is required")
    if existing.get("split") != "train" or {
        row["scene"] for row in existing["selection"]
    } != set(TRAINING_SCENES):
        raise ValueError("Expected the complete fixed training selection")
    blocked_names = set(DEVELOPMENT_SCENES) | set(TRAINING_SCENES)
    blocked_names.update(row["scene"] for row in protected["protected"])
    blocked_hashes = {
        row["source"]["sha1"]
        for row in protected["protected"]
        if row.get("source", {}).get("sha1")
    }
    blocked_hashes.update(
        record["sha1"]
        for row in existing["selection"]
        for role in ["clean", "noisy"]
        for record in row[role]
    )
    grants = permissions_by_scene(permissions)
    selected, excluded, seen_hashes = [], [], set()
    for name, row in sorted(dataset["Bayer"].items()):
        filenames = [r["filename"] for key in ["clean_images", "noisy_images"] for r in row[key]]
        reason = None
        if name in blocked_names:
            reason = "Existing training or protected evaluation scene"
        elif row.get("test_reserve") or any("_TEST_" in f.upper() for f in filenames):
            reason = "Publisher test reserve or TEST filename"
        elif row.get("unknown_sensor"):
            reason = "Unknown sensor"
        elif name.startswith(EXCLUDED_FAMILIES):
            reason = "Conservatively excluded protected scene family"
        elif name in grants and not grants[name].startswith("CC0,"):
            reason = "Scene permission override lacks a reviewed commercial grant"
        if reason:
            excluded.append({"scene": name, "reason": reason})
            continue
        try:
            # Reuse the non-test metadata-only pair rule. This does not assign
            # a training split: every returned record is explicitly quarantined.
            pair, = select_pairs(dataset, version["files"], "development", scenes=[name])
            records = [r for role in ["clean", "noisy"] for r in pair[role]]
            identities = {r["sha1"] for r in records}
            if any(len(s) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in s) for s in identities):
                raise ValueError("Invalid source SHA1 identity")
            if identities & (blocked_hashes | seen_hashes):
                raise ValueError("Source identity overlaps protected/existing/selected data")
            if len(identities) != len(records):
                raise ValueError("Repeated source identity within a scene")
            if any(r["bytes"] <= 0 for r in records):
                raise ValueError("Invalid publisher file size")
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as error:
            excluded.append({"scene": name, "reason": str(error)})
            continue
        pair["split"] = "quarantine"
        pair["permission"] = {
            "license": "CC0-1.0" if name in grants else "CC-BY-SA-4.0",
            "publisher_scene_text": grants.get(name),
            "basis": "permissions.txt override" if name in grants else "Publisher dataset license",
        }
        selected.append(pair)
        seen_hashes.update(identities)
    if not selected:
        raise ValueError("No eligible new paired scenes")
    records = [r for pair in selected for key in ["clean", "noisy"] for r in pair[key]]
    return {
        "format_version": 1,
        "split": "quarantine",
        "selection": selected,
        "excluded": excluded,
        "catalog_scenes": len(dataset["Bayer"]),
        "files": len(records),
        "bytes": sum(r["bytes"] for r in records),
        "dataset_license": version["license"],
        "dataset_doi": "10.14428/DVN/DEQCIM",
        "catalog_url": CATALOG_URL,
        "dataset_version": f"{version['versionNumber']}.{version['versionMinorNumber']}",
        "attribution": "Benoit Brummer and Christophe De Vleeschouwer, Raw Natural Image Noise Dataset. Individual CC0 credits in permissions.txt.",
        "selection_rule": "All metadata-eligible new Bayer scenes in sorted order; up to two filename-ordered clean frames, noisy ISO nearest1600 and highest remaining <=12800. No image quality or model scores enter selection.",
        "exclusions": {"scene_families": list(EXCLUDED_FAMILIES), "protected_names": sorted(blocked_names), "blocked_source_sha1": sorted(blocked_hashes)},
        "usage": "Quarantine only. Not training admission or an evaluation split. Review cached protected/Commons overlap, content, camera metadata and registration before any separate opt-in training extension.",
    }


def fetch(catalog, protected_path, output, *, download=False, workers=1, reserve_gib=512):
    if workers not in (1, 2) or reserve_gib < 64:
        raise ValueError("Use one or two workers and at least64GiB free reserve")
    catalog, protected_path = Path(catalog).resolve(), Path(protected_path).resolve()
    paths = [catalog / n for n in ["dataverse-metadata.json", "dataset.yaml", "permissions.txt", "manifest-train.json"]]
    paths.append(protected_path)
    version = json.loads(paths[0].read_text())["data"]["latestVersion"]
    lookup = {r["dataFile"]["filename"]: r for r in version["files"]}
    for path in paths[1:3]:
        entry = lookup[path.name]
        if entry.get("restricted"):
            raise ValueError("Publisher restricts auxiliary metadata")
        item = entry["dataFile"]
        verify_file(path, {"filename": path.name, "bytes": item["filesize"], "publisher_checksum": item["checksum"]})
    plan = plan_extension(
        yaml.safe_load(paths[1].read_text()), version, paths[2].read_text(),
        json.loads(protected_path.read_text()), json.loads(paths[3].read_text()),
    )
    plan["inputs"] = {str(p): sha(p) for p in paths}
    plan["script_sha256"] = sha(__file__)
    plan["paired_source_sha256"] = sha(inspect.getsourcefile(select_pairs))
    plan["runtime"] = {"workers": workers, "reserve_gib": reserve_gib}
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (output / ".download.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        path = output / "plan-quarantine.json"
        encoded = json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n"
        if path.exists() and path.read_text() != encoded:
            raise ValueError("Frozen quarantine plan differs; use a new output")
        path.write_text(encoded)
        archive = output / "source"
        archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for p in [*paths, Path(__file__), Path(inspect.getsourcefile(select_pairs))]:
            (archive / p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
        print(json.dumps({"event": "quarantine-plan", "scenes": len(plan["selection"]), "files": plan["files"], "bytes": plan["bytes"], "download": download}), flush=True)
        if not download:
            return plan
        records = [r for pair in plan["selection"] for role in ["clean", "noisy"] for r in pair[role]]

        def acquire(record):
            if shutil.disk_usage(output).free < reserve_gib * 2**30 + workers * record["bytes"]:
                raise RuntimeError("Quarantine download reached its free-space reserve")
            if record["url"] != DATA_URL + str(record["file_id"]):
                raise ValueError("Source URL is not the frozen publisher endpoint")
            return download_file(output / "files", record)

        verified = {}
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
            for record in pool.map(acquire, records):
                verified[record["filename"]] = record
                progress = {"event": "quarantine-verified", "files_done": len(verified), "files_total": len(records), "filename": record["filename"], "bytes": record["bytes"]}
                temporary = output / "progress.tmp"
                temporary.write_text(json.dumps(progress, indent=2) + "\n")
                temporary.replace(output / "progress.json")
                print(json.dumps(progress), flush=True)
        result = json.loads(encoded)
        for pair in result["selection"]:
            for role in ["clean", "noisy"]:
                pair[role] = [verified[r["filename"]] for r in pair[role]]
        assert all(sha(p) == digest for p, digest in plan["inputs"].items())
        temporary = output / "manifest-quarantine.tmp"
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(output / "manifest-quarantine.json")
        return result

    parser.add_argument("--protected", type=Path, default=Path("/mnt/external/demosaic/audits/public-raw-protected-scenes-v2/result.json"))

    args = parser.parse_args()

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def six_channels(packed, pattern, black, white, adc_white, subtract_black):
    """Reconstruct integer ADC samples, then follow the publisher's sparse/mask path."""
    assert packed.dtype == np.float32 and packed.shape[0:2] == (1, 4)
    assert len(black) == len(white) == 4 and all(w == adc_white for w in white)
    assert all(0 <= b < w for b, w in zip(black, white))
    labels = np.array(PATTERNS[pattern]).reshape(2, 2)
    h, w = packed.shape[-2:]
    raw = np.empty((h * 2, w * 2), dtype=np.float64)
    for phase in range(4):
        b, top = black[phase], white[phase]
        dn = np.rint(packed[0, phase].astype(np.float64) * (top - b) + b)
        assert dn.min() >= 0 and dn.max() <= 65535
        raw[phase // 2 :: 2, phase % 2 :: 2] = dn - b if subtract_black else dn
    mask = np.tile(labels, (h, w))[None] == np.arange(3)[:, None, None]
    sparse = raw[None] * mask / adc_white
    return (
        np.concatenate([np.clip(sparse, 0, 1), mask], axis=0)[None]
        .astype(np.float16)
        .astype(np.float32)
    )


def validate_publisher_sparse(root):
    """Compare all CFA layouts against the independently packaged upstream helper."""
    path = root / "RawHandler-0.2.2/RawHandler/utils.py"
    function = next(
        n
        for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "sparse_representation_and_mask"
    )
    namespace = {"np": np}
    # Compile only the reviewed sparse/mask function from the pinned wheel.
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), namespace)  # noqa: S102
    upstream = namespace[function.name]
    checked = 0
    # Include below-black samples and both ADC endpoints. Neither tensors nor
    # source RAW files are modified.
    dn = np.arange(16 * 20, dtype=np.float64).reshape(16, 20) * 200
    dn[-1, -1] = 65535
    black = [4101.0, 4098.0, 4104.0, 4106.0]
    white = [65535.0] * 4
    for pattern, colors in PATTERNS.items():
        packed = np.stack(
            [
                (dn[y::2, x::2] - black[2 * y + x]) / (65535 - black[2 * y + x])
                for y in range(2)
                for x in range(2)
            ]
        )[None].astype(np.float32)
        for subtract in [False, True]:
            raw = dn.copy()
            if subtract:
                for phase in range(4):
                    raw[phase // 2 :: 2, phase % 2 :: 2] -= black[phase]
            sparse, mask = upstream(raw, np.array(colors).reshape(2, 2).copy())
            expected = (
                np.concatenate([np.clip(sparse / 65535, 0, 1), mask], axis=0)[None]
                .astype(np.float16)
                .astype(np.float32)
            )
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                six_channels(packed, pattern, black, white, 65535.0, subtract), expected
            )
            checked += 1
    return {
        "helper": str(path),
        "helper_sha256": sha(path),
        "all4CFAs_both_black_policies_match_publisher_F16_inputs_exactly": checked,
    }


def cases():
    old = read(REPO / "docs/results/nonlocal-matchfilter-cpu-probe.json")

        )
    gfx = read(GFX / "report.json")
    metadata = next(s["metadata"] for s in gfx["sources"] if s["role"] == "noisy")

        )

        result.append(
            {
                "id": "gfx-" + name,
                "kind": "real-GFX-context",
                "source": noisy,
                "observation": str(GFX / noisy["image"]),
                "observation_sha256": noisy["sha256"],

                "wb": crop["shared_wb"],

    assert len(result) == 6
    return result


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(root, inspection, output):
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    output = writable_path(output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("RawForge pilot exists; choose a new output")
    reviewed = read(inspection)
    assert (
        reviewed["status"]
        == "completed-signed-RAWForge-JDD-export-inspection-and-explicit-CPU-port"
    )
    checked = validate_publisher_sparse(root)
    prepared = cases()
    for c in prepared:
        assert sha(c["observation"]) == c["observation_sha256"]
        if "reference_array" in c:
            assert sha(c["reference_array"]) == c["reference_array_sha256"]
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (output / Path(__file__).name).write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    plan = {
        "models": reviewed["models"],
        "inspection": str(inspection),
        "inspection_sha256": sha(inspection),
        "cases": prepared,
        "preprocessing_fixture": checked,
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "physical_units": "Restore integer16 ADC from known per-phase levels; apply publisher per-phase black subtraction only for JDD256, sparse RGB+mask, clip, F16-round then expand to F32. Output publisher clipping then metadata-only nominal-white conversion; JDD uses publisher mean-black subtraction. Nonuniform real phase blacks use the publisher global mean convention, not a fitted per-color correction.",
        "execution": "CPU F32 with the explicitly device-only port. Blind models: supplied protocol shot/read describe observations but are not network conditioning. Photo256px; GFX512px contexts. Native160px ROI. No original RAW decode, new noise draw, output fitting or model training; no GPU parity or serving-speed claim.",
    }
    (output / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
    results, arrays, crops = [], [], []
    for record in reviewed["models"]:
        assert sha(record["CPU_port"]) == record["CPU_port_sha256"]
        network = torch.jit.load(record["CPU_port"], map_location="cpu").eval()
        subtract = record["registry"]["subtract_bl"]
        for case in prepared:
            if case["kind"] == "synthetic-photo":
                with np.load(case["observation"], allow_pickle=False) as data:
                    b = {k: torch.from_numpy(data[k].copy()) for k in data.files}
                target, wb, matrix = b["target"], b["wb"], b["matrix"]
            else:
                b = {
                    "packed": torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["observation"], allow_pickle=False)),
                    "colors": color_indices(case["pattern"])[None],
                }
                target = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["reference_array"], allow_pickle=False))
                wb = torch.tensor(case["wb"], dtype=torch.float32).reshape(1, 3)
                matrix = torch.tensor(case["matrix"], dtype=torch.float32).reshape(1, 3, 3)
            x = torch.from_numpy(
                six_channels(
                    b["packed"].numpy(),
                    case["pattern"],
                    case["black"],
                    case["white"],
                    case["adc_white"],
                    subtract,
                )
            )
            y = network(x)
            assert (
                y.shape == (1, 3, *x.shape[-2:])
                and y.dtype == torch.float32
                and torch.isfinite(y).all()
            )
            mean_black = float(np.mean(case["black"])) / case["adc_white"]
            p = (y.clamp(0, 1) - (0 if subtract else mean_black)) / (1 - mean_black)
            files = {}
            for label, tensor in [
                ("input-six-f32", x),
                ("raw-network-f32", y),
                ("normalized-RGB-f32", p),
            ]:
                path = output / (record["name"] + "-" + case["id"] + "-" + label + ".npy")
                np.save(path, tensor.numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
                files[label] = {
                    "path": str(path),
                    "sha256": sha(path),
                    "shape": list(tensor.shape),
                    "dtype": "float32",
                }
            arrays.append({"model": record["name"], "case": case["id"], "files": files})
            roi = case["roi_xywh"]
            noisy = malvar(b["packed"], b["colors"], wb)
            exact = case["kind"] == "synthetic-photo"
            target_roi = roi if exact else [0, 0, 160, 160]
            scores = None
            if exact:
                x0, y0, w, h = roi
                scores = {
                    k: (float(v[0]) if math.isfinite(float(v[0])) else None)
                    for k, v in quality_metrics(
                        p[..., y0 : y0 + h, x0 : x0 + w],
                        target[..., y0 : y0 + h, x0 : x0 + w],
                        wb,
                        matrix,
                    ).items()
                }
            results.append({"model": record["name"], "case": case["id"], "metrics": scores})
            crops.append(
                save_triplet(
                    output,
                    record["name"] + ":" + case["id"],
                    [
                        (
                            label,
                            display_crop(
                                rgb, wb, matrix, region, exposure=case["display_exposure"]
                            ),
                        )
                        for label, rgb, region in [
                            ("Noisy (Malvar)", noisy, roi),
                            ("RawForge / CPU port", p, roi),
                            (
                                "GT (synthetic)" if exact else "ISO100 ref (not GT)",
                                target,
                                target_roi,
                            ),
                        ]
                    ],
                    caption=record["name"] + " / " + case["id"],
                    metadata={
                        "case": case,
                        "model": {
                            k: record[k]
                            for k in [
                                "name",
                                "original",
                                "original_sha256",
                                "CPU_port",
                                "CPU_port_sha256",
                            ]
                        },
                        "ROI_xywh": roi,
                        "white_balance": wb.tolist(),
                        "camera_to_srgb": matrix.tolist(),
                        "display_exposure": case["display_exposure"],
                        "reference": case["reference"],
                        "conditioning": "Blind: no noise/ISO input per publisher registry",
                        "compute_precision": "CPU F32; F16-rounded six-channel input; positional Device constant ported explicitly; GPU parity pending",
                    },
                )
            )
            print(
                json.dumps({"model": record["name"], "case": case["id"], "completed": True}),
                flush=True,
            )
        del network
    assert len(results) == len(arrays) == len(crops) == 12 and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    report = {
        "status": "completed-small-RawForge-CPU-port-pilot-awaiting-numerical-and-native-review",
        "plan": str(output / "plan.json"),
        "plan_sha256": sha(output / "plan.json"),
        "results": results,
        "arrays": arrays,
        "native_crops": crops,
        "CUDA_initialized": False,
        "limitations": "Two fixed synthetic photo observations and four standing GFX contexts, not a full benchmark or a model's registered768px serving run. Explicit CPU device port and F16-rounded/F32 arithmetic; original-CUDA parity remains pending. Reference training membership and separate weight license unspecified. GFX ISO100 is a qualitative reference, not GT. No promotion/SOTA/broad superiority/speed claim.",
    }
    (output / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--inspection", required=True, type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    a = p.parse_args()
    main(a.root, a.inspection, a.output)

    (root / "review.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)

    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")

    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(

    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    collections = {}

            dest = point / "module.pt"

                        ),
                        flush=True,
                    )
                del batch, output, aux, value, arrays, base
            assert count[0] == 822 and model_hash(module) == initial
            assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
                cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
            )
            dest = point / "collection-v1.json"

                dest,
                {

                    "plan": ref(path),
                    "arm": arm,
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "export": ref(point / "module.pt"),

                    "new_noise_draws": 0,
                    "RNG_unchanged": True,
                },
            )
            collections[label] = ref(dest)

"""Fresh physical sensor noise on retained, preflighted camera-RGB scenes.

This does not treat an arbitrary restoration target as an unclipped sensor
signal. Paired clean-sensor fingerprints must match their original construction;
unpaired scenes need a separate preflight proving reference-white clipping was
inactive. Targets/calibration/pair units stay fixed and never enter inference.
"""

import hashlib
import math

import numpy as np
import torch
from coupled_sensor_noise import coupled_sensor_noise

from demosaic.cfa import mosaic
from demosaic.noise import add_noise, variance_map
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint


class SensorSignalUnavailable(ValueError):
    """A valid cached target cannot prove the original unclipped sensor signal."""


def noise_seed(row, cache_step, *, seed=17501):
    if any(type(v) is not int or v < 1 for v in [row, cache_step, seed]):
        raise ValueError("Positive integer row, cache step and seed required")
    token = f"V175-fresh-sensor:{seed}:{row}:{cache_step}".encode()
    return int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(token).digest()[:8], "little") % 2**63


def clean_sensor(arrays, metadata):
    """Recover only the exact unclipped sensor cases admitted by preflight."""
    names = {"packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix", "target", "pair_indices", "pair_units"}
    if set(arrays) != names:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected cached observation fields")
    if any(not isinstance(v, np.ndarray) or not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in arrays.values()):
        raise ValueError("Cached fields must be finite NumPy arrays")
    target, packed, colors, pairs = [
        arrays[k] for k in ["target", "packed", "colors", "pair_indices"]
    ]
    if (
        target.dtype != np.float32
        or target.ndim != 4
        or target.shape[1] != 3
        or min(target.shape) < 1
        or target.shape[-2] % 2
        or target.shape[-1] % 2
        or packed.dtype != np.float32
        or packed.shape != (len(target), 4, target.shape[-2] // 2, target.shape[-1] // 2)
        or colors.dtype != np.int64
        or colors.shape != (len(target), 4)
        or (colors < 0).any()
        or (colors > 2).any()
        or arrays["variance"].shape != packed.shape
        or arrays["variance"].dtype != np.float32
        or (arrays["variance"] < 0).any()
        or arrays["wb"].shape != (len(target), 3)
        or arrays["wb"].dtype != np.float32
        or arrays["matrix"].shape != (len(target), 3, 3)
        or arrays["matrix"].dtype != np.float32
        or (arrays["wb"] <= 0).any()
        or pairs.dtype != np.int64
        or pairs.ndim != 2
        or pairs.shape[1] != 2
        or arrays["pair_units"].shape != (len(pairs), 1, 1, 1)
        or arrays["pair_units"].dtype != np.float32
        or (arrays["pair_units"] <= 0).any()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Invalid cached observation shape, dtype or calibration")
    if len(pairs) and (
        pairs.min() < 0
        or pairs.max() >= len(target)
        or len(np.unique(pairs)) != pairs.size
        or pairs.size != len(target)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected disjoint pairs covering every member")
    sensor = metadata["sensor"]
    if sensor["black_level"] != 0.03 or sensor["bit_depth"] != 16:
        raise ValueError("Only the retained 16-bit, 0.03-black sensor is admitted")
    noise = metadata["noise"]
    if any(not math.isfinite(noise[k]) or noise[k] < 0 for k in ["shot", "read"]):
        raise ValueError("Invalid sensor coefficients")
    clean = mosaic(torch.from_numpy(target).clamp_min(0), torch.from_numpy(colors))
    if len(pairs):
        first, second = pairs.T
        if any(
            not np.array_equal(arrays[k][first], arrays[k][second])
            for k in ["colors", "wb", "matrix"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Paired calibration must match")
        if (
            fingerprint(clean[first].numpy()) != sensor["clean_packed_a"]
            or fingerprint(clean[second].numpy()) != sensor["clean_packed_b"]
        ):
            raise SensorSignalUnavailable("Target does not reproduce the original unclipped sensor")
    else:
        # Reference-white clipping would place at least one scene-linear RGB
        # channel at one. Require a generous interior margin instead of trying
        # to invert a clipped target. The full retained bank is preflighted too.
        scene = np.einsum(
            "bij,bjhw->bihw",
            arrays["matrix"].astype(np.float64),
            target.astype(np.float64) * arrays["wb"][:, :, None, None],
        )
        if scene.max() >= 0.999 or scene.min() < -1e-6:
            raise SensorSignalUnavailable("Unpaired reference-white clipping cannot be excluded")
    return clean


def renoise(arrays, metadata, row, cache_step, *, seed=17501):
    """Change only noisy RAW and its noisy-intensity variance conditioning.

    A stateless CPU generator supplies a new realization for every continuation
    row. Paired members keep common Poisson counts/read noise. Global CPU/CUDA
    generators are untouched. ADC-only rows are reused and skipped by training.
    """
    selected_seed = noise_seed(row, cache_step, seed=seed)
    clean = clean_sensor(arrays, metadata)
    noise = metadata["noise"]
    if noise["shot"] == noise["read"] == 0:
        return dict(arrays), {
            "seed": None,
            "Poisson_calls": 0,
            "Gaussian_calls": 0,
            "ADC_reused": True,
        }
    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(selected_seed)
    pairs = arrays["pair_indices"]
    if len(pairs):
        first, second = pairs.T
        a, b = coupled_sensor_noise(
            clean[first],
            clean[second],
            noise["shot"],
            noise["read"],
            black_level=0.03,
            generator=generator,
        )
        packed = torch.empty_like(clean)
        packed[first], packed[second] = a, b
        poisson = 3
    else:
        packed = add_noise(
            clean, noise["shot"], noise["read"], black_level=0.03, generator=generator
        )
        poisson = 1
    result = dict(arrays)
    result["packed"] = packed.numpy()
    result["variance"] = variance_map(packed, noise["shot"], noise["read"]).numpy()
    return result, {
        "seed": selected_seed,
        "Poisson_calls": poisson,
        "Gaussian_calls": 1,
        "ADC_reused": False,
    }

    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")

        assert root == ROOT

            assert read(root / name)["status"].startswith("pass-")

    assert result["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
    prior = read(plan["prior_figures"]["path"])
    out = root / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    channels = copied_channels = 0
    for old in prior["images"]:
        if old["triplet"] and not old["panels"][1]["label"].startswith("V180-local-phase-"):
            continue
        assert ref(old["image"]["path"]) == old["image"]

        values = result["native_predictions"][case["id"]]

        variants = []

            endpoint = "raw" if old["panels"][1]["label"].endswith("-raw") else "EMA"
            for arm in ["evidence"]:
                variants.append([old["panels"][0], METHODS[arm][endpoint], old["panels"][-1]])
        else:
            assert [p["label"] for p in old["panels"][:11]] == [
                "Noisy Malvar",
                "V143 parent",
                "V169 EMA",
                "V172-EMA",
                "V175-EMA",
                "V178-control-raw",
                "V178-control-EMA",
                "V178-evidence-raw",
                "V178-evidence-EMA",
                "V180-local-phase-raw",
                "V180-local-phase-EMA",
            ]
            selections = (
                old["panels"][:11]
                + [METHODS["evidence"][e] for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
                + old["panels"][11:]
