            variants.append(selections)
        for selections in variants:
            panels = []
            bindings = {}
            for selection in selections:
                if isinstance(selection, str):
                    binding = values[selection]
                    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                    value = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
                    displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                    actual = pixels(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        actual, independent_display(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    )
                    assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                    channels += actual.size
                    bindings[selection] = binding
                    panels.append((selection, actual))
                else:
                    x, y, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                    assert w == h == 160
                    panels.append((selection["label"], source[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
                    copied_channels += w * h * 3
            board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(panels), 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4),
                f"{'CPU LAYOUT FIXTURE / NO V181 QUALITY | ' if fixture else ''}{case['id']} | V181 spatial loss vs completed V180,contrast{old['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
                font=font,
                fill="black",
            )
            records = []
            for index, (label, value) in enumerate(panels):
                x = 8 + 168 * index
                draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
                records.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})
            path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
            board.save(path)
            image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
            for record, (_, value) in zip(records, panels, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = record["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], value)
            figures.append(
                {
                    "case": case,
                    "ROI_xywh": old["ROI_xywh"],
                    "anchor": old["anchor"],
                    "contrast": old["contrast"],
                    "exposure": old["exposure"],
                    "image": ref(path),
                    "panels": records,
                    "predictions": bindings,
                    "source_figure": old["image"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                    "triplet": old["triplet"],
                }
            )
    assert len(figures) == 60 and sum(f["triplet"] for f in figures) == 12 and channels == 8294400
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(figures), 4):
        group = figures[start : start + 4]
        width = max(Image.open(f["image"]["path"]).width for f in group)
        sheet = Image.new("RGB", (width, 212 * len(group)), "#eeeeee")
        for row, item in enumerate(group):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, 212 * row))
        path = out / f"sheet-{len(sheets):02d}.png"
        sheet.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(group))),
                "image": ref(path),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-layout-fixture-not-quality"
            if fixture
            else "rendered-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V181_quality": fixture,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(root / "scores-v1.json"),
            "images": figures,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "new_RGB_channels_independently_checked": channels,
            "unchanged_RGB_channels_copied": copied_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered60nativefigures12triplets;fixture", fixture, "newchannels", channels, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":

from preflight_flat_palette_cuda import portable_predictions

from demosaic.safety import writable_path
from demosaic.train import train

BASE = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic")
PRECEDING = {
    "wide-flat-palette-full4k-workflow-v1": "completed-original4000-and-evaluation-awaiting-manual-review",
    "palette-final-review-workflow-v1": "completed-final4k-review-artifacts-awaiting-native-review",
    "rawforge-original-GPU-workflow-v1": "completed-original-exports-awaiting-numerical-and-native-review",
    "rawforge-original-GPU-render-workflow-v1": "completed-original-GPU-native-rendering-awaiting-visual-review",
}


def preceding_review(review_path, expected_sha256):
    """Check actual producer exits before output creation or CUDA initialization."""
    if sha(review_path) != expected_sha256:
        raise ValueError("Completed palette review SHA differs")
    review = json.loads(Path(review_path).read_text())
    if not review["review_complete"]:
        raise ValueError("Palette review is incomplete")
    records = []
    for name, terminal in PRECEDING.items():
        path = BASE / "runs" / (name + ".json")
        status = json.loads(path.read_text())
        owner = status["controller"]
        try:
            proc = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
            if (
                abs(proc.create_time() - owner["created"]) < 0.01
                and proc.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
            ):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Preceding owned workflow remains live: {proc.pid}")
        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
            pass
        if status["status"] != terminal:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Preceding owned workflow incomplete: {name}")
        records.append(
            {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(path), "controller": owner, "status": terminal}
        )
    return {"path": str(review_path), "sha256": expected_sha256, "actual_exits": records}


def main(config_path, control_path, output, device, review_path, review_sha256, weight=0.01):
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    preceding = preceding_review(review_path, review_sha256)
    if device == "cpu":
        assert not torch.cuda.is_available(), "Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' for CPU checks"
    else:
        assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9 > 24 and sha(PARENT) == PARENT_SHA
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(Path(config_path).read_text())
    control = yaml.safe_load(Path(control_path).read_text())
    excluded = {"run", "experiment_notes", "multiscale_sensor_weight"}
    assert {k: v for k, v in cfg.items() if k not in excluded} == {
        k: v for k, v in control.items() if k not in excluded
    }
    assert 0 < weight <= 0.01
    assert (
        cfg["multiscale_sensor_weight"] == weight
        and control.get("multiscale_sensor_weight", 0) == 0
    )
    assert cfg["flat_chroma_stops"] == 8 and cfg["steps"] == 4000
    assert cfg["batch_size"] == 16 and cfg["patch_size"] == 256 and cfg["seed"] == 48
    assert all(
        not cfg.get(key, False)
        for key in ["refiner_only", "coarse_refiner_only", "pyramid_refiner_only"]
    )
    source = {str(path): sha(path) for path in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    frozen = json.loads(
        (BASE / "benchmarks/wide-flat-palette-full4k-workflow-v1/plan.json").read_text()
    )
    assert {Path(k).name: v for k, v in source.items()} == {
        Path(k).name: v for k, v in frozen["source_files"].items()
    }
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    assert shutil.disk_usage(output).free > 512 * 1024**3
    archive = output / "source"
    archive.mkdir()
    scripts = [
        Path(__file__),
        *[
            Path(__file__).with_name(name)
            for name in [
                "audit_flat_palette.py",

                "preflight_paired_extension.py",
            ]
        ],
    ]
    for path in [
        *Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py"),
        *scripts,
        Path(config_path),
        Path(control_path),
    ]:
        (archive / path.name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
    manifests = {
        key: {"path": cfg[key], "sha256": sha(cfg[key])}
        for key in ["manifest", "validation_manifest", "paired_manifest", "raw_clean_manifest"]
    }
    template = {
        **cfg,
        "device": device,
        "workers": 0,
        "paired_workers": 0,
        "raw_clean_workers": 0,
        "log_every": 1,
        "checkpoint_every": 4,
        "flat_fraction": 1,
        "synthetic_fraction": 0,

    if device == "cpu":
        template.update(batch_size=1, patch_size=64, amp=False, precision="float32")
    configs = [("control", 0, False), ("loss-resumed", weight, True)]

        checkpoint = train(path, initialize=PARENT, stop_after=2 if resume else 4)

            state = torch.load(step2, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
            assert state["step"] == 2 and len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
            assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
            if device == "cuda":

        assert state["config"]["initialized_from"]["sha256"] == PARENT_SHA

        assert (

            and len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89

        )

            torch.isfinite(v).all()

        for key, item in manifests.items():

        runs[label] = train_rows(output / label)

                for r in runs[label]
            )
        del state
        gc.collect()
        if device == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    for label, rows in runs.items():
        assert all(
            a["batch_sha256"] == b["batch_sha256"]
            for a, b in zip(rows, runs["control"], strict=True)
        ), label
    exact_fields = []
    if device == "cpu":

            torch.load(checkpoints[name]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
            for name in ["loss-full", "loss-resumed"]

        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    assert source == {str(path): sha(path) for path in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    assert sha(PARENT) == PARENT_SHA
    result = {
        "status": "completed-actual-trainer-sensor-mean-engineering-only",
        "device": device,

        "preceding": preceding,

        "observations": runs,

        "peak_cuda_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
        if device == "cuda"
        else None,
        "limitations": "Four discarded updates per arm, forced smooth Commons/workers0. CPU exact restart is separate from CUDA saved-state/portable checks; no deterministic CUDA optimization claim. Full restoration network trains with frozen DINO backbone. No quality, throughput, general color repair or model promotion claim.",

"""Freeze unchanged full panels and native audits for the native-data study."""

import argparse
import copy
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from prepare_directional_bank_review import references
from review_directional_bank import alive
from train_directional_interval_trial import guard, read, ref, save

from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def prepare(training_path, historical_path, closure_path, preflight_path, output):
    training, historical = read(training_path), read(historical_path)
    guard(training)
    assert training["parent"] == historical["parent"]
    assert not training["engineering_only"] and training["boundary_updates"] == 20000
    status_path = Path(training["root"]) / "status.json"
    status = read(status_path)
    assert alive(status["controller"])
    assert status["status"] == "running-native-data-original20000-arm"
    root = writable_path(output)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    work, trained = root / "work", Path(training["work"])
    # Model/runtime source comes from the actual running study. Only review
    # orchestration is taken from the current committed scripts.
    sources = [*trained.glob("src/demosaic/*.py")]
    sources += [trained / name for name in ["pyproject.toml", "uv.lock", "configs/evaluation.yaml"]]
    sources += [p for p in (trained / "third_party").rglob("*LICENSE*") if p.is_file()]
    for source in sources:
        destination = work / source.relative_to(trained)
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    for source in Path("scripts").glob("*.py"):
        destination = work / source
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    core = {
        str(p.relative_to(trained)): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in trained.glob("src/demosaic/*.py")
    }
    assert len(core) == 44
    assert all(ref(work / path)["sha256"] == digest for path, digest in core.items())
    criteria = Path("docs/native-data-v84-v85.md").resolve()
    assert ref(criteria) in training["inputs"]
    snapshot = work / "docs/native-data-v84-v85.md"
    snapshot.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(criteria, snapshot)
    plan = copy.deepcopy(historical)
    plan.update(
        root=str(root),
        work=str(work),
        python=training["python"],
        HF_HOME=training["HF_HOME"],
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/review_native_data_trial.py"),
        training_status=str(status_path),
        training_plan=ref(training_path),
        training_owner=status["controller"],
        actual_training_core=core,
        static_input_recipe=ref(historical_path),
        engineering_preflight=False,
        review_CPU_preflight=ref(preflight_path),
        quality_numerical_scorer=ref(work / "scripts/score_native_data_eligibility.py"),
        quality_criteria={
            "predeclared_snapshot": ref(snapshot),
            "scope": "Original20k native128/150 data-only study; full primary, sensitivity, weak carrier, all ADC cases, hue and native review. No automatic extension/promotion.",
        },
        git_head_at_freeze=subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
        scope="Fresh V84/V85 original20000 final EMA review after exact successful controller/child exits. Same full427, known4/unseen5, sensitivity, hue, analytic and GFX/highlight panels, fresh V63, retained V43/RawNIND with witnesses. Native160 crops include foliage/fence. No protected-final scoring, extension or promotion.",
    )
    plan.pop("recovery_of", None)
    plan["outputs"] = {key: str(work / "outputs" / key) for key in historical["outputs"]}
    closure = copy.deepcopy(read(closure_path))
    closure.update(
        root=str(root),
        output=str(work / "outputs/closure"),
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/close_native_data_review.py"),
        closure_engine=ref(work / "scripts/close_bank_detachment_review.py"),
        historical_replay=False,
        scope="CPU saved-array/arithmetic, original20k data criteria and native boards after all10 stages; actual viewing remains required. No promotion.",
    )
    for key in ["review_owner", "review_plan", "recovery_of", "frozen_files", "inputs"]:
        closure.pop(key, None)
    supplement = copy.deepcopy(read(Path(closure_path).parent / "reference-plan.json"))
    supplement.update(
        output=str(work / "outputs/reference-closure"),
        worker=ref(work / "scripts/prepare_directional_reference_boards.py"),
        closure_root=str(root),
    )
    supplement.pop("closure_owner", None)
    for panel, spec in supplement["panels"].items():
        spec["fresh_report"] = str(
            work
            / "outputs"
            / (
                "gfx/report.json"
                if panel == "gfx"
                else f"closure/{panel}-native-sources/report.json"
            )
        )
    inputs = [
        *historical["inputs"],
        ref(training_path),
        ref(historical_path),
        ref(closure_path),
        ref(preflight_path),
        ref(criteria),
        ref(snapshot),
    ]
    for template in [closure, supplement]:
        inputs += list(references(template))
    # Current frozen scripts are covered by frozen_files; references to those
    # same bytes are harmless and retain the wrapper/engine distinction.
    plan["inputs"] = list({(r["path"], r["sha256"]): r for r in inputs}.values())
    plan["frozen_files"] = {
        str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in sorted(work.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()
    }
    guard(plan)
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    closure.update(
        review_plan=ref(root / "plan.json"),
        inputs=plan["inputs"],
        frozen_files=plan["frozen_files"],
    )
    save(root / "closure-template.json", closure)
    save(root / "reference-template.json", supplement)
    print(
        {
            "plan": ref(root / "plan.json"),
            "frozen_files": len(plan["frozen_files"]),
            "identical_training_modules": len(core),
        }
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ["training-plan", "historical-review", "historical-closure", "preflight", "output"]:
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    prepare(
        args.training_plan.resolve(),
        args.historical_review.resolve(),
        args.historical_closure.resolve(),
        args.preflight.resolve(),
        args.output.resolve(),
    )

"""Check actual raw/EMA matched browser captures against their public PNG pixels."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from PIL import Image
from train_phase_evidence_trial import METHODS, save


def verify(directory, output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    browser = read(directory / "browser-records-v1.json")
    assert browser["fixture_only_no_V178_quality"] is False and browser["JS_errors"] == []
    assert len(browser["records"]) == 480 and len(browser["metadata"]) == 96
    viewer = Path(browser["viewer"])
    manifest_path = viewer.with_name("manifest-v1.json")
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["native_figures"] == 72
    assert set(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == {
        method for endpoints in METHODS.values() for method in endpoints.values()
    }
    images = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in manifest["images"] if not item["triplet"]}
    assert len(images) == 48
    for item in images.values():
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
    assert len({(m["case"], m["endpoint"]) for m in browser["metadata"]}) == 96
    for record in browser["metadata"]:
        for arm in ["control", "evidence"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
            metadata = manifest["method_checkpoints"][method]
            assert metadata["state"] == record["endpoint"]
            for value in [method, metadata["source_checkpoint"]["sha256"], metadata["module_hash"]]:
                assert value in record["description"]
    channels = 0
    assert len({(r["case"], r["endpoint"], r["id"]) for r in browser["records"]}) == 480
    for record in browser["records"]:
        rect = record["rect"]
        assert rect["width"] == rect["height"] == 160
        assert rect["x"].is_integer() and rect["y"].is_integer()
        item = images[record["source"]]
        expected_panel = next(p for p in item["panels"] if p["label"] == record["label"])
        assert expected_panel["xywh"] == record["panel"]
        if record["id"] in ["a", "b"]:
            arm = "control" if record["id"] == "a" else "evidence"
            assert record["label"] == METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
        x, y, width, height = record["panel"]
        assert width == height == 160
        expected = np.asarray(Image.open(record["source"]).convert("RGB"))[
            y : y + height, x : x + width
        ]
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(record["screenshot"]).convert("RGB"))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
        channels += actual.size
    assert channels == 36864000
    save(
        output,
        {
            "status": "pass-actual-matched-browser-480-native-crops-checkpoint-state-and-source-pixels",
            "viewer": ref(viewer),
            "manifest": ref(manifest_path),
            "browser_records": ref(directory / "browser-records-v1.json"),
            "browser_version": browser["browser"],
            "cases": 48,
            "matched_raw_EMA_pairs": 96,
            "browser_crop_screenshots": 480,
            "RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG": channels,
            "rectangle_width_height": [160, 160],
            "per_method_state_metadata_checked": True,
            "matched_default_control_EMA_vs_evidence_EMA": True,
            "click_keyboard_flip_and_navigation": True,
            "JS_errors": [],
            "screenshot_bindings": [ref(r["screenshot"]) for r in browser["records"]],
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V178_quality": False,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "scope": "Actual headless-browser screenshot pixels and source/checkpoint-state metadata are checked. Image-quality gains and costs require the separate matched measurements and actual human native viewing.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS480actualbrowsercrops/36864000RGBchannels/raw+EMAstate-metadata")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify(args.directory.resolve(), args.output.resolve())

"""Matched native2DN/floor16 array scores, including actual blank errors."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import os
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save


def load_module(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


def main(root):
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    design_path = root / "quality-design-v1.json"
    design = read(design_path)
    review = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")
    assert read(review["plan"]["path"])["design"] == ref(design_path)
    metric_paths = [
        root.parent / "collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py",
        root.parent / "V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py",
    ]
    error_metric, photo_metric = [
        load_module(path, f"metric{i}") for i, path in enumerate(metric_paths)
    ]
    maps = {}
    for label, binding in review["collections"].items():
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        c = read(binding["path"])
        assert c["module_before"] == c["module_after"] and c["RNG_unchanged"]
        assert (
            c["component_forwards"] == 822
            and c["new_parent_DINO_forwards"] == c["new_noise_draws"] == 0
        )
        assert [o["id"] for o in c["observations"]] == [o["id"] for o in design["observations"]]
        maps[label] = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in c["observations"]}
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[-1:1:512j, -1:1:512j]
    q = np.linalg.qr(np.stack([np.ones_like(xx), xx, yy], -1).reshape(-1, 3), mode="reduced")[0]

    def detrend(value):
        v = value.reshape(3, -1).T
        return v - q @ (q.T @ v)

    rows = []
    for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        bindings = {
            "parent": case["parent"],
            **{label: values[case["id"]] for label, values in maps.items()},
        }
        if "periodic_detail" in case:
            bindings["periodic-detail"] = case["periodic_detail"]
        parent = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            empty = a["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
            signal = detrend(a["target_present"][0].astype(np.float64) - empty)
            blank = (
                np.all(a["target_present"] == a["target_empty"], axis=1)[0]
                if case["present"]
                else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
            )
        for label, binding in bindings.items():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            value = np.load(binding["path"])
            assert (
                value.dtype == np.float32
                and value.shape == parent.shape
                and np.isfinite(value).all()
            )
            v = value.astype(np.float64)
            change = v - parent.astype(np.float64)
            row = {
                "id": case["id"],
                "index": index,
                "kind": case["kind"],
                "cohort": case.get("cohort"),
                "method": label,
                "prediction": binding,
                "fresh": case.get("fresh", False),
                "new_forward": label in maps,
                "changed": not np.array_equal(value, parent),
                "correction_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change**2)) * 65535),
            }
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                row.update(
                    present=case["present"],
                    seed=case["seed"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    template_gain=float(np.sum(detrend(v[0] - empty) * signal) / np.sum(signal**2)),
                    blank_pixels=int(blank.sum()),
                    blank_added_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change[0][:, blank] ** 2)) * 65535)
                    if blank.any()
                    else None,
                )
                if blank.any():
                    error = (v[0] - a["target"][0].astype(np.float64))[:, blank]
                    means = error.mean(1, keepdims=True)
                    row.update(
                        blank_error_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
                        blank_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(
                            np.sqrt(np.mean((error - means) ** 2)) * 65535
                        ),
                        blank_DC_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(means**2)) * 65535),
                    )
            elif case["kind"] == "photo":
                row.update(
                    variant=case["variant"]["name"],
                    **photo_metric.photo_metrics(value, a["target"], a, case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "flat":
                error = v - a["target"].astype(np.float64)
                dc = error.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                h, w = error.shape[-2:]
                blocks = error.reshape(1, 3, h // 32, 32, w // 32, 32).mean((3, 5))
                x, y, cw, ch = case["ROI_xywh"]
                crop = error[..., y : y + ch, x : x + cw]
                crop_dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                cb = crop.reshape(1, 3, 5, 32, 5, 32).mean((3, 5))
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    full_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((blocks - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    crop_block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((cb - crop_dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    maximum_abs_DC_DN16=float(np.max(np.abs(dc)) * 65535),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "mixed-quiet":
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
                x, y, w, h = case["ROI_xywh"]
                row.update(
                    quiet_error_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(
                            np.mean(
                                (v - a["target"].astype(np.float64))[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2
                            )
                        )
                        * 65535
                    ),
                    quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16=row["crop_spatial_RMS_DN16"],
                    quiet_added_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(change[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2)) * 65535
                    ),
                )
            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "real"
                row["reference_scored"] = False
                if value.shape[-1] == 512:
                    plane = detrend(value[0]).T.reshape(3, 512, 512)
                    blocks = plane.reshape(3, 16, 32, 16, 32).mean((2, 4))
                    row["detrended_block32_variation_DN16"] = float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(blocks**2)) * 65535
                    )
            rows.append(row)
    assert len(rows) == 4686 and sum(r["new_forward"] for r in rows) == 3288
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[
            row["kind"],
            row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))),
            row.get("cohort"),
            row["method"],
        ].append(row)
    fields = (
        "full_error_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_relative_band_error",
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain",
        "template_gain",
        "blank_added_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_error_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_DC_RMS_DN16",
        "full_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "block32_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_block32_RMS_DN16",
        "correction_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_error_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_added_RMS_DN16",
    )
    summary = []
    for (kind, condition, cohort, method), group in groups.items():
        item = {
            "kind": kind,
            "condition": condition,
            "cohort": cohort,
            "method": method,
            "cases": len(group),
        }
        for field in fields:
            values = [r[field] for r in group if r.get(field) is not None]
            if values:
                item[field] = float(np.mean(values))
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = max(r["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] or 0 for r in group)
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_error_RMS_DN16"] = max(
                r.get("blank_error_RMS_DN16", 0) for r in group
            )
        if kind == "flat":
            item["worst_abs_DC_DN16"] = max(r["maximum_abs_DC_DN16"] for r in group)
        summary.append(item)
    save(
        root / "scores-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-array-only-scores",
            "design": ref(design_path),
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "scorer": ref(__file__),
            "metric_sources": [ref(p) for p in metric_paths],
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "new_module_forwards_in_scorer": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "real_reference_scores": 0,
        },
    )
    print("Scored4686 paired rows; real references unscored")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Publish closed V190 geometry with audited coordinates and actual plot viewing."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live, read, ref
from report_native_alias_geometry import REPO, ROOT, guard, lines, save

STEM = "v190-native-alias-geometry-v1"
REPORT = REPO / "docs/native-wave-alias-geometry.md"
INDEX = REPO / "docs/results" / (STEM + ".json")
PROOF = REPO / "docs/results/v190-native-alias-geometry-publication-verification-v1.json"
IMAGES = REPO / "docs/images" / STEM
EVIDENCE = REPO / "docs/results" / STEM


def context():
    plan, result = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"), read(ROOT / "result-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    seal = read(ROOT / "publication-source-v1.json")
    assert seal["publisher"] == ref(__file__)
    assert seal["plan"] == result["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    audit = read(ROOT / "verification-v1.json")
    assert audit["result"] == ref(ROOT / "result-v1.json") and audit["status"].startswith("pass-")
    assert not owner_live(result["owner"]) and not owner_live(audit["owner"])
    assert result["status"] == "completed-closed-input-native-template-alias-geometry-not-quality"
    return plan, result, lines(result["template_journal"]["path"])


def cdf_series(rows):
    series = []
    for present in [True, False]:
        for method in ["V187_actual8", "V189_actual8"]:
            group = [
                r
                for r in rows
                if r["present"] == present
                and r["method"] == method
                and r["neighborhood"] == "localwidth"
            ]
            assert len(group) == 256
            for field in ["principal_carrier_proximity", "four_lift_carrier_proximity"]:
                series.append(
                    {
                        "present": present,
                        "method": method,
                        "field": field,
                        "x_percent": sorted(100 * r[field] for r in group),
                        "y_fraction": ((np.arange(256) + 1) / 256).tolist(),
                    }
                )
    return series


def render():
    _plan, result, rows = context()
    directory = ROOT / "figures-v1"
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    import matplotlib

    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    series = cdf_series(rows)
    absent_max = max(max(s["x_percent"]) for s in series if not s["present"])
    absent_limit = max(10, 10 * math.ceil(absent_max / 10))
    with plt.rc_context(
        {
            "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
            "font.size": 10,
            "axes.spines.top": False,
            "axes.spines.right": False,
            "svg.fonttype": "none",
            "pdf.fonttype": 42,
        }
    ):
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.4, 4.6), layout="constrained")
        for present, ax in zip([True, False], axes, strict=True):
            for item in series:
                if item["present"] != present:
                    continue
                version = item["method"].split("_")[0]
                principal = item["field"].startswith("principal")
                ax.plot(
                    item["x_percent"],
                    item["y_fraction"],
                    color="#2563a6" if version == "V187" else "#bd5425",
                    linestyle="-" if principal else "--",
                    linewidth=1.7,
                    label=version + (" principal" if principal else " four lifts"),
                )
            ax.set(
                title="Present mesh (256 records)"
                if present
                else "Absent mesh: hypothetical template (256 records)",
                xlabel="Native RGB template power near selected carriers (%)",
                ylabel="Fraction of records at or below value",
                ylim=(0, 1.01),
                xlim=(0, 100 if present else absent_limit),
            )
            ax.grid(alpha=0.18)
            ax.legend(loc="lower right", frameon=False, fontsize=9)
        fig.suptitle(
            "Native carrier geometry after frozen input-only selection\nSquare radius 4 native FFT bins; descriptive proximity, not restoration capacity",
            fontsize=12,
        )
        files = []
        for suffix in ["png", "svg", "pdf"]:
            path = directory / ("native-carrier-proximity." + suffix)

"""Resource-bounded single GPU capture after genuine CPU parity; no retry."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from queue_tf32x3_cuda import alive, read, ref, stop_owned


def save(path, value):
    import json

    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def main(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    plan = read(path)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["controller"]
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(owner["pid"]))
    proof = ref(Path(plan["CPU_output"]) / "receipt.json")
    state = {"controller": owner, "plan": ref(path), "CPU_preflight": proof}

    def record(value, **details):
        state.update(status=value, updated_unix=time.time(), **details)
        save(root / "controller-status.json", state)

    def guard():
        for p, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
            assert ref(p)["sha256"] == digest, p
        for item in plan["inputs"] + [proof]:
            assert ref(item["path"]) == item
        cpu = read(proof["path"])
        assert cpu["all_full_tail_head_replays_exact"] and cpu["all_states_and_RNG_unchanged"]
        assert cpu["plan"] == ref(path) and not alive(cpu["owner"]) and not cpu["CUDA_initialized"]
        assert all(not alive(o) for o in plan["blocking_owners"])

    def resources(available):
        return (
            psutil.virtual_memory().available >= available * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage(root).free >= 500 * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic").free >= 64 * 2**30
        )

    try:
        guard()
        assert not Path(plan["GPU_output"]).exists()
        record("waiting-for-stable-headroom-no-Torch-or-CUDA")
        started, stable = time.monotonic(), None
        while True:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if now - started > 3600:
                raise TimeoutError("Resource wait bound; no retry")
            stable = now if stable is None and resources(48) else stable if resources(48) else None
            if stable is not None and now - stable >= 60:
                break
            time.sleep(5)
        guard()
        work = Path(plan["work"])
        env = dict(
            os.environ,
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
            HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"],
            HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
            TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
            OMP_NUM_THREADS="4",
            OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="4",
            PYTHONPATH=str(work / "src") + ":" + str(work / "scripts"),
        )
        with (root / "GPU-worker.log").open("xb") as log:
            child = subprocess.Popen(
                [plan["python"], "-P", plan["worker"]["path"], str(path)],
                cwd=work,
                env=env,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
            record("running-fixed-late-RGB-component-GPU-capture", child=child_owner)
            started = time.monotonic()
            try:
                while child.poll() is None:
                    if time.monotonic() - started > 900:
                        raise TimeoutError("Owned GPU worker bound")
                    if not resources(24):
                        raise MemoryError("Shared memory/disk floor")
                    time.sleep(2)
            except BaseException:
                stop_owned(child, child_owner)
                raise
            assert child.returncode == 0
        guard()
        result = read(Path(plan["GPU_output"]) / "receipt.json")
        assert result["owner"] == child_owner and result["all_full_tail_head_replays_exact"]
        assert result["common_trunk_and_DINO_forwards"] == 75
        record(
            "completed-fixed-component-GPU-arrays-awaiting-native-and-independent-scalar-review",
            receipt=ref(Path(plan["GPU_output"]) / "receipt.json"),
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-late-RGB-component-controller-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    main(p.parse_args().plan)

def recipe_contrast(control, candidate, reviewed_manifest):
    recipes = [yaml.safe_load(Path(item["path"]).read_text()) for item in (control, candidate)]
    for item, recipe in zip((control, candidate), recipes, strict=True):
        if binding(item["path"]) != item:
            raise ValueError("Changed frozen training recipe")
        recipe.setdefault("normalized_band_weight", 0.0)
        recipe.setdefault("fine_weak_texture_fraction", 0.0)
    a, b = recipes
    allowed = {"run", "experiment_notes", "validation_protocol", "paired_manifest", "fine_weak_texture_fraction"}
    differences = {key: {"control": a.get(key), "candidate": b.get(key)} for key in a.keys() | b.keys()
                   if a.get(key) != b.get(key)}
    if set(differences) - allowed:
        raise ValueError(f"Unplanned training changes: {sorted(set(differences)-allowed)}")
    if (a["fine_weak_texture_fraction"] != 0 or b["fine_weak_texture_fraction"] != .075
            or a["paired_manifest"] == b["paired_manifest"] or b["paired_manifest"] != reviewed_manifest["path"]
            or binding(b["paired_manifest"]) != reviewed_manifest
            or binding(a["validation_protocol"])["sha256"] != binding(b["validation_protocol"])["sha256"]
            or a["steps"] != 20000 or a["normalized_band_weight"] != 0):
        raise ValueError("Recipes do not describe the declared matched data trial")
    return {"recipes": {"control": control, "candidate": candidate}, "differences": differences,
            "matched_parent": a["initialize_parent"], "matched_model": a["model"], "updates_per_arm": a["steps"],
            "scope": "Combined fine-source and four reviewed-mask changes; not separate causal effects. Missing optional loss/fine fields use their verified default-off values. Paths/notes differ, validation protocol bytes agree; all other explicit settings match."}

Wait exact audit identities and successful exit; stop/preserve failures without retries. No automatic recommendation or documentation publication; actual material/GFX viewing follows."}

def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    if binding(__file__) != plan["controller_source"] or os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "" or "torch" in sys.modules:
        raise ValueError("Frozen CPU-only comparison required")
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root/"controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {"owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}, "plan": binding(path), "completed": {}}
    def record(status, **fields):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        temporary = root/"status.tmp"
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+"\n")
        temporary.replace(root/"status.json")
    try:
        for role, dependency in plan["roles"].items():
            record("waiting-for-exact-independent-audits", role=role, dependency=dependency["audit_owner"])
            began = time.monotonic()
            while live(dependency["audit_owner"]):
                observed = read(dependency["audit_status"])
                if (binding(dependency["audit_plan"]["path"]) != dependency["audit_plan"]
                        or observed["owner"] != dependency["audit_owner"] or observed["plan"] != dependency["audit_plan"]
                        or observed["status"].startswith("failed")):
                    raise ValueError("Independent audit failed or identity changed")
                if time.monotonic()-began > plan["maximum_wait_seconds"]:
                    raise TimeoutError("Declared matched-comparison deadline")
                time.sleep(10)
            state["completed"][role] = completed_role(dependency)
        guard(plan)
        if (psutil.virtual_memory().available < plan["minimum_available_RAM_GiB"]*2**30
                or shutil.disk_usage(root).free < plan["minimum_free_output_GiB"]*2**30):
            raise RuntimeError("Insufficient CPU comparison headroom")
        old, new = (state["completed"][role] for role in ("control", "candidate"))
        if old["checkpoint"] != plan["expected_control_checkpoint"] or old["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == new["checkpoint"]["sha256"] or old["official_frozen_encoder_hash"] != new["official_frozen_encoder_hash"]:
            raise ValueError("Endpoint/control identity differs")
        recipes = recipe_contrast(plan["roles"]["control"]["recipe"], plan["roles"]["candidate"]["recipe"], plan["reviewed_manifest"])
        if recipes != plan["recipe_comparison"]:
            raise ValueError("Matched recipes changed")
        write(root/"completed-dependencies-v1.json", state["completed"])
        output = Path(plan["output"])
        record("joining-independent-metrics-and-native-crops")
        statistics = compare(old["audit"]["path"], new["audit"]["path"], old["checkpoint"]["sha256"], new["checkpoint"]["sha256"], output,
                             expected_observations=plan["expected_observations"])
        materials = photo_comparison(read_bound(statistics["stages"]["photo"]), output)
        gfx = gfx_comparison(old["full_gfx"]["path"], new["full_gfx"]["path"], old["checkpoint"]["sha256"], new["checkpoint"]["sha256"], output)
        report(output, statistics, materials, gfx)
        if "torch" in sys.modules:
            raise RuntimeError("CPU comparison imported Torch")
        guard(plan)
        write(root/"result-v1.json", {"queue_plan": binding(path), "owner": state["owner"],
              "dependencies": binding(root/"completed-dependencies-v1.json"), "statistics": binding(output/"result.json"),
              "recipes": recipes, "materials": materials, "gfx": gfx, "report": binding(output/"report.md"),
              "Torch_imported": False, "new_neural_forwards": 0, "new_encoder_forwards": 0,
              "new_noise_observations": 0, "RAW_decodes": 0, "native_review": "Prepared; actual human viewing pending"})
        record("completed-matched-V114-V116-comparison-native-viewing-pending", result=binding(root/"result-v1.json"))
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-matched-comparison-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["prepare", "controller"])
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--provenance", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path, args.provenance, args.proof))
    else:
        controller(args.path)

import argparse

import numpy as np

from train_dense_spectrum_trial import METHODS, ROOT, guard, read, ref, save


def render(root=ROOT, *, fixture=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    if fixture:
        assert root != ROOT and plan["fixture_only_no_actual_V191_quality"] is True
    else:
        assert root == ROOT
        guard(plan)
        seal = read(root / "render-source-v1.json")
        assert seal["renderer"] == ref(__file__) and seal["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
        terminal(root / "scores-v1.json")
        for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
            assert read(root / name)["status"].startswith("pass-")
    result = read(root / "scores-v1.json")
    assert result["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
    previous_figures = ROOT.parent / "V189-spaced-pooled-trial-v1/figures-v1.json"
    if not fixture:
        assert seal["previous_figures"] == ref(previous_figures)
    prior = read(previous_figures)
    out = root / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    channels = copied_channels = 0
    for old in prior["images"]:
        if old["triplet"] and not old["panels"][1]["label"].startswith("V189-spaced-pooled-"):
            continue
        assert ref(old["image"]["path"]) == old["image"]
        source = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]))
        case = old["case"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        values = result["native_predictions"][case["id"]]
        anchor = np.asarray(old["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        variants = []
        if old["triplet"]:
            endpoint = "raw" if old["panels"][1]["label"].endswith("-raw") else "EMA"
            variants.append([old["panels"][0], METHODS[endpoint], old["panels"][-1]])
        else:
            assert [p["label"] for p in old["panels"][:23]] == [
                "Noisy Malvar",
                "V143 parent",
                "V169 EMA",
                "V172-EMA",
                "V175-EMA",
                "V178-control-raw",
                "V178-control-EMA",
                "V178-evidence-raw",
                "V178-evidence-EMA",
                "V180-local-phase-raw",
                "V180-local-phase-EMA",
                "V181-flat-spatial-raw",
                "V181-flat-spatial-EMA",
                "V183-coherent-pair-raw",
                "V183-coherent-pair-EMA",
                "V184-wave-readout-raw",
                "V184-wave-readout-EMA",
                "V185-spatial-context-raw",
                "V185-spatial-context-EMA",
                "V187-pooled-wave-raw",
                "V187-pooled-wave-EMA",
                "V189-spaced-pooled-raw",
                "V189-spaced-pooled-EMA",
            ]
            selections = (
                old["panels"][:23] + [METHODS[e] for e in ["raw", "EMA"]] + old["panels"][23:]
            )
            variants.append(selections)
        for selections in variants:
            panels = []
            bindings = {}
            for selection in selections:
                if isinstance(selection, str):
                    binding = values[selection]
                    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                    value = load_native(binding)
                    displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                    actual = pixels(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        actual, independent_display(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    )
                    assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                    channels += actual.size
                    bindings[selection] = binding
                    panels.append((selection, actual))
                else:
                    x, y, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                    assert w == h == 160
                    panels.append((selection["label"], source[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
                    copied_channels += w * h * 3
            board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(panels), 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4),
                f"{'CPU LAYOUT FIXTURE / NO V191 QUALITY | ' if fixture else ''}{case['id']} | V191 dense local spectral readout above frozen V183 EMA,contrast{old['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
                font=font,
                fill="black",
            )
            records = []
            for index, (label, value) in enumerate(panels):
                x = 8 + 168 * index
                draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
                records.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})
            path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
            board.save(path)
            image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
            for record, (_, value) in zip(records, panels, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = record["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], value)
            figures.append(
                {
                    "case": case,
                    "ROI_xywh": old["ROI_xywh"],
                    "anchor": old["anchor"],
                    "contrast": old["contrast"],
                    "exposure": old["exposure"],
                    "image": ref(path),
                    "panels": records,
                    "predictions": bindings,
                    "source_figure": old["image"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                    "triplet": old["triplet"],
                }
            )
    assert len(figures) == 60 and sum(f["triplet"] for f in figures) == 12 and channels == 8294400
    assert copied_channels == 95001600
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(figures), 4):
        group = figures[start : start + 4]
        width = max(Image.open(f["image"]["path"]).width for f in group)
        sheet = Image.new("RGB", (width, 212 * len(group)), "#eeeeee")
        for row, item in enumerate(group):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, 212 * row))
        path = out / f"sheet-{len(sheets):02d}.png"
        sheet.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(group))),
                "image": ref(path),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-layout-fixture-not-quality"
            if fixture
            else "rendered-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V191_quality": fixture,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(root / "scores-v1.json"),
            "images": figures,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "new_RGB_channels_independently_checked": channels,
            "unchanged_RGB_channels_copied": copied_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered60nativefigures12triplets;fixture", fixture, "newchannels", channels, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    render(args.fixture_root if args.fixture_root else ROOT, fixture=args.fixture_root is not None)

"""CPU array/native preparation after the exact frozen CUDA controller exits."""

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from queue_tf32x3_cuda import alive, stop_owned
from queue_uniform_physics_cuda import COMPLETE, REJECTED, resource_ready
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save


def ready(plan):
    try:
        state = read(plan["GPU_status"])
    except FileNotFoundError:
        # The parent can be live before its atomic initial status write.
        if alive(plan["GPU_owner"]):
            return False
        raise RuntimeError("GPU owner exited before writing its initial status") from None
    if state["controller"] != plan["GPU_owner"] or state["plan"] != plan["GPU_controller_plan"]:
        raise ValueError("Exact GPU controller identity/plan changed")
    if ref(state["plan"]["path"]) != state["plan"]:
        raise ValueError("GPU controller plan bytes changed")
    if state["status"].startswith("failed-"):
        raise RuntimeError("GPU dependency failed; no review retry")
    if alive(plan["GPU_owner"]):
        return False
    if state["status"] not in (COMPLETE, REJECTED):
        raise RuntimeError("GPU owner exited without a completed/rejected terminal")
    if state.get("child") and alive(state["child"]):
        raise RuntimeError("Exact GPU worker remains live")
    return True


def guard(plan):
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(item["path"]) == item
    proof = read(plan["CPU_preflight"]["path"])
    assert (
        proof["status"]
        == "completed-uniform-physics-review-historical-CPU-integration-no-current-GPU-result"
    )
    assert proof["historical_RGB_values_independently_reduced"] == 7077888
    assert proof["live_current_GPU_refused_before_output"]
    assert proof["native_panels_match_historical_pixels"] == 72
    assert proof["native_board_cells"] == 48 and proof["native_triplets"] == 24
    assert proof["manual_review_completed"] is False and proof["CUDA_initialized"] is False


def main(path):
    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == ""
    os.nice(10)
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["driver"]
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    state = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(path),
    }

    def record(status, **values):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        record("waiting-for-exact-uniform-physics-CUDA-controller-exit-no-Torch-CUDA")
        started = time.monotonic()
        while not ready(plan):
            if time.monotonic() - started > plan["dependency_timeout_seconds"]:
                raise TimeoutError("GPU wait bound reached; no review retry")
            time.sleep(5)
        started = time.monotonic()
        while not resource_ready(plan):
            if time.monotonic() - started > plan["resource_timeout_seconds"]:
                raise TimeoutError("CPU review resource wait bound reached")
            time.sleep(5)
        for stage, script, arguments in [
            (
                "arrays",
                plan["array_driver"],
                [plan["GPU_controller_plan"]["path"], plan["array_output"]],
            ),
            (
                "native",
                plan["native_driver"],
                [str(Path(plan["array_output"]) / "array-audit.json"), plan["native_output"]],
            ),
        ]:
            assert ready(plan)
            guard(plan)
            if stage == "native" and read(plan["GPU_status"])["status"] == REJECTED:
                record(
                    "audited-CUDA-array-rejection-no-native-package-or-integration",
                    arrays=ref(Path(plan["array_output"]) / "array-audit.json"),
                )
                return
            with (root / f"{stage}.log").open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", script["path"], *arguments],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                    env=dict(os.environ, **plan["worker_env"]),
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-CPU-uniform-physics-review", stage=stage, child=owner)
                started = time.monotonic()
                try:
                    while child.poll() is None:
                        if time.monotonic() - started > plan["worker_timeout_seconds"]:
                            raise TimeoutError("Owned CPU review runtime bound reached")
                        if not resource_ready(
                            dict(plan, launch_available_gib=plan["active_available_gib"])
                        ):
                            raise MemoryError("Shared CPU review memory/disk floor reached")
                        time.sleep(2)
                except BaseException:
                    stop_owned(child, owner)
                    raise
                assert child.returncode == 0 and not alive(owner)
        guard(plan)
        native = Path(plan["native_output"]) / "report.json"
        result = read(native)
        assert result["manual_review_completed"] is False and result["CUDA_initialized"] is False
        assert result["native_source_triplets"] == 24 and result["displayed_board_cells"] == 48
        record(
            "prepared-uniform-physics-native-views-awaiting-actual-inspection-no-promotion",
            arrays=ref(Path(plan["array_output"]) / "array-audit.json"),
            native_report=ref(native),
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-uniform-physics-CPU-review-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    main(p.parse_args().plan)

            for case in plan["cases"]:
                cpu, batch, base = load_case(case)
                reference = reference_aux = None
                if case["noisy"]:
                    with torch.no_grad():

                    feature_calls["CPU"] += 1
                for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]:

                    status(phase, owner, counts=counts)
                    old.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
                    if endpoint == "EMA":
                        old.network.load_state_dict(state["ema"], strict=True)
                    new.initialize_from_local_matching(old.state_dict())
                    if frozen_hash is None:
                        frozen_hash = model_hash(new.frozen)
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
                        started = time.perf_counter()
                        baseline, baseline_aux = invoke(old, batch, base)
                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
                        seconds_old = time.perf_counter() - started
                        started = time.perf_counter()
                        output, aux = invoke(new, batch, base)
                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
                        seconds_new = time.perf_counter() - started
                    row = {
                        "id": case["id"],
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "source": case["arrays"],
                        "parent": case["parent"],

            phase = "direct-CUDA-feature-invariants"

                    watch=True,

        assert not any(

                "admission.claim",
                "admission-launch-v1.json",

        assert code == 0, f"Admission exited{code};no retry"
        result = read(ROOT / "admission-result-v1.json")
        assert result["owner"] == child_owner and result["status"].startswith("pass-")
        save(
