        "disk_reserves": {"root_reserve_gib": 64, "external_reserve_gib": 384},
        "external_device": Path("/mnt/external").stat().st_dev,
        "stable_seconds": 60,
        "wait_seconds": 7200,
        "dependency_wait_seconds": 43200,
        "CPU_stage_timeout_seconds": 7200,
        "inputs": inputs,
        "frozen_files": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
        "scope": "CPU-only wait and independent audit of both fixed4k endpoints. After exact training owners exit, prepare the frozen full seven-panel common-policy comparison, launch its existing resource-managed controller and exit. No restart, retry, checkpoint selection, speed work or automatic promotion; independent numeric and native-crop review still required.",
    }
    save(root / "plan.json", plan)
    guard(plan)
    print(ref(root / "plan.json"))


def worker(plan_path, stage):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == ""
    repository, training_root = Path(plan["repository"]), Path(plan["training_root"])
    if stage.startswith("audit-"):
        import audit_v43_quality_training as auditor

        auditor.REPO = repository
        arm = stage.removeprefix("audit-")
        auditor.audit(
            training_root, arm, training_root / f"independent-{arm}-training-audit-v1.json"
        )
    else:
        assert stage == "prepare-evaluation"
        import evaluate_v43_quality_trial as evaluator

        evaluator.REPO = repository
        evaluator.prepare(
            training_root,
            Path(plan["evaluation_root"]),
            adc_training=True,
            artifact_root=Path(plan["artifact_root"]),
            source_repository=Path(plan["work"]),
        )
    guard(plan)


def controller(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root, work = Path(plan["root"]), Path(plan["work"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child, identity = None, None

    def record(status, **extra):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **extra)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    def observe():
        snapshot = resource_snapshot(root)
        with (root / "resource-history.jsonl").open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(snapshot) + "\n")
        return snapshot

    try:
        record("waiting-for-exact-ADC-training-owners-to-complete-and-exit")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + plan["dependency_wait_seconds"]
        while True:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "Training dependency wait bound"
            training_state = read(Path(plan["training_root"]) / "status.json")
            if training_ready(training_state, plan["training_plan"], plan["training_controller"]):
                break
            record(
                "waiting-for-exact-ADC-training-owners-to-complete-and-exit",
                observed_training_status=training_state["status"],
                observed_training_phase=training_state.get("phase"),
                observed_training_arm=training_state.get("arm"),
                resource_snapshot=observe(),
            )
            time.sleep(10)
        completed_results(training_state, plan["training_plan"])
        save(root / "completed-training-observation.json", training_state)
        env = dict(
            os.environ,
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
            PYTHONPATH=f"{work}/src:{work}/scripts",
            PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
            OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",
            OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
            HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
            TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
        )
        env.update(plan["cache_environment"])
        for stage in ("audit-V98", "audit-V99", "prepare-evaluation"):
            guard(plan)
            record("waiting-for-CPU-audit-headroom", stage=stage)
            began, stable = time.monotonic(), None
            while True:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < plan["wait_seconds"]
                stable = (
                    (time.monotonic() if stable is None else stable)
                    if headroom(observe(), plan, 48)
                    else None
                )
                if stable is not None and time.monotonic() - stable >= plan["stable_seconds"]:
                    break
                time.sleep(2)
            with (root / (stage + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        str(work / "scripts/queue_v95_adc_quality.py"),
                        "worker",
                        str(plan_path),
                        "--stage",
                        stage,
                    ],
                    cwd=work,
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                identity = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-CPU-only-ADC-audit-or-preparation", child=identity)
                monitor_child(
                    child,
                    identity,
                    plan=plan,
                    observe=observe,
                    record=record,
                    deadline=time.monotonic() + plan["CPU_stage_timeout_seconds"],
                )
                assert child.wait() == 0, (stage, child.returncode)
            output = (
                Path(plan["evaluation_root"]) / "plan.json"
                if stage == "prepare-evaluation"
                else Path(plan["training_root"])
                / f"independent-{stage.removeprefix('audit-')}-training-audit-v1.json"
            )
            state["completed"][stage] = ref(output)
            record("completed-CPU-only-ADC-queue-stage")
        evaluation_plan_path = Path(plan["evaluation_root"]) / "plan.json"
        evaluation = read(evaluation_plan_path)
        guard(plan)
        guard(evaluation)
        assert not (Path(plan["evaluation_root"]) / "controller.claim").exists()
        (root / "handoff.claim").open("x").close()
        evaluation_work = Path(evaluation["work"])
        env["PYTHONPATH"] = f"{evaluation_work}/src:{evaluation_work}/scripts"
        with (Path(plan["evaluation_root"]) / "controller.log").open("xb") as log:
            # The evaluator owns its separate-session workers and their resource policy.
            # This queue exits; it must never signal only that supervisor's process group.
            launched = subprocess.Popen(
                [
                    plan["python"],
                    "-P",
                    str(evaluation_work / "scripts/evaluate_v43_quality_trial.py"),
                    "controller",
                    str(evaluation_plan_path),
                ],
                cwd=evaluation_work,
                env=env,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
        owner = {"pid": launched.pid, "created": psutil.Process(launched.pid).create_time()}
        receipt = {
            "plan": ref(evaluation_plan_path),
            "owner": owner,
            "queue_plan": ref(plan_path),
            "scope": "Handoff only; panel completion and review remain pending.",
        }
        save(Path(plan["evaluation_root"]) / "launch.json", receipt)
        save(root / "evaluation-launch.json", receipt)
        record(
            "handed-off-full-ADC-quality-evaluation-awaiting-panels-and-review",
            evaluation_controller=owner,
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
            stop_owned_child(child, identity)
        record("failed-ADC-quality-queue-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller", "worker"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--artifact-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=("audit-V98", "audit-V99", "prepare-evaluation"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        assert args.output and args.evaluation_root and args.artifact_root
        prepare(args.path, args.output, args.evaluation_root, args.artifact_root)
    elif args.mode == "controller":
        controller(args.path)
    else:
        assert args.stage
        worker(args.path, args.stage)

"""Run two frozen mature-parent camera-supervision arms to their first1000 boundary."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def ref(path):
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": sha(path)}


def save(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


def guard(plan):
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert sha(item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    for path, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert sha(path) == digest, path


def worker(plan_path, arm_name):
    import torch
    from audit_flat_palette import train_rows
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    import demosaic.train as training

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    arm = next(a for a in plan["arms"] if a["name"] == arm_name)
    with (root / (arm_name + ".claim")).open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 128 * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 500 * 2**30
    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    quota = min(
        torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device),
        24 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory,
    )
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(quota, device)
    parent = torch.load(plan["parent"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    constructor = training.JointDemosaic
    prepare = training.prepare_training_batch
    capture, sampled = {}, []

    def instrument(options):
        model = constructor(options)
        capture["model"] = model

        def first_forward(module, args):
            for name, value in module.restoration_state_dict().items():
                assert torch.equal(value.cpu(), parent["ema"][name]), name
            capture["initial_EMA_exact"] = True
            capture["DINO_sha256"] = model_hash(module.context.backbone)
            hook.remove()

        hook = model.register_forward_pre_hook(first_forward)
        return model

    def observe(*args, **kwargs):
        batch = prepare(*args, **kwargs)
        if args[0] <= 16 or args[0] % 25 == 0:
            sampled.append(
                {
                    "step": args[0],
                    "domain": args[1],
                    "legacy_batch_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(
                        {k: v for k, v in batch.items() if k != "sensor_target"}
                    ),
                    "input_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(
                        {
                            k: batch[k]
                            for k in [
                                "packed",
                                "variance",
                                "colors",
                                "wb",
                                "matrix",
                                "shot",
                                "read",
                            ]
                        }
                    ),
                    "sensor_target_present": "sensor_target" in batch,
                }
            )
            save(root / (arm_name + "-sampled-observations.json"), sampled)
        return batch

    training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = instrument, observe
    try:
        checkpoint = training.train(
            arm["config"], initialize=plan["parent"]["path"], stop_after=1000
        )
    finally:
        training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = constructor, prepare
    model = capture.pop("model")
    assert capture["DINO_sha256"] == model_hash(model.context.backbone)
    assert all(not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
    state = torch.load(checkpoint, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
    assert state["step"] == 1000 and state["config"]["steps"] == 4000
    assert state["config"]["reconstruction_objective"] == "charbonnier-v1"
    assert state["config"]["camera_supervision"] == arm["camera_supervision"]
    assert state["config"]["manifest_sha256"] == plan["training_manifest_sha256"]
    assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    for field in ["model", "ema"]:
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[field].values())
    for values in state["optimizer"]["state"].values():
        assert int(values["step"]) == 1000
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor))
    rows = train_rows(Path(checkpoint).parent)
    assert [r["step"] for r in rows] == [1, *range(25, 1001, 25)]
    assert [r["step"] for r in sampled] == [*range(1, 17), *range(25, 1001, 25)]
    assert all(
        r["sensor_target_present"]
        == (arm["camera_supervision"] == "sensor-valid-v1" and r["domain"] != "paired")
        for r in sampled
    )
    guard(plan)
    result = {
        "status": "completed-one-camera-supervision-first1000-awaiting-quality-review",
        "arm": arm_name,
        "checkpoint": ref(checkpoint),
        "capture": capture,
        "metrics": ref(Path(checkpoint).parent / "metrics.jsonl"),
        "sampled_observations": ref(root / (arm_name + "-sampled-observations.json")),
        "finite_states": {"model": 91, "EMA": 91, "AdamW": 89},
        "logged_observations": rows,
        "source_sha256": state["config"]["source_sha256"],
        "actual_step": 1000,
        "planned_steps": 4000,
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
    }
    save(root / (arm_name + "-result.json"), result)


def controller(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    info = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "completed": {},
    }

    def record(status, **values):
        info.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        save(root / "status.json", info)
        print(json.dumps({"status": status, "arm": info.get("arm")}), flush=True)

    try:
        record("starting-frozen-mature-camera-supervision-first1000-trial")
        for arm in plan["arms"]:
            guard(plan)
            env = dict(os.environ)
            env.update(
                PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(
                    [str(Path(plan["work"]) / p) for p in ["src", "scripts"]]
                ),
                HF_HOME=plan["HF_HOME"],
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
            )
            with (root / (arm["name"] + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        plan["worker"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(plan_path),
                        "--arm",
                        arm["name"],
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                identity = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("running-camera-supervision-first1000", arm=arm["name"], child=identity)
                try:
                    code = child.wait(timeout=plan["per_arm_timeout_seconds"])
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    # Terminate only this exact owned process group, including its data workers.
                    import signal

                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    child.wait(timeout=30)
                    raise
            assert code == 0, f"{arm['name']} exited {code}"
            result_path = root / (arm["name"] + "-result.json")
            result = read(result_path)
            assert result["actual_step"] == 1000 and result["planned_steps"] == 4000
            info["completed"][arm["name"]] = ref(result_path)
            record("completed-one-camera-supervision-first1000", arm=arm["name"])
        a, b = [read(info["completed"][a["name"]]["path"]) for a in plan["arms"]]
        for x, y in zip(
            read(a["sampled_observations"]["path"]),
            read(b["sampled_observations"]["path"]),
            strict=True,
        ):
            assert all(

def sha(path):

        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def identical(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
        assert torch.equal(a, b)
    elif isinstance(a, dict):
        assert a.keys() == b.keys()
        for k in a:
            identical(a[k], b[k])
    elif isinstance(a, (tuple, list)):
        assert type(a) is type(b) and len(a) == len(b)
        for x, y in zip(a, b):
            identical(x, y)
    else:
        assert a == b

    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second

def cuda_loss_checks(plan):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from flat_target_anchor import flat_target_anchor_loss, flat_target_mask

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    records = []
    for row in plan["prefix"]:
        resource_check(Path(plan["root"]))
        a = dict(np.load(row["arrays"]["path"]))
        clean = a["target"]
        base = np.load(row["parent"]["path"])

        def maximum(x):
            height, width = x.shape[-2:]
            p = np.pad(x, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (0, 0), (8, 8)), mode="edge")
            x = np.maximum.reduce([p[..., i : i + width] for i in range(17)])
            p = np.pad(x, ((0, 0), (0, 0), (8, 8), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
            return np.maximum.reduce([p[..., i : i + height, :] for i in range(17)])

        mask = (maximum(clean) + maximum(-clean)).max(1, keepdims=True) <= 1 / 65535
        target = torch.from_numpy(clean).cuda()
        actual_mask = flat_target_mask(target)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual_mask.cpu().numpy(), mask)
        value = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda().requires_grad_()
        loss = flat_target_anchor_loss(value, target, actual_mask)
        loss.backward()
        error = (base.astype(np.float64) - clean.astype(np.float64)) * 65535 / 16
        expected = float(np.mean(error**2 / (np.sqrt(1 + error**2) + 1) * mask))
        derivative = error / np.sqrt(1 + error**2) * (65535 / 16) / error.size * mask
        np.testing.assert_allclose(float(loss.detach()), expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-8)
        actual = value.grad.cpu().numpy()
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, derivative, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-8)
        records.append(
            {
                "step": row["step"],
                "domain": row["metadata"]["domain"],
                "mask": fingerprint(mask),
                "eligible_pixels": int(mask.sum()),
                "total_pixels": mask.size,
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "independent_loss": expected,
                "maximum_adjoint_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(actual - derivative))),
                "leaf_backwards": 1,
                "neural_forwards": 0,
            }
        )
        del target, actual_mask, value, loss, error, derivative, actual
    assert len(records) == 10
    return records


def cuda_pair_unit_checks(plan):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from paired_response_objective import paired_response_loss

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    table = read(plan["pair_unit_table"]["path"])["rows"]
    records = []
    for item in plan["prefix"]:
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        pairs = a["pair_indices"]
        if not len(pairs):
            continue
        base = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
        target = a["target"]
        entry = table[item["step"] - 1]
        units = np.array(entry["candidate_units_FP32"], dtype=np.float32).reshape(entry["shape"])
        value = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda().requires_grad_()
        clean = torch.from_numpy(target).cuda()
        scale = torch.from_numpy(units).cuda()
        loss = paired_response_loss(value, clean, scale, pairs)
        loss.backward()
        first, second = pairs.T
        residual = ((base[first] - base[second]) - (target[first] - target[second])) / units
        error = residual.astype(np.float64)
        expected = float(np.mean(error**2 / (np.sqrt(error**2 + 0.003**2) + 0.003)))
        derivative = error / np.sqrt(error**2 + 0.003**2) / units.astype(np.float64) / error.size
        adjoint = np.zeros(base.shape, dtype=np.float64)
        adjoint[first] = derivative
        adjoint[second] = -derivative
        actual = value.grad.cpu().numpy()
        np.testing.assert_allclose(float(loss.detach()), expected, rtol=3e-6, atol=1e-8)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, adjoint, rtol=3e-5, atol=3e-8)
        records.append(
            {
                "step": item["step"],
                "units": fingerprint(units),
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "independent_loss": expected,
                "maximum_adjoint_difference": float(np.max(np.abs(actual - adjoint))),
                "leaf_backwards": 1,
                "neural_forwards": 0,
            }
        )
        del value, clean, scale, loss, actual
    assert len(records) == 6
    return records


def cuda_common_checks(plan):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from paired_common_objective import paired_common_error_loss
    rows=[]
    for index,(size,offset,ADC) in enumerate([(5,0.0,False),(7,0.1,False),(9,8.0,False),(11,64.0,True)]):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(16510+index)
        target=rng.normal(size=(4,3,size,size+2)).astype(np.float32)*.01
        value=target+rng.normal(size=target.shape).astype(np.float32)*.0001+np.float32(offset/65535)
        pairs=np.array([[3,1],[2,0]],dtype=np.int64)
        output=torch.tensor(value,device='cuda',requires_grad=True)
        loss=paired_common_error_loss(output,torch.tensor(target,device='cuda'),pairs,unit_DN16=16)
        if ADC:loss=loss*0
        loss.backward()
        error=value.astype(np.float64)-target.astype(np.float64)
        first,second=pairs.T;z=(error[first]+error[second])/(2*16/65535)
        expected=float(np.mean(z*z/(np.sqrt(1+z*z)+1)))
        derivative=z/np.sqrt(1+z*z)/(2*16/65535)/z.size
        gradient=np.zeros_like(error);gradient[first]=derivative;gradient[second]=derivative
        if ADC:expected=0.;gradient*=0
        actual=output.grad.cpu().numpy();np.testing.assert_allclose(actual,gradient,rtol=3e-6,atol=1e-7)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(float(loss.detach()),expected,rtol=3e-6,atol=1e-8)
        assert np.array_equal(actual[first],actual[second])
        rows.append({'size':size,'offset_DN16':offset,'ADC_zero_weight':ADC,
            'loss':float(loss.detach()),'independent_loss':expected,
            'maximum_full_output_adjoint_difference':float(np.max(np.abs(actual-gradient)))})
    return rows

def fit(plan, phase):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    import yaml
    from flat_target_anchor import flat_target_anchor_loss, flat_target_mask
    from local_excess_risk import local_excess_risk
    from noisy_objective import ADC_only, apply_ADC_weight
    from paired_response_objective import paired_response_loss
    from paired_common_objective import paired_common_error_loss
    from regional_dc_objective import regional_dc_excess
    from robust_spectral_objective import spectral_loss

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    root = Path(plan["root"])
    config = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["config"]["path"]).read_text())
    recipe = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["config"]["path"]).read_text())
    counts = {label: 0 for label in recipe["arms"]}
    updates = dict(counts)
    supervised = dict(counts)
    zero_ADC = dict(counts)
    peak_evaluations = dict(counts)
    LIVE_PROGRESS.update(phase=phase, counts=counts, updates=updates, last_completed_step=0)

    def fresh():
        modules = {k: classes()[k](256).cuda() for k in recipe["arms"]}
        for name, value in modules["fine-control"].state_dict().items():
            assert all(torch.equal(value, m.state_dict()[name]) for m in modules.values())
        assert all(m.relative_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0 for m in modules.values())
        assert modules["pair-common"].harmonic_in.weight.count_nonzero() == 0
        for label, m in modules.items():
            assert (
                sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameters"]
                and len(m.state_dict()) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameter_tensors"]
            )
            m.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, label=label: counts.__setitem__(label, counts[label] + 1)
            )
        opts = {k: torch.optim.AdamW(m.parameters(), lr=config["lr"]) for k, m in modules.items()}
        emas = {
            k: {n: v.detach().clone() for n, v in m.state_dict().items()}
            for k, m in modules.items()
        }
        return modules, opts, emas

    modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
    maximum = {k: {n: 0.0 for n, _ in m.named_parameters()} for k, m in modules.items()}
    cache_rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    reference_trace = read(plan["baseline_training"]["path"])["trace"]
    unit_rows = read(plan["pair_unit_table"]["path"])["rows"]
    compatible_steps = 0
    smoke_trace = read(root / "smoke-result-v1.json")["trace"] if phase == "train" else None
    checkpointdir = root / "checkpoints"
    checkpointdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    trace = []
    last = 0
    journal = (root / f"{phase}-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step):
        dest = checkpointdir / f"{phase}-step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not dest.exists()
        with dest.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(
                {
                    "step": step,
                    "horizon": 1000,
                    "module_config": {"max_window": 256},
                    "arms": recipe["arms"],
                    "models": {k: m.state_dict() for k, m in modules.items()},
                    "emas": emas,
                    "optimizers": {k: o.state_dict() for k, o in optimizers.items()},
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "updates": dict(updates),
                    "parent": plan["parent"],
                    "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
                    "config": config,
                    "torch_CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "torch_CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                },
                stream,
            )
        return dest

    for step in range(1, 11 if phase == "smoke" else 1001):
        resource_check(root)
        item = cache_rows[step - 1]
        assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        assert ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
        base = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
        assert fingerprint(base) == item["parent_values"]
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in a.items()} == item["inputs"]
        batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in a.items()}
        base = torch.from_numpy(base).cuda()
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "arms": {},
        }
        mask = flat_target_mask(
            batch["target"],
            window=recipe["flat_anchor_window"],
            tolerance_DN16=recipe["flat_anchor_tolerance_DN16"],
        )
        mask_cpu = mask.cpu().numpy()
        row["flat_target_mask"] = {
            "values": fingerprint(mask_cpu),
            "eligible_pixels": int(mask_cpu.sum()),
            "total_pixels": mask_cpu.size,
            "per_image_eligible_pixels": [int(v.sum()) for v in mask_cpu],
        }
        progress = max(0, step - config["warmup"]) / max(1, 1000 - config["warmup"])
        lr = (
            config["lr"]
            * min(1, step / config["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        for label, module in modules.items():
            optimizer = optimizers[label]
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")), return_aux=True
            )
            if step == 1:
                assert torch.equal(output, base) and aux["correction"].count_nonzero() == 0
            scale = (
                batch["variance"]
                .clamp_min(0)
                .mean((1, 2, 3), keepdim=True)
                .sqrt()
                .clamp_min(recipe["arms"][label]["loss_floor_DN16"] / 65535)
            )
            error = (output - batch["target"]) / scale
            pixel = (error.square() + config["pixel_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
            derivatives = [error[..., 1:] - error[..., :-1], error[..., 1:, :] - error[..., :-1, :]]
            gradient = (
                sum(
                    (v.square() + config["gradient_epsilon_in_noise_units"] ** 2).sqrt().mean()
                    for v in derivatives
                )
                / 2
            )
            arm = recipe["arms"][label]
            is_ADC = ADC_only(item["metadata"]["noise"])
            peak_bonus = arm["spectral_peak_bonus"] if not is_ADC else 0
            assert peak_bonus == 0
            spectral = spectral_loss(
                module,
                output,
                batch["target"],
                batch["colors"],
                aux,
                arm["loss_floor_DN16"],
                arm["penalty"],
                arm["spectral_epsilon"],
            )
            peak_evaluations[label] += int(peak_bonus > 0)
            loss = config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * (
                pixel + config["gradient_weight"] * gradient + config["spectral_weight"] * spectral
            )
            local_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["local_risk_weight"]:
                local_penalty = local_excess_risk(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["local_risk_window_native"],
                    transition=recipe["local_risk_transition_noise_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["local_risk_weight"]
                    * local_penalty
                )
            dc_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["regional_DC_weight"]:
                dc_penalty = regional_dc_excess(
                    output,
                    base,
                    batch["target"],
                    scale,
                    window=recipe["regional_DC_window_native"],
                    transition=arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["regional_DC_weight"]
                    * dc_penalty
                )
            pair_scale = batch["pair_units"]
            if arm["pair_unit_floor_DN16"] == 2:
                entry = unit_rows[step - 1]
                assert entry["step"] == step and entry["batch"] == item["arrays"]
                pair_scale = pair_scale.new_tensor(entry["candidate_units_FP32"]).reshape(
                    entry["shape"]
                )
            pair_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["paired_response_weight"] and len(batch["pair_indices"]):
                pair_penalty = paired_response_loss(
                    output,
                    batch["target"],
                    pair_scale,
                    batch["pair_indices"],
                    epsilon=recipe["pair_epsilon"],
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["paired_response_weight"]
                    * pair_penalty
                )
            anchor_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["flat_anchor_weight"]:
                anchor_penalty = flat_target_anchor_loss(
                    output, batch["target"], mask, unit_DN16=recipe["flat_anchor_unit_DN16"]
                )
                loss = (
                    loss
                    + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]]
                    * arm["flat_anchor_weight"]
                    * anchor_penalty
                )
            common_penalty = output.new_zeros(())
            if arm["pair_common_weight"] and len(batch["pair_indices"]):
                common_penalty = paired_common_error_loss(
                    output, batch["target"], batch["pair_indices"],
                    unit_DN16=recipe["pair_common_unit_DN16"],
                )
                loss = loss + config["domain_loss_weights"][row["domain"]] * arm["pair_common_weight"] * common_penalty
            loss = apply_ADC_weight(loss, item["metadata"]["noise"], arm["ADC_loss_weight"])
            has_supervision = not (is_ADC and arm["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0)
            supervised[label] += int(has_supervision)
            zero_ADC[label] += int(not has_supervision)
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            for name, p in module.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all()
                maximum[label][name] = max(maximum[label][name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                if not has_supervision:
                    assert p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0
            if not has_supervision:
                assert loss == 0
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(module.parameters(), 1.0, error_if_nonfinite=True)
            optimizer.step()
            updates[label] += 1
            decay = min(config["EMA_decay"], (1 + step) / (10 + step))
            with torch.no_grad():
                for name, value in module.state_dict().items():
                    emas[label][name].lerp_(value, 1 - decay)
            row["arms"][label] = {
                "loss": float(loss.detach()),
                "pixel": float(pixel.detach()),
                "gradient": float(gradient.detach()),
                "spectral": float(spectral.detach()),
                "gradient_norm": float(norm),
                "lr": lr,
                "local_excess_risk": float(local_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_excess": float(dc_penalty.detach()),
                "regional_DC_transition_units": arm["regional_DC_transition_units"],
                "paired_response": float(pair_penalty.detach()),
                "pair_common_error": float(common_penalty.detach()),
                "pair_unit_values": fingerprint(pair_scale.detach().cpu().numpy()),
                "pair_unit_floor_DN16": arm["pair_unit_floor_DN16"],
                "flat_target_anchor": float(anchor_penalty.detach()),
                "coupled_pairs": len(batch["pair_indices"]),
                **(
                    {
                        "spatial_correction_RMS_DN16": float(
                            aux["spatial_correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt()
                        )
                        * 65535
                    }
                    if "spatial_correction" in aux
                    else {}
                ),
            }
            if label == "fine-control":
                expected = reference_trace[step - 1]["arms"]["fine-pair"]
                assert {k: row["arms"][label][k] for k in expected} == expected, (
                    phase,
                    step,
                    "V164 control trace",
                )
                compatible_steps += 1
            del (
                output,
                aux,
                error,
                pixel,
                derivatives,
                gradient,
                spectral,
                local_penalty,
                dc_penalty,
                loss,
                scale,
                pair_penalty,
                common_penalty,
                pair_scale,
                anchor_penalty,
            )
        if phase == "train" and step <= 10:
            assert row == smoke_trace[step - 1], (step, "smoke/train prefix continuation")
        trace.append(row)
        journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        journal.flush()
        LIVE_PROGRESS["last_completed_step"] = step
        last = step
        if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "phase": phase,
                        "step": step,
                        "arms": row["arms"],
                        "CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),
                    }
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
            save(
                root / f"{phase}-progress-v1.json",
                {"step": step, "counts": counts, "updates": updates},
            )
        del batch, base, a, mask, mask_cpu
        if phase == "smoke" and step == 8:
            path = checkpoint(8)
            s = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            modules, optimizers, emas = fresh()
            for label in modules:
                modules[label].load_state_dict(s["models"][label], strict=True)
                optimizers[label].load_state_dict(s["optimizers"][label])
                emas[label] = {n: v.cuda() for n, v in s["emas"][label].items()}
                assert len(optimizers[label].state) == recipe["arms"][label][
                    "parameter_tensors"
                ] and all(float(v["step"]) == 8 for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["models"][label][n])
                    for n, v in modules[label].state_dict().items()
                )
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(v.cpu(), s["emas"][label][n]) for n, v in emas[label].items()
                )
                reloaded = optimizers[label].state_dict()
                assert reloaded["param_groups"] == s["optimizers"][label]["param_groups"]
                for index, state in reloaded["state"].items():
                    for key, value in state.items():
                        assert torch.equal(value.cpu(), s["optimizers"][label]["state"][index][key])
            torch.set_rng_state(s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state(s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            assert torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), s["torch_CPU_RNG"])
            assert torch.equal(torch.cuda.get_rng_state().cpu(), s["torch_CUDA_RNG"])
            del s
        if phase == "train" and step % 250 == 0:
            checkpoint(step)
    journal.close()
    final = checkpoint(last) if phase == "smoke" else checkpointdir / "train-step1000.pt"
    assert counts == updates == {k: last for k in modules}
    for label, module in modules.items():
        assert (
            min(maximum[label].values()) > 0
            and len(optimizers[label].state) == recipe["arms"][label]["parameter_tensors"]
        )
        assert all(float(v["step"]) == last for v in optimizers[label].state.values())
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(t).all()
            for state in optimizers[label].state.values()
            for t in state.values()
        )
        assert all(
            torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*module.state_dict().values(), *emas[label].values()]
        )
    expected_ADC = sum(ADC_only(x["metadata"]["noise"]) for x in cache_rows[:last])
    assert supervised == {
        k: last - (expected_ADC if v["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0 else 0)
        for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    assert zero_ADC == {
        k: (expected_ADC if v["ADC_loss_weight"] == 0 else 0) for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    assert peak_evaluations == {
        k: (last - expected_ADC if v["spectral_peak_bonus"] else 0)
        for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()
    }
    if phase == "train":
        previous = read(plan["baseline_training"]["path"])
        assert ref(previous["checkpoint"]["path"]) == previous["checkpoint"]
        saved = torch.load(previous["checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        assert equal_tree(modules["fine-control"].state_dict(), saved["models"]["fine-pair"])
        assert equal_tree(emas["fine-control"], saved["emas"]["fine-pair"])
        assert equal_tree(
            optimizers["fine-control"].state_dict(), saved["optimizers"]["fine-pair"]
        )
        del saved
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-head-phase",
            "phase": phase,
            "steps": last,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": ref(final),
            "counts": counts,
            "updates": updates,
            "supervised_batches": supervised,
            "zero_ADC_gradient_batches": zero_ADC,
            "peak_weight_evaluations": peak_evaluations,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "loss_floors_DN16": {k: v["loss_floor_DN16"] for k, v in recipe["arms"].items()},
            "initial_outputs_exact_parent": True,
            "trace": trace,
            "exact_V164_control_trace_rows": compatible_steps,
            "control_final_raw_EMA_Adam_exact": phase == "train",
            "head_image_evaluations": 8 * last,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": recipe["scope"],
        },
    )


def worker(path, phase):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"{phase}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    try:
        if phase == "parity":
            parity(plan)
        else:
            fit(plan, phase)
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "progress": LIVE_PROGRESS,
                "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            },
        )
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        for phase in ("parity", "smoke", "train"):
            guard(plan)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "phase": phase},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"{phase}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
                        "-P",
                        plan["runner"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(path),
                        "--phase",
                        phase,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase", "phase": phase, "child": owner},
                )
                observed = 0.0
                last = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < (1800 if phase in ("parity", "smoke") else 7200), phase
                assert child.returncode == 0, phase
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][phase] = ref(root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json")
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "worker", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("parity", "smoke", "train"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path))
    elif args.mode == "worker":
        worker(args.path.resolve(), args.phase)
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

"""Plot fixed fine-band gradient projections from the saved CPU loss replay."""

import argparse

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def main(root, version=2):
    import matplotlib

    matplotlib.use("Agg")

    root = root.resolve()

    assert analysis["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json") and not analysis["Torch_imported"]

    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    cases = [
        ("bark", "Bark / ≥20%"),
        ("raccoon-fur", "Fur / 0–2%"),
        ("pixls-5002-fine", "Grass estimate / 2–5%"),
        ("pixls-1951-field", "Wood estimate / 2–5%"),
    ]
    plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 9, "svg.hashsalt": "conditional-loss-gradients-v1"})
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(2, 4, figsize=(12.6, 7.3))
    rows = []
    for row, method in enumerate(("V120", "V117")):
        for column, (case, title) in enumerate(cases):
            selected = next(
                s
                for s in analysis["summaries"]
                if s["method"] == method
                and s["case_id"] == case
                and s["scope"] == f"band-contrast-{plan['selected_contrast_bins'][case]}"
                and s["term"] == "total"
            )
            rows.append(selected)
            ax = axes[row, column]
            x = np.arange(2)
            for offset, key, label, color in (
                (-0.18, "control", "Per-view control", "#3374ac"),
                (0.18, "mixture", ".75 per-view + .25 mean", "#dd8430"),
            ):
                values = [
                    selected["projections"][key][field] * 1e8
                    for field in ("heldout_bias_projection", "noise_covariance_projection")
                ]
                ax.bar(x + offset, values, width=0.34, label=label, color=color)
            before = selected["projections"]["control"]
            after = selected["projections"]["mixture"]
            bias = 100 * (after["heldout_bias_projection"] / before["heldout_bias_projection"] - 1)
            noise = 100 * (
                after["noise_covariance_projection"] / before["noise_covariance_projection"] - 1
            )
            ax.set_title(f"{method} · {title}\n{selected['reference_blocks']} reference blocks")
            ax.text(
                0.5,
                0.97,
                f"bias {bias:+.2f}% · covariance {noise:+.2f}%",
                ha="center",
                va="top",
                transform=ax.transAxes,
                fontsize=8,
            )
            ax.set_xticks(x, ["Held-out\nerror", "Noise\ncovariance"])
            ax.axhline(0, color="#777777", linewidth=0.6)
            maximum = max(
                selected["projections"][objective][field] * 1e8
                for objective in ("control", "mixture")
                for field in ("heldout_bias_projection", "noise_covariance_projection")
            )
            ax.set_ylim(bottom=0, top=maximum * 1.18)
            ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.18)
            ax.set_axisbelow(True)
            if column == 0:
                ax.set_ylabel("Gradient/error projection (×10⁻⁸)")
            ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    figure.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.945), ncol=2)
    figure.suptitle(
        "Mean-loss gradients: a modest shift in the detail/noise balance", y=0.995, fontsize=14
    )
    figure.text(
        0.5,
        0.952,
        "Existing outputs · 8 independent draws per CFA · 4 CFAs · fine band 1/8–1/3 cycles/pixel",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=10,
    )
    figure.text(
        0.5,
        0.025,
        "Output-space loss diagnostics only. No neural parameter update or new inference; finite-draw uncertainty remains.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=9,
    )
    figure.subplots_adjust(top=0.82, bottom=0.12, hspace=0.65, wspace=0.32)
    png, svg = output / "gradient-projections.png", output / "gradient-projections.svg"
    figure.savefig(png, dpi=180)
    figure.savefig(svg, metadata={"Date": None})
    plt.close(figure)
    assert "torch" not in sys.modules
    save(
        root / f"plot-v{version}.json",
        {
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "analysis": ref(root / "analysis-v1.json"),
            "plot_source": ref(__file__),
            "PNG": ref(png),
            "SVG": ref(svg),
            "selected_rows": rows,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_observations": 0,
            "Torch_imported": False,
        },
    )
    print(ref(png))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--version", type=int, default=2)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.root, args.version)

"""Native readout comparisons; all prior completed panel pixels remain exact."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from audit_coherent_pair_evidence_trial import terminal
from lossless_native import load_native
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_spaced_pooled_trial import METHODS, ROOT, guard, read, ref, save


def render(root=ROOT, *, fixture=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    if fixture:
        assert root != ROOT and plan["fixture_only_no_actual_V189_quality"] is True
    else:
        assert root == ROOT
        guard(plan)
        seal = read(root / "render-source-v1.json")
        assert seal["renderer"] == ref(__file__) and seal["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
        terminal(root / "scores-v1.json")
        for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
            assert read(root / name)["status"].startswith("pass-")
    result = read(root / "scores-v1.json")
    assert result["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
    previous_figures = ROOT.parent / "V187-pooled-wave-trial-v1/figures-v1.json"
    if not fixture:
        assert seal["previous_figures"] == ref(previous_figures)
    prior = read(previous_figures)
    out = root / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    figures = []
    channels = copied_channels = 0
    for old in prior["images"]:
        if old["triplet"] and not old["panels"][1]["label"].startswith("V187-pooled-wave-"):
            continue
        assert ref(old["image"]["path"]) == old["image"]
        source = np.asarray(Image.open(old["image"]["path"]))
        case = old["case"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
        values = result["native_predictions"][case["id"]]
        anchor = np.asarray(old["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        variants = []
        if old["triplet"]:
            endpoint = "raw" if old["panels"][1]["label"].endswith("-raw") else "EMA"
            variants.append([old["panels"][0], METHODS[endpoint], old["panels"][-1]])
        else:
            assert [p["label"] for p in old["panels"][:21]] == [
                "Noisy Malvar",
                "V143 parent",
                "V169 EMA",
                "V172-EMA",
                "V175-EMA",
                "V178-control-raw",
                "V178-control-EMA",
                "V178-evidence-raw",
                "V178-evidence-EMA",
                "V180-local-phase-raw",
                "V180-local-phase-EMA",
                "V181-flat-spatial-raw",
                "V181-flat-spatial-EMA",
                "V183-coherent-pair-raw",
                "V183-coherent-pair-EMA",
                "V184-wave-readout-raw",
                "V184-wave-readout-EMA",
                "V185-spatial-context-raw",
                "V185-spatial-context-EMA",
                "V187-pooled-wave-raw",
                "V187-pooled-wave-EMA",
            ]
            selections = (
                old["panels"][:21] + [METHODS[e] for e in ["raw", "EMA"]] + old["panels"][21:]
            )
            variants.append(selections)
        for selections in variants:
            panels = []
            bindings = {}
            for selection in selections:
                if isinstance(selection, str):
                    binding = values[selection]
                    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                    value = load_native(binding)
                    displayed = anchor + old["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                    actual = pixels(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                        actual, independent_display(displayed, a, old["ROI_xywh"], old["exposure"])
                    )
                    assert actual.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                    channels += actual.size
                    bindings[selection] = binding
                    panels.append((selection, actual))
                else:
                    x, y, w, h = selection["xywh"]
                    assert w == h == 160
                    panels.append((selection["label"], source[y : y + h, x : x + w].copy()))
                    copied_channels += w * h * 3
            board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(panels), 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4),
                f"{'CPU LAYOUT FIXTURE / NO V189 QUALITY | ' if fixture else ''}{case['id']} | V189 wider-separation wave readout above frozen V183 EMA,contrast{old['contrast']:g},RAW exposure{old['exposure']:g}",
                font=font,
                fill="black",
            )
            records = []
            for index, (label, value) in enumerate(panels):
                x = 8 + 168 * index
                draw.text((x, 26), label, font=font, fill="black")
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(value), (x, 44))
                records.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x, 44, 160, 160]})
            path = out / f"comparison-{len(figures):02d}.png"
            board.save(path)
            image = np.asarray(Image.open(path))
            for record, (_, value) in zip(records, panels, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = record["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y : y + h, x : x + w], value)
            figures.append(
                {
                    "case": case,
                    "ROI_xywh": old["ROI_xywh"],
                    "anchor": old["anchor"],
                    "contrast": old["contrast"],
                    "exposure": old["exposure"],
                    "image": ref(path),
                    "panels": records,
                    "predictions": bindings,
                    "source_figure": old["image"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                    "triplet": old["triplet"],
                }
            )
    assert len(figures) == 60 and sum(f["triplet"] for f in figures) == 12 and channels == 8294400
    assert copied_channels == 87628800
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(figures), 4):
        group = figures[start : start + 4]
        width = max(Image.open(f["image"]["path"]).width for f in group)
        sheet = Image.new("RGB", (width, 212 * len(group)), "#eeeeee")
        for row, item in enumerate(group):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]), (0, 212 * row))
        path = out / f"sheet-{len(sheets):02d}.png"
        sheet.save(path)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(group))),
                "image": ref(path),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        root / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-layout-fixture-not-quality"
            if fixture
            else "rendered-awaiting-actual-native-viewing",
            "fixture_only_no_actual_V189_quality": fixture,
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "scores": ref(root / "scores-v1.json"),
            "images": figures,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "new_RGB_channels_independently_checked": channels,
            "unchanged_RGB_channels_copied": copied_channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "native_figures": 60,
            "native_triplets": 12,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "renderer": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        },
    )
    print("Rendered60nativefigures12triplets;fixture", fixture, "newchannels", channels, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    render(args.fixture_root if args.fixture_root else ROOT, fixture=args.fixture_root is not None)
