            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": recipe["scope"],
        },
    )


def worker(path, phase):
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / f"{phase}.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    try:
        if phase == "parity":
            parity(plan)
        else:
            fit(plan, phase)
    except BaseException as error:
        save(
            root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "progress": LIVE_PROGRESS,
                "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            },
        )
        raise


def controller(path):
    plan = read(path)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = owner = None
    try:
        for phase in ("parity", "smoke", "train"):
            guard(plan)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "phase": phase},
                )
                time.sleep(2)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"{phase}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
                        "-P",
                        plan["runner"]["path"],
                        "worker",
                        str(path),
                        "--phase",
                        phase,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase", "phase": phase, "child": owner},
                )
                observed = 0.0
                last = time.monotonic()
                while child.poll() is None:
                    time.sleep(2)
                    now = time.monotonic()
                    if live(owner) and psutil.Process(child.pid).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED:
                        observed += min(now - last, 5.0)
                    last = now
                    assert observed < (1800 if phase in ("parity", "smoke") else 7200), phase
                assert child.returncode == 0, phase
            assert not live(owner)
            state["completed"][phase] = ref(root / f"{phase}-result-v1.json")
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "worker", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("parity", "smoke", "train"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        print(prepare(args.path))
    elif args.mode == "worker":
        worker(args.path.resolve(), args.phase)
    else:
        controller(args.path.resolve())

    )
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    collections = {}
    total = 0
    for arm in state["arms"]:
        for endpoint, key in (("raw", "models"), ("EMA", "emas")):
            label = f"{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000"

            point.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            module = classes()[arm](**state["module_config"]).cuda().eval()

                Path(module.forward.__code__.co_filename)

            module.load_state_dict(state[key][arm], strict=True)
            assert sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters()) == state["arms"][arm]["parameters"]
            initial = model_hash(module)
            dest = point / "module.pt"
            with dest.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(
                    {
                        "component": state["arms"][arm]["class"],
                        "module_config": state["module_config"],
                        "state_dict": state[key][arm],
                        "parent": state["parent"],
                        "paired_training_checkpoint": result["checkpoint"],
                        "arm": arm,
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "step": 1000,
                    },
                    stream,
                )
            count = [0]
            module.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args, count=count: count.__setitem__(0, count[0] + 1)

            observations = []
            for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):

                    psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
                    and shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
                    and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
                )
                assert (
                    ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
                    and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
                )
                arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
                base = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
                batch = {
                    k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda()
                    for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")
                }
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    output, aux = module(torch.from_numpy(base).cuda(), **batch, return_aux=True)
                value = output.cpu().numpy()
                assert (
                    value.dtype == np.float32
                    and value.shape == base.shape
                    and np.isfinite(value).all()
                )
                dest = point / f"prediction-{index:03d}.npy"
                np.save(dest, value)
                observations.append(
                    {
                        "id": case["id"],
                        "prediction": ref(dest),
                        "values": fingerprint(value),
                        "parent": case["parent"],
                        "inputs": {k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in batch},
                        "support_mean": float(aux["support"].mean()),
                        "coefficient_correction_RMS": float(
                            aux["spectral_delta"].abs().square().mean().sqrt()
                        ),
                        "module_forwards": 1,
                    }
                )
                total += 1
                if index % 64 == 0:
                    print(
                        json.dumps(
                            {
                                "endpoint": label,
                                "done": index + 1,
                                "total_component_forwards": total,
                            }
                        ),
                        flush=True,
                    )
                del batch, output, aux, value, arrays, base
            assert count[0] == 822 and model_hash(module) == initial
            assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
                cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
            )
            dest = point / "collection-v1.json"
            save(
                dest,
                {
                    "status": "completed-fixed-paired-endpoint",
                    "plan": ref(path),
                    "arm": arm,
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "export": ref(point / "module.pt"),
                    "module_before": initial,
                    "module_after": model_hash(module),
                    "observations": observations,
                    "component_forwards": count[0],
                    "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
                    "new_noise_draws": 0,
                    "RNG_unchanged": True,
                },
            )
            collections[label] = ref(dest)
            del module
    assert total == design["new_component_forwards"] == 4932
    guard(training)
    save(
        root / "review-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-six-fixed-endpoints-awaiting-audit-native-viewing",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "collections": collections,
            "component_forwards": total,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        prepare(args.root.resolve(), args.revision)

import json

from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second

def make_module(plan, counts, *, state=None):
    from demosaic.late_nonlocal_residual import LateNonlocalResidualDetail

    m = LateNonlocalResidualDetail(**plan["module_config"])
    m.load_frozen_component(plan["frozen_component"]["export"]["path"])
    if state is not None:
        m.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
    m.cuda()
    for name, child in [("wrapper", m), ("frozen", m.frozen), ("network", m.network)]:
        child.register_forward_hook(
            lambda *args, name=name: counts.__setitem__(name, counts[name] + 1)
        )
    for child in m.network.modules():
        if type(child).__name__ == "NonlocalBlock":
            child.register_forward_hook(
                lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("sampler", counts["sampler"] + 1)
            )
    return m


def tree_equal(a, b):
    import torch

    if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(b, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(a.cpu(), b.cpu())
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(tree_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(a) is type(b)
            and len(a) == len(b)
            and all(tree_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True))
        )
    return a == b


def train(plan):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from nonlocal_residual_objective import objective
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    (ROOT / "train.claim").open("x").close()
    runtime(plan)
    counts = {"wrapper": 0, "frozen": 0, "network": 0, "sampler": 0}
    module = make_module(plan, counts)
    frozen = model_hash(module.frozen)
    assert frozen == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        module.network.parameters(), lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
    )
    ema = {k: v.detach().clone() for k, v in module.network.state_dict().items()}
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
    trace = []
    updates = skipped = images = 0
    maximum = {n: 0.0 for n, p in module.network.named_parameters()}
    checkpoints = []
    restoration = None
    journal = (ROOT / "train-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x")

    def checkpoint(step):
        path = EXTERNAL / f"checkpoints/step{step:04d}.pt"
        assert not path.exists()
        state = {
            "step": step,
            "models": module.state_dict(),
            "ema": ema,
            "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
            "updates": updates,
            "skipped": skipped,
            "counts": dict(counts),
            "module_config": plan["module_config"],
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
            "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
            "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
        }
        with path.open("xb") as stream:
            torch.save(state, stream)
        binding = ref(path)
        checkpoints.append(binding)
        return binding

    for step, item in enumerate(rows, 1):
        resources(plan, "train", owner)
        assert (
            ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
            and ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
        )
        arrays = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"]))
        parent = np.load(item["parent"]["path"])
        assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == item["inputs"]
        assert fingerprint(parent) == item["parent_values"]
        assert units[step - 1]["step"] == step and units[step - 1]["batch"] == item["arrays"]
        progress = max(0, step - plan["warmup"]) / (plan["steps"] - plan["warmup"])
        lr = (
            plan["lr"]
            * min(1, step / plan["warmup"])
            * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        )
        row = {
            "step": step,
            "batch": item["arrays"],
            "parent": item["parent"],
            "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
            "noisy": bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0)),
            "lr": lr,
        }
        if row["noisy"]:
            batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in arrays.items()}
            base = torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda()
            pair_units = torch.tensor(
                units[step - 1]["candidate_units_FP32"], device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
            ).reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = lr
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
            started = time.perf_counter()
            output, aux = module(
                base, *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]), return_aux=True
            )
            if updates == 0:
                assert torch.equal(output, aux["frozen_output"])
            loss, terms, mask = objective(
                output,
                aux["frozen_output"],
                batch,
                pair_units,
                plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]],
            )
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            zero = []
            for name, p in module.network.named_parameters():
                assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all(), name
                maximum[name] = max(maximum[name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                if p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0:
                    zero.append(name)
            assert not any(p.grad is not None for p in module.frozen.parameters())
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                module.network.parameters(), plan["gradient_clip"], error_if_nonfinite=True
            )
            optimizer.step()
            updates += 1
            images += len(base)
            decay = min(plan["EMA_decay"], (1 + updates) / (10 + updates))
            with torch.no_grad():
                for k, v in module.network.state_dict().items():
                    ema[k].lerp_(v, 1 - decay)
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
            row.update(
                loss=float(loss.detach()),
                terms={k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
                gradient_norm=float(norm),
                zero_gradient_tensors=zero,
                flat_eligible_pixels=int(mask.sum()),
                flat_mask=fingerprint(mask.cpu().numpy()),
                correction_RMS_DN16=float(aux["correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt())
                * 65535,
                seconds=time.perf_counter() - started,
                counts=dict(counts),
                updates=updates,
            )
            del output, aux, loss, terms, mask, batch, base, pair_units
        else:
            skipped += 1
            row.update(
                skipped="zero supplied variance;no new model or optimizer evaluation",
                counts=dict(counts),
                updates=updates,
            )
        assert model_hash(module.frozen) == frozen
        trace.append(row)
        journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        journal.flush()
        if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
            status = {
                "status": "training",
                "owner": owner,
                "step": step,
                "updates": updates,
                "skipped": skipped,
                "counts": dict(counts),
                "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            }
            save(ROOT / "train-status-v1.json", status)
            print(json.dumps(status), flush=True)
        if step in [8, 250, 500, 750, 1000]:
            binding = checkpoint(step)
            if step == 8:
                before_hash = model_hash(module)
                state = torch.load(binding["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                del optimizer, module
                module = make_module(plan, counts, state=state["models"])
                optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
                    module.network.parameters(), lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                )
                optimizer.load_state_dict(state["optimizer"])
                assert model_hash(module) == before_hash
                assert tree_equal(optimizer.state_dict(), state["optimizer"])
                assert tree_equal(ema, state["ema"]) and state["updates"] == updates
                torch.set_rng_state(state["CPU_RNG"])
                torch.cuda.set_rng_state(state["CUDA_RNG"])
                restoration = {
                    "checkpoint": binding,
                    "model_exact": True,
                    "optimizer_exact": True,
                    "EMA_exact": True,
                    "CPU_RNG_exact": torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), state["CPU_RNG"]),
                    "CUDA_RNG_exact": torch.equal(
                        torch.cuda.get_rng_state().cpu(), state["CUDA_RNG"]
                    ),
                    "continued_at_step": 9,
                    "repeated_prefix_forwards": 0,
                }
                save(ROOT / "checkpoint-restoration-v1.json", restoration)
                del state
        del arrays, parent
    journal.close()
    assert (
        len(trace) == 1000
        and updates + skipped == 1000
        and counts
        == {"wrapper": updates, "frozen": updates, "network": updates, "sampler": 5 * updates}
    )
    assert min(maximum.values()) > 0 and len(optimizer.state) == 141
    assert all(
        float(s["step"]) == updates and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in s.values())
        for s in optimizer.state.values()
    )
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*module.state_dict().values(), *ema.values()])
    assert model_hash(module.frozen) == frozen
    assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    guard(plan)
    save(
        ROOT / "train-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed1000-row-schedule-with-actual-checkpoint-restoration",
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "final_checkpoint": checkpoints[-1],
            "updates": updates,
            "skipped_ADC_batches": skipped,
            "counts": counts,
            "training_images": images,
            "trace": trace,
            "parameter_maximum_gradients": maximum,
            "final_Adam_states": 141,
            "checkpoint_restoration": restoration,
            "frozen_module_hash": frozen,
            "frozen_weights_unchanged": True,
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    save(
        ROOT / "train-status-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-training-awaiting-fixed-quality",
            "owner": owner,
            "step": 1000,
            "updates": updates,
            "counts": counts,

    )

                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                started = time.perf_counter()
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    output, aux = module(
                        torch.from_numpy(base).cuda(),
                        *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                        return_aux=True,
                    )
                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
                event = {
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "index": index,
                    "id": case["id"],
                    "ordinal": ordinal,
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "seconds": elapsed,
                    "matching_evaluated": aux["matching_evaluated"],
                }
                events.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
                events.flush()
                value = output.cpu().numpy()
                frozen = aux["frozen_output"].cpu().numpy()
                correction = aux["correction"].cpu().numpy()
                assert fingerprint(frozen) == expected[case["id"]]["values"]
                replays += 1
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(value, frozen + correction)
                closure_channels += value.size
                if not aux["matching_evaluated"]:
                    assert np.array_equal(value, frozen) and not np.any(a["variance"])
                    ADC_exact += 1
                method = f"V171-{endpoint}"
                row = metric.measure(case, a, base, value)
                row.update(
                    method=method,
                    index=index,
                    values=fingerprint(value),
                    nonlocal_correction_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(correction.astype(np.float64) ** 2))
                    )
                    * 65535,
                    nonlocal_correction_values=fingerprint(correction),
                    frozen_values=fingerprint(frozen),
                    frozen_replay_exact=True,
                    ADC_exact=not aux["matching_evaluated"],
                )
                if case["id"] in plan["native_cases"]:
                    for label, array in [(method, value), (method + "-correction", correction)]:
                        path = EXTERNAL / f"native/{label}-{index:03d}.npy"
                        assert not path.exists()
                        np.save(path, array, allow_pickle=False)
                        native.setdefault(case["id"], {})[label] = ref(path)
                    row["prediction"] = native[case["id"]][method]
                rows.append(row)
                record = {
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "index": index,
                    "id": case["id"],
                    "arrays": case["arrays"],
                    "parent": case["parent"],
                    "inputs": {k: fingerprint(a[k]) for k in batch},
                    "row": row,
                    "frozen_replay_exact": True,
                    "closure_exact": True,
                }
                journal.write(json.dumps(record, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                journal.flush()
                if ordinal % 16 == 0:
                    status = {
                        "status": "reviewing",
                        "owner": owner,
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "index": index,
                        "counts": dict(counts),
                        "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                    }
                    save(ROOT / "review-status-v1.json", status)
                    print(json.dumps(status), flush=True)
                del output, aux, batch, value, correction, frozen, a, base
            assert before == model_hash(module)
            weights[endpoint]["after"] = model_hash(module)
            del module
    assert counts == plan["expected_quality_counts"] and len(rows) == 1644 and len(native) == 36
    assert replays == 1644 and ADC_exact == 144
    assert torch.equal(CPU_RNG, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        CUDA_RNG, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["index"], r["method"]))
    guard(plan)
    save(
        ROOT / "scores-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-fixed-raw-EMA-streamed-quality",
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "checkpoint": training["final_checkpoint"],

            "exact_V169_replays": replays,
            "ADC_outputs_exact_V169": ADC_exact,
            "independent_inprocess_addition_channels": closure_channels,
            "peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
            "new_training_updates": 0,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    save(
        ROOT / "review-status-v1.json",

"""Capture fixed mature precision outputs and resident timings after prior jobs exit."""

import argparse
import gc
import os
import random
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
from mature_precision_execution import FIXED_EXECUTION, execution_snapshot, fixed_execution
from mature_precision_tools import POLICIES, precision_policy
from preflight_mature_precision import KEYS
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def main(plan_path):
    policy = read(plan_path).get("execution_policy")
    if policy == FIXED_EXECUTION:
        previous = execution_snapshot()
        with fixed_execution():
            capture(plan_path)
        assert execution_snapshot() == previous
        save(
            Path(read(plan_path)["output"]) / "fixed-execution-restoration.json",
            {
                "plan": ref(plan_path),
                "receipt": ref(Path(read(plan_path)["output"]) / "receipt.json"),
                "outer_backend_settings_restored_exact": True,
                "before": previous,
                "after": execution_snapshot(),
            },
        )
        return
    if policy is not None:
        raise ValueError("Unknown research execution policy")
    return capture(plan_path)


def capture(plan_path):
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
    from demosaic.precision import amp_context
    from demosaic.train import batch_fingerprint

    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["worker"]
    assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != ""
    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    previous = {
        "benchmark": torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark,
        "limit": torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark_limit,
        "quota": torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device),
    }
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        min(previous["quota"], 16 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory),
        device,
    )
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark_limit = (
        plan.get("execution_policy") != FIXED_EXECUTION,
        10,
    )
    execution = execution_snapshot()
    output = Path(plan["output"])
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    cpu_proof = read(plan["CPU_preflight"]["path"])
    models = []
    try:
        with torch.inference_mode():
            for index, (label, checkpoint) in enumerate(plan["models"].items()):
                model, state = load_checkpoint(checkpoint["path"], device)
                assert (
                    state["loaded_sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"]
                    and state["step"] == checkpoint["step"]
                )
                del state
                model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
                before, dino = model_hash(model), model_hash(model.context.backbone)
                expected = next(r for r in cpu_proof["models"] if r["label"] == label)
                assert before == expected["model_sha256"] and dino == expected["DINO_sha256"]
                identities, config = [id(p) for p in model.parameters()], model.config.to_dict()
                cpu_rng, python_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), random.getstate()
                cuda_rng = [r.clone() for r in torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()]
                events, calls, captures, timings = [], [], [], []
                network = model.pretrained_rgb.network

                def hooks(model=model, network=network, calls=calls, events=events):
                    handles = [
                        model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(
                            lambda *_, calls=calls: calls.append(True)
                        )
                    ]
                    for key, layer in [
                        ("physical_head", network.m_head),
                        ("first_encoder", network.m_down1),
                        ("middle", network.m_body),
                        ("physical_tail", network.m_tail),
                    ]:
                        handles.append(
                            layer.register_forward_pre_hook(
                                lambda _m, inputs, key=key, events=events: events.append(
                                    (key, str(inputs[0].dtype))
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    return handles

                def forward(args, policy, model=model, network=network, config=config):
                    with precision_policy(model, policy, device):
                        result = model(*args)
                    assert result.dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(result).all()
                    assert not network.hidden_autocast and model.config.to_dict() == config
                    return result

                policy_order = list(POLICIES) if index == 0 else list(reversed(POLICIES))
                handles = hooks()
                try:
                    for fixture_index, fixture in enumerate(plan["fixtures"]):
                        with np.load(fixture["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
                            cpu = {k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k].copy()) for k in KEYS}
                        digest = batch_fingerprint(cpu)
                        args = [cpu[k].to(device) for k in KEYS]
                        args = [
                            v.contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last) if v.ndim == 4 else v
                            for v in args
                        ]
                        assert batch_fingerprint(dict(zip(KEYS, args, strict=True))) == digest
                        model.set_noise(fixture["condition"]["shot"], fixture["condition"]["read"])
                        reference = {}
                        for policy in policy_order:
                            start = len(events)
                            torch.cuda.synchronize()
                            began = time.perf_counter()
                            prediction = forward(args, policy)
                            torch.cuda.synchronize()
                            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - began
                            observed = dict(events[start:])
                            assert observed == {
                                "physical_head": "torch.float32",
                                "first_encoder": "torch.float16"
                                if policy == "fp16-hidden"
                                else "torch.float32",
                                "middle": "torch.float32",
                                "physical_tail": "torch.float32",
                            }, observed
                            assert prediction.shape[-2:] == (
                                args[0].shape[-2] * 2,
                                args[0].shape[-1] * 2,
                            )
                            array = prediction.cpu().numpy()
                            path = output / f"{label}-{policy}-fixture{fixture_index:02d}.npy"
                            np.save(path, array, allow_pickle=False)
                            captures.append(
                                {
                                    "model": label,
                                    "policy": policy,
                                    "fixture": fixture["id"],
                                    "RGB": ref(path),
                                    "dtypes": observed,
                                    "input_sha256": digest,
                                }
                            )
                            reference[policy] = array
                            if fixture["kind"] == "gfx":
                                timings.append(
                                    {
                                        "kind": "first-policy-call-in-this-process",
                                        "policy": policy,
                                        "seconds": elapsed,
                                        "includes_dtype_hooks_and_checks": True,
                                    }
                                )
                                for _ in range(2):
                                    forward(args, policy)
                        if fixture["kind"] == "gfx":
                            assert fixture_index == 0 and len(calls) == 9
                            for handle in handles:
                                handle.remove()
                            handles = []
                            # Four samples per policy; first/reverse and a balanced rotation.
                            sequence = [0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0, 2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2]
                            for sample, item in enumerate(sequence):
                                policy = policy_order[item]
                                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                                began = time.perf_counter()
                                with precision_policy(model, policy, device):
                                    prediction = model(*args)
                                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                                seconds = time.perf_counter() - began
                                assert (
                                    prediction.dtype == torch.float32
                                    and torch.isfinite(prediction).all()
                                )
                                array = prediction.cpu().numpy()
                                path = output / f"{label}-timed{sample:02d}-{policy}.npy"
                                np.save(path, array, allow_pickle=False)
                                timings.append(
                                    {
                                        "kind": "synchronized-resident-unhooked-sample",
                                        "policy": policy,
                                        "sample": sample,
                                        "seconds": seconds,
                                        "RGB": ref(path),
                                        "byte_equal_first_capture": np.array_equal(
                                            array, reference[policy]
                                        ),
                                    }
                                )
                            handles = hooks()
                        if fixture["kind"] == "photo" and fixture_index == 1:
                            with (
                                precision_policy(model, "fp16-hidden", device),
                                amp_context(device, dtype="float32"),
                            ):
                                identity = model(*args).cpu().numpy()
                            assert np.array_equal(identity, reference["fp32"])
                        assert batch_fingerprint(dict(zip(KEYS, args, strict=True))) == digest
                        del args, cpu, reference
                finally:
                    for handle in handles:
                        handle.remove()
                assert model_hash(model) == before and model_hash(model.context.backbone) == dino
                assert [
                    id(p) for p in model.parameters()
                ] == identities and model.config.to_dict() == config
                assert (
                    torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and random.getstate() == python_rng
                )
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(a, b)
                    for a, b in zip(cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all(), strict=True)
                )
                assert all(
                    not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None
                    for p in model.context.backbone.parameters()
                )
                assert execution_snapshot() == execution
                assert len(captures) == len(plan["fixtures"]) * 3
                assert len(calls) == 9 + (len(plan["fixtures"]) - 1) * 3 + 1
                models.append(
                    {
                        "model": label,
                        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
                        "model_sha256": before,
                        "DINO_sha256": dino,
                        "captures": captures,
                        "timings": timings,
                        "instrumented_encoder_calls": len(calls),
                        "unhooked_timing_forwards": 12,
                        "FP32_hidden_identity_exact": True,
                        "model_config_parameter_RNG_exact": True,
                    }
                )
                save(output / (label + "-receipt.json"), models[-1])
                del model, network, hooks, forward
                gc.collect()
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    finally:
        torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = previous["benchmark"]
        torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark_limit = previous["limit"]
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(previous["quota"], device)
    assert torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark == previous["benchmark"]
    assert torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark_limit == previous["limit"]
    assert torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device) == previous["quota"]
    guard(plan)
    save(
        output / "receipt.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-mature-precision-GPU-arrays-awaiting-native-and-independent-scalar-review",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "models": models,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "backend_settings_restored": True,
            "execution_policy": plan.get("execution_policy", "original-autotune"),
            "execution_backend_settings": execution,
            "scope": "Fixed existing-weight precision outputs and resident timings only. First policy calls share per-process library caches; not isolated cold starts or pure search cost. Quality, numeric gates and timing interpretation await actual native views. No full-frame result, training, export, default change or promotion.",
        },
    )
    print(
        {
            "receipt": ref(output / "receipt.json"),
            "status": "awaiting-native-and-independent-scalar-review",
        }
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().plan)

def source_bundle(plan, recipe):
    work = Path(plan["work"])
    payloads = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in (work / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    payloads.update({name: (work / name).read_bytes() for name in ["pyproject.toml", "uv.lock"]})
    for name, key in [
        ("paired-manifest.json", "paired_manifest"),
        ("raw-clean-manifest.json", "raw_clean_manifest"),
        ("validation-manifest.jsonl", "validation_manifest"),
    ]:
        payloads[name] = Path(recipe[key]).read_bytes()
    payloads["validation_protocol.yaml"] = (work / recipe["validation_protocol"]).read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in sorted(payloads.items()):
        digest.update(name.encode() + value)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def check_state(state, recipe, plan, step, source_sha):
    config = state["config"]
    assert state["step"] == step and state["data_step"] == step * 4
    assert state["example_draws"] == step * 16
    assert "initialized_from" not in config
    for key in [
        "steps",
        "batch_size",
        "optimizer_batch_groups",
        "optimizer_forward_groups",
        "precision",
        "warmup_steps",
        "ema_decay",
        "lr",
        "seed",
        "channels_last",
        "data_seed_per_step",
        "paired_fraction",
        "raw_clean_fraction",
    ]:
        assert config[key] == recipe[key], key
    assert config["steps"] == 40000 and config["warmup_steps"] == 500
    assert config["precision"] == "float32" and config["lr"] == 2e-4
    assert config["ema_decay"] == 0.999**4 and config["batch_size"] == 4
    assert config["optimizer_batch_groups"] == 4 and config["optimizer_forward_groups"] == 1
    assert config["source_sha256"] == source_sha
    for key, value in plan["manifest_hashes"].items():
        assert config[key] == value
    model = ModelConfig.from_checkpoint(state["model_config"])
    assert model.to_dict() == ModelConfig(**recipe["model"]).to_dict()
    assert model.isotropic_raw_gain == 32 and model.isotropic_residual_scale == 1 / 32
    count = 863 if model.dino else 852
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == count
    for values in state["optimizer"]["state"].values():
        assert int(values["step"]) == step
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for k in ["model", "ema"] for v in state[k].values())
    assert all(k in state for k in ["torch_rng", "python_rng", "cuda_rng"])
    assert len(state["cuda_rng"]) == 1


def check_worker(training, plan, arm, phase, source_sha):
    boundary = training["completed"][phase + "-" + arm["arm"]]

    assert actual["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == archive["sha256"]
    if not prefix:
        assert actual["checkpoint"] == ref(actual["checkpoint"]["path"])
    assert actual["phase"] == phase and actual["arm"] == arm["arm"]
    assert actual["start_optimizer_step"] == start and actual["end_optimizer_step"] == end

    assert actual["source_bundle_SHA256"] == source_sha
    assert actual["finite_model_EMA_Adam_states"] == (863 if arm["arm"] == "dino" else 852)
    assert actual["all_Adam_steps"] == end and actual["data_steps"] == 4 * end
    assert actual["example_draws"] == 16 * end

def check_observations(records):

        warmup = min(1, step / 500)
        progress = max(0, step - 500) / (40000 - 500)
        assert row["lr"] == 2e-4 * warmup * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2)
        groups = row["source_groups"]
        assert (
            row["batch_sha256"]
            == hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(groups, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        )
        assert [g["data_step"] for g in groups] == list(range(4 * step - 3, 4 * step + 1))
        for group in groups:
            assert group["examples"] == 4

    current = {g["data_step"]: g for row in observations for g in row["source_groups"]}
    domains = {"synthetic": "commons", "native-RAW-synthetic": "native", "paired-RAW": "paired"}

            for label, model_label in zip(

def main():

    )

    attenuation, texture = data.attenuate_photographic_contrast, data.weak_texture
    capture, observations = {}, []
    counts = {
        "forwards": 0,
        "DINO": 0,
        "contrast_attenuation": 0,
        "weak_texture": 0,
        "optimizer_steps": 0,
    }

    def instrument(options):
        model = constructor(options)
        capture["model"] = model

        def before(module, args, kwargs):
            assert len(args) == 5 and set(kwargs) == {"auxiliary"} and kwargs["auxiliary"] is True
            assert all(isinstance(x, torch.Tensor) and x.device.type == "cpu" for x in args)
            if counts["forwards"] == 0:
                capture["initial_model_sha256"] = model_hash(module)
                assert (
                    capture["initial_model_sha256"]
                    == "4a45d92210acaeca3d4189c78eb22aa1cbc33f28b971dbeb56d1f6f29d62ed9a"
                )
                capture["DINO_sha256"] = model_hash(module.context.backbone)
                assert (
                    capture["DINO_sha256"]
                    == "35035ba142eb119cd5980cf0d9809bfa28f622538c259ffb0fcf348ca6e68898"
                )
                assert set(module.restoration_state_dict()) == set(parent["ema"])
                assert all(
                    torch.equal(value, parent["ema"][name])
                    for name, value in module.restoration_state_dict().items()
                )
            counts["forwards"] += 1

        def dino(*_):
            counts["DINO"] += 1

        model.register_forward_pre_hook(before, with_kwargs=True)
        model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(dino)
        return model

    def batch(*args, **kwargs):
        value = prepare_batch(*args, **kwargs)
        observations.append(training.batch_fingerprint(value))
        return value

    def attenuated(*args, **kwargs):
        counts["contrast_attenuation"] += 1
        return attenuation(*args, **kwargs)

    def textured(*args, **kwargs):
        counts["weak_texture"] += 1
        return texture(*args, **kwargs)

    def forbidden(*_args, **_kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("No optical PSF is permitted in this recipe")

    optimizer_factory = training.make_optimizer

    def optimizer(model, options):
        result = optimizer_factory(model, options)

        def after(_optimizer, _args, _kwargs):
            counts["optimizer_steps"] += 1
            assert all(p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())

        result.register_step_post_hook(after)
        return result

    training.JointDemosaic, training.prepare_training_batch = instrument, batch
    training.make_optimizer = optimizer
    data.attenuate_photographic_contrast, data.weak_texture = attenuated, textured
    data.optical_blur = forbidden
    checkpoint = training.train(
        plan["config"]["path"], initialize=plan["parent"]["path"], stop_after=plan["updates"]
    )
    state = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    model = capture.pop("model")
    assert model_hash(model.context.backbone) == capture["DINO_sha256"]
    assert model_hash(model) != capture["initial_model_sha256"]
    assert all(not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
    for section in ("model", "ema"):
        assert all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in state[section].values())
        assert any(
            not torch.equal(value, parent["ema"][name]) for name, value in state[section].items()
        )
    assert (
        state["step"]
        == counts["optimizer_steps"]
        == counts["forwards"]
        == counts["DINO"]
        == plan["updates"]
    )
    metrics = [
        json.loads(line) for line in (checkpoint.parent / "metrics.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
    ]
    assert {m["event"] for m in metrics} == {"train"}
    assert {m["domain"] for m in metrics} == {"synthetic", "native-RAW-synthetic", "paired-RAW"}
    assert all(
        torch.isfinite(value).all()
        for values in state["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        for value in values.values()
        if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor)
    )
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "receipt.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-discarded-CPU-training-proof",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "checkpoint": ref(checkpoint),
            "metrics": ref(checkpoint.parent / "metrics.jsonl"),
            "counts": counts,
            **capture,
            "batch_fingerprints": observations,
            "domains": sorted({m["domain"] for m in metrics}),
            "exact_original_V43_EMA_and_architecture": True,
            "frozen_DINO_and_finite_gradients_optimizer_EMA": True,
            "CUDA_initialized": False,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )

def read(path):

def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def save(path, value):

def fingerprint(value):
    return {
        "shape": list(value.shape),
        "dtype": value.dtype.str,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(value).tobytes()).hexdigest(),
    }


def model_hash(model):
    # Same tensor-only format as profile_raw_kernel_inference.model_hash.
    import torch

    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
        value = value.detach().cpu().contiguous()
        digest.update(name.encode() + str(value.dtype).encode() + str(tuple(value.shape)).encode())
        flat = value.reshape(-1).clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
        digest.update(flat.view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
    return digest.hexdigest()

"""Compare the two matched arms and earlier useful strengths on identical cases."""

import argparse
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from audit_flat_spatial_evidence_trial import terminal, validate_summary
from balanced_spatial_metrics import summarize
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from train_flat_spatial_evidence_trial import ARMS, METHODS, ROOT, guard, save

V175 = ROOT.parent / "V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2"

EARLIER = ["parent", "V161-EMA", "V169-EMA", "V171-EMA", "V172-EMA", "V173-EMA", "V174-EMA"]
CANDIDATES = [METHODS[arm][endpoint] for arm in ARMS for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]]
MATCHED_METHODS = [f"V178-{a}-{e}" for a in ["control", "evidence"] for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
MATCHED_METHODS += [f"V180-local-phase-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
ALL_METHODS = EARLIER + ["V175-raw", "V175-EMA"] + MATCHED_METHODS + CANDIDATES
REQUIRED = {
    "mesh": [
        "template_gain",
        "blank_error_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_DC_RMS_DN16",
    ],
    "photo": ["crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain", "crop_relative_band_error"],
    "flat": ["full_spatial_RMS_DN16", "block32_RMS_DN16"],
    # Older parent rows contain crop_DC_RMS_DN16, checked below, without the
    # later duplicate quiet_DC_RMS_DN16 name. Keep the common original field.
    "mixed-quiet": ["quiet_error_RMS_DN16", "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16"],
}


def condition(row):
    return row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise")))


def numeric(value):
    return isinstance(value, (float, int)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)


def source_rows(binding, method, label, plan):
    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    scores = read(binding["path"])
    if "plan" in scores:
        assert ref(scores["plan"]["path"]) == scores["plan"]
        context = read(scores["plan"]["path"])
    else:
        context = scores
    assert context["design"] == plan["design"]
    assert context.get("metrics_sources", context.get("metric_sources")) == plan["metrics_sources"]
    return [dict(row, method=label) for row in scores["rows"] if row["method"] == method]


def earlier_rows(plan):
    previous = read(V175 / "plan-v1.json")
    post = read(V175 / "postprocess-inputs-v1.json")
    assert post["training_plan"] == ref(V175 / "plan-v1.json")
    specifications = [
        (previous["parent_scores"], "parent", "parent"),
        (post["V161_current_metrics"], "V161-EMA", "V161-EMA"),
        (previous["prior_scores"], "balanced-EMA", "V169-EMA"),
        (previous["earlier_flat_scores"], "V171-EMA", "V171-EMA"),
        (post["canonical_V172_scores"], "V172-EMA", "V172-EMA"),
        (previous["earlier_quiet_scores"], "V173-EMA", "V173-EMA"),
        (previous["spread_scores"], "V174-EMA", "V174-EMA"),
    ]
    rows = [
        row
        for binding, method, label in specifications
        for row in source_rows(binding, method, label, plan)
    ]
    return rows, [binding for binding, _, _ in specifications]


def comparisons(rows, methods, case_ids):
    """Keep actual paired values and direction counts without ranking signed gains."""
    maps = {(row["id"], row["method"]): row for row in rows}
    assert len(maps) == len(rows) == len(methods) * len(case_ids)
    for method in methods:
        assert {row["id"] for row in rows if row["method"] == method} == set(case_ids)
    for name in case_ids:
        group = [maps[name, method] for method in methods]
        assert len({(row["kind"], condition(row), row.get("cohort")) for row in group}) == 1
        for row in group:
            if row["kind"] == "real":
                assert row["reference_scored"] is False
                assert not any(
                    key.endswith("error_RMS_DN16") or key == "template_gain" for key in row
                )
            else:
                for field in [
                    "full_error_RMS_DN16",
                    "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16",
                    "crop_DC_RMS_DN16",
                    *REQUIRED[row["kind"]],
                ]:
                    assert numeric(row[field]), (name, method, field)
    summary = summarize(rows)
    checks = validate_summary(rows, summary)
    summary_map = {(r["kind"], r["condition"], r["cohort"], r["method"]): r for r in summary}
    grouped = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        grouped[row["kind"], condition(row), row.get("cohort"), row["method"]].append(row)
    contrasts = [
        (METHODS["evidence"][e], f"V180-local-phase-{e}", "matched-loss-" + e)
        for e in ["raw", "EMA"]
    ]
    contrasts += [
        (candidate, baseline, "context")
        for candidate in CANDIDATES
        for baseline in EARLIER + ["V175-raw", "V175-EMA"] + MATCHED_METHODS[:4]
    ]
    paired = []
    for candidate, baseline, role in contrasts:
        for (kind, state, cohort, method), group in grouped.items():
            if method != candidate or kind == "real":
                continue
            for field in group[0]:
                if not field.endswith(("DN16", "gain", "error")):
                    continue
                if not all(
                    numeric(row.get(field)) and numeric(maps[row["id"], baseline].get(field))
                    for row in group
                ):
                    continue
                values = [
                    {
                        "id": row["id"],
                        "candidate": row[field],
                        "baseline": maps[row["id"], baseline][field],
                        "difference": row[field] - maps[row["id"], baseline][field],
                    }
                    for row in group
                ]
                a, b = [
                    math.fsum(float(value[key]) for value in values) / len(values)
                    for key in ["candidate", "baseline"]
                ]
                differences = [value["difference"] for value in values]
                mean_difference = math.fsum(differences) / len(differences)
                assert abs(a - summary_map[kind, state, cohort, candidate][field]) < 1e-10
                assert abs(b - summary_map[kind, state, cohort, baseline][field]) < 1e-10
                assert abs(mean_difference - (a - b)) < 1e-10
                ratio = (
                    None
                    if (kind == "mesh" and state is False and field == "template_gain") or b <= 0
                    else 100 * (a / b - 1)
                )
                paired.append(
                    {
                        "kind": kind,
                        "condition": state,
                        "cohort": cohort,
                        "method": candidate,
                        "baseline": baseline,
                        "comparison_role": role,
                        "field": field,
                        "cases": len(values),
                        "mean_candidate": a,
                        "mean_baseline": b,
                        "mean_difference": mean_difference,
                        "percent_change_of_means": ratio,
                        "decreased": sum(value < 0 for value in differences),
                        "increased": sum(value > 0 for value in differences),
                        "equal": sum(value == 0 for value in differences),
                        "minimum_difference": min(differences),
                        "maximum_difference": max(differences),
                        "pairs": values,
                    }
                )
    return {
        "summary": summary,
        "groups": paired,
        "independent_Decimal_summary_means": checks,
        "paired_mean_and_difference_checks": 3 * len(paired),
        "methods": len(methods),
        "metric_rows": len(rows),
        "contrasts": len(contrasts),
        "matched_endpoint_contrasts": 2,
        "real_references_scored": False,
    }

def tables(summary, *, fixture=False):
    lookup = {(row["kind"], row["condition"], row["cohort"], row["method"]): row for row in summary}
    title = (
        "CPU COMPARISON FIXTURE — reused baseline values, no V181 quality"
        if fixture
        else "Flat spatial loss and retained local/global/control comparison tables"
    )
    lines = [
        "# " + title,
        "",
        "RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Signed gain 1 is exact constructed amplitude. Real ISO100 references are unscored. This reused development suite is not blind validation.",
        "",
    ]
    cells = []
    for section, methods in [
        (
            "New loss and retained local/global/control at the same budget",
            MATCHED_METHODS + CANDIDATES,
        ),
        ("Earlier strengths and both endpoints", ALL_METHODS),
    ]:
        lines += ["## " + section, ""]
        for heading, specifications in table_specs():
            lines += [
                "### " + heading,
                "",
                "| Metric | " + " | ".join(methods) + " |",
                "| --- | " + " | ".join(["---:"] * len(methods)) + " |",
            ]
            for label, kind, state, cohort, field, digits in specifications:
                values = []
                for method in methods:
                    value = lookup[kind, state, cohort, method][field]
                    rendered = f"{value:.{digits}f}"
                    cells.append(
                        {
                            "section": section,
                            "kind": kind,
                            "condition": state,
                            "cohort": cohort,
                            "field": field,
                            "method": method,
                            "value": value,
                            "rendered": rendered,
                            "digits": digits,
                        }
                    )
                    values.append(rendered)
                lines.append("| " + label + " | " + " | ".join(values) + " |")
            lines.append("")
    assert len(cells) == 1050
    return "\n".join(lines), cells


def reduce(root):

    previous_plan = read(previous["plan"]["path"])

    rows += previous["rows"] + matched["rows"] + local["rows"] + scores["rows"]
    design = read(plan["design"]["path"])["observations"]

    result = comparisons(rows, ALL_METHODS, [case["id"] for case in design])

Completed outputs reused,not rerun or bit-exact paired retraining;atomic sampler backward remains warn-only.26 contextual contrasts keep bothV175/fourV178 and earlier strengths. V175 has a larger fresh-noise budget. All822cases andsame metrics/sourceROI;real references unscored. Counts are directions,not automatic improvements;absent signed gains have no unstable relative percentages. No blind,seed uncertainty or flat-safety claim;actualnative viewing required.",

"""Check actual raw/EMA matched browser captures against their public PNG pixels."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref
from PIL import Image
from train_dense_spectrum_trial import REPO, save

METHODS = {
    "control": {e: f"V187-pooled-wave-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
    "evidence": {e: f"V191-dense-spectrum-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]},
}


def verify(directory, output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output)
    browser = read(directory / "browser-records-v1.json")
    assert browser["fixture_only_no_V191_quality"] is False and browser["JS_errors"] == []
    assert len(browser["records"]) == 480 and len(browser["metadata"]) == 96
    viewer = Path(browser["viewer"])
    manifest_path = viewer.with_name("manifest-v1.json")
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert manifest["fixture"] is False and manifest["native_figures"] == 60
    expected_old = read(REPO / "docs/results/v189-spaced-pooled-final-v1.json")[
        "viewer_method_checkpoints"
    ]
    assert set(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == set(expected_old) | set(
        METHODS["evidence"].values()
    )
    assert len(expected_old) == 18 and len(manifest["method_checkpoints"]) == 20
    for method, entry in expected_old.items():
        assert manifest["method_checkpoints"][method] == entry
    for entry in manifest["method_checkpoints"].values():
        assert ref(entry["source_checkpoint"]["path"]) == entry["source_checkpoint"]
    images = {item["image"]["path"]: item for item in manifest["images"] if not item["triplet"]}
    assert len(images) == 48
    for item in images.values():
        assert ref(item["image"]["path"]) == item["image"]
    assert len({(m["case"], m["endpoint"]) for m in browser["metadata"]}) == 96
    for record in browser["metadata"]:
        for arm in ["control", "evidence"]:
            method = METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
            metadata = manifest["method_checkpoints"][method]
            assert metadata["state"] == record["endpoint"]
            for value in [method, metadata["source_checkpoint"]["sha256"], metadata["module_hash"]]:
                assert value in record["description"]
    channels = 0
    assert len({(r["case"], r["endpoint"], r["id"]) for r in browser["records"]}) == 480
    for record in browser["records"]:
        rect = record["rect"]
        assert rect["width"] == rect["height"] == 160
        assert rect["x"].is_integer() and rect["y"].is_integer()
        item = images[record["source"]]
        expected_panel = next(p for p in item["panels"] if p["label"] == record["label"])
        assert expected_panel["xywh"] == record["panel"]
        if record["id"] in ["a", "b"]:
            arm = "control" if record["id"] == "a" else "evidence"
            assert record["label"] == METHODS[arm][record["endpoint"]]
        x, y, width, height = record["panel"]
        assert width == height == 160
        expected = np.asarray(Image.open(record["source"]).convert("RGB"))[
            y : y + height, x : x + width
        ]
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(record["screenshot"]).convert("RGB"))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, expected)
