def bind(root, step):
    master = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    for binding in [master["training_plan"], master["prefix_control"], *master["helpers"]]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    training = read(master["training_plan"]["path"])
    guard(training)
    state = read(Path(training["root"]) / "status.json")
    assert (
        state["plan"] == master["training_plan"]
        and state["controller"] == master["training_controller"]
    )
    point = Path(master["points"][str(step)]["root"])
    queue = read(point / "queue-plan-v1.json")
    guard(queue)
    if step < 5000:
        binding = ref(Path(training["root"]) / f"train-V143-progress{step}.json")
        actual = read(binding["path"])
        assert actual["status"] == "immutable-progress-checkpoint-within-original-training-budget"
        assert actual["step"] == step and actual["declared_training_horizon"] == 5000
        counts = actual["counts_at_checkpoint"]
    else:
        if "adopted_original_worker" in master:
            adopted_producer_matches(master, state)
            assert not live(state["controller"]) and not live(state["child"])
            binding = ref(Path(training["root"]) / "train-V143-result.json")
        else:
            assert state["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons" and not live(
                state["controller"]
            )
            binding = state["completed"]["train-V143"]
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        actual = read(binding["path"])
        assert actual["status"] == "completed-crossed-gradient5000-training-phase"
        assert actual["updates"] == actual["all_AdamW_steps"] == step
        counts = actual["counts"]
    assert actual["arm"] == "V143" and actual["owner"] == state["child"]
    assert (
        counts["training_forwards"]
        == counts["optimizer_steps"]
        == counts["prepared_training_batches"]
        == step
    )
    assert counts["validation_forwards"] == step // 500 * 32
    assert counts["encoder_forwards"] == step + counts["validation_forwards"]
    matching_prefix(
        actual["observed_inputs"], read(master["prefix_control"]["path"])["observed_inputs"], step
    )
    import torch

    torch.set_num_threads(master.get("collector_cpu_threads", 2))
    checkpoint = actual["checkpoint"]
    assert ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
    saved = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], weights_only=True, map_location="cpu", mmap=True)
    assert saved["step"] == step and saved["config"]["steps"] == 5000
    assert (
        saved["config"]["gradient_charbonnier_epsilon"] == 0.00003
        and saved["config"]["mesh_texture_fraction"] == 0.1
    )
    assert saved["config"]["reconstruction_charbonnier_epsilon"] == 0.0003
    assert saved["config"]["initialized_from"] == queue["expected_lineage"]
    assert len(saved["model"]) == len(saved["ema"]) == 91 and len(saved["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
    assert all(float(s["step"]) == step for s in saved["optimizer"]["state"].values())
    values = [*saved["model"].values(), *saved["ema"].values()]
    values += [
        v
        for s in saved["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        for v in s.values()
        if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
    ]
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in values)
    trained = Path(saved["config"]["source_snapshot"])
    sources = list((Path(queue["work"]) / "src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))
    assert len(sources) == 69 and all(
        p.read_bytes() == (trained / p.name).read_bytes() for p in sources
    )
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    target = point / f"V143-step{step}-inference.pt"
    os.link(checkpoint["path"], target)
    target.chmod(0o444)
    save(
        point / "endpoint-verification-v1.json",
        {
            "training_result": binding,
            "checkpoint": ref(target),
            "review_step": step,
            "declared_horizon": 5000,
            "matched_V142_prefix_inputs": 1000,
            "trained_source_modules_exact": 69,
            "EMA_tensors": 91,
            "Adam_states": 89,
            "all_Adam_steps": step,
            "finite_state_values": sum(v.numel() for v in values),
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
        },
    )
    save(
        point / "plan-v1.json",
        {
            **queue,
            "checkpoint": ref(target),
            "inputs": [
                *queue["inputs"],
                binding,
                ref(target),
                ref(point / "endpoint-verification-v1.json"),
            ],
        },
    )


def run(root, step):
    master = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    point_info = master["points"][str(step)]
    point, flat, peaks = [Path(point_info[k]) for k in ("root", "flat", "peaks")]
    for binding in point_info["operators"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    bind(root, step)
    run_native(point)
    env = dict(os.environ, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="", PYTHONPATH="src:scripts")
    for name, script, args in [
        ("flat-collect", point / "flat-operator-v1.py", ["collect", flat]),
        ("flat-report", point / "flat-operator-v1.py", ["report", flat]),
        ("flat-audit", point / "flat-auditor-v1.py", [flat]),
        (
            "flat-control",
            point / "compare-flat-controls-v1.py",
            [flat, FLAT_CONTROL, root / f"step{step}-flat-control"],
        ),
        ("mesh-peaks", REPO / "scripts/compare_retained_mesh_peaks.py", ["compare", peaks]),
    ]:
        with (point / f"{name}-runner.log").open("x") as log:
            subprocess.run(
                [master["python"], str(script), *map(str, args)],
                cwd=REPO,
                env=env,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                timeout=3600,
                check=True,
            )


def watch(root):
    """Wait for the original producer; never reset training or retry a collection."""
    import json

    master = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    assert ref(__file__) == master["operator"]
    (root / "controller.claim").open("x").close()
    training = read(master["training_plan"]["path"])
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    state = {"owner": owner, "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"), "completed": {}}

    def record(value, **fields):
        state.update(status=value, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    began = time.monotonic()
    try:
        for step in sorted(map(int, master["points"])):
            path = Path(training["root"]) / (
                f"train-V143-progress{step}.json" if step < 5000 else "train-V143-result.json"
            )
            record("waiting-for-original-V143-checkpoint", step=step)
            while True:
                producer = read(Path(training["root"]) / "status.json")
                assert producer["plan"] == master["training_plan"]
                assert producer["controller"] == master["training_controller"]
                adopted = "adopted_original_worker" in master
                if adopted:
                    adopted_producer_matches(master, producer)
                    assert not live(producer["controller"])
                    if time.time() >= master["adopted_original_worker"]["deadline_unix"]:
                        if live(producer["child"]):
                            psutil.Process(producer["child"]["pid"]).terminate()
                        raise TimeoutError("Original worker reached its original8h deadline")
                ready = False
                if path.exists():
                    try:
                        read(path)
                        ready = (
                            (adopted and not live(producer["child"]))
                            or step < 5000
                            or (
                                producer["status"]
                                == "completed-training-awaiting-model-comparisons"
                                and not live(producer["controller"])
                            )
                        )
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        pass  # Re-poll the same owned producer during a receipt write.
                if ready:
                    break
                assert not producer["status"].startswith("failed"), producer
                assert live(producer["child"] if adopted else producer["controller"]), producer
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 10 * 3600
                time.sleep(10)
            record("waiting-for-review-headroom", step=step)
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 50 * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - began < 10 * 3600
                time.sleep(10)
            record("running-fixed-checkpoint-review", step=step)
            run(root, step)
            point = Path(master["points"][str(step)]["root"])
            flat = Path(master["points"][str(step)]["flat"])
            state["completed"][str(step)] = {
                "primary_audit": ref(point / "independent-audit-v1.json"),
                "faint_audit": ref(point / "faint-detail-v1/independent-audit-v1.json"),
                "flat_audit": ref(flat / "independent-flat-audit-v1.json"),
            }
            record("completed-numeric-checkpoint-review-awaiting-actual-viewing", step=step)
        record("completed-declared-reviews-awaiting-actual-native-viewing")
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-review-preserved-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "bind", "run", "watch"))
    p.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--training-plan", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--step", type=int, choices=STEPS)
    p.add_argument("--from-step", type=int, choices=STEPS, default=1000)
    p.add_argument("--cpu-threads", type=int, choices=(1, 2), default=2)
    p.add_argument("--adopt-live-worker", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    if args.mode == "prepare":
        prepare(
            args.root.resolve(),
            args.training_plan.resolve(),
            from_step=args.from_step,
            collector_cpu_threads=args.cpu_threads,
            adopt_live_worker=args.adopt_live_worker,
        )
    elif args.mode == "bind":
        bind(args.root.resolve(), args.step)
    elif args.mode == "watch":
        watch(args.root.resolve())
    else:
        run(args.root.resolve(), args.step)

MATCHED_METHODS += [f"V184-wave-readout-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
MATCHED_METHODS += [f"V185-spatial-context-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
MATCHED_METHODS += [f"V187-pooled-wave-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
MATCHED_METHODS += [f"V189-spaced-pooled-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]]
PRIMARY_BASELINE = {e: f"V187-pooled-wave-{e}" for e in ["raw", "EMA"]}
ALL_METHODS = EARLIER + ["V175-raw", "V175-EMA"] + MATCHED_METHODS + CANDIDATES
REQUIRED = {

    ],

    # Older parent rows contain crop_DC_RMS_DN16, checked below, without the

def condition(row):
    return row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise")))


def numeric(value):
    return isinstance(value, (float, int)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)


def source_rows(binding, method, label, plan):
    assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
    scores = read(binding["path"])
    if "plan" in scores:
        assert ref(scores["plan"]["path"]) == scores["plan"]
        context = read(scores["plan"]["path"])
    else:
        context = scores
    assert context["design"] == plan["design"]
    assert context.get("metrics_sources", context.get("metric_sources")) == plan["metrics_sources"]
    return [dict(row, method=label) for row in scores["rows"] if row["method"] == method]


def earlier_rows(plan):
    previous = read(V175 / "plan-v1.json")
    post = read(V175 / "postprocess-inputs-v1.json")
    assert post["training_plan"] == ref(V175 / "plan-v1.json")
    specifications = [
        (previous["parent_scores"], "parent", "parent"),
        (post["V161_current_metrics"], "V161-EMA", "V161-EMA"),
        (previous["prior_scores"], "balanced-EMA", "V169-EMA"),
        (previous["earlier_flat_scores"], "V171-EMA", "V171-EMA"),
        (post["canonical_V172_scores"], "V172-EMA", "V172-EMA"),
        (previous["earlier_quiet_scores"], "V173-EMA", "V173-EMA"),
        (previous["spread_scores"], "V174-EMA", "V174-EMA"),
    ]
    rows = [
        row
        for binding, method, label in specifications
        for row in source_rows(binding, method, label, plan)
    ]
    return rows, [binding for binding, _, _ in specifications]


def comparisons(rows, methods, case_ids):
    """Keep actual paired values and direction counts without ranking signed gains."""
    maps = {(row["id"], row["method"]): row for row in rows}
    assert len(maps) == len(rows) == len(methods) * len(case_ids)
    for method in methods:
        assert {row["id"] for row in rows if row["method"] == method} == set(case_ids)
    for name in case_ids:
        group = [maps[name, method] for method in methods]
        assert len({(row["kind"], condition(row), row.get("cohort")) for row in group}) == 1
        for row in group:
            if row["kind"] == "real":
                assert row["reference_scored"] is False
                assert not any(
                    key.endswith("error_RMS_DN16") or key == "template_gain" for key in row
                )
            else:
                for field in [
                    "full_error_RMS_DN16",
                    "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16",
                    "crop_DC_RMS_DN16",
                    *REQUIRED[row["kind"]],
                ]:
                    assert numeric(row[field]), (name, method, field)
    summary = summarize(rows)
    checks = validate_summary(rows, summary)
    summary_map = {(r["kind"], r["condition"], r["cohort"], r["method"]): r for r in summary}
    grouped = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        grouped[row["kind"], condition(row), row.get("cohort"), row["method"]].append(row)
    contrasts = [
        (METHODS[e], PRIMARY_BASELINE[e], "matched-dense-local-spectrum-" + e)
        for e in ["raw", "EMA"]
    ]
    contrasts += [
        (candidate, baseline, "context")
        for candidate in CANDIDATES
        for baseline in EARLIER + ["V175-raw", "V175-EMA"] + MATCHED_METHODS
        if baseline != PRIMARY_BASELINE[next(e for e, m in METHODS.items() if m == candidate)]
    ]
    paired = []
    for candidate, baseline, role in contrasts:
        for (kind, state, cohort, method), group in grouped.items():
            if method != candidate or kind == "real":
                continue
            for field in group[0]:
                if not field.endswith(("DN16", "gain", "error")):
                    continue
                if not all(
                    numeric(row.get(field)) and numeric(maps[row["id"], baseline].get(field))
                    for row in group
                ):
                    continue
                values = [
                    {
                        "id": row["id"],
                        "candidate": row[field],
                        "baseline": maps[row["id"], baseline][field],
                        "difference": row[field] - maps[row["id"], baseline][field],
                    }
                    for row in group
                ]
                a, b = [
                    math.fsum(float(value[key]) for value in values) / len(values)
                    for key in ["candidate", "baseline"]
                ]
                differences = [value["difference"] for value in values]
                mean_difference = math.fsum(differences) / len(differences)
                assert abs(a - summary_map[kind, state, cohort, candidate][field]) < 1e-10
                assert abs(b - summary_map[kind, state, cohort, baseline][field]) < 1e-10
                assert abs(mean_difference - (a - b)) < 1e-10
                ratio = (
                    None
                    if (kind == "mesh" and state is False and field == "template_gain") or b <= 0
                    else 100 * (a / b - 1)
                )
                paired.append(
                    {
                        "kind": kind,
                        "condition": state,
                        "cohort": cohort,
                        "method": candidate,
                        "baseline": baseline,
                        "comparison_role": role,
                        "field": field,
                        "cases": len(values),
                        "mean_candidate": a,
                        "mean_baseline": b,
                        "mean_difference": mean_difference,
                        "percent_change_of_means": ratio,
                        "decreased": sum(value < 0 for value in differences),
                        "increased": sum(value > 0 for value in differences),
                        "equal": sum(value == 0 for value in differences),
                        "minimum_difference": min(differences),
                        "maximum_difference": max(differences),
                        "pairs": values,
                    }
                )
    return {
        "summary": summary,
        "groups": paired,
        "independent_Decimal_summary_means": checks,
        "paired_mean_and_difference_checks": 3 * len(paired),
        "methods": len(methods),
        "metric_rows": len(rows),
        "contrasts": len(contrasts),
        "primary_endpoint_contrasts": 2,
        "real_references_scored": False,
    }

"""Read-only gradient routing at trained weights; no optimizer or EMA updates."""

import argparse
import gc
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
import yaml
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from torch.utils.data import default_collate

from demosaic.data import CleanDataset
from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.losses import reconstruction_loss
from demosaic.paired_training import PairedDataset, paired_reconstruction_loss
from demosaic.precision import amp_context, ieee_fp32
from demosaic.raw_clean import RawCleanDataset
from demosaic.suite import observation
from demosaic.train import batch_fingerprint, prepare_training_batch


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        sha = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha}


def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def compare(a, b):
    """Scalar FP64 norm/dot accumulation from CPU copies of FP32 gradients."""
    assert a.keys() == b.keys()
    aa, bb, dd, ab, maximum, changed = [], [], [], [], 0.0, 0
    for key in a:
        x, y = a[key].double(), b[key].double()
        delta = x - y
        aa.append(float(x.square().sum()))
        bb.append(float(y.square().sum()))
        dd.append(float(delta.square().sum()))
        ab.append(float((x * y).sum()))
        maximum = max(maximum, float(delta.abs().max()))
        changed += not torch.equal(a[key], b[key])
    an, bn, dn = (math.sqrt(math.fsum(v)) for v in (aa, bb, dd))
    return {
        "tensors": len(a),
        "changed_tensors": changed,
        "connected_l2": an,
        "detached_l2": bn,
        "difference_l2": dn,
        "difference_over_connected_l2": dn / max(an, 1e-30),
        "cosine": math.fsum(ab) / max(an * bn, 1e-30),
        "maximum_abs_difference": maximum,
    }


def route(model, batch, domain, device, precision, detach):
    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    branch, captured = model.pretrained_rgb.raw_directional, {}

    def capture(_module, args, _output):
        for name, value in [("base", args[0]), ("features", args[4])]:
            value.retain_grad()
            captured[name] = value

    handles = [branch.register_forward_hook(capture)]
    if detach:
        handles.append(
            branch.bank.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda _module, args: (args[0].detach(),))
        )
    try:
        with amp_context(device, dtype=precision):
            prediction, auxiliary = model(
                *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix")),
                auxiliary=True,
            )
            if domain == "paired":
                loss, terms = paired_reconstruction_loss(prediction, batch, auxiliary)
            else:
                loss, terms = reconstruction_loss(
                    prediction, batch, auxiliary, camera_supervision="sensor-valid-v1"
                )
        assert torch.isfinite(loss)
        with ieee_fp32():
            loss.backward()
        gradients = {
            name: p.grad.detach().cpu().clone()
            for name, p in model.named_parameters()
            if p.requires_grad and p.grad is not None
        }
        assert len(gradients) == 103
        assert all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in gradients.values())
        assert all(p.grad is None for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
        cut = {name: value.grad.detach().cpu().clone() for name, value in captured.items()}
        with ieee_fp32():
            norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1, error_if_nonfinite=True)
        clipped = {
            name: p.grad.detach().cpu().clone()
            for name, p in model.named_parameters()
            if p.requires_grad and p.grad is not None
        }
        return {
            "prediction": prediction.detach().cpu(),
            "auxiliary": auxiliary.detach().cpu(),
            "loss": float(loss.detach()),
            "terms": {k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
            "preclip_norm": float(norm),
            "raw": gradients,
            "clipped": clipped,
            "cut": cut,
        }
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
        assert not branch._forward_hooks and not branch.bank._forward_pre_hooks


def cases(plan, cfg, model, device, preflight):
    size, batch_size = (64, 1) if preflight else (256, 16)
    datasets = {
        "commons": CleanDataset(
            cfg["manifest"],
            patch_size=size,
            seed=51,
            synthetic_fraction=0.2,
            flat_fraction=0.1,
            flat_chroma_stops=8,
            augmentation_downsample=2,
        ),
        "native": RawCleanDataset(
            cfg["raw_clean_manifest"],
            patch_size=size,
            seed=51,
            augmentation_downsample=2,
        ),
        "paired": PairedDataset(cfg["paired_manifest"], patch_size=size, seed=51),
    }
    for item in plan["training_batches"]:
        step, domain = item["step"], item["domain"]
        # Preserve global B16 source indices even in the separate B1 CPU check.
        indices = list(range((step - 1) * 16, (step - 1) * 16 + batch_size))
        clean = default_collate([datasets[domain][i] for i in indices])
        batch = prepare_training_batch(
            step, domain, clean, model=model, device=device, config=cfg, seed=51
        )
        digest = batch_fingerprint(
            {k: batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix", "shot", "read")}
        )
        if not preflight:
            assert digest == item["input_sha256"], (step, digest, item["input_sha256"])
            assert (
                batch_fingerprint({k: v for k, v in batch.items() if k != "sensor_target"})
                == item["legacy_batch_sha256"]
            )
        yield {"kind": "training", "step": step, "domain": domain, "indices": indices}, batch
    del datasets
    protocol = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["protocol"]["path"]).read_text())
    for item in plan["analytic_cases"]:
        level, contrast, period = (item[k] for k in ("level", "contrast", "period"))
        draws = 1 if preflight else 4
        coords = torch.arange(size, dtype=torch.float32)
        rgb = (
            (level * (1 + contrast * (coords * (2 * math.pi / period)).cos()))[None, None, None]
            .expand(draws, 3, size, size)
            .clone()
        )
        ids = [f"carrier-l{level}-c{contrast}-p{period}-draw{i}" for i in range(draws)]
        condition = next(x for x in protocol["conditions"] if x["name"] == item["condition"])
        for pattern in protocol["patterns"]:
            cpu = observation(
                rgb,
                ids,
                condition,
                pattern,
                protocol["white_balance"],
                protocol["camera_to_srgb"],
                20261016,
            )
            # These low-level gray fixtures do not clip in the camera/display
            # target conversion, so both clean targets coincide exactly.
            assert cpu["target"].min() >= 0 and cpu["target"].max() < 0.98
            cpu["sensor_target"] = cpu["target"].clone()
            cpu["shot"] = torch.full((draws,), condition["shot"])
            cpu["read"] = torch.full((draws,), condition["read"])
            yield (
                {"kind": "analytic", **item, "pattern": pattern},
                {k: v.to(device) for k, v in cpu.items()},
            )


def main(plan_path, output, device_name, preflight):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    output = output.resolve()
    assert output.is_relative_to(Path(plan["root"]))
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(item["path"]) == item
    for name, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert ref(name)["sha256"] == digest
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["worker"]
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(2 if preflight else 4)
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
    device = torch.device(device_name)
    if device.type == "cuda":
        prior = read(Path(plan["root"]) / "cpu-preflight/summary.json")
        assert prior["status"] == "completed-CPU-gradient-routing-preflight"
        assert prior["driver"] == plan["worker"]
        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
            24 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory, device
        )
    else:
        assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized() and os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") == ""
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    model, state = load_checkpoint(plan["checkpoint"]["path"], device)
    assert state["loaded_sha256"] == plan["checkpoint"]["sha256"]
    del state
    if device.type == "cuda":
        model.to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    model.train()
    initial, dino = model_hash(model), model_hash(model.context.backbone)
    assert dino == plan["DINO_sha256"]
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(Path(plan["template"]["path"]).read_text())
    records, started = [], time.monotonic()
    branch_prefix = "pretrained_rgb.raw_directional."
    for label, batch in cases(plan, cfg, model, device, preflight):
        assert time.monotonic() - started < 1800
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 24 * 2**30
        model.set_noise(batch["shot"], batch["read"])
        precision = "float32" if preflight or label["kind"] == "analytic" else "bfloat16"
        rng = torch.get_rng_state()
        cuda_rng = torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all() if device.type == "cuda" else []
        a = route(model, batch, label.get("domain"), device, precision, False)
        torch.set_rng_state(rng)
        if cuda_rng:
            torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all(cuda_rng)
        b = route(model, batch, label.get("domain"), device, precision, True)
        assert torch.equal(a["prediction"], b["prediction"])
        assert torch.equal(a["auxiliary"], b["auxiliary"])
        assert a["loss"] == b["loss"] and a["terms"] == b["terms"]
        assert torch.equal(a["cut"]["features"], b["cut"]["features"])
        assert all(
            torch.equal(v, b["raw"][n]) for n, v in a["raw"].items() if n.startswith(branch_prefix)
        )
        groups = {
            "common": lambda n: not n.startswith(branch_prefix),
            "local_directional": lambda n: (
                n.startswith(branch_prefix) and not n.startswith(branch_prefix + "bank.")
            ),
            "bank": lambda n: n.startswith(branch_prefix + "bank."),
        }
        record = {
            "case": label,
            "examples": len(batch["packed"]),
            "precision": precision,
            "batch_sha256": batch_fingerprint(batch),
            "predictions_auxiliary_loss_terms_exact": True,
            "branch_raw_parameter_gradients_exact": True,
            "feature_cut_gradients_exact": True,
            "loss": a["loss"],
            "terms": a["terms"],
            "preclip_norm": {"connected": a["preclip_norm"], "detached": b["preclip_norm"]},
            "base_cut_gradient": compare({"base": a["cut"]["base"]}, {"base": b["cut"]["base"]}),
            "parameter_gradients": {
                stage: {
                    group: compare(
                        {n: v for n, v in a[stage].items() if select(n)},
                        {n: v for n, v in b[stage].items() if select(n)},
                    )
                    for group, select in groups.items()
                }
                for stage in ["raw", "clipped"]
            },
            "variance_floor_fraction": float((batch["variance"] <= 1e-8).float().mean()),
        }
        records.append(record)
        save(output / "partial.json", records)
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "case": label,
                    "common_gradient_relative_change": record["parameter_gradients"]["raw"][
                        "common"
                    ]["difference_over_connected_l2"],
                }
            ),
            flush=True,
        )
        del a, b, batch
        gc.collect()
    assert len(records) == 15
    assert model_hash(model) == initial and model_hash(model.context.backbone) == dino
    for name, digest in plan["frozen_files"].items():
        assert ref(name)["sha256"] == digest
    for item in plan["inputs"]:
        assert ref(item["path"]) == item
    save(
        output / "summary.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-CPU-gradient-routing-preflight"
            if preflight
            else "completed-read-only-bank-gradient-routing",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "driver": ref(__file__),
            "device": str(device),
            "model_state_sha256_before_and_after": initial,
            "DINO_sha256": dino,
            "records": records,
            "new_training_updates": 0,
            "new_checkpoint_or_default": False,
            "scope": "Connected versus bank-input-detached gradients at fixed V81 EMA. Identical forward values, losses, feature-cut gradients and raw branch parameter gradients are required. Training inputs replay original source/domain/noise identities; CPU preflight uses separate B1/native64 inputs. Analytic cases are explicit loss Jacobian fixtures, not new quality scores. No attribution of historical training causes, independent retraining effect, convergence or promotion.",
        },
    )
    print(json.dumps({"completed": True, "cases": len(records)}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=["cpu", "cuda"], required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--preflight", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.plan, args.output, args.device, args.preflight)

def batch(path):
    with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as values:
        return {k: values[k].copy() for k in values.files}


def checked_correction(prediction, arrays):
    t = {k: torch.from_numpy(v) for k, v in arrays.items()}
    output, gain, terms = correct(
        torch.from_numpy(prediction),
        *(t[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"]),
    )
    oracle = numpy_terms(
        prediction, *(arrays[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"])
    )
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(terms["count"].numpy(), oracle["count"])
    for key in ["numerator", "denominator"]:
        np.testing.assert_allclose(terms[key].numpy(), oracle[key], rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-12)
    ng = numpy_solve(oracle)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(gain.numpy(), ng, rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-12)
    expected = numpy_apply(prediction, ng, arrays["wb"], arrays["matrix"])
    error = float(np.max(np.abs(expected - output.numpy())))
    assert error <= 2e-7 and torch.isfinite(output).all()
    return output.numpy(), gain.numpy(), {k: v.tolist() for k, v in terms.items()}, error


def perfect_target_oracle():
    from probe_saved_cfa_gain_grid import channel_gain

    image = torch.full((1, 3, 64, 64), 0.2)
    image[..., :32] = torch.tensor([3.6, 1.8, 0.9])[None, :, None, None]
    wb = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 1.5]])
    matrix = torch.tensor(
        [
            [
                [1.117647, -0.0588235, -0.0588235],
                [-0.0588235, 1.117647, -0.0588235],
                [-0.0588235, -0.0588235, 1.117647],
            ]
        ]
    )
    clean, target = camera_pair(image, torch.linalg.inv(matrix), wb, reconstruct_highlights=True)
    rows = []
    for pattern, labels in PATTERNS.items():
        colors = torch.tensor(labels)[None]
        packed = mosaic(clean.clamp(0, 1), colors)
        old, g0 = channel_gain(target, packed, colors)
        guarded, g1, terms = correct(target, packed, torch.zeros_like(packed), colors, wb, matrix)
        assert torch.equal(guarded, target)
        rows.append(
            {
                "pattern": pattern,
                "unmasked_MSE_from_perfect_target": float((old - target).square().mean()),
                "guarded_MSE_from_perfect_target": 0.0,
                "unmasked_gains": g0.tolist()[0],
                "guarded_gains": g1.tolist()[0],
                "guarded_fit_counts": terms["count"].tolist()[0],
            }
        )
    return {
        "scope": "Analytical target-compatibility oracle, not learned-model performance. Prediction deliberately equals exact reference-white target; observation is ideal noiseless ADC-clipped exposed CFA. This establishes a target/input conflict, not its contribution to real neural errors.",
        "cases": rows,
    }


def gfx(plan, output):
    fixture = read(plan["fixture"]["path"])
    wb = torch.tensor(fixture["gfx_metadata"]["white_balance"])[None]
    matrix = torch.tensor(fixture["gfx_metadata"]["camera_to_srgb"])[None]
    colors = torch.tensor(PATTERNS[fixture["gfx_metadata"]["pattern"]])[None]
    rgb = np.load(plan["full_RGB"]["path"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
    raw = np.load(plan["full_raw"]["path"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
    assert rgb.shape == (3, 8746, 11662) and raw.shape == (8746, 11662)
    collected = {k: [[] for _ in range(3)] for k in ["numerator", "denominator", "count"]}
    independent = {k: [[] for _ in range(3)] for k in collected}
    shot, readvar = fixture["conditioning"]["shot"], fixture["conditioning"]["read"]
    for y in range(0, raw.shape[0], 256):
        p = np.array(rgb[:, y : y + 256], copy=True)[None]
        packed = np.stack(
            [
                np.asarray(raw[y + dy : min(y + 256, raw.shape[0]) : 2, dx::2])
                for dy, dx in [(0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1)]
            ]
        )[None]
        z = torch.from_numpy(packed)
        variance = z.clamp_min(0) * shot + readvar
        terms = fit_terms(torch.from_numpy(p), z, variance, colors, wb, matrix)
        oracle = numpy_terms(
            p, packed, variance.numpy(), colors.numpy(), wb.numpy(), matrix.numpy()
        )
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(terms["count"].numpy(), oracle["count"])
        for key in collected:
            for channel in range(3):
                collected[key][channel].append(float(terms[key][0, channel]))
                independent[key][channel].append(float(oracle[key][0, channel]))
    total = {
        k: torch.tensor(
            [[math.fsum(v) for v in values]], dtype=torch.int64 if k == "count" else torch.float64
        )
        for k, values in collected.items()
    }
    oracle = {
        k: np.array(
            [[math.fsum(v) for v in values]], dtype=np.int64 if k == "count" else np.float64
        )
        for k, values in independent.items()
    }
    gain = solve(total)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(gain.numpy(), numpy_solve(oracle), rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-12)
    for key in ["numerator", "denominator"]:
        np.testing.assert_allclose(total[key].numpy(), oracle[key], rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-12)
    values_checked = 0
    max_pixel_error = 0.0
    maximum_change = 0.0
    squared = []
    for y in range(0, raw.shape[0], 256):
        p = np.array(rgb[:, y : y + 256], copy=True)[None]
        changed = apply_gain(torch.from_numpy(p), gain, wb, matrix).numpy()
        expected = numpy_apply(p, numpy_solve(oracle), wb.numpy(), matrix.numpy())
        error = float(np.max(np.abs(expected - changed)))
        max_pixel_error = max(max_pixel_error, error)
        assert error <= 2e-7 and np.isfinite(changed).all()
        delta = changed.astype(np.float64) - p.astype(np.float64)
        maximum_change = max(maximum_change, float(np.abs(delta).max()))
        squared.append(float(np.square(delta).sum()))
        values_checked += delta.size
    assert values_checked == 305987556
    output.mkdir()
    source_report = Path(plan["full_native_report"]["path"])
    templates = [
        c
        for c in read(source_report)["native_crops"]
        if c["model_label"] == "V63-step20000:original-FP32"

    highlights = Path(plan["highlight_report"]["path"])
    templates += [

        for c in read(highlights)["native_crops"]

    assert len(templates) == 6
    crops = []
    for index, template in enumerate(templates):

        src = parent / template["image"]
        assert ref(src)["sha256"] == template["png_sha256"]
        pixels = np.array(Image.open(src))
        x, y = template["region"]["noisy_xy"]
        p = torch.from_numpy(np.array(rgb[:, y : y + 160, x : x + 160], copy=True))[None]
        changed = apply_gain(p, gain, wb, matrix)
        for label, prediction, g in [
            ("V63-parent-saved-full-FP32", p, [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]),

            def panel(i, pixels=pixels, template=template):

"""Deferred CUDA component parity/timing after the exact earlier inverse probe."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import os
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_context_trial import alive
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def main(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    with (root / "controller.claim").open("x") as file:
        file.write(str(os.getpid()))
    state = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
    }

    def record(status, **fields):
        state.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **fields)
        save(root / "status.json", state)

    try:
        launch = read(plan["predecessor_launch"]["path"])
        previous = read(plan["predecessor_plan"]["path"])
        record("waiting-for-exact-prior-inverse-probe-after-training-and-quality")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 28800
        while alive(launch):
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "Eight-hour wait bound exhausted"
            status = read(Path(previous["root"]) / "status.json")
            assert not status["status"].startswith("failed-"), "Preceding work failed; no retry"
            time.sleep(5)
        status = read(Path(previous["root"]) / "status.json")
        assert status["controller"]["pid"] == launch["pid"]
        assert status["controller"]["created"] == launch["created"]
        assert (
            status["status"]
            == "completed-isolated-VST-inverse-CUDA-numerical-and-resident-timing-probe"
        )
        assert ref(status["result"]["path"]) == status["result"]
        guard(plan)
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 40 * 2**30
        import torch

        from demosaic.cfa import PATTERNS, color_indices, malvar
        from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32
        from demosaic.pretrained_rgb import physical_rgb_features
        from demosaic.vst import GeneralizedAnscombe

        torch.set_num_threads(2)
        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
        torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
            min(
                torch.cuda.get_per_process_memory_fraction(device),
                16 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).total_memory,
            ),
            device,
        )
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            "legacy_physical", plan["legacy_fixture"]["path"]
        )
        legacy = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(legacy)
        functions = {
            "original": legacy.original_anchored_features,
            "candidate": physical_rgb_features,
        }
        colors = torch.stack([color_indices(p, device=device) for p in PATTERNS])
        wb = torch.tensor(
            [[2.0, 1.0, 1.5], [0.7, 1.0, 2.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], [4.0, 0.8, 1.5]], device=device
        )
        matrix = torch.eye(3, device=device)[None].expand(4, -1, -1)
        profiles = [
            (GeneralizedAnscombe(0.00256, 0.0000262144).to(device), 1.0, True),
            (None, 1.0, False),
            (None, 0.01, True),
            (GeneralizedAnscombe(1e-10, 0.0001).to(device), 1.0, True),
        ]
        cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()
        results = []
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
        record("running-isolated-anchored-physical-feature-CUDA-parity-and-timing")
        with torch.inference_mode(), ieee_fp32():
            for size in [64, 512]:
                source = torch.linspace(
                    -0.02, 1.2, 4 * 4 * (size // 2) ** 2, device=device
                ).reshape(4, 4, size // 2, size // 2)
                transformed, proxies, interpolated = [], [], []
                for b, (transform, scale, stochastic) in enumerate(profiles):
                    z = (
                        transform(source[b : b + 1])
                        if transform is not None
                        else (source[b : b + 1].double() / scale).float()
                    )
                    transformed.append(z)
                    proxies.append(torch.ones_like(z) if stochastic else torch.zeros_like(z))
                    interpolated.append(
                        malvar(
                            z, colors[b : b + 1], None if transform is not None else wb[b : b + 1]
                        )
                    )
                for layout in [torch.contiguous_format, torch.channels_last]:
                    packed, variance, rgb = (
                        torch.cat(v).contiguous(memory_format=layout)
                        for v in [transformed, proxies, interpolated]
                    )
                    kwargs = {"rgb": rgb, "stabilized": True, "photometry_profiles": profiles}
                    args = [packed, variance, colors, wb, matrix]
                    first, second = (function(*args, **kwargs) for function in functions.values())
                    for x, y in zip(first, second, strict=True):
                        assert torch.isfinite(x).all() and torch.isfinite(y).all()
                        assert x.stride() == y.stride()
                        assert torch.equal(
                            x.flatten().view(torch.uint8), y.flatten().view(torch.uint8)
                        )
                    values = sum(x.numel() for x in first)
                    del first, second
                    for _ in range(2):
                        for function in functions.values():
                            function(*args, **kwargs)
                    samples = {name: [] for name in functions}
                    for repeat in range(5):
                        assert time.monotonic() < deadline
                        order = list(functions) if repeat % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(functions))
                        for name in order:
                            start, end = (
                                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
                                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
                            )
                            start.record()
                            functions[name](*args, **kwargs)
                            end.record()
                            end.synchronize()
                            samples[name].append(start.elapsed_time(end))
                    results.append(
                        {
                            "native_size": size,
                            "batch": 4,
                            "layout": "channels_last"
                            if layout == torch.channels_last
                            else "contiguous",
                            "all_six_output_fields_bytes_and_strides_exact": True,
                            "values_compared": values,
                            "CUDA_ms": samples,
                            "median_ms": {k: statistics.median(v) for k, v in samples.items()},
                        }
                    )
        assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state())
        assert all(
            torch.equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all(), strict=True)
        )
        guard(plan)
        result = {
            "status": "completed-isolated-anchored-physical-feature-CUDA-parity-and-timing",
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "predecessor_result": status["result"],
            "results": results,
            "all_output_bytes_and_strides_exact": True,
            "CPU_CUDA_RNG_unchanged": True,
            "scope": "Physical feature component only, deterministic nonphotographic all-CFA fields and mixed noise families. IEEE FP32 physical work with the unchanged FP64 GAT anchors. Five alternating CUDA-event samples after two warmups. No neural model, optimizer, training, reference, quality or full-frame speed claim; shared-machine workloads are not excluded.",
        }
        save(root / "result.json", result)
        record(result["status"], result=ref(root / "result.json"))
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-physical-feature-CUDA-probe-no-automatic-retry", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.plan.resolve())

def parents(path):
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
    from demosaic.precision import ieee_fp32
    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / "parents.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[0]):
        model, state = load_checkpoint(plan["parent"]["path"], "cuda")
    assert state["loaded_sha256"] == plan["parent"]["sha256"]
    model.eval().requires_grad_(False).to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    before, backbone = model_hash(model), model_hash(model.context.backbone)
    assert backbone == plan["expected_DINO_sha256"]
    counts = {"parent": 0, "DINO": 0}
    model.register_forward_hook(lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("parent", counts["parent"] + 1))
    model.context.backbone.register_forward_hook(
        lambda *args: counts.__setitem__("DINO", counts["DINO"] + 1)
    )
    cpu, cuda = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    rows = []
    for i, case in enumerate(plan["cases"]):
        assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
        assert (
            shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
        )
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        keys = ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"]
        tensors = [torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda() for k in keys]
        model.set_noise(0.0, 0.0)
        with torch.inference_mode(), ieee_fp32():
            value = model(*tensors).cpu().numpy()
        assert (
            value.dtype == np.float32
            and value.shape == arrays["target"].shape
            and np.isfinite(value).all()
        )
        dest = root / "parents" / f"parent-{i:03d}.npy"
        np.save(dest, value)
        rows.append(
            {
                **case,
                "parent": ref(dest),
                "input_fingerprints": {k: fingerprint(arrays[k]) for k in keys},
            }
        )
        print(case["id"], flush=True)
    assert counts == {"parent": 24, "DINO": 24}
    assert model_hash(model) == before and model_hash(model.context.backbone) == backbone
    assert torch.equal(cpu, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(cuda, torch.cuda.get_rng_state())
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed24-fixed-ADC-parent-contexts",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "observations": rows,
            "counts": counts,
            "parent_before": before,
            "parent_after": model_hash(model),
            "DINO_before": backbone,
            "DINO_after": model_hash(model.context.backbone),
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "new_stochastic_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=["prepare", "parents"])
    parser.add_argument("path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    (prepare if args.mode == "prepare" else parents)(args.path.absolute())

        git_head_at_freeze=subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),

Same full427, known4/unseen5, sensitivity/analytic/ADC/hue/GFX/highlight panels, fresh V63 and witnessed retained V43/RawNIND. Native160 triplets include foliage/fence. No protected-final scoring, extension or promotion.",
    )
    plan.pop("recovery_of", None)

    closure = copy.deepcopy(read(closure_path))
    closure.update(

        output=str(work / "outputs/closure"),

        closure_engine=ref(work / "scripts/close_bank_detachment_review.py"),
        historical_replay=False,

"""Measure both conditional swap orders on actual fixed output arrays."""

import argparse
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save


def main(root):
    review = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")
    methods = ["native-native", "relative-relative", "relative-native", "native-relative"]
    maps = {
        method: {o["id"]: o for o in read(review["collections"][method]["path"])["observations"]}
        for method in methods
    }
    rows = []
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for case in read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")["observations"]:
        if case["kind"] == "real":
            continue
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        values = {
            method: np.load(maps[method][case["id"]]["prediction"]["path"]).astype(np.float64)
            for method in methods
        }
        target = arrays["target"].astype(np.float64)
        x, y, w, h = case["ROI_xywh"]
        errors = {method: (value - target) * 65535 for method, value in values.items()}
        regions = {
            "full": {key: value for key, value in errors.items()},
            "crop": {key: value[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] for key, value in errors.items()},
        }
        if case["kind"] == "mixed-quiet":
            regions["quiet"] = regions["crop"]
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            mask = (
                np.all(arrays["target_present"] == arrays["target_empty"], axis=1)[0]
                if case["present"]
                else np.ones(target.shape[-2:], bool)
            )
            assert mask.any()
            regions["blank"] = {key: value[0][:, mask] for key, value in errors.items()}
        condition = (
            case["present"]
            if case["kind"] == "mesh"
            else (case["variant"]["name"] if case["kind"] == "photo" else case["noise"]["name"])
        )
        for region, selected in regions.items():
            risk = {key: float(np.mean(value**2)) for key, value in selected.items()}
            nn, rr, rn, nr = (risk[key] for key in methods)
            proposal_at_N = rn - nn
            proposal_at_R = rr - nr
            map_at_N = nr - nn
            map_at_R = rr - rn
            proposal_average = (proposal_at_N + proposal_at_R) / 2
            map_average = (map_at_N + map_at_R) / 2
            assert abs(proposal_average + map_average - (rr - nn)) < 1e-10
            row = {
                "id": case["id"],
                "kind": case["kind"],
                "cohort": case.get("cohort"),
                "condition": condition,
                "region": region,
                "native_native_MSE_DN16_squared": nn,
                "relative_relative_MSE_DN16_squared": rr,
                "relative_native_MSE_DN16_squared": rn,
                "native_relative_MSE_DN16_squared": nr,
                "proposal_change_at_N_map": proposal_at_N,
                "proposal_change_at_R_map": proposal_at_R,
                "map_change_at_N_proposal": map_at_N,
                "map_change_at_R_proposal": map_at_R,
                "average_proposal_change": proposal_average,
                "average_map_change": map_average,
                "combined_change": rr - nn,
            }
            rows.append(row)
            groups[case["kind"], str(condition), case.get("cohort"), region].append(row)
    summary = []
    for (kind, condition, cohort, region), members in groups.items():
        item = {
            "kind": kind,
            "condition": condition,
            "cohort": cohort,
            "region": region,
            "cases": len(members),
        }
        fields = members[0].keys() - {"id", "kind", "condition", "cohort", "region"}
        for field in fields:
            item[field] = math.fsum(row[field] for row in members) / len(members)
        assert (
            abs(
                item["average_proposal_change"]
                + item["average_map_change"]
                - item["combined_change"]
            )
            < 1e-10
        )
        summary.append(item)
    assert len(rows) == 2176
    save(
        root / "conditional-effects-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-fixed-array-two-order-risk-reduction",
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "source": dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Exact target used only for scoring existing constructed-target arrays, never output. MSE in cameraRGB x65535 squared, equal observation weights; mean RMS is not used for additive attribution. Both conditional swap orders and their equal average are reported. They sum to RR-minus-NN risk, but are not a unique causal attribution of training or gate weights. Maps remain the original data-dependent fields; no real-reference error is scored.",
        },
    )
    for item in summary:
        if item["region"] == "quiet":
            print(item)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.absolute())

"""Full input-field bindings and sampled QR math; neither is confidence."""

import re
import numpy as np
from lossless_native import fingerprint


def geometry(shape, config):
    batch, _, height, width = shape
    length = config["dense_window"]
    stride = config["dense_stride"]
    r = length // 2
    axes = [np.unique([*range(0, n, stride), n - 1]).astype("<i8") for n in [height, width]]
    y, x = np.meshgrid(*axes, indexing="ij")
    centers = np.stack([y.ravel(), x.ravel()], 1)
    yy, xx = np.indices((length, length))
    iy = centers[:, 0, None, None] + yy
    ix = centers[:, 1, None, None] + xx
    fy, fx = np.meshgrid(np.fft.fftfreq(length) / 2, np.fft.fftfreq(length) / 2, indexing="ij")
    rad = np.hypot(fy, fx)
    eligible = (rad >= 1 / 16) & (rad <= 1 / 3)
    patches = sorted(set([0, (len(centers) - 1) // 2, len(centers) - 1]))
    coords = np.argwhere(eligible)
    coords = coords[np.linspace(0, len(coords) - 1, min(12, len(coords)), dtype=int)]
    fields = {
        "centers_y": axes[0],
        "centers_x": axes[1],
        "centers_yx": centers,
        "linear_indices": (iy * (width + 2 * r) + ix).astype("<i8"),
        "valid": (iy >= r) & (iy < height + r) & (ix >= r) & (ix < width + r),
        "eligible": eligible,
        "image_shape": np.array([height, width], dtype="<i8"),
        "windows": np.array([length, *config["dense_support_windows"]], dtype="<i8"),
        "stride": np.array(stride, dtype="<i8"),
    }
    return fields, patches, coords


def select(array, patches, coords):
    array = np.take(array, patches, axis=1)
    flat = coords[:, 0] * array.shape[-1] + coords[:, 1]
    return np.take(array.reshape(*array.shape[:-2], -1), flat, axis=-1)


def real_values(value):
    return np.stack([value.real, value.imag], -1) if np.iscomplexobj(value) else value


def describe_dense(aux):
    if aux["dense_spectrum"] is None:
        assert aux["dense_context"] is aux["dense_coefficient"] is None
        return None
    fields = {k: v.detach().cpu().numpy() for k, v in aux["dense_spectrum"].items()}
    context = aux["dense_context"].detach().cpu().numpy()
    coefficient = aux["dense_coefficient"].detach().cpu().numpy()
    b, p, _, l, _ = coefficient.shape
    config = {
        "dense_window": l,
        "dense_stride": int(fields["stride"]),
        "dense_support_windows": fields["windows"][1:].tolist(),
    }
    h, w = map(int, fields["image_shape"])
    _, patches, coords = geometry((b, 4, h, w), config)
    arrays = {
        "context": context.reshape(b, p, 18, l, l),
        "coefficient": coefficient,
        "aligned_spectra": fields["aligned_spectra"],
        "propagated_variance": fields["propagated_variance"],
    }
    assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in arrays.values())
    return {
        "windows": fields["windows"].tolist(),
        "stride": int(fields["stride"]),
        "context": fingerprint(context),
        "coefficient": fingerprint(coefficient),
        "fields": {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in fields.items()},
        "finite_fields": True,
        "patch_indices": patches,
        "frequency_yx": coords.tolist(),
        "samples": {k: real_values(select(v, patches, coords)).tolist() for k, v in arrays.items()},
        "scope": "Full hashes bind input-only execution/raw-EMA equality. Deterministic QR samples check math,not every full field value or restoration/safety.",
    }


def validate_dense(record, shape, colors, config):
    b, _, h, w = shape
    l = config["dense_window"]
    expected, patches, coords = geometry(shape, config)
    p = len(expected["centers_yx"])
    layout = np.broadcast_to(colors, (b, 4))
    expected["green_phase_indices"] = np.stack([np.flatnonzero(v == 1) for v in layout]).astype(
        "<i8"
    )
    assert (
        record["windows"] == [l, *config["dense_support_windows"]]
        and record["stride"] == config["dense_stride"]
        and record["finite_fields"] is True
    )
    for key, value in expected.items():
        assert record["fields"][key] == fingerprint(value), key
    floating = {
        "affine_basis": ([l, l, 3], "<f8"),
        "native_fy": ([l, l], "<f8"),
        "native_fx": ([l, l], "<f8"),
        "subpixel_phase": ([4, l, l], "<c16"),
        "synthesis_window": ([l, l], "<f8"),
        "normalization": ([h, w], "<f8"),
        "aligned_spectra": ([b, p, 3, 2, l, l], "<c16"),
        "propagated_variance": ([b, p, 3, 2, l, l], "<f8"),
    }
    assert set(record["fields"]) == set(expected) | set(floating)
    for key, (dimensions, dtype) in floating.items():
        value = record["fields"][key]
        assert (
            value["shape"] == dimensions
            and value["dtype"] == dtype
            and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", value["sha256"])
        )
    for key, dimensions, dtype in [
        ("context", [b * p, 18, l, l], "<f4"),
        ("coefficient", [b, p, 2, l, l], "<c8"),
    ]:
        value = record[key]
        assert (
            value["shape"] == dimensions
            and value["dtype"] == dtype
            and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", value["sha256"])
        )
    assert record["patch_indices"] == patches and record["frequency_yx"] == coords.tolist()
    samples = {
        "context": (b, len(patches), 18, len(coords)),
        "coefficient": (b, len(patches), 2, len(coords), 2),
        "aligned_spectra": (b, len(patches), 3, 2, len(coords), 2),
        "propagated_variance": (b, len(patches), 3, 2, len(coords)),
    }
    assert set(record["samples"]) == set(samples)
    for key, dimensions in samples.items():
        value = np.asarray(record["samples"][key])
        assert value.shape == dimensions and np.isfinite(value).all()
    assert (np.asarray(record["samples"]["propagated_variance"]) >= 0).all()


def audit_samples(record, packed, variance, colors, config):
    from dense_spectrum_reference import measurements

    fields, patches, coords = geometry(packed.shape, config)
    context, coefficient, eg = measurements(
        packed,
        variance,
        colors,
        window=config["dense_window"],
        stride=config["dense_stride"],
        support_windows=tuple(config["dense_support_windows"]),
        centers_yx=fields["centers_yx"][patches],
    )
    b, p, _, l, _ = coefficient.shape
    expected = {
        "context": context.reshape(b, p, 18, l, l),
        "coefficient": coefficient,
        "aligned_spectra": eg["aligned_spectra"],
        "propagated_variance": eg["propagated_variance"],
    }
    tolerances = {
        "context": (4e-6, 4e-6),
        "coefficient": (4e-6, 3e-8),
        "aligned_spectra": (2e-8, 3e-12),
        "propagated_variance": (2e-8, 3e-16),
    }
    checks = 0
    maxima = {}
    for key, value in expected.items():
        value = real_values(select(value, list(range(p)), coords))
        actual = np.asarray(record["samples"][key])
        rtol, atol = tolerances[key]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, value, rtol=rtol, atol=atol)
        checks += value.size
        maxima[key] = float(abs(actual - value).max())
    return checks, maxima

from probe_saved_cfa_gain_grid import channel_gain, read, ref

def paired_predictions(model, batch, condition):
    """One shared FP32 forward; the correction never receives a target."""
    model.set_noise(condition["shot"], condition["read"])
    with amp_context(batch["packed"].device, dtype="float32"):
        original = model(*(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"]))
    corrected, gains = channel_gain(original, batch["packed"], batch["colors"])
    return original, corrected, gains


def model_hash(model):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
        value = value.detach().cpu().contiguous()
        result.update(name.encode() + str(value.dtype).encode() + str(tuple(value.shape)).encode())
        flat = value.reshape(-1).clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
        result.update(flat.view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
    return result.hexdigest()


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(plan_path):
    from audit_fresh_dino_statistics import audit_photo

    os.nice(5)
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    plan = read(plan_path)

        assert ref(item["path"]) == item
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
    assert psutil.disk_usage(root).free > 128 * 2**30
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized() and torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        24 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory, 0
    )
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    with (root / "claim").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(str(os.getpid()))
    started = time.monotonic()
    status = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(plan_path),
        "sources_done": 0,
        "actual_network_forwards": 0,
    }

    def record(state, **values):
        status.update(status=state, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        temporary = root / "status.tmp"
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(root / "status.json")
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {k: status[k] for k in ["status", "sources_done", "actual_network_forwards"]}
            ),

    try:
        record("loading-genuine-parent-for-shared-forward-photo-comparison")

        (output / "protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n")
        entries = [("photo", row["id"], i) for i, row in enumerate(data.rows)] + [
            ("synthetic", f"synthetic-{i}", i) for i in range(16)
        ]
        rows, fits, crops = [], [], []
        border = protocol["border"]
        trim = (slice(None), slice(None), slice(border, -border), slice(border, -border))
        with (
            (output / "per-image.jsonl").open("w") as stream,
            (output / "input-only-fits.jsonl").open("w") as fit_stream,
        ):
            for first in range(0, len(entries), 4):
                assert time.monotonic() - started < 7200
                assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 24 * 2**30
                current = entries[first : first + 4]
                rgb = torch.stack(
                    [
                        data[i]["rgb"]
                        if kind == "photo"
                        else synthetic(256, random.Random(1_000_000 + i))
                        for kind, _, i in current
                    ]
                ).cuda()
                ids = [identity for _, identity, _ in current]
                for condition in protocol["conditions"]:
                    for pattern in protocol["patterns"]:
                        batch = observation(
                            rgb,

                        status["actual_network_forwards"] += 1
                        for prediction in [original, corrected]:
                            assert (
                                prediction.dtype == torch.float32
                                and torch.isfinite(prediction).all()
                            )
                        noisy = malvar(batch["packed"], batch["colors"], batch["wb"])
                        predictions = [
                            (models[0]["label"], original),
                            (models[1]["label"], corrected),
                            ("Bilinear", bilinear(batch["packed"], batch["colors"])),

                        for i, (kind, identity, _) in enumerate(current):

                            fit_stream.write(json.dumps(fit, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                            fits.append(fit)
                        for label, prediction in predictions:

                            values = {k: v.cpu().tolist() for k, v in scores.items()}

                                rows.append(row)
                                if (

                                    record_model["gains"] = (
                                        gains[i].cpu().tolist()

                                    record_model["snapshot"] = str(plan_path)
                                    source = data.rows[source_index]
                                    cache = Path(plan["manifest"]["path"]).parent / source["cache"]
                                    shape = np.load(cache, mmap_mode="r").shape
                                    rng = random.Random(data.seed + source_index)

                                    crop = save_triplet(

                                        ],

                                            "reference": "Exact synthetic clean target",

                                    crops.append(crop)
                stream.flush()

                record(
                    "running-full427-shared-forward-FP32-photo-test",

                    case_rows=len(rows),
                    native_triplets=len(crops),

        assert len(rows) == 62020 and len(fits) == 12404 and len(crops) == 4

import argparse

import hashlib

from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
import yaml
from audit_flat_palette import identical, train_rows
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

import demosaic.train as training
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def main(config_path, parent, output):
    os.nice(5)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_available() and not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), "Hide CUDA"
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available / 2**30 > 32
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    assert shutil.disk_usage(output).free > 128 * 2**30
    parent_sha = sha(parent)
    source = {str(p): sha(p) for p in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    template = yaml.safe_load(Path(config_path).read_text())
    template.update(
        device="cpu",
        precision="float32",
        amp=False,
        channels_last=False,
        batch_size=1,
        patch_size=64,
        cpu_threads=2,
        workers=0,
        paired_workers=0,
        raw_clean_workers=0,
        steps=4000,
        warmup_steps=100,
        seed=48,
        log_every=1,
        trace_observations=True,
        checkpoint_every=4,
        validation_images=1,
        val_batches=1,
        min_available_gb=24,
        data_seed_per_step=True,
        experiment_notes="Discarded camera-supervision CPU engineering fixture only",
        reconstruction_objective="charbonnier-v1",
    )
    assert template["paired_fraction"] == template["raw_clean_fraction"] == 0.25
    template.pop("normalization_augmentation", None)
    plan = {
        "config": {"path": str(config_path), "sha256": sha(config_path)},
        "parent": {"path": str(parent), "sha256": parent_sha},
        "source_files": source,
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "template": template,
        "scope": "Four discarded updates per arm/B1/native64/CPU FP32/workers0 on the cleaned84867-source corpus. "
        "Real parent, frozen genuine DINO, actual Commons/native/paired data. "
        "Uninterrupted vs2+2 resume and matched legacy/input-only observation hashes. "
        "No GPU, production launch, convergence, timing or quality claim.",
    }
    (output / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, output / "source.py")
    parent_state = torch.load(parent, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    constructor = training.JointDemosaic
    prepare = training.prepare_training_batch
    current, expected, starts = {}, {}, []
    observations = {}

    def observe(*args, **kwargs):
        batch = prepare(*args, **kwargs)
        observations[current["label"]].append(
            {
                "step": args[0],
                "domain": args[1],
                "legacy_batch_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(
                    {k: v for k, v in batch.items() if k != "sensor_target"}
                ),
                "input_sha256": training.batch_fingerprint(
                    {
                        k: batch[k]
                        for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix", "shot", "read"]
                    }
                ),
                "sensor_target_present": "sensor_target" in batch,
            }
        )
        return batch

    def instrument(config):
        net = constructor(config)
        current["model"] = net
        seen = False

        def first_forward(module, args, kwargs):
            nonlocal seen
            if seen:
                return
            seen = True
            actual = module.restoration_state_dict()
            assert actual.keys() == expected["weights"].keys()
            for key in actual:
                assert torch.equal(actual[key], expected["weights"][key]), key
            assert all(
                not p.requires_grad and p.grad is None for p in module.context.backbone.parameters()
            )
            current["DINO_hash"] = model_hash(module.context.backbone)
            starts.append(
                {
                    "leg": expected["leg"],
                    "initial_weights_exact": True,
                    "DINO_hash": current["DINO_hash"],
                }
            )

        net.register_forward_pre_hook(first_forward, with_kwargs=True)
        return net

    rows, checkpoints = {}, {}
    try:
        training.JointDemosaic = instrument
        training.prepare_training_batch = observe
        for label, policy, resumed in [
            ("control", "reference-white-v1", False),
            ("sensor-full", "sensor-valid-v1", False),
            ("sensor-resumed", "sensor-valid-v1", True),
        ]:
            current["label"] = label
            observations[label] = []
            cfg = {**template, "run": str(output / label), "camera_supervision": policy}
            path = output / (label + ".yaml")
            path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg))
            expected.update(weights=parent_state["ema"], leg=label + "-initial")
            checkpoint = training.train(path, initialize=parent, stop_after=2 if resumed else 4)
            net = current.pop("model")
            assert model_hash(net.context.backbone) == current["DINO_hash"]
            assert all(p.grad is None for p in net.context.backbone.parameters())
            del net
            gc.collect()
            if resumed:
                step2 = output / "sensor-resumed-step2.pt"
                shutil.copyfile(checkpoint, step2)
                middle = torch.load(step2, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
                expected.update(weights=middle["model"], leg=label + "-resume-model")
                checkpoint = training.train(path, resume=step2, stop_after=2)
                net = current.pop("model")
                assert model_hash(net.context.backbone) == current["DINO_hash"]
                assert all(p.grad is None for p in net.context.backbone.parameters())
                del net, middle
                gc.collect()
            state = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
            assert state["step"] == 4 and state["config"]["steps"] == 4000
            assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 91
            assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 89
            for group in ["model", "ema"]:
                assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[group].values())
            for item in state["optimizer"]["state"].values():
                assert float(item["step"]) == 4

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": digest}


def stats(values):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    assert np.isfinite(values).all()
    return {
        "count": values.size,
        "mean": float(values.mean()),
        "median": float(np.median(values)),
        "p10": float(np.quantile(values, 0.1)),
        "p90": float(np.quantile(values, 0.9)),
        "minimum": float(values.min()),
        "maximum": float(values.max()),
