from pathlib import Path

import psutil

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
BASE = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic")
ROOT = BASE / "benchmarks/mixed16-packed-profile-after-quarter-v1"
STATUS = BASE / "runs/mixed16-packed-profile-after-quarter-v1.json"
REVIEW = BASE / "runs/packed-isotropic-mixed16-quarter-review-workflow-v1.json"
TERMINAL = "completed-mixed16-quarter-panels-statistics-artifacts-hue-sensitivities-and-parent-progress-awaiting-native-quality-review"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        sha = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(Path(path).resolve()), "sha256": sha}


def alive(owner):
    try:
        p = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        return p.create_time() == owner["created"] and p.status() != psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        return False


def guard(plan):
    for path, digest in {**plan["inputs"], **plan["guards"]}.items():
        assert ref(path)["sha256"] == digest, path


def gate(plan):
    status = read(plan["review_status"])
    if status["status"] != TERMINAL:
        raise RuntimeError("Complete quarter quality panels must finish before GPU profiling")
    assert status["controller"] == plan["review_owner"]
    assert all(not alive(status[k]) for k in ["controller", "child"])
    assert status["plan"] == plan["review_plan"] == ref(plan["review_plan"]["path"])
    review_plan = read(plan["review_plan"]["path"])
    for key in [
        "statistics",
        "hue",
        "artifacts",
        "supplementary",
        "source_sensitivity",
        "progress",
        "analytic",
    ]:
        assert status[key] == ref(status[key]["path"]), key
    # Run the frozen completed-boundary validator on CPU, with its exact source.
    sys.path[:0] = [review_plan["tools"], str(Path(review_plan["work"]) / "src")]
    import torch
    from review_mixed_packed_trial import completed

    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    _training, checkpoints, _evidence = completed(review_plan)
    assert checkpoints == status["checkpoints"]
    assert [c["path"] for c in checkpoints] == plan["checkpoints"]
    assert all(c["step"] == 10000 and c["example_draws"] == 160000 for c in checkpoints)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    return checkpoints


def prepare():
    assert not ROOT.exists() and not STATUS.exists()
    review = read(REVIEW)
    assert alive(review["controller"])
    assert review["plan"] == ref(review["plan"]["path"])
    previous = read(review["plan"]["path"])
    guard(previous)
    fixture = BASE / "benchmarks/packed-isotropic-compilation-inputs-v1/inputs.json"
    manifest = read(fixture)
    cpu_root = BASE / "benchmarks/mixed16-packed-profile-CPU-v1"
    cpu = [cpu_root / arm / "result.json" for arm in ["no-dino", "dino"]]
    for path, dino in zip(cpu, [False, True], strict=True):
        result = read(path)
        assert not result["CUDA_initialized"] and result["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] == 0
        assert result["hooked_unhooked_traced_RGB_bitwise_equal"]
        assert (
            result["model_and_actual_DINO_state_unchanged"] and result["CPU_and_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
        )
        assert (
            result["checkpoint"]["step"] == 2000
            and result["checkpoint"]["model_config"]["dino"] is dino
        )
        assert len(result["inclusive_branches"]) == (15 if dino else 13)
        assert all(v["calls"] == 2 for v in result["inclusive_branches"].values())
        for source, digest in result["helpers"].items():
            assert ref(source)["sha256"] == digest
    ROOT.mkdir()
    work = ROOT / "work"
    shutil.copytree(previous["work"], work, symlinks=True)
    for path in cpu:
        for source, digest in read(path)["source_files"].items():
            assert ref(work / "src/demosaic" / Path(source).name)["sha256"] == digest
    tools = ROOT / "tools"
    tools.mkdir()
    for name in ["profile_packed_inference.py", "profile_raw_kernel_inference.py"]:
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / "scripts" / name, tools / name)
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, ROOT / "controller.py")
    files = [
        fixture,
        Path(manifest["serving_probes"][0]["observation"]["path"]),
        Path(review["plan"]["path"]),
        *cpu,
    ]
    checkpoints = previous["checkpoints_to_evaluate"][:2]
    plan = {
        "python": previous["python"],
        "work": str(work),
        "tools": str(tools),
        "review_status": str(REVIEW),
        "review_plan": review["plan"],
        "review_owner": review["controller"],
        "checkpoints": checkpoints,
        "fixture": ref(fixture),
        "CPU_preflights": [ref(p) for p in cpu],
        "outputs": [
            str(BASE / f"benchmarks/mixed16-quarter-FP32-profile-{arm}-v1")
            for arm in ["no-dino", "dino"]
        ],
        "inputs": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in files},
        "guards": {
            str(p): ref(p)["sha256"]
            for p in ROOT.rglob("*")
            if p.is_file() and ".cache" not in p.parts
        },
        "scope": "Two unchanged actual10k/160k-example endpoints, serial IEEE FP32/native512/B4/channels-last. Three warmups, five synchronized unhooked samples, five hooked samples and one operator trace. Wait for exact complete numerical-quality controller/final child exit and independent completed training-boundary validator. CPU preflights verify instrumentation only. No optimization, compilation, new quality inference, training, production change or promotion; native manual review remains required. Inclusive ranges overlap; transfer/tiling/blending/decode/encode excluded. Never infer a GPU bottleneck from CPU timings or MAC counts.",
    }
    assert all(not Path(p).exists() for p in plan["outputs"])
    (ROOT / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + "\n")
    guard(plan)
    try:
        gate(plan)
    except RuntimeError as error:
        assert "Complete quarter" in str(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Live unfinished quality work was admitted")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "prepared": ref(ROOT / "plan.json"),
                "inputs": len(plan["inputs"]),
                "guards": len(plan["guards"]),
            }
        )
    )


def run():
    assert not STATUS.exists()
    plan = read(ROOT / "plan.json")
    guard(plan)
    info = {
        "controller": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan.json"),
        "previous_owner": plan["review_owner"],
        "completed": [],
    }

    def record(status, **values):
        info.update(status=status, updated_unix=time.time(), **values)
        temporary = STATUS.with_suffix(".tmp")
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(STATUS)

    record("waiting-for-exact-quarter-quality-owner-exit-no-GPU-profiling")
    try:
        while alive(plan["review_owner"]):
            time.sleep(15)
        guard(plan)
        checkpoints = gate(plan)
        env = {
            **os.environ,
            "PYTHONPATH": str(Path(plan["work"]) / "src") + ":" + plan["tools"],
            "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1",
            "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "2",
            "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "2",
        }
        for checkpoint, output in zip(checkpoints, plan["outputs"], strict=True):
            assert (
                psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
                and shutil.disk_usage(BASE).free > 500 * 2**30
            )
            guard(plan)
            with (ROOT / (checkpoint["arm"] + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        plan["python"],
                        "-P",
                        str(Path(plan["tools"]) / "profile_packed_inference.py"),
                        "--checkpoint",
                        checkpoint["path"],
                        "--inputs",
                        plan["fixture"]["path"],
                        "--output",
                        output,
                    ],
                    cwd=plan["work"],
                    env=env,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                record("profiling-actual-quarter-FP32-CUDA", arm=checkpoint["arm"], child=owner)
                try:
                    code = child.wait(timeout=300)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    child.terminate()
                    try:
                        child.wait(timeout=10)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        child.kill()
                        child.wait()
                    raise
                assert code == 0 and not alive(owner)
            result_path = Path(output) / "result.json"
            result = read(result_path)
            assert (
                result["status"] == "completed-packed-mixed16-bounded-FP32-CUDA-inference-profile"
            )
            assert (
                result["checkpoint"]["sha256"]
                == checkpoint["sha256"]
                == ref(checkpoint["path"])["sha256"]
            )
            assert result["checkpoint"]["step"] == 10000
            assert result["CUDA_initialized"] and result["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] > 0
            assert result["hooked_unhooked_traced_RGB_bitwise_equal"]
            assert (
                result["model_and_actual_DINO_state_unchanged"]
                and result["CPU_and_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
            )
            info["completed"].append(ref(result_path))
        guard(plan)
        record(
            "completed-bounded-mixed16-quarter-FP32-CUDA-profiles-awaiting-trace-analysis",
            quality_review=ref(plan["review_status"]),
            no_optimization_or_promotion=True,
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        record("failed-no-automatic-restart-or-promotion", error=repr(error))
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.prepare_only:
        prepare()
    else:
        with (REPO / ".cache/mixed16-packed-profile-after-quarter-v1.lock").open("a") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            run()

"""Audit completed corrected-grid exports and fixed-photo predictions on CPU."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import tifffile
import torch
from benchmark_packed_compilation import batch, difference, read, ref, sha
from evaluate_packed_grid import export_difference, scores
from review_packed_isotropic_quarter import completed

from demosaic.cfa import color_indices, malvar
from demosaic.reporting import display_crop, save_triplet
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

METRIC_REPLAY_ATOL = 1e-4


def legacy_frame(report, checkpoint):
    models = [m for m in report["models"] if m.get("sha256") == checkpoint["sha256"]]
    assert len(models) == 1, "Ambiguous or missing legacy checkpoint"
    model = models[0]
    assert model["precision"] == "float16" and model["device"] == "cuda"
    assert model["model_config"]["restoration_backbone"] == "packed-isotropic"
    frames = [f for f in report["full_frames"] if f["model_label"] == model["label"]]
    assert len(frames) == 1, "Ambiguous or missing legacy full-frame method"
    frame = frames[0]
    timing = frame["timing"]
    assert all(timing[k] == v for k, v in {"tile": 512, "overlap": 64, "batch_size": 4}.items())
    assert timing["compute_precision"] == "float16"
    assert timing.get("tile_grid_alignment", 2) == 2
    assert frame["display_exposure"] == 4
    files = [f for f in frame["files"] if f["path"].endswith("-linear16.tiff")]
    assert len(files) == 1
    return model, frame, files[0]


def audit_photos(directory, checkpoint, fixture):
    directory = Path(directory)
    report = read(directory / "receipt.json")
    assert report["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"]
    assert report["checkpoint"]["step"] == 40000
    assert report["device"] == "cuda" and report["precision"] == "float16"
    assert (
        report["CUDA_initialized"]
        and report["all_tensor_bytes_parameter_identities_and_keys_unchanged"]
    )
    assert len(report["cases"]) == 2 and len(report["native_crops"]) == 6
    audit = []
    for case, entry in zip(report["cases"], fixture["photos"], strict=True):
        assert case["source_id"] == entry["metadata"]["source"]["id"]
        assert case["observation"] == entry["observation"]
        values = batch(entry["observation"]["path"], torch.device("cpu"))
        predictions, maximum = {}, 0.0
        for policy in ["Whole", "Legacy", "Corrected"]:
            artifact = case["arrays"][policy]
            assert ref(artifact["path"]) == artifact
            prediction = np.load(artifact["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            assert prediction.shape == (3, 510, 510) and prediction.dtype == np.float32
            assert np.isfinite(prediction).all()
            predictions[policy] = prediction
            actual = scores(torch.from_numpy(prediction), values)
            expected = case["exact_synthetic_GT_metrics_border8"][policy]
            assert actual.keys() == expected.keys()
            for metric, value in actual.items():
                if value is None or expected[metric] is None:
                    assert value is expected[metric]
                else:
                    error = abs(value - expected[metric])
                    maximum = max(maximum, error)
                    assert error <= METRIC_REPLAY_ATOL, (policy, metric, error)
        for policy in ["Legacy", "Corrected"]:
            error = difference(
                predictions[policy][:, 128:-128, 128:-128],
                predictions["Whole"][:, 128:-128, 128:-128],
            )
            assert error == case["interior_exclude128_errors_against_whole"][policy]
        audit.append({"source_id": case["source_id"], "max_metric_replay_error": maximum})
    for crop in report["native_crops"]:
        assert sha(directory / crop["image"]) == crop["png_sha256"]
        assert crop["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"]
        assert crop["evaluation_tile_xywh"] == [176, 176, 160, 160]
        assert crop["display_exposure"] == 1
    return {"receipt": ref(directory / "receipt.json"), "metric_and_all_array_audit": audit}


def export_auditor(receipt):
    assert ref(receipt["path"]) == receipt
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("frozen_export_auditor", receipt["path"])
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.audit_exports


@torch.inference_mode()
def review(manifest_path, output):
    assert not torch.cuda.is_available() and not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), "Hide CUDA"
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    output = writable_path(output)
    assert not output.exists()
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    assert ref(manifest["review_plan"]["path"]) == manifest["review_plan"]
    _, _, checkpoints = completed(read(manifest["review_plan"]["path"]))
    assert checkpoints == manifest["checkpoints"]
    assert ref(manifest["fixture"]["path"]) == manifest["fixture"]
    fixture = read(manifest["fixture"]["path"])
    for path, expected in fixture["files"].items():
        assert sha(path) == expected, path
    assert ref(manifest["legacy_GFX_report"]["path"]) == manifest["legacy_GFX_report"]
    legacy_report = read(manifest["legacy_GFX_report"]["path"])
    assert legacy_report["sources"] == fixture["gfx_sources"]
    assert legacy_report["conditioning"] == fixture["conditioning"]
    legacy_folder = Path(manifest["legacy_GFX_report"]["path"]).parent
    audit_exports = export_auditor(manifest["export_auditor"])
    meta = fixture["gfx_metadata"]
    assert meta["flip"] == 0
    wb = torch.tensor(meta["white_balance"], dtype=torch.float32)[None]
    matrix = torch.tensor(meta["camera_to_srgb"], dtype=torch.float32)[None]
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    comparisons, crops, timings, photographs = [], [], [], []
    for checkpoint in checkpoints:
        arm = checkpoint["arm"]
        photographs.append(audit_photos(manifest["photo_outputs"][arm], checkpoint, fixture))
        folder = Path(manifest["full_outputs"][arm])
        current = read(folder / "receipt.json")
        assert current["status"] == "completed-full-frame-compilation-timing-case"
        assert current["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"]
        assert current["checkpoint"]["step"] == 40000
        assert current["policy"] == "eager" and current["backend"] is None
        assert current["compiled_components"] == 0
        assert current["parameters_keys_and_tensor_bytes_unchanged"]
        assert current["CUDA_initialized"] and current["device"] == "cuda"
        grid = 32 if arm == "dino" else 4
        samples = current["full_frame_samples"]
        assert len(samples) == 3 and len(current["repeat_pixel_errors"]) == 2
        assert all(e["passes_predeclared_bound"] for e in current["repeat_pixel_errors"])
        for sample in [current["excluded_warmup"], *(s["timing"] for s in samples)]:
            assert sample["tile_grid_alignment"] == grid and sample["tile_stride"] == 448
            assert sample["tile"] == 512 and sample["overlap"] == 64
            assert sample["batch_size"] == 4 and sample["tiles"] == 520
            assert sample["megapixels"] == 101.995852 and sample["compute_precision"] == "float16"
        # This frozen auditor checks every RGB16 pixel against the saved F32.
        values = audit_exports(current)
        for start in range(0, values.shape[1], 128):
            assert np.isfinite(values[:, start : start + 128]).all()
        model, frame, encoded = legacy_frame(legacy_report, checkpoint)
        assert model["model_config"] == current["checkpoint"]["model_config"]
        old_path = legacy_folder / encoded["path"]
        assert sha(old_path) == encoded["sha256"] and old_path.stat().st_size == encoded["bytes"]
        with tifffile.TiffFile(old_path) as tif:
            page = tif.pages[0]
            assert page.shape == (8746, 11662, 3) and page.bitspersample == 16
            assert json.loads(page.description)["color_space"] == "linear-camera-RGB"
        exports = {
            "Legacy RGB16": tifffile.memmap(old_path, mode="r"),
            "Corrected RGB16": tifffile.memmap(current["RGB16"]["path"], mode="r"),
        }
        comparisons.append(
            {
                "checkpoint": checkpoint,
                "legacy_model_label": model["label"],
                "legacy_export": ref(old_path),
                "corrected_export": current["RGB16"],
                "all_RGB16_pixels": export_difference(
                    exports["Corrected RGB16"], exports["Legacy RGB16"]
                ),
            }
        )
        seconds = [s["timing"]["seconds"] for s in samples]
        timings.append(
            {
                "arm": arm,
                "corrected_seconds": seconds,
                "median_seconds": float(np.median(seconds)),
                "range_seconds": [min(seconds), max(seconds)],
                "legacy_historical_single_run_seconds": frame["timing"]["seconds"],
                "scope": "Three corrected restores after one excluded full warmup; historical legacy run is not a concurrent speed control",
                "repeat_pixel_errors": current["repeat_pixel_errors"],
                "full_receipt": ref(folder / "receipt.json"),
            }
        )
        for entry in fixture["gfx_regions"]:
            region = entry["region"]
            x, y = region["noisy_xy"]
            size = region["size"]
            tx, ty, _, _ = entry["context_xywh"]
            packed = torch.from_numpy(
                np.load(entry["noisy_packed"]["path"], allow_pickle=False).copy()
            )
            noisy = display_crop(
                malvar(packed, color_indices(meta["pattern"])[None], wb),
                wb,
                matrix,
                [x - tx, y - ty, size, size],
                exposure=4,
            )
            reference = torch.from_numpy(
                np.load(entry["reference_RGB"]["path"], allow_pickle=False).copy()
            )
            reference = display_crop(reference, wb, matrix, [0, 0, size, size], exposure=4)
            for policy, encoded_values in exports.items():
                rgb = encoded_values[y : y + size, x : x + size].astype(np.float32) / np.float32(
                    65535
                )
                display = display_crop(
                    torch.from_numpy(rgb.transpose(2, 0, 1).copy())[None],
                    wb,
                    matrix,
                    [0, 0, size, size],
                    exposure=4,
                )
                crops.append(
                    save_triplet(
                        output,
                        arm + ":" + region["name"] + ":" + policy,
                        [
                            ("Noisy (Malvar)", noisy),
                            (policy, display),
                            ("ISO100 ref (not GT)", reference),
                        ],
                        caption=arm + " / " + region["name"] + " / " + policy,
                        metadata={
                            "checkpoint": checkpoint,
                            "policy": policy,
                            "region": region,
                            "tile_grid_alignment": 2 if policy.startswith("Legacy") else grid,
                            "conditioning": fixture["conditioning"],
                            "shared_wb": meta["white_balance"],
                            "shared_matrix": meta["camera_to_srgb"],
                            "display_exposure": 4,
                            "sources": fixture["gfx_sources"],
                            "reference": entry["reference"],
                            "full_frame": True,
                            "display_encoding": "8-bit sRGB preview; both method panels decode the recorded RGB16 exports",
                            "output_sample_encoding": "Both method panels use decoded camera-linear RGB16 exports; not unquantized F32",
                        },
                    )
                )
    assert len(crops) == 4 * len(fixture["gfx_regions"]) and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    result = {
        "status": "completed-corrected-grid-CUDA-photos-and-full-RGB16-awaiting-native-visual-review",
        "checkpoints": checkpoints,
        "photo_audits": photographs,
        "all_export_pixel_comparisons": comparisons,
        "timings": timings,
        "native_GFX_triplets": crops,
        "GT_metric_replay_absolute_tolerance": METRIC_REPLAY_ATOL,
        "CPU_audit_CUDA_initialized": False,
        "no_automatic_model_or_compute_policy_promotion": True,
        "scope": "Supplement to the unchanged full40k quality review. All RGB16 export pixels "
        "are compared; clipping/quantization differs from unquantized-F32 equivalence. Both "
        "displayed method panels use the same RGB16 decoding, WB/matrix/exposure. Real ISO100 "
        "refs are not GT. No training, protected-final scoring, output correction, compilation "
        "or automatic promotion. Native visual review remains required.",
    }
    (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    review(args.manifest, args.output)

"""Verify a fresh, matched no-context / DINO-S / DINO-B comparison on CPU."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import yaml

from demosaic.cfa import PATTERNS, color_indices
from demosaic.model import JointDemosaic, ModelConfig
from demosaic.pretrained_rgb import initialize_rgb_prior
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def common_config(config):
    result = {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k not in ("run", "experiment_notes")}
    result["model"] = ModelConfig(**config["model"]).to_dict()
    for field in ("dino", "dino_model", "dino_revision"):
        result["model"].pop(field)
    return result


@torch.no_grad()
def preflight(config_paths, output):
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")
    models, entries, lineages = [], [], []
    code = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py")}
    snapshot = output / "source"
    snapshot.mkdir()
    for name, payload in code.items():
        (snapshot / name).write_bytes(payload)
    for name in ("pyproject.toml", "uv.lock"):
        (snapshot / name).write_bytes(Path(name).read_bytes())
    (snapshot / Path(__file__).name).write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    configs = [yaml.safe_load(Path(p).read_text()) for p in config_paths]
    if len(configs) != 3 or not all(common_config(c) == common_config(configs[0]) for c in configs):
        raise ValueError("Expected three recipes differing only in DINO branch/backbone and run notes")
    if sum(c["model"]["dino"] for c in configs) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two frozen DINO arms and one no-context control")
    for config_path, config in zip(config_paths, configs):
        torch.manual_seed(config["seed"])
        model = JointDemosaic(ModelConfig(**config["model"])).cpu().eval()
        lineages.append(
            initialize_rgb_prior(model, config["gaussian_initialization"], archive=output)
        )
        assert all(p.device.type == "cpu" for p in model.parameters())
        projection = model.pretrained_rgb.measurement_adapter
        assert torch.count_nonzero(projection.weight) == torch.count_nonzero(projection.bias) == 0
        backbone = None
        if model.context is not None:
            assert not model.config.dino_lora_rank
            assert torch.count_nonzero(model.context.gate) == 0
            assert all(not p.requires_grad for p in model.context.backbone.parameters())
            assert model.context.backbone.config._commit_hash == config["model"]["dino_revision"]
            backbone = {
                "repo": model.config.dino_model,
                "revision": model.config.dino_revision,
                "parameters": sum(p.numel() for p in model.context.backbone.parameters()),
                "hidden_size": model.context.backbone.config.hidden_size,
                "adapter_input_channels": model.context.adapter.in_channels,
            }
        models.append(model)
        entries.append(
            {
                "path": str(config_path),
                "sha256": digest(config_path),
                "config": config,
                "backbone": backbone,
                "parameters": sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),
                "trainable_parameters": sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
            }
        )
        (snapshot / Path(config_path).name).write_bytes(Path(config_path).read_bytes())
    states = [
        {k: v for k, v in m.state_dict().items() if not k.startswith("context.")}
        for m in models
    ]
    assert all(s.keys() == states[0].keys() for s in states)
    assert all(torch.equal(value, s[name]) for s in states[1:] for name, value in states[0].items())
    common_digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, value in sorted(states[0].items()):
        common_digest.update(
            json.dumps(
                {"name": name, "dtype": str(value.dtype), "shape": list(value.shape)},
                sort_keys=True,
            ).encode()
            + b"\0"
        )
        common_digest.update(value.detach().contiguous().reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
    colors = torch.stack([color_indices(pattern) for pattern in PATTERNS])
    wb = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 1.5]]).expand(4, -1)
    matrix = torch.tensor([[1.1, -0.08, -0.02], [-0.03, 1.06, -0.03], [-0.01, -0.1, 1.11]])
    matrix = matrix[None].expand(4, -1, -1)
    checks = []
    for height, width in [(16, 16), (24, 32)]:
        raw = torch.rand(4, 4, height, width, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(48)) * 0.3
        for shot, read in [(0.0, 0.0), (0.00002, 0.0000000016), (0.00256, 0.0000262144)]:
            variance = raw * shot + read
            for precision in ["float32", "bfloat16"]:
                with torch.autocast("cpu", enabled=precision != "float32", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
                    predictions = [
                        model.set_noise(shot, read)(raw, variance, colors, wb, matrix)
                        for model in models
                    ]
                assert all(p.dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(p).all() for p in predictions)
                assert all(torch.equal(predictions[0], p) for p in predictions[1:])
                checks.append(
                    {
                        "native_hw": [2 * height, 2 * width],
                        "shot": shot,
                        "read": read,
                        "compute_precision": precision,
                        "all_four_cfas_exact": True,
                    }
                )
    assert all(Path("src/demosaic", n).read_bytes() == value for n, value in code.items())
    result = {
        "status": "CPU genuine-weight initialization/forward preflight only; no GPU or trained quality claim",
        "configs": entries,
        "lineages": lineages,
        "common_state_tensors": len(states[0]),
        "common_state_sha256": common_digest.hexdigest(),
        "common_tensors_exact": True,
        "zero_measurement_and_context_gates": True,
        "original_foundation_parameters_frozen": True,
        "cpu_forward_checks": checks,
        "white_balance": wb[0].tolist(),
        "camera_matrix": matrix[0].tolist(),
        "torch": torch.__version__,
        "cuda_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
        "source_files": {name: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for name, value in code.items()},
        "driver_sha256": digest(__file__),
        "limitation": "Three fresh Gaussian initializers, no inherited JDD/DINO history. Backbone width changes the context adapter width. GPU backward/memory and matched training/quality/convergence still require verification.",
    }
    assert not result["cuda_initialized"]
    (output / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in ("source_files", "configs", "lineages")}),
        flush=True,
    )
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--configs", nargs=3, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    preflight(args.configs, args.output)

"""Isolated eager/compiled comparison after a genuine V67 inference profile.

Compile only seven pure neural blocks; retain weights, precision, physical code,
inputs and model configuration. CUDA mode needs the actual final10000 profile.
CPU mode is an engineering fixture, never CUDA timing or quality evidence.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import load_inputs, model_hash, sha
from torch._dynamo.utils import counters
from torch._inductor import metrics

from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.precision import amp_context
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

BLOCKS = ("m_down1", "m_down2", "m_down3", "m_body", "m_up3", "m_up2", "m_up1")


def differences(actual, expected):
    delta = actual.double() - expected.double()
    return [
        {
            "image_index": i,
            "maximum_absolute_difference": float(row.abs().max()),
            "RMS_difference": float(row.square().mean().sqrt()),
            "bitwise_equal": torch.equal(actual[i], expected[i]),
        }
        for i, row in enumerate(delta)
    ]


@torch.inference_mode()
def main(profile_result, output, device="cuda", warmup=3, forwards=5, order="ABBABAAB"):
    os.nice(5)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    device = torch.device(device)
    cpu = device.type == "cpu"
    profile = json.loads(profile_result.read_text())
    if cpu:
        assert not torch.cuda.is_available() and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
        assert profile["status"] == "completed-real-V67-CPU-profiler-preflight-no-GPU-timing"
        assert profile["checkpoint"]["step"] == 2000 and order == "AB"
    else:
        assert device.type == "cuda" and warmup == 3 and forwards == 5 and order == "ABBABAAB"
        assert profile["status"] == "completed-real-V67-bounded-CUDA-inference-profile"
        assert profile["checkpoint"]["step"] == 10000 and profile["genuine_CUDA_trace_events"] > 0
    assert warmup >= 1 and forwards >= 1
    assert profile["all_hooked_unhooked_profiled_outputs_bitwise_reference"]
    assert (
        profile["model_and_actual_DINO_state_unchanged"] and profile["CPU_and_CUDA_RNG_unchanged"]
    )
    available = psutil.virtual_memory().available / 1e9
    assert available > (32 if cpu else 40)
    memory_policy = {"available_GB": available, "allocator_cap_GB": None}
    if not cpu:
        total = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
        fraction = min((available - 24) * 1e9 / total, 0.75)
        torch.cuda.memory.set_per_process_memory_fraction(fraction, 0)
        memory_policy.update(allocator_cap_GB=fraction * total / 1e9, reserve_GB=24)
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    checkpoint = profile["checkpoint"]
    assert sha(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint["sha256"]
    batch, provenance = load_inputs(
        Path(profile["inputs"]["report"]), device, profile["batch_size"], profile["native_size"]
    )
    assert provenance == profile["inputs"]
    model, state = load_checkpoint(checkpoint["path"], device)
    assert state["loaded_sha256"] == checkpoint["sha256"] and state["step"] == checkpoint["step"]
    del state
    model.eval()
    if not cpu:
        model.to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    model.set_noise(provenance["conditioning"]["shot"], provenance["conditioning"]["read"])
    before = model_hash(model)
    assert before == profile["model_and_actual_DINO_state_hash_before_after"]
    original_config = model.config.to_dict()
    cpu_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
    cuda_rng = torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone() if not cpu else None
    reference_path = profile_result.parent / "unchanged-reference-f32.npy"
    reference = torch.from_numpy(np.load(reference_path, allow_pickle=False)).to(device)

    def synchronize():
        if not cpu:
            torch.cuda.synchronize(device)

    def forward():
        with amp_context(device, dtype="float32" if cpu else "float16"):
            return model(*batch)

    for _ in range(warmup):
        actual = forward()
        assert torch.equal(actual, reference), "Eager output differs from the genuine prior profile"
    synchronize()
    blocks = {name: getattr(model.pretrained_rgb.network, name) for name in BLOCKS}
    assert all(block._compiled_call_impl is None for block in blocks.values())
    counters.clear()
    metrics.reset()
    compile_started = time.monotonic()
    for block in blocks.values():
        block.compile(backend="inductor", fullgraph=True, dynamic=False)
    for _ in range(warmup):
        compiled = forward()
    synchronize()
    assert compiled.dtype == torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(compiled).all()
    assert torch.equal(forward(), compiled), "Compiled forward is not repeatable"
    compiled_calls = {name: block._compiled_call_impl for name, block in blocks.items()}
    assert all(call is not None for call in compiled_calls.values())
    assert {
        name for name, part in model.named_modules() if part._compiled_call_impl is not None
    } == {"pretrained_rgb.network." + name for name in BLOCKS}
    assert counters["stats"]["unique_graphs"] >= 7
    compile_seconds = time.monotonic() - compile_started
    errors = differences(compiled, reference)
    numerical_pass = all(
        row["maximum_absolute_difference"] <= 1e-5 and row["RMS_difference"] <= 1e-6
        for row in errors
    )
    np.save(output / "eager-reference-f32.npy", reference.cpu().numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
    np.save(output / "compiled-f32.npy", compiled.cpu().numpy(), allow_pickle=False)
    measured_cpu_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
    measured_cuda_rng = torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone() if not cpu else None
    records = []
    if numerical_pass:
        for index, policy in enumerate(order):
            for name, block in blocks.items():
                block._compiled_call_impl = compiled_calls[name] if policy == "B" else None
            # Exclude one policy-switch warmup from every timing block.
            actual = forward()
            assert torch.equal(actual, reference if policy == "A" else compiled)
            synchronize()
            if not cpu:
                torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device)
            start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) if not cpu else None
            end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) if not cpu else None
            began = time.perf_counter()
            if start is not None:
                start.record()
            for _ in range(forwards):
                actual = forward()
            if end is not None:
                end.record()
            synchronize()
            wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - began) * 1000 / forwards
            assert torch.equal(actual, reference if policy == "A" else compiled)
            row = {
                "block": index,
                "policy": "eager" if policy == "A" else "compiled-neural-blocks",
                "forwards": forwards,
                "synchronized_wall_ms_per_forward": wall_ms,
                "CUDA_ms_per_forward": start.elapsed_time(end) / forwards
                if start is not None
                else None,
                "peak_CUDA_GB": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) / 1e9 if not cpu else None,
            }
            records.append(row)
            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    assert torch.equal(torch.get_rng_state(), measured_cpu_rng)
    if not cpu:
        assert torch.equal(torch.cuda.get_rng_state(), measured_cuda_rng)
    assert model_hash(model) == before and model.config.to_dict() == original_config
    assert sha(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint["sha256"]
    medians = (
        {
            policy: statistics.median(
                row["synchronized_wall_ms_per_forward"]
                for row in records
                if row["policy"] == policy
            )
            for policy in ["eager", "compiled-neural-blocks"]
        }
        if numerical_pass
        else None
    )
    result = {
        "status": "completed-CPU-compiled-trial-engineering-fixture"
        if cpu
        else "completed-bounded-CUDA-compiled-neural-block-trial",
        "profile_result": {"path": str(profile_result), "sha256": sha(profile_result)},
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "inputs": provenance,
        "batch_size": profile["batch_size"],
        "native_size": profile["native_size"],
        "device": str(device),
        "neural_compute_precision": "float32" if cpu else "float16",
        "physical_compute_precision": "float32",
        "hardware": "CPU engineering fixture" if cpu else torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
        "compiled_blocks": list(BLOCKS),
        "only_seven_pure_neural_blocks_compiled": True,
        "actual_unique_graphs": counters["stats"]["unique_graphs"],
        "generated_kernels_including_cache_metadata": metrics.generated_kernel_count,
        "compilation_and_warmup_seconds_excluded": compile_seconds,
        "prespecified_numerical_thresholds": {
            "maximum_absolute_difference": 1e-5,
            "RMS_difference": 1e-6,
        },
        "per_image_numerical_differences": errors,
        "numerical_gate_pass": numerical_pass,
        "timing_skipped_for_numerical_failure": not numerical_pass,
        "warmup_per_policy": warmup,
        "excluded_switch_warmups": len(records),
        "order": order,
        "timing_blocks": records,
        "median_synchronized_wall_ms": medians,
        "eager_over_compiled_wall_ratio": medians["eager"] / medians["compiled-neural-blocks"]
        if medians
        else None,
        "baseline_bitwise_prior_profile_reference": True,
        "all_measured_outputs_bitwise_their_policy_reference": True if records else None,
        "all_model_and_actual_DINO_state_SHA256_unchanged": before,
        "model_config_and_checkpoint_unchanged": True,
        "all_measured_forward_RNG_unchanged": True if records else None,
        "compilation_and_warmup_CPU_RNG_unchanged": torch.equal(cpu_rng, measured_cpu_rng),
        "compilation_and_warmup_CUDA_RNG_unchanged": torch.equal(cuda_rng, measured_cuda_rng)
        if not cpu
        else None,
        "CUDA_initialized": torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
        "memory_policy": memory_policy,
        "arrays": {
            name: sha(output / name) for name in ["eager-reference-f32.npy", "compiled-f32.npy"]
        },
        "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
        "scope": "Isolated process-local seven neural blocks compiled with Inductor/fullgraph/static, original model/weights/FP16-neural physicalFP32 precision/inputs/defaults preserved. Exact eager equality to actual profile reference, per-image numerical gate before timing, excluded initial/compile and switch warmups, ABBA/BAAB block timing. Both timing policies retain compiled-cache allocations. Sum or median is not full-frame throughput or idle hardware performance; shared machine. Numerical acceptance is an engineering bound, not preserved image quality or promotion. CPU fixture uses original real2k B1/native256/FP32 and AB only; no CUDA timing or equivalence claim. No training/export/source/config/production batch or precision change. Full quality/native/full-frame checks remain necessary.",
    }
    (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps({"result": str(output / "result.json"), "status": result["status"]}), flush=True
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--profile-result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--device", choices=["cpu", "cuda"], default="cuda")
    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--forwards", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--order", default="ABBABAAB")
    main(**vars(parser.parse_args()))

"""Audit exact mixed-scene quiet errors and render unscaled diagnostic crops."""

import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar


def independent_display(value, arrays, roi, exposure):
    rgb = np.einsum(
        "bij,bjhw->bihw",
        arrays["matrix"].astype(np.float64),
        value.astype(np.float64) * exposure * arrays["wb"].astype(np.float64)[..., None, None],
    ).clip(0, 1)
    rgb = np.where(rgb <= 0.0031308, 12.92 * rgb, 1.055 * rgb ** (1 / 2.4) - 0.055)
    x, y, w, h = roi
    return np.rint(rgb[0, :, y : y + h, x : x + w].transpose(1, 2, 0) * 255).astype(np.uint8)


def main(root):
    point = root / "mixed-quiet-v1"
    plan = read(point / "plan-v1.json")
    result = read(point / "result-v1.json")
    assert result["plan"] == ref(point / "plan-v1.json")
    assert result["counts"] == {"parent": 32, "DINO": 32, "raw-step1000": 32, "EMA-step1000": 32}
    rows = defaultdict(dict)
    for row in result["rows"]:
        assert row["method"] not in rows[row["id"]]
        rows[row["id"]][row["method"]] = row
    scalar_checks = 0
    out = point / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    images = []
    channels = 0
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    for case in plan["observations"]:
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        values = {}
        for label, row in rows[case["id"]].items():
            assert ref(row["prediction"]["path"]) == row["prediction"]
            values[label] = np.load(row["prediction"]["path"])
        assert set(values) == {"parent", "raw-step1000", "EMA-step1000"}
        # Independently form each160x160 quiet channel from explicit slices.
        for label, value in values.items():
            e = value.astype(np.float64) - a["target"].astype(np.float64)
            crop = np.stack([e[0, c, 176:336, 80:240] for c in range(3)])
            dc = crop.mean((1, 2))
            delta = value[..., 176:336, 80:240].astype(np.float64) - values["parent"][
                ..., 176:336, 80:240
            ].astype(np.float64)
            actual = {
                "full_RMS_DN16": np.sqrt(np.mean(e * e)) * 65535,
                "quiet_RMS_DN16": np.sqrt(np.mean(crop * crop)) * 65535,
                "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16": np.sqrt(np.mean((crop - dc[:, None, None]) ** 2)) * 65535,
                "quiet_correction_RMS_DN16": np.sqrt(np.mean(delta * delta)) * 65535,
            }
            for key, number in actual.items():
                assert abs(rows[case["id"]][label][key] - number) < 1e-10
                scalar_checks += 1
        if case["pattern"] != "RGGB":
            continue
        noisy = noisy_malvar(a)
        for name, roi, contrast in (
            ("quiet", case["quiet_ROI_xywh"], 40),
            ("edge", case["edge_ROI_xywh"], 1),
        ):
            anchor = (
                a["target"][..., 176:336, 80:240].mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True).astype(np.float64)
            )
            labels = [
                "Noisy Malvar",
                "V143 parent",
                "V147 raw1000",
                "V147 EMA1000",
                "Exact constructed GT",
            ]
            sources = [
                noisy,
                values["parent"],
                values["raw-step1000"],
                values["EMA-step1000"],
                a["target"],
            ]
            board = Image.new("RGB", (848, 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4),
                f"{case['id']} | {name}, contrast{contrast}, exposure8",
                font=font,
                fill="black",
            )
            panels = []
            for j, (label, source) in enumerate(zip(labels, sources, strict=True)):
                transformed = anchor + contrast * (source.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(transformed, a, roi, 8)
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(cell, independent_display(transformed, a, roi, 8))
                assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                xywh = [8 + j * 168, 44, 160, 160]
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), xywh[:2])
                draw.text((xywh[0], 24), label, font=font, fill="black")
                panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": xywh})
                channels += cell.size
            dest = out / f"{case['id']}-{name}.png"
            board.save(dest)
            actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
            for panel, source in zip(panels, sources, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                    actual[y : y + h, x : x + w],
                    independent_display(
                        anchor + contrast * (source.astype(np.float64) - anchor), a, roi, 8
                    ),
                )
            images.append(
                {
                    "image": ref(dest),
                    "case": case,
                    "ROI_xywh": roi,
                    "exposure": 8,
                    "contrast_about_quiet_GT": contrast,
                    "camera_RGB_anchor": anchor.ravel().tolist(),
                    "panels": panels,
                    "no_resize": True,
                }
            )
    assert scalar_checks == 384 and len(images) == 16 and channels == 6144000
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in result["rows"]:
        groups[row["method"], row["noise"]].append(row)
    summary = [
        {
            "method": method,
            "noise": noise,
            "cases": len(group),
            **{
                k: float(np.mean([r[k] for r in group]))
                for k in (
                    "full_RMS_DN16",
                    "quiet_RMS_DN16",
                    "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16",
                    "quiet_correction_RMS_DN16",
                )
            },
        }
        for (method, noise), group in groups.items()
    ]
    sheets = []
    for i in range(0, 16, 4):
        sheet = Image.new("RGB", (848, 848), "white")
        for j, item in enumerate(images[i : i + 4]):
            board = Image.open(item["image"]["path"])
            sheet.paste(board, (0, 212 * j))
        dest = out / f"sheet-{i // 4:02d}.png"
        sheet.save(dest)
        reread = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for j, item in enumerate(images[i : i + 4]):
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                reread[j * 212 : (j + 1) * 212], np.asarray(Image.open(item["image"]["path"]))
            )
        sheets.append({"image": ref(dest), "indices": list(range(i, i + 4)), "no_resize": True})
    save(
        point / "report-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass-independent-metrics-and-native-pixels",
            "result": ref(point / "result-v1.json"),
            "reporter": ref(__file__),
            "scalar_checks": scalar_checks,
            "RGB_channels_checked": channels,
            "summary": summary,
            "images": images,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Quiet rectangle80,176,160,160 is exact constant target; this does not assert the entire left quarter of every analytic scene is constant. Exposure8 shared; quiet contrast40 about exact target, edge contrast1. Native160 pixels, no resize.",
        },
    )
    print("PASS384 mixed-scene scalar checks and6144000 native RGB channels")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Inspect paired training-target residuals; never edit data or score a model."""

import os

os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "2")
os.environ.setdefault("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "2")

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from demosaic.cfa import PATTERNS
from demosaic.safety import writable_path


def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def correlation(a, b, valid):
    if valid.sum() < 64:
        return None
    x, y = a[valid], b[valid]
    denominator = np.sqrt(np.dot(x, x) * np.dot(y, y))
    return float(np.clip(np.dot(x, y) / denominator, -1, 1)) if denominator > 0 else None


def residual_diagnostics(raw, reference, valid, pattern, shot, read):
    raw, reference = np.asarray(raw, np.float64), np.asarray(reference, np.float64)
    valid = np.asarray(valid, bool)
    if raw.ndim != 2 or reference.shape != (3, *raw.shape) or valid.shape != reference.shape:
        raise ValueError("Expected a Bayer plane and matching RGB reference/mask")
    if pattern not in PATTERNS or min(raw.shape) < 16:
        raise ValueError("Expected a supported Bayer pattern and useful crop size")
    if not np.isfinite(raw).all() or not np.isfinite(reference).all():
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite paired measurements")
    if not np.isfinite([shot, read]).all() or min(shot, read) < 0:
        raise ValueError("Expected finite nonnegative conditioning")
    phases = []
    design, rhs = np.zeros((2, 2)), np.zeros(2)
    fit_samples = 0
    for phase, color in enumerate(PATTERNS[pattern]):
        y, x = divmod(phase, 2)
        observed, target = raw[y::2, x::2], reference[color, y::2, x::2]
        usable = valid[color, y::2, x::2] & (target > 0.005) & (target < 0.95) & (observed < 0.99)
        n = int(usable.sum())
        if n < 128:
            phases.append({"phase": phase, "color": color, "samples": n})
            continue
        sigma = np.sqrt(shot * target.clip(0) + read + 1 / (12 * 65535**2))
        residual = (observed - target) / sigma
        mean = float(residual[usable].mean())
        centered = residual - mean
        cx = correlation(centered[:, 1:], centered[:, :-1], usable[:, 1:] & usable[:, :-1])
        cy = correlation(centered[1:], centered[:-1], usable[1:] & usable[:-1])
        phases.append(
            {
                "phase": phase,
                "color": color,
                "samples": n,
                "mean_noise_units": mean,
                "rms_noise_units": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual[usable] ** 2))),
                "lag2_sensor_x": cx,
                "lag2_sensor_y": cy,
            }
        )
        # Same-color phase neighbors are two sensor pixels apart. Central
        # differences therefore span four native sensor pixels.
        gx = (target[1:-1, 2:] - target[1:-1, :-2]) / 4 / sigma[1:-1, 1:-1]
        gy = (target[2:, 1:-1] - target[:-2, 1:-1]) / 4 / sigma[1:-1, 1:-1]
        fit = (
            usable[1:-1, 1:-1]
            & usable[1:-1, 2:]
            & usable[1:-1, :-2]
            & usable[2:, 1:-1]
            & usable[:-2, 1:-1]
        )
        if fit.sum() < 128:
            continue
        g = np.stack([gx[fit], gy[fit]], axis=1)
        e = residual[1:-1, 1:-1][fit]
        g -= g.mean(0)
        e -= e.mean()
        design += g.T @ g
        rhs += g.T @ e
        fit_samples += len(e)
    correlations = [
        p[k] for p in phases for k in ["lag2_sensor_x", "lag2_sensor_y"] if p.get(k) is not None
    ]
    condition = float(np.linalg.cond(design))
    shift = (
        np.linalg.solve(design, rhs).tolist()
        if np.isfinite(condition) and condition < 1e5 and fit_samples >= 512
        else None
    )
    return {
        "phases": phases,
        "samples": sum(p["samples"] for p in phases),
        "mean_phase_lag_correlation": float(np.mean(correlations)) if correlations else None,
        "first_order_shift_xy_sensor_pixels": shift,
        "shift_fit_samples": fit_samples,
        "shift_design_condition": condition if np.isfinite(condition) else None,
    }


def diagnose(manifest, output):
    manifest = Path(manifest).resolve()
    payload = manifest.read_bytes()
    input_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    driver = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(payload)
    if data["split"] not in ["train", "quarantine"]:
        raise ValueError("Diagnose only training/quarantine data; held-out scoring stays closed")
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (output / "acquisition-or-prepared-manifest.json").write_bytes(payload)
    (output / Path(__file__).name).write_bytes(driver)
    rows, grouped = [], defaultdict(list)
    for case in data["cases"]:
        for crop in case["crops"]:
            path = manifest.parent / crop["path"]
            if sha(path) != crop["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Paired target crop checksum changed")
            with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
                result = residual_diagnostics(
                    arrays["raw"],
                    arrays["sensor_reference"],
                    arrays["sensor_mask"],
                    case["metadata"]["pattern"],
                    case["conditioning"]["shot"],
                    case["conditioning"]["read"],
                )
            row = {
                "scene": case["scene"],
                "camera": case["metadata"]["camera"],
                "iso": case["metadata"].get("iso"),
                "noisy_sha256": case["noisy"]["sha256"],
                "crop": crop,
                **result,
            }
            rows.append(row)
            grouped[(row["scene"], row["noisy_sha256"])].append(row)
    (output / "per-crop.jsonl").write_text(
        "".join(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
    )
    cases = []
    for (scene, source), values in grouped.items():
        correlations = [
            r["mean_phase_lag_correlation"]
            for r in values
            if r["mean_phase_lag_correlation"] is not None
        ]
        shifts = [
            r["first_order_shift_xy_sensor_pixels"]
            for r in values
            if r["first_order_shift_xy_sensor_pixels"] is not None
        ]
        cases.append(
            {
                "scene": scene,
                "noisy_sha256": source,
                "camera": values[0]["camera"],
                "iso": values[0]["iso"],
                "crops": len(values),
                "median_phase_lag_correlation": float(np.median(correlations))
                if correlations
                else None,
                "median_first_order_shift_xy": np.median(shifts, axis=0).tolist()
                if shifts
                else None,
            }
        )
    cases.sort(
        key=lambda c: (
            c["median_phase_lag_correlation"]
            if c["median_phase_lag_correlation"] is not None
            else -2
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )
    summary = {
        "manifest": str(manifest),
        "manifest_sha256": input_sha256,
        "script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(driver).hexdigest(),
        "case_count": len(cases),
        "crop_count": len(rows),
        "cases": cases,
        "per_crop_sha256": sha(output / "per-crop.jsonl"),
        "scope": "Training/quarantine data diagnostic only; no target edits, model prediction or held-out scoring.",
        "method": "Measured same-color CFA residuals normalized by declared shot/read plus ADC variance; phase-centered lag correlation at2 sensor pixels, first-order gradient fit for a rough x/y translation descriptor.",
        "selection": "Reference mask, target in(.005,.95), observed<.99, >=128 samples/phase. No rejection/admission threshold is applied.",
        "limitations": "Reference noise is omitted from the normalization proxy. Real correlated sensor noise, gain/black-level errors, defocus, motion, interpolation and clipping can cause correlation or apparent shifts. Neither a nonzero fit nor correlation proves misregistration. Inspect native pairs; do not automatically change targets or evaluation.",
    }
    assert sha(manifest) == summary["manifest_sha256"] and sha(__file__) == summary["script_sha256"]
    (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps({"cases": len(cases), "crops": len(rows), "inspection_priorities": cases[:8]}),
        flush=True,
    )
    return summary


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("manifest", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    diagnose(args.manifest, args.output)

"""Acquire explicitly CC0 low-ISO RAW candidates into quarantine, never training."""

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

from demosaic import paired, safety
from demosaic.paired import download_file
from demosaic.safety import writable_path

CC0 = "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/"


def checksum(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, text):
        super().__init__()
        self.hrefs, self.checksums = [], []
        self.in_checksum = False
        self.feed(text)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == "a" and "href" in attrs:
            self.hrefs.append(attrs["href"])
        if tag == "span":
            self.in_checksum = attrs.get("title", "").lower() == "sha256 checksum"

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == "span":
            self.in_checksum = False

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_checksum and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", data.strip()):
            self.checksums.append(data.strip().lower())


def select_candidates(survey_path, catalog_path):
    survey = json.loads(Path(survey_path).read_text())
    if checksum(catalog_path) != survey["catalog_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Survey/catalog checksum mismatch")
    catalog = json.loads(Path(catalog_path).read_text())["data"]
    records, identities = [], set()
    for candidate in survey["scouted"]:
        matches = [
            r
            for r in catalog
            if r[:3] == [candidate[k] for k in ["make", "model", "mode"]]
            and r[7] == candidate["raw_link_html"]
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1 or candidate["license_url"] != CC0:
            raise ValueError("Candidate does not identify one explicit CC0 catalog entry")
        row = matches[0]
        if CC0 not in Links(row[5]).hrefs:
            raise ValueError("Catalog entry is not explicitly CC0")
        if candidate["metadata_url"] not in Links(row[8]).hrefs:
            raise ValueError("Scouted metadata URL differs from its catalog entry")
        link = Links(row[7])
        if len(link.hrefs) != 1 or len(link.checksums) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Expected one RAW link and published SHA256")
        url = urllib.parse.urlparse(link.hrefs[0])
        identity = re.fullmatch(r"/getfile.php/(\d+)/nice/[^/]+", url.path)
        if url.scheme != "https" or url.netloc != "raw.pixls.us" or not identity:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected RAW host/path")
        identifier = identity[1]
        if identifier in identities:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate candidate file ID")
        identities.add(identifier)
        suffix = Path(url.path).suffix.lower()
        if suffix not in {
            ".nef",
            ".raf",
            ".dng",
            ".arw",
            ".rw2",
            ".cr2",
            ".cr3",
            ".pef",
            ".orf",
            ".srw",
            ".nrw",
        }:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected RAW file extension")
        metadata = Path(candidate["metadata_file"])
        if checksum(metadata) != candidate["metadata_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Scouted metadata checksum changed")
        text = metadata.read_text()
        iso = re.search(r"^Exif\.Photo\.ISOSpeedRatings\s+(\d+)\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
        if not iso or not 0 < int(iso[1]) <= 200:
            raise ValueError("Candidate metadata does not establish low ISO")
        model = re.sub(r"\s+", "", candidate["model"]).upper()
        if re.search(r"DSCF(?:3842|3879|3880|3883)", text, re.IGNORECASE) or (
            model == "GFX100S" and "2023:12:31" in text
        ):
            raise ValueError("Standing GFX capture family cannot be acquired for training")
        records.append(
            {
                "file_id": int(identifier),
                "filename": identifier + suffix,
                "url": urllib.parse.quote(link.hrefs[0], safe=":/?=&%"),
                "publisher_checksum": {"type": "SHA-256", "value": link.checksums[0]},
                "license": "CC0-1.0",
                "license_url": CC0,
                "make": row[0],
                "model": row[1],
                "catalog_mode": row[2],
                "catalog_row": row,
                "metadata_path": str(metadata.resolve()),
                "metadata_url": candidate["metadata_url"],
                "metadata_sha256": candidate["metadata_sha256"],
                "scouted_iso": int(iso[1]),
            }
        )
    if not records:
        raise ValueError("No candidates selected")
    return records


def fetch_public_raw(survey, catalog, output, *, workers=2):
    if workers not in (1, 2):
        raise ValueError("Use one or two acquisition workers")
    selected = select_candidates(survey, catalog)  # Fail before any network I/O.
    output = writable_path(output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (output / ".fetch.lock").open("a") as lock:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            raise RuntimeError("Another public RAW acquisition owns this output") from None
        code = [Path(__file__), Path(paired.__file__), Path(safety.__file__)]
        recipe = {
            "survey_sha256": checksum(survey),
            "catalog_sha256": checksum(catalog),
            "implementation": {p.name: checksum(p) for p in code},
        }
        recipe_path = output / "recipe.json"
        if recipe_path.exists() and json.loads(recipe_path.read_text()) != recipe:
            raise ValueError("Acquisition recipe changed; choose a new output")
        recipe_path.write_text(json.dumps(recipe, indent=2) + "\n")
        archive = output / "source"
        archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for path in code + [Path(survey), Path(catalog)]:
            (archive / path.name).write_bytes(path.read_bytes())
        metadata_archive = output / "metadata"
        metadata_archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for record in selected:
            original = Path(record["metadata_path"])
            copy = metadata_archive / f"exif-{record['file_id']}.txt"
            if copy.exists() and checksum(copy) != record["metadata_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Archived metadata checksum changed")
            if not copy.exists():
                copy.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
            record["metadata_origin_path"] = str(original)
            record["metadata_path"] = str(copy)
        previous = {}
        if (output / "manifest.json").exists():
            previous = {
                r["file_id"]: r for r in json.loads((output / "manifest.json").read_text())["files"]
            }

        def fetch(record):
            if record["file_id"] in previous:
                size = previous[record["file_id"]]["bytes"]
            else:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(
                    urllib.request.Request(record["url"], method="HEAD"), timeout=60
                ) as response:
                    size = int(response.headers["Content-Length"])
            if not 0 < size <= 512 * 1024**2:
                raise ValueError("Unexpected RAW byte count")
            if shutil.disk_usage(output).free < 512 * 1024**3 + 2 * size:
                raise RuntimeError("Public RAW acquisition reached its 512GiB reserve")
            result = download_file(output / "files", {**record, "bytes": size})
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {"event": "public-raw-verified", "id": result["file_id"], "bytes": size}
                ),
                flush=True,
            )
            return result

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
            acquired = list(pool.map(fetch, selected))
        result = {
            "format_version": 1,
            "usage": "Quarantine only; NOT a training manifest. Actual decoding, metadata checks and protected-scene/near-duplicate audit required before admission.",
            "recipe": recipe,
            "files": acquired,
            "bytes": sum(r["bytes"] for r in acquired),
        }
        temporary = output / "manifest.json.tmp"
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
        temporary.replace(output / "manifest.json")
        return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--survey", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--catalog", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=2)
    result = fetch_public_raw(**vars(parser.parse_args()))
    print(json.dumps({"files": len(result["files"]), "bytes": result["bytes"]}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    optimizer, ema = fresh_state(module, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"])
    inherited = plan["initializer"]["module_hash"]
    assert inherited_hash(module) == inherited
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    rows = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
    units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
    updates = skipped = images = 0
    trace = []
    checkpoints = []
    restoration = None
    maxima = {n: 0.0 for n in readout_parameters(module)}
    with (ROOT / "wave-train-trace-v1.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
        for step, item in enumerate(rows, 1):
            common.resources(plan, "wave-train", owner)
            assert (
                ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
                and ref(item["parent"]["path"]) == item["parent"]
            )
            arrays = dict(np.load(item["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False))
            parent = np.load(item["parent"]["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            assert {k: fingerprint(v) for k, v in arrays.items()} == item["inputs"] and fingerprint(
                parent
            ) == item["parent_values"]
            assert units[step - 1]["step"] == step and units[step - 1]["batch"] == item["arrays"]
            phase = max(0, step - plan["warmup"]) / (plan["steps"] - plan["warmup"])
            lr = (
                plan["lr"]
                * min(1, step / plan["warmup"])
                * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * phase)) / 2)
            )
            row = {
                "step": step,
                "batch": item["arrays"],
                "parent": item["parent"],
                "domain": item["metadata"]["domain"],
                "noisy": bool(np.any(arrays["variance"] > 0)),
                "lr": lr,
            }
            if row["noisy"]:
                batch = {k: torch.from_numpy(v).cuda() for k, v in arrays.items()}
                base = torch.from_numpy(parent).cuda()
                pair_units = torch.tensor(
                    units[step - 1]["candidate_units_FP32"], device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
                ).reshape(-1, 1, 1, 1)
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                    group["lr"] = lr
                output, aux = module(
                    base,
                    *(batch[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]),
                    return_aux=True,
                )
                loss, terms, mask = objective(
                    output,
                    aux["frozen_output"],
                    batch,
                    pair_units,
                    plan["domain_weights"][row["domain"]],
                )
                assert torch.isfinite(loss)
                loss.backward()
                zero = []
                for name, p in readout_parameters(module).items():
                    assert p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all(), name
                    maxima[name] = max(maxima[name], float(p.grad.abs().max()))
                    if p.grad.count_nonzero() == 0:
                        zero.append(name)
                assert all(
                    p.grad is None
                    for n, p in module.named_parameters()
                    if not n.startswith("wave_readout.")
                )
                norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    readout_parameters(module).values(),
                    plan["gradient_clip"],
                    error_if_nonfinite=True,
                )
                optimizer.step()
                updates += 1
                images += len(base)
                decay = update_ema(module, ema, updates=updates)
                row.update(
                    loss=float(loss.detach()),
                    terms={k: float(v.detach()) for k, v in terms.items()},
                    gradient_norm=float(norm),
                    zero_gradient_tensors=zero,
                    flat_mask=fingerprint(mask.cpu().numpy()),
                    flat_eligible_pixels=int(mask.sum()),
                    wave_RMS_DN16=float(aux["wave_correction"].detach().square().mean().sqrt())
                    * 65535,
                    EMA_decay=decay,
                )
                del batch, base, pair_units, output, aux, loss, terms, mask
            else:
                skipped += 1
                row["skipped"] = "zero variance;no matching,readout or optimizer call"
            row.update(updates=updates, counts=dict(counts))
            trace.append(row)
            journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            journal.flush()
            if step == 1 or step % 10 == 0:
                common.progress(
                    "wave-train",
                    {
                        "status": "training",
                        "owner": owner,
                        "step": step,
                        "updates": updates,
                        "counts": dict(counts),
                        "peak_CUDA_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                    },
                )
            if step in [8, 250, 500, 750, 1000]:
                assert inherited_hash(module) == inherited and clocks(module, optimizer) == {
                    "tensors": 4,
                    "states": 4,
                    "steps": [float(updates)],
                }
                path = ARTIFACTS / "checkpoints" / f"wave-step{step:04d}.pt"
                payload = {
                    "models": module.state_dict(),
                    "ema": ema,
                    "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(),
                    "step": step,
                    "updates": updates,
                    "inherited_hash": inherited,
                    "CPU_RNG": torch.get_rng_state(),
                    "CUDA_RNG": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(),
                    "counts": dict(counts),
                    "component": type(module).__name__,
                    "module_config": plan["module_config"],
                    "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
                }
                with path.open("xb") as stream:
                    torch.save(pack_checkpoint(payload, plan["initializer"]["export"]), stream)
                checkpoints.append(ref(path))
                del payload
                if step == 8:
                    before = model_hash(module)
                    saved = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
                    del module, optimizer
                    gc.collect()
                    module = common.instrument(
                        factory(plan["module_config"]).cuda(), counts
                    ).train()
                    optimizer, ema = restore_factored(
                        module, saved, lr=plan["lr"], weight_decay=plan["weight_decay"]
                    )
                    assert model_hash(module) == before and inherited_hash(module) == inherited
                    restoration = {
                        "checkpoint": ref(path),
                        "model_Adam_EMA_CPU_CUDA_RNG_exact": True,
                        "continued_at_row": 9,
                        "repeated_prefix_forwards": 0,
                    }
                    save(ROOT / "wave-restoration-v1.json", restoration)
                    del saved
            del arrays, parent
    assert len(trace) == 1000 and updates == 900 and skipped == 100 and images == 3600
    assert counts == {
        "wrapper": 900,

            "external": shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free,
