                        **(
                            {
                                "spatial_correction_RMS_DN16": float(
                                    aux["spatial_correction"].square().mean().sqrt()
                                )
                                * 65535
                            }
                            if "spatial_correction" in aux
                            else {}
                        ),
                        "archive_replayed_bit_exact": bool(old_collection),
                    }
                )
                observation_stream.write(json.dumps(rows[-1], allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                observation_stream.flush()
                total += 1
                if index % 64 == 0:
                    print(
                        json.dumps(
                            {"endpoint": label, "done": index + 1, "current_head_calls": total}
                        ),
                        flush=True,
                    )
                del batch, arrays, base, output, aux, value
            observation_stream.close()
            forward_stream.close()
            assert count[0] == 822 and before == model_hash(module)
            assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
                cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
            )
            path = point / "collection-v1.json"
            save(
                path,
                {
                    "status": "completed-fixed-endpoint",
                    "arm": arm,
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "export": ref(exported),
                    "module_before": before,
                    "module_after": model_hash(module),
                    "observations": rows,
                    "component_forwards": count[0],
                    "RNG_unchanged": True,
                    "observation_journal": ref(point / "observations-v1.jsonl"),
                    "forward_journal": ref(point / "forward-events-v1.jsonl"),
                    "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
                    "new_noise_draws": 0,
                    "adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay": bool(old_collection),
                    "original_control_collection": plan["control_collections"].get(label),
                },
            )
            collections[label] = ref(path)
            del module
    assert total == 3288 and controls_exact == saved_predictions == 1644
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "review-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-four-fixed-endpoints-awaiting-independent-quality-and-native-viewing",
            "plan": ref(root / "postprocess-plan-v1.json"),
            "collections": collections,
            "component_forwards": total,
            "control_replayed_exact": controls_exact,
            "new_prediction_arrays": saved_predictions,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--validate-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    (validate if args.validate_only else collect)(args.root.absolute())

"""Publish the completed matched trial only after audits and actual native viewing.

No model inference is performed. Checkpoint construction/loading is CPU-only
and starts after terminal-owner, audit, source and viewing checks.
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live, read, ref
from train_phase_evidence_trial import ARMS, METHODS, REPO, ROOT, factory, guard, save

STEM = "v178-phase-evidence-v1"
INDEX = REPO / "docs/results/v178-phase-evidence-final-v1.json"
REPORT = REPO / "docs/phase-evidence-comparison.md"
IMAGES = REPO / "docs/images" / STEM
EVIDENCE = REPO / "docs/results" / STEM
VERIFICATION = REPO / "docs/results/v178-phase-evidence-publication-verification-v1.json"


def terminal_result(root, phase, filename, expected_status):
    launch = read(root / f"{phase}-launch-v1.json")
    if owner_live(launch["owner"]):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Actual {phase} owner is still live")
    if (root / f"{phase}-failure-v1.json").exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"Preserved {phase} failure requires inspection")
    result = read(root / filename)
    if result["owner"] != launch["owner"] or result["status"] != expected_status:
        raise ValueError(f"Wrong terminal {phase} owner/status")
    return result


def completed_context(root, *, viewed=False):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    seal = read(root / "publication-source-v1.json")
    if ref(__file__) != seal["publisher"]:
        raise ValueError("Use the sealed publication entry")
    for binding in seal["helpers"]:
        if ref(binding["path"]) != {k: binding[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}:
            raise ValueError("Publication helper bytes changed")
    training = {
        arm: terminal_result(
            root,
            f"{arm}-train",
            f"{arm}-train-result-v1.json",
            "completed-matched-warmstart-one-pass",
        )
        for arm in ARMS
    }
    scores = terminal_result(
        root,
        "review",
        "scores-v1.json",
        "completed-four-endpoint-fixed-quality-awaiting-native-viewing",
    )
    controller = terminal_result(
        root,
        "controller",
        "controller-result-v1.json",
        "completed-matched-trial-quality-render-awaiting-actual-viewing",
    )
    binding = ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
    for result in [*training.values(), scores]:
        if result["plan"] != binding:
            raise ValueError("Actual results must bind the same plan")
    for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
        audit = read(root / name)
        if not audit["status"].startswith("pass-") or audit["plan"] != binding:
            raise ValueError("Both actual audits must pass")
    if read(root / "quality-audit-v1.json")["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json"):
        raise ValueError("Quality audit binds different scores")
    figures = read(root / "figures-v1.json")
    if (
        figures.get("fixture", False)
        or figures["plan"] != binding
        or figures["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json")
        or controller["figures"] != ref(root / "figures-v1.json")
        or figures["native_figures"] != 72
        or figures["native_triplets"] != 24
        or len(figures["images"]) != 72
        or sum(item["triplet"] for item in figures["images"]) != 24
        or not all(item["no_resize"] for item in figures["images"])
        or len(figures["sheets"]) != 18
        or sorted(i for s in figures["sheets"] for i in s["indices"]) != list(range(72))
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected actual 72-figure render bound to terminal results")
    paired = read(root / "paired-comparisons-v1.json")
    if paired["plan"] != binding or paired["scores"] != ref(root / "scores-v1.json"):
        raise ValueError("Matched comparisons bind different actual results")
    if (
        len(paired["table_cells"]) != 714
        or not paired["status"].startswith("completed-")
        or paired["methods"] != 13
        or paired["metric_rows"] != 10686
        or paired["matched_endpoint_contrasts"] != 2
        or paired["contrasts"] != 34
        or paired["real_references_scored"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected all matched/context tables")
    if viewed:
        viewing = read(root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json")
        if viewing["figures"] != ref(root / "figures-v1.json") or viewing["indices"] != list(
            range(72)
        ):
            raise ValueError("All actual native figures must have recorded viewing")
        if ref(viewing["journal"]["path"]) != viewing["journal"]:
            raise ValueError("Viewing journal changed")
    return plan, training, scores, figures, paired


def record_viewing(root, selected, notes):
    _, _, _, figures, _ = completed_context(root)
    if (
        not selected
        or not notes.strip()
        or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
        or not set(selected) <= set(range(18))
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected distinct actual sheet indices0..17 and viewing notes")
    journal = root / "native-viewing-v1.jsonl"
    events = (
        [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
    )
    seen = {i for event in events for i in event["sheets"]}
    if seen & set(selected):
        raise ValueError("A sheet viewing is already recorded")
    for index in selected:
        binding = figures["sheets"][index]["image"]
        if ref(binding["path"]) != binding:
            raise ValueError("Viewed sheet bytes differ from render")
    event = {
        "recorded_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "sheets": selected,
        "detail": "original",
        "notes": notes,
    }
    with journal.open("a") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
    events.append(event)
    seen.update(selected)
    if seen == set(range(18)):
        save(
            root / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "actually-viewed72-native-figures-in18-original-detail-sheets",
                "figures": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),
                "journal": ref(journal),
                "events": events,
                "indices": list(range(72)),
                "native_figures": 72,
                "native_triplets": 24,
                "no_resize": True,
            },
        )
    print(f"Recorded sheets{selected};viewed{len(seen)}/18")


def export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores):
    import torch
    from phase_evidence_training_state import load_matching_ema
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    directory = Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    base = torch.load(
        plan["frozen_component"]["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
    )
    exports = {}
    for arm in ARMS:
        checkpoint = training[arm]["final_checkpoint"]
        assert ref(checkpoint["path"]) == checkpoint
        state = torch.load(checkpoint["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        for endpoint in ["raw", "EMA"]:
            module = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            module.load_state_dict(state["models"], strict=True)
            if endpoint == "EMA":
                load_matching_ema(module, state["ema"])
            method = METHODS[arm][endpoint]
            expected = scores["module_hashes"][method]["before"]
            assert model_hash(module) == expected
            assert model_hash(module.frozen) == plan["frozen_component"]["module_hash"]
            config = dict(plan["module_config"])
            if arm == "control":
                config.pop("evidence_peaks")
            source = (
                REPO
                / "src/demosaic"
                / (
                    "late_local_noise_matching.py"
                    if arm == "control"
                    else "late_phase_evidence_matching.py"
                )
            )
            path = directory / f"phase-evidence-{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000.pt"
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                torch.save(
                    {
                        "component": type(module).__name__,
                        "module_config": config,
                        "state_dict": module.state_dict(),
                        "parent": base["parent"],
                        "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
                        "sampling_library": plan["sampling_library"],
                        "source": ref(source),
                        "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
                        "arm": arm,
                        "endpoint": endpoint,
                        "initial_checkpoint": plan["initial_checkpoint"],
                        "old_network_updates": 1800,
                        "new_optimizer_updates": 900,
                        "adapter_updates": 900 if arm == "evidence" else 0,
                        "training_plan": ref(Path(plan["root"]) / "plan-v1.json"),
                    },
                    stream,
                )
            restored = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
            fresh = factory(arm, plan["module_config"]).eval()
            fresh.load_state_dict(restored["state_dict"], strict=True)
            assert model_hash(fresh) == expected
            exports[method] = {
                "export": ref(path),
                "source_checkpoint": checkpoint,
                "state": endpoint,
                "arm": arm,
                "module_hash": expected,
                "component": restored["component"],
                "module_config": config,
                "source": restored["source"],
                "full_state_tensors": len(fresh.state_dict()),
            }
            del module, fresh, restored
        del state
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    return exports

def publish(root, notes):
    plan, training, scores, figures, paired = completed_context(root, viewed=True)
    if not notes.is_file() or len(notes.read_text()) < 300:
        raise ValueError("Actual human quality notes are required")
    for path in [INDEX, REPORT, IMAGES, EVIDENCE, Path(plan["artifacts"]) / "exports"]:
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(path)
    names = evidence_names()
    if not all((root / name).is_file() for name in names):
        raise FileNotFoundError("Required actual evidence is missing")
    for item in figures["images"]:
        if ref(item["image"]["path"]) != item["image"]:
            raise ValueError("Native image bytes changed")
    needed = sum((root / name).stat().st_size for name in names)
    needed += sum(Path(item["image"]["path"]).stat().st_size for item in figures["images"])
    # Includes strict exports, index/report/source metadata and a publication margin.
    needed += 128 * 2**20
    if shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free < (48 + 0.5) * 2**30 + needed:
        raise RuntimeError("Insufficient reserved local publication space")
    exports = export_checkpoints(plan, training, scores)
    IMAGES.mkdir()
    EVIDENCE.mkdir()
    images = []
    for item in figures["images"]:
        source = Path(item["image"]["path"])
        destination = IMAGES / source.name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        assert destination.read_bytes() == source.read_bytes()
        images.append(dict(item, original_image=item["image"], image=ref(destination)))
    manifest = IMAGES / "manifest-v1.json"
    save(
        manifest,
        {
            "images": images,
            "method_checkpoints": exports,
            "source": ref(root / "figures-v1.json"),

            "no_resize": True,
            "fixture": False,
            "frozen_component": plan["frozen_component"],
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },

    copies = {}
    for name in names:
        source = root / name
        destination = EVIDENCE / name
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        assert source.read_bytes() == destination.read_bytes()
        copies[name] = {"original": ref(source), "public": ref(destination)}
    note_copy = EVIDENCE / "human-quality-notes-v1.md"
    shutil.copyfile(notes, note_copy)
    text = "# Matched phase-evidence trial: completed quality\n\n" + notes.read_text().strip()
    text += "\n\n[Exact evidence](results/v178-phase-evidence-final-v1.json) · "
    text += "[Native-pixel viewer](images/v178-phase-evidence-v1/native-viewer.html).\n\n"
    text += (root / "comparison-tables-v1.md").read_text().rstrip() + "\n\n"
    text += "RMS is camera-RGB DN16; template gain1 means exact constructed amplitude. "

    text += "fresh-noise budget. Reused inputs do not establish blind generalization, seed "
    text += (
        "uncertainty or noisy-sky safety. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references are qualitative, not GT.\n\n"
    )

    text += "The manifest records source/ROI, checkpoint/state, physical noise, exposure, "
    text += "contrast, anchor and qualified references for every view. Both protected GFX "
    text += "families/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded from training.\n\n"
    for triplet, title in [
        (False, "Comparison boards"),
        (True, "Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT"),
    ]:
        text += f"### {title}\n\n"

            if item["triplet"] != triplet:
                continue
            text += f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, "
            text += f"exposure{item['exposure']:g}, contrast{item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
            text += f"![Native comparison](images/{STEM}/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
    text += "[Publication verification](results/v178-phase-evidence-publication-verification-v1.json).\n"
    with REPORT.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(text)
    save(
        INDEX,
        {
            "status": "completed-matched-trial-audited-actually-viewed-and-four-strict-exports",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "copies": copies,
            "notes": ref(note_copy),
            "report": ref(REPORT),
            "figures": ref(manifest),
            "checkpoints": exports,

def equal_tree(first, second):
    import torch

    if isinstance(first, torch.Tensor):
        return isinstance(second, torch.Tensor) and torch.equal(first.cpu(), second.cpu())
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(
            equal_tree(v, second[k]) for k, v in first.items()
        )
    if isinstance(first, (list, tuple)):
        return (
            type(first) is type(second)
            and len(first) == len(second)
            and all(equal_tree(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second, strict=True))
        )
    return first == second

"""Measure spatial scales of residual noise on exact synthetic flat targets.

Block-average error power is an orthogonal piecewise-constant projection, not a
photographic quality score. A spatially independent zero-mean residual has an
expected retained power of 1/k^2 after averaging k-by-k blocks.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F

from demosaic.cfa import malvar
from demosaic.inference import load_checkpoint
from demosaic.precision import amp_context
from demosaic.reference import load_rawnind
from demosaic.reporting import center_crop, display_crop, save_triplet
from demosaic.safety import writable_path
from demosaic.suite import freeze_checkpoint, observation


@torch.inference_mode()
def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("checkpoint", type=Path, nargs="+")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--camera", type=Path, required=True, help="Cached read-only metadata receipt"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--rawnind", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    output = writable_path(args.output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if (output / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Choose a new diagnostic directory")
    source = output / "source"
    source.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for p in [Path(__file__), *sorted(Path("src/demosaic").glob("*.py"))]:
        (source / p.name).write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
    camera = json.loads(args.camera.read_text())
    meta = camera.get("raw", camera)
    levels = [0.002, 0.01, 0.05]
    rgb = torch.tensor(levels, device="cuda")[:, None, None, None].expand(-1, 3, 512, 512)
    condition = {"name": "iso6400-prior", "exposure": 1.0, "shot": 0.00128, "read": 6.5536e-6}
    batch = observation(
        rgb,
        [f"flat-{x}" for x in levels],
        condition,
        meta["pattern"],
        meta["white_balance"],
        meta["camera_to_srgb"],
        20261015,
    )
    for name in ("packed", "variance"):
        batch[name] = batch[name].contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    noisy = malvar(batch["packed"], batch["colors"], batch["wb"])
    predictions, models = [("Noisy:Malvar", noisy)], []
    for i, checkpoint in enumerate(args.checkpoint):
        frozen, digest = freeze_checkpoint(checkpoint, output / "weights")
        model, state = load_checkpoint(frozen, "cuda")
        model.eval().to(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
        label = f"{i}:{Path(state['config']['run']).name}:step-{state['step']}"
        with amp_context("cuda", dtype="float16"):
            prediction = model(
                *(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"))
            )
        predictions.append((label, prediction))
        models.append(
            {
                "label": label,
                "step": state["step"],
                "sha256": digest,
                "snapshot": str(frozen),
                "model_config": model.config.to_dict(),
            }
        )
        del state, model
    reference = load_rawnind(args.rawnind, gain_mode="cfa-ls", device="cuda")
    with amp_context("cuda", dtype="float32"):
        predictions.append(
            (
                "RawNIND:CFA-LS",
                reference(*(batch[k] for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb", "matrix"))),
            )
        )
    rows, crops = [], []
    for label, prediction in predictions:
        error = (prediction - batch["target"])[..., 64:-64, 64:-64].float()
        bias = error.mean((-2, -1), keepdim=True)
        centered = error - bias
        total = centered.square().mean((1, 2, 3))
        for i, level in enumerate(levels):
            row = {
                "model": label,
                "scene_level": level,
                "camera_mse": error.square().mean((1, 2, 3))[i].item(),
                "camera_abs_bias": bias.abs().mean((1, 2, 3))[i].item(),
                "camera_centered_sigma": total[i].sqrt().item(),
                "scales": [],
            }
            for side in [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128]:
                power = F.avg_pool2d(centered, side, side).square().mean((1, 2, 3))[i]
                row["scales"].append(
                    {
                        "block": side,
                        "centered_error_power": power.item(),
                        "retained_power_fraction": (power / total[i].clamp_min(1e-20)).item(),
                    }
                )
            rows.append(row)
        if label != "Noisy:Malvar":
            xywh = center_crop(prediction.shape)
            for i in [0, 1]:
                panels = [
                    (
                        name,
                        display_crop(
                            value[i : i + 1],
                            batch["wb"][i : i + 1],
                            batch["matrix"][i : i + 1],
                            xywh,
                            exposure=4,
                        ),
                    )
                    for name, value in [
                        ("Noisy (Malvar)", noisy),
                        ("Denoised", prediction),
                        ("GT (flat)", batch["target"]),
                    ]
                ]
                crops.append(
                    save_triplet(
                        output,
                        f"{label}:{i}",
                        panels,
                        caption=f"{label} / scene level {levels[i]} / +2 EV display",
                        metadata={
                            "xywh": xywh,
                            "scene_level": levels[i],
                            "model_label": label,
                            "display_exposure": 4.0,
                        },
                    )
                )
    result = {
        "protocol": __doc__,
        "condition": condition,
        "size": 512,
        "border": 64,
        "camera_metadata": meta,
        "camera_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.camera.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "models": models,
        "rows": rows,
        "native_crops": crops,
        "rawnind_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            (args.rawnind / "utnet2-bayer.pt").read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
    }
    (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    for row in rows:
        if row["scene_level"] == 0.01:
            print(
                row["model"],
                row["camera_centered_sigma"],
                [
                    (s["block"], s["retained_power_fraction"])
                    for s in row["scales"]
                    if s["block"] in (8, 32, 64)
                ],
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Training-only spatial-error supervision inside clean flat neighborhoods."""

import math

import torch
from nonlocal_residual_objective import objective as previous_objective
from torch.nn import functional as F


def flat_spatial_error_loss(output, target, mask, *, window=17, unit_DN16=4):
    """Pseudo-Huber of local error variance, with fixed DN16 training units.

    The mask is the existing clean-target neighborhood-range mask. Each selected
    center supervises the spatial error in that same truncated window. Channel
    means are removed independently, so uniform RGB error remains the job of
    the absolute/DC losses. Actual target gradients are retained, never zeroed.
    The whole-image mean keeps mask coverage as a weight. FP64 centered moments
    avoid cancellation from a large spatially constant color error; separable
    pooling avoids materializing windows. This is not an inference flat gate.
    """
    if (
        output.ndim != 4
        or output.shape[1] != 3
        or min(output.shape) < 1
        or target.shape != output.shape
        or not output.is_floating_point()
        or not target.is_floating_point()
        or target.device != output.device
        or not torch.isfinite(output).all()
        or not torch.isfinite(target).all()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected matching finite floating-point N x 3 x H x W RGB")
    if (
        mask.dtype != torch.bool
        or mask.shape != (len(output), 1, *output.shape[-2:])
        or mask.device != output.device
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected a matching boolean clean-neighborhood mask")
    if type(window) is not int or window < 1 or window % 2 != 1:
        raise ValueError("Window must be a positive odd integer")
    if isinstance(unit_DN16, bool) or not math.isfinite(unit_DN16) or unit_DN16 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Spatial error units must be positive and finite")
    with torch.autocast(output.device.type, enabled=False):
        error = (output.double() - target.detach().double()) / (unit_DN16 / 65535)
        centered = error - error[..., :1, :1].detach()
        radius = window // 2

        def mean(value):
            value = F.avg_pool2d(
                value, (1, window), stride=1, padding=(0, radius), count_include_pad=False
            )
            return F.avg_pool2d(
                value, (window, 1), stride=1, padding=(radius, 0), count_include_pad=False
            )

        power = (mean(centered.square()) - mean(centered).square()).clamp_min(0)
        loss = (power / ((power + 1).sqrt() + 1) * mask).mean()
        return loss.to(torch.float64 if output.dtype == torch.float64 else torch.float32)


def objective(output, frozen, batch, pair_units, domain_weight):
    """Retain all seven V180 terms and add one flat spatial-error term at 0.25."""
    loss, terms, mask = previous_objective(output, frozen, batch, pair_units, domain_weight)
    spatial = flat_spatial_error_loss(output, batch["target"], mask, window=17, unit_DN16=4)
    return loss + (0.25 * domain_weight) * spatial, dict(terms, flat_spatial=spatial), mask

def metric_points(points, field):
    """Omit unfinished panels rather than inventing or carrying forward a score."""
    completed = [p for p in points if field in p]
    for point in completed:
        value = point[field]
        if (
            isinstance(value, bool)
            or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
            or not math.isfinite(value)
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"Completed {field} must be finite: V{point['version']}")
    return [p["version"] for p in completed], [p[field] for p in completed]


def metric_text(point, field):
    return f"{point[field]:.5f}" if field in point else "pending"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def checked_reference(item):
    path = Path(item["path"])
    assert digest(path) == item["sha256"], path
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def primary(data):
    if "comparisons" in data:
        return data
    if "primary_comparisons" in data:
        return {"comparisons": data["primary_comparisons"]}
    value = data["primary_statistics"]
    if "data" in value:
        return value["data"]
    if "comparisons" in value:
        return value
    return checked_reference(value)


def collect():
    output, evidence = [], []
    for filename, versions, report in STUDIES:
        path = REPO / "docs/results" / filename
        source = json.loads(path.read_text())
        evidence.append(
            {
                "path": str(path.relative_to(REPO)),
                "sha256": digest(path),
                "versions": versions,
                "report": report,
            }
        )
        selected = {}
        if "runs" in source:
            for panel in ("full427", "known", "unseen"):
                if panel not in source["runs"]:
                    continue
                summary = source["runs"][panel]
                if "path" in summary and "sha256" in summary:
                    summary = checked_reference(summary)
                models = {m["label"]: m for m in summary["models"]}
                for row in summary["overall"]:
                    name = row["model"]
                    match = re.search(r"(?:-|\b)v(\d+)(?=:|-|\b)", name, re.IGNORECASE)
                    if not match or int(match[1]) not in versions:
                        continue
                    version = int(match[1])
                    model = models[name]
                    point = selected.setdefault(
                        version,
                        {
                            "version": version,
                            "checkpoint_sha256": model["sha256"],
                            "endpoint": f"step-{model['step']}",
                            "step": model["step"],
                            "report": report,
                            "source": filename,
                        },
                    )
                    assert point["checkpoint_sha256"] == model["sha256"]
                    effective = model.get("effective_model_config", model.get("model_config", {}))
                    if effective.get("adc_cfa_projection", False):
                        point["inference_policy"] = "ADC-only CFA projection"
                        point["endpoint"] = f"step-{model['step']} (ADC-projected)"
                    metric = "srgb_psnr" if panel == "full427" else "sensor_psnr"
                    if panel == "full427" and row["kind"] != "photo":
                        continue
                    field = "photo_srgb_PSNR" if panel == "full427" else panel + "_CFA_PSNR"
                    point[field] = row["metrics"][metric]["mean"]
                    point.setdefault("evaluation_metadata", {})[panel] = {
                        k: summary.get(k)
                        for k in (
                            "sources",
                            "protocol",
                            "precision",
                            "observation_and_metrics_precision",
                            "prepared_sha256",
                            "manifest_sha256",
                            "patch_size",
                            "native_crop",
                        )
                        if k in summary
                    }
        else:
            stats = primary(source)
            comparisons = stats["comparisons"]
            for row in comparisons:
                key = row.get("panel"), row.get("kind"), row.get("metric")
                if key not in METRICS:
                    continue
                assert row["sources"] == {"full427": 427, "known": 4, "unseen": 5}[row["panel"]]
                for side in ("first", "second"):
                    match = re.search(r"\bV(\d+)(?=\b|-|_)", row[side], re.IGNORECASE)
                    if not match or int(match[1]) not in versions:
                        continue
                    version, sha = int(match[1]), row[side + "_checkpoint_sha256"]
                    # Completed primary comparisons lead with their reviewed
                    # endpoint. Later own-parent/progress rows cannot replace it.
                    point = selected.setdefault(
                        version,
                        {
                            "version": version,
                            "checkpoint_sha256": sha,
                            "endpoint": row[side],
                            "report": report,
                            "source": filename,
                        },
                    )
                    if point["checkpoint_sha256"] != sha:
                        continue
                    value = row[side + "_source_balanced_mean"]
                    field = METRICS[key]
                    if field in point:
                        assert abs(point[field] - value) < 1e-9
                    point[field] = value
            # Bind raw evaluation provenance without re-evaluating predictions.
            for item in stats.get("sources", []):
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                for side in ("first", "second"):
                    entry = item.get(side, {})
                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                        continue
                    for point in selected.values():
                        if entry.get("checkpoint_sha256") == point["checkpoint_sha256"]:
                            point.setdefault("evaluation_sources", []).append(entry)
        assert set(selected) == set(versions), (filename, set(selected), versions)
        for point in selected.values():
            required = REQUIRED_METRICS_BY_STUDY.get(filename, tuple(METRICS.values()))
            assert all(k in point for k in required), (filename, point)
            for field in METRICS.values():
                metric_points([point], field)
            output.append(point)
    output.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"])
    assert len({r["version"] for r in output}) == len(output)
    return output, evidence

"""Scores for fixed proposal/support crossover diagnostics; actual neural calls separate."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import os
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from diagnose_support_crossover import METHODS, ORIGINALS
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save


def load_module(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value


def main(root):
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    design_path = root / "quality-design-v1.json"
    design = read(design_path)
    review = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")
    assert read(review["plan"]["path"])["design"] == ref(design_path)
    assert set(review["collections"]) == set(METHODS)
    metric_paths = [
        root.parent / "collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py",
        root.parent / "V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py",
    ]
    error_metric, photo_metric = [
        load_module(path, f"metric{i}") for i, path in enumerate(metric_paths)
    ]
    maps = {}
    for label, binding in review["collections"].items():
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        c = read(binding["path"])
        assert c["module_before"] == c["module_after"] and c["RNG_unchanged"]
        assert (
            c["component_forwards"] == (822 if label in ORIGINALS else 0)
            and c["new_parent_DINO_forwards"] == c["new_noise_draws"] == 0
        )
        assert [o["id"] for o in c["observations"]] == [o["id"] for o in design["observations"]]
        maps[label] = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in c["observations"]}
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[-1:1:512j, -1:1:512j]
    q = np.linalg.qr(np.stack([np.ones_like(xx), xx, yy], -1).reshape(-1, 3), mode="reduced")[0]

    def detrend(value):
        v = value.reshape(3, -1).T
        return v - q @ (q.T @ v)

    rows = []
    for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        bindings = {
            "parent": case["parent"],
            **{label: values[case["id"]] for label, values in maps.items()},
        }
        if "periodic_detail" in case:
            bindings["periodic-detail"] = case["periodic_detail"]
        parent = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            empty = a["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
            signal = detrend(a["target_present"][0].astype(np.float64) - empty)
            blank = (
                np.all(a["target_present"] == a["target_empty"], axis=1)[0]
                if case["present"]
                else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
            )
        for label, binding in bindings.items():
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            value = np.load(binding["path"])
            assert (
                value.dtype == np.float32
                and value.shape == parent.shape
                and np.isfinite(value).all()
            )
            v = value.astype(np.float64)
            change = v - parent.astype(np.float64)
            row = {
                "id": case["id"],
                "index": index,
                "kind": case["kind"],
                "cohort": case.get("cohort"),
                "method": label,
                "prediction": binding,
                "fresh": case.get("fresh", False),
                "new_forward": label in ORIGINALS,
                "derived_diagnostic": label in METHODS and label not in ORIGINALS,
                "changed": not np.array_equal(value, parent),
                "correction_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change**2)) * 65535),
            }
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                row.update(
                    present=case["present"],
                    seed=case["seed"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    template_gain=float(np.sum(detrend(v[0] - empty) * signal) / np.sum(signal**2)),
                    blank_pixels=int(blank.sum()),
                    blank_added_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change[0][:, blank] ** 2)) * 65535)
                    if blank.any()
                    else None,
                )
                if blank.any():
                    error = (v[0] - a["target"][0].astype(np.float64))[:, blank]
                    means = error.mean(1, keepdims=True)
                    row.update(
                        blank_error_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
                        blank_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(
                            np.sqrt(np.mean((error - means) ** 2)) * 65535
                        ),
                        blank_DC_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(means**2)) * 65535),
                    )
            elif case["kind"] == "photo":
                row.update(
                    variant=case["variant"]["name"],
                    **photo_metric.photo_metrics(value, a["target"], a, case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "flat":
                error = v - a["target"].astype(np.float64)
                dc = error.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                h, w = error.shape[-2:]
                blocks = error.reshape(1, 3, h // 32, 32, w // 32, 32).mean((3, 5))
                x, y, cw, ch = case["ROI_xywh"]
                crop = error[..., y : y + ch, x : x + cw]
                crop_dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
                cb = crop.reshape(1, 3, 5, 32, 5, 32).mean((3, 5))
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                    full_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((blocks - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    crop_block32_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((cb - crop_dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
                    maximum_abs_DC_DN16=float(np.max(np.abs(dc)) * 65535),
                )
            elif case["kind"] == "mixed-quiet":
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    **error_metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]),
                )
                x, y, w, h = case["ROI_xywh"]
                row.update(
                    quiet_error_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(
                            np.mean(
                                (v - a["target"].astype(np.float64))[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2
                            )
                        )
                        * 65535
                    ),
                    quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16=row["crop_spatial_RMS_DN16"],
                    quiet_added_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(change[..., y : y + h, x : x + w] ** 2)) * 65535
                    ),
                )
            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "real"
                row["reference_scored"] = False
                if value.shape[-1] == 512:
                    plane = detrend(value[0]).T.reshape(3, 512, 512)
                    blocks = plane.reshape(3, 16, 32, 16, 32).mean((2, 4))
                    row["detrended_block32_variation_DN16"] = float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean(blocks**2)) * 65535
                    )
            rows.append(row)
    assert len(rows) == 6330 and sum(r["new_forward"] for r in rows) == 1644
    assert sum(r["derived_diagnostic"] for r in rows) == 3288
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[
            row["kind"],
            row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))),
            row.get("cohort"),
            row["method"],
        ].append(row)
    fields = (
        "full_error_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_relative_band_error",
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain",
        "template_gain",
        "blank_added_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_error_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "blank_DC_RMS_DN16",
        "full_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "block32_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_block32_RMS_DN16",
        "correction_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_error_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "quiet_added_RMS_DN16",
    )
    summary = []
    for (kind, condition, cohort, method), group in groups.items():
        item = {
            "kind": kind,
            "condition": condition,
            "cohort": cohort,
            "method": method,
            "cases": len(group),
        }
        for field in fields:
            values = [r[field] for r in group if r.get(field) is not None]
            if values:
                item[field] = float(np.mean(values))
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_added_RMS_DN16"] = max(r["blank_added_RMS_DN16"] or 0 for r in group)
        if kind == "mesh":
            item["worst_blank_error_RMS_DN16"] = max(
                r.get("blank_error_RMS_DN16", 0) for r in group
            )
        if kind == "flat":
            item["worst_abs_DC_DN16"] = max(r["maximum_abs_DC_DN16"] for r in group)
        summary.append(item)
    save(
        root / "scores-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-array-only-scores",
            "design": ref(design_path),
            "review": ref(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
            "scorer": ref(__file__),
            "metric_sources": [ref(p) for p in metric_paths],
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "new_module_forwards_in_scorer": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "real_reference_scores": 0,
        },
    )
    print("Scored6330 paired rows; real references unscored")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Retain atomic training boundaries and audit states without model inference."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
from close_camera_supervision_review import alive, read, ref, save
from train_directional_interval_trial import guard

PREFIX = "pretrained_rgb.raw_directional."
TERMINAL = (
    "completed-matched-directional-interval-original4000-awaiting-full-quality-and-native-review"
)


def audit(path, arm, plan):
    state = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
    step, cfg = state["step"], state["config"]
    assert step in (1000, 2000, 3000, 4000) and cfg["steps"] == 4000
    assert len(state["model"]) == len(state["ema"]) == 99
    assert len(state["optimizer"]["state"]) == 97
    assert state["model_config"]["raw_directional_residual"] is True
    assert cfg["initialized_from"] == {**plan["parent"], "step": 20000}
    assert cfg["camera_supervision"] == "sensor-valid-v1"
    assert cfg["reference_interval_weight"] == arm["reference_interval_weight"]
    assert cfg["manifest_sha256"] == plan["training_manifest_sha256"]
    for field in ("model", "ema"):
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state[field].values())
    # The frozen recipe trains every restoration parameter except the two
    # context normalization buffers. make_optimizer keeps named-parameter
    # order within common and directional groups; check every saved shape.
    names = [n for n in state["model"] if n not in ("context.mean", "context.std")]
    ordered = [
        [n for n in names if not n.startswith(PREFIX)],
        [n for n in names if n.startswith(PREFIX)],
    ]
    assert list(map(len, ordered)) == [89, 8]
    groups = state["optimizer"]["param_groups"]
    assert [g["lr_multiplier"] for g in groups] == [1, 20]
    assert groups[1]["lr"] == groups[0]["lr"] * 20
    branch = []
    for group, names in zip(groups, ordered, strict=True):
        for index, name in zip(group["params"], names, strict=True):
            item, value = state["optimizer"]["state"][index], state["model"][name]
            assert int(item["step"]) == step
            assert item["exp_avg"].shape == item["exp_avg_sq"].shape == value.shape
            assert (
                torch.isfinite(item["exp_avg"]).all() and torch.isfinite(item["exp_avg_sq"]).all()
            )
            assert (item["exp_avg_sq"] >= 0).all()
            if name.startswith(PREFIX):
                branch.append(
                    {
                        "name": name,
                        "parameters": value.numel(),
                        "parameter_nonzero": int(value.count_nonzero()),
                        "first_moment_nonzero": int(item["exp_avg"].count_nonzero()),
                        "second_moment_nonzero": int(item["exp_avg_sq"].count_nonzero()),
                    }
                )
    assert len(branch) == 8 and sum(r["parameters"] for r in branch) == 25800
    assert all(k in state for k in ("torch_rng", "python_rng", "cuda_rng", "best"))
    return {
        "step": step,
        "arm": arm["name"],
        "checkpoint": ref(path),
        "source_sha256": cfg["source_sha256"],
        "finite_states": {"model": 99, "EMA": 99, "AdamW": 97},
        "directional_parameters": branch,
        "all_eight_directional_moments_nonzero": all(
            r["first_moment_nonzero"] and r["second_moment_nonzero"] for r in branch
        ),
        "scope": "State/optimizer engineering audit only; no forward, validation-score review or quality decision.",
    }


def main(plan_path, output):
    os.nice(10)
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_available() and not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), "Hide CUDA"
    plan = read(plan_path)
    guard(plan)
    output = Path(output).absolute()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    status_path = Path(plan["root"]) / "status.json"
    owner = read(status_path)["controller"]
    assert alive(owner)
    status = {
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "training_owner": owner,
        "training_plan": ref(plan_path),
        "driver": ref(__file__),
        "boundaries": {},
        "status": "watching-exact-directional-training-boundaries",
    }
    started, inodes = time.monotonic(), {}
    try:
        while True:
            training = read(status_path)
            assert training["controller"] == owner
            for arm in plan["arms"]:
                source = Path(arm["run"]) / "last.pt"
                if not source.exists() or inodes.get(arm["name"]) == source.stat().st_ino:
                    continue
                candidate = output / ("." + arm["name"] + "-candidate.pt")
                # save_checkpoint writes a separate .tmp and atomically replaces
                # last.pt. This hard link keeps its old inode without copying or
                # modifying training output, even when the next boundary saves.
                os.link(source, candidate)
                inode = candidate.stat().st_ino
                state = torch.load(candidate, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, mmap=True)
                step = state["step"]
                del state
                target = output / f"{arm['name']}-step{step}.pt"
                assert step in (1000, 2000, 3000, 4000) and not target.exists()
                candidate.rename(target)
                result = audit(target, arm, plan)
                assert target.stat().st_ino == inode
                save(output / f"{arm['name']}-step{step}.json", result)
                status["boundaries"][f"{arm['name']}-{step}"] = ref(
                    output / f"{arm['name']}-step{step}.json"
                )
                inodes[arm["name"]] = inode
                save(output / "status.json", status)
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "arm": arm["name"],
                            "step": step,
                            "all_eight_moments_nonzero": result[
                                "all_eight_directional_moments_nonzero"
                            ],
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
            if training["status"].startswith("failed-"):
                raise RuntimeError("Training failed; retained existing boundaries, no retry")
            if not alive(owner):
                assert training["status"] == TERMINAL and len(status["boundaries"]) == 8
                guard(plan)
                status["status"] = (
                    "completed-eight-directional-training-boundaries-no-quality-claim"
                )
                save(output / "status.json", status)
                break
            assert time.monotonic() - started < 21700
            time.sleep(5)
    except BaseException as error:
        status.update(status="failed-boundary-audit-no-training-intervention", error=repr(error))
        save(output / "status.json", status)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.plan, args.output)

"""Measure trained phase-input removal on the prospectively fixed twelve inputs."""

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_harmonic_phase_trial import classes, resource_check, runtime

from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint


def main(root):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    runtime(plan)
    (root / "phase-removal.claim").open("x").close()
    review = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")
    design = read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")
    recipe = design["phase_removal"]
    cases = {c["id"]: c for c in design["observations"]}
    assert len(recipe["case_ids"]) == 12 and recipe["new_head_calls"] == 48
    dest = Path(plan["external_quality_root"]) / "phase-removal-v1"
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    counts = total = 0
    records = []
    cpu_rng, cuda_rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    forward_journal = (root / "phase-removal-forward-events-v1.jsonl").open("x")
    observation_journal = (root / "phase-removal-observations-v1.jsonl").open("x")
    for label in recipe["endpoints"]:
        binding = review["collections"][label]
        assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        collection = read(binding["path"])
        assert ref(collection["export"]["path"]) == collection["export"]
        export = torch.load(collection["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        module = classes()["harmonic-phase"](**export["module_config"]).cuda().eval()
        module.load_state_dict(export["state_dict"], strict=True)
        before = model_hash(module)
        assert before == collection["module_before"] == collection["module_after"]
        weight = module.phase_in.weight.detach().clone()
        assert weight.count_nonzero() > 0
        archived = {r["id"]: r["prediction"] for r in collection["observations"]}

        def observe(*args):
            nonlocal counts
            counts += 1

        module.register_forward_hook(observe)
        for index, identity in enumerate(recipe["case_ids"]):
            resource_check(root)
            case = cases[identity]
            assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            assert ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
            arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
            base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"])).cuda()
            batch = {
                k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda()
                for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors", "wb"]
            }
            values, spatial = [], []
            for active in [True, False]:
                with torch.no_grad():
                    module.phase_in.weight.copy_(weight if active else torch.zeros_like(weight))
                with torch.inference_mode():
                    output, aux = module(base, **batch, return_aux=True)
                forward_journal.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "endpoint": label,
                            "id": identity,
                            "active": active,
                            "returned_forwards": counts,
                        }
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                forward_journal.flush()
                values.append(output.cpu().numpy())
                spatial.append(aux["spatial_correction"].cpu().numpy())
                del output, aux
            with torch.no_grad():
                module.phase_in.weight.copy_(weight)
            assert before == model_hash(module)
            on, off = values
            assert on.dtype == off.dtype == np.float32 and np.isfinite(off).all()
            assert ref(archived[identity]["path"]) == archived[identity]
            assert fingerprint(on) == fingerprint(np.load(archived[identity]["path"]))
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(spatial[0], spatial[1])
            path = dest / f"{label}-off-{index:02d}.npy"
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                np.save(stream, off, allow_pickle=False)
            effect = (on.astype(np.float64) - off.astype(np.float64)) * 65535
            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(effect**2)))
            assert abs(rms - np.linalg.norm(effect.ravel()) / np.sqrt(effect.size)) < 1e-10
            record = {
                "endpoint": label,
                "id": identity,
                "kind": case["kind"],
                "case": case,
                "export": collection["export"],
                "on_prediction": archived[identity],
                "off_prediction": ref(path),
                "off_values": fingerprint(off),
                "effect_RMS_DN16": rms,
                "effect_maximum_abs_DN16": float(np.abs(effect).max()),
                "on_replayed_bit_exact": True,
                "direct_spatial_path_bit_exact": True,
                "module_before_after_restored": before,
                "head_calls": 2,
            }
            records.append(record)
            observation_journal.write(json.dumps(record, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            observation_journal.flush()
            total += 1
            del base, batch, arrays, values, spatial, on, off, effect
        del module, weight
    forward_journal.close()
    observation_journal.close()
    assert total == 24 and counts == 48
    assert torch.equal(cpu_rng, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        cuda_rng, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    assert (
        sum(Path(r["off_prediction"]["path"]).stat().st_size for r in records)
        == recipe["expected_bytes"]
    )
    guard(plan)
    save(
        root / "phase-removal-result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-fixed-phase-removal-diagnostic",
            "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "records": records,
            "head_calls": counts,
            "new_prediction_arrays": total,
            "forward_journal": ref(root / "phase-removal-forward-events-v1.jsonl"),
            "observation_journal": ref(root / "phase-removal-observations-v1.jsonl"),
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "new_parent_DINO_calls": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "scope": "12 prospectively fixed inputs at both candidate endpoints;24 on/off pairs and48 actual head calls. On values replay full review exactly;only phase adapter zeroed for off,then restored. Direct RGB path output stays exact. Displacement measures trained phase-adapter contribution,not improved accuracy or an isolated account of training dynamics. Real references remain qualitative,not GT.",
        },
    )
    print("Completed48 fixed on/off calls;24 off arrays retained,24 on archive replays exact")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Native GT-oracle boards plus unchanged standing-real V148 baselines."""

import argparse
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar


def main(root):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    trial = Path(plan["trial"])
    previous = read(trial / "figures-v1.json")
    templates = [v for v in previous["images"] if "triplet_source_board" not in v]
    assert len(templates) == 42
    diagnostic = {o["id"]: o for o in read(root / "result-v1.json")["observations"]}
    review = read(trial / "review-result-v1.json")
    baselines = {}
    for label in ("scalar-control-raw-step1000", "phase-matrix-raw-step1000"):
        collection = read(review["collections"][label]["path"])
        baselines[label] = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in collection["observations"]}
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 9)
    names = [
        "Noisy Malvar",
        "V143 parent",
        "Scalar raw1k",
        "Matrix raw1k",
        "GT scalar/frozen",
        "GT scalar/full",
        "GT matrix/frozen",
        "GT matrix/full",
        "GT matrix/alpha",
        "GT L2 relaxed",
        "GT band residual",
        "GT unbanded",
        "Constructed GT",
    ]
    out = root / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    images, channels = [], 0
    for index, item in enumerate(templates):
        case = item["case"]
        if case["kind"] == "real":
            dest = out / f"unchanged-V148-real-{index:02d}.png"
            shutil.copyfile(item["image"]["path"], dest)
            assert ref(dest)["sha256"] == item["image"]["sha256"]
            images.append(
                {
                    **item,
                    "image": ref(dest),
                    "adopted_real_baseline": True,
                    "original_V148_board": item["image"],
                }
            )
            continue
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        bindings = [case["parent"]] + [baselines[k][case["id"]] for k in baselines]
        bindings += [diagnostic[case["id"]]["predictions"][k] for k in plan["modes"]]
        for binding in bindings:
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
        values = [noisy_malvar(a)] + [np.load(b["path"]) for b in bindings] + [a["target"]]
        assert len(values) == len(names) == 13
        anchor = np.array(item["anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        cells = []
        for value in values:
            transformed = anchor + item["contrast"] * (value.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
            cell = pixels(transformed, a, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"])
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                cell, independent_display(transformed, a, item["ROI_xywh"], item["exposure"])
            )
            assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
            cells.append(cell)
        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(cells), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"GT-ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC: uses target inside output | {case['id']} | contrast{item['contrast']} exposure{item['exposure']:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="#880000",
        )
        panels = []
        for j, (name, cell) in enumerate(zip(names, cells, strict=True)):
            xywh = [8 + 168 * j, 44, 160, 160]
            board.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), xywh[:2])
            draw.text((xywh[0], 24), name, font=font, fill="#880000" if 4 <= j <= 11 else "black")
            panels.append({"label": name, "xywh": xywh, "uses_GT_inside_output": 4 <= j <= 11})
            channels += cell.size
        dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}.png"
        board.save(dest)
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for p, cell in zip(panels, cells, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = p["xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[y : y + h, x : x + w], cell)
        record = {
            **item,
            "image": ref(dest),
            "original_V148_board": item["image"],
            "panels": panels,
            "adopted_real_baseline": False,
            "oracle_prediction_bindings": diagnostic[case["id"]]["predictions"],
            "oracle_uses_exact_GT": True,
            "no_resize": True,
        }
        images.append(record)
        triplet = (case["kind"] == "mesh" and case["present"] and item["contrast"] == 1) or (
            case["kind"] == "photo" and "3e638bbb" in case["id"]
        )
        if triplet:
            sources = [0, 8, 12]
            board = Image.new("RGB", (512, 212), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
            draw.text(
                (8, 4), f"GT ORACLE (not inference) | {case['id']}", font=font, fill="#880000"
            )
            tp = []
            for j, k in enumerate(sources):
                xywh = [8 + 168 * j, 44, 160, 160]
                board.paste(Image.fromarray(cells[k]), xywh[:2])
                draw.text((xywh[0], 24), names[k], font=font, fill="#880000" if j == 1 else "black")
                tp.append(
                    {
                        "label": names[k],
                        "xywh": xywh,
                        "source_xywh": panels[k]["xywh"],
                        "uses_GT_inside_output": j == 1,
                    }
                )
                channels += cells[k].size
            dest = out / f"comparison-{index:02d}-GT-oracle-triplet.png"
            board.save(dest)
            actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
            for p, k in zip(tp, sources, strict=True):
                x, y, w, h = p["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[y : y + h, x : x + w], cells[k])
            images.append(
                {
                    **record,
                    "image": ref(dest),
                    "panels": tp,
                    "triplet_source_board": record["image"],
